segments.text: The Quran's mathematical code is a tangible and utterly incontrovertible proof that this is God's message to the world. It takes divine intervention to prevent any reader from appreciating this extraordinary phenomenon, then falling prostrate, and accepting this overwhelming miracle (see 17:45-46, 18:57, 56:79, and Appendix One).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "Bring your witnesses who would testify that GOD has prohibited this or that." If they testify, do not testify with them. Nor shall you follow the opinions of those who reject our revelations, and those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, and those who stray away from their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Major Commandments
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Come let me tell you what your Lord has really prohibited for you: You shall not set up idols besides Him. You shall honor your parents. You shall not kill your children from fear of poverty—we provide for you and for them. You shall not commit gross sins, obvious or hidden. You shall not kill—GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. These are His commandments to you, that you may understand."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additional Commandments
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not touch the orphans' money except in the most righteous manner, until they reach maturity. You shall give full weight and a full measure when you trade, equitably. We do not burden any soul beyond its means. You shall be absolutely just when you bear witness, even against your relatives. You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD. These are His commandments to you, that you may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is My path—a straight one. You shall follow it, and do not follow any other paths, lest they divert you from His path. These are His commandments to you, that you may be saved.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we gave Moses the scripture, complete with the best commandments, and detailing everything, and a beacon and mercy, that they may believe in meeting their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This too is a blessed scripture that we have revealed; you shall follow it and lead a righteous life, that you may attain mercy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Now you can no longer say, "The scripture was sent down to two groups before us, and we were unaware of their teachings."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mathematics: The Ultimate Proof
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Nor can you say, "If only a scripture could come down to us, we would be better guided than they." A proven scripture has now come to you from your Lord, and a beacon, and a mercy. Now, who is more evil than one who rejects these proofs from GOD, and disregards them? We will commit those who disregard our proofs to the worst retribution, for their heedlessness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The role of the Quran's mathematical code is evident from the fact that the sum of the verse number (157) plus the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), through whom the code was revealed, gives 1387, or 19x73.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Requirements of the Test
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or your Lord, or some physical manifestations of your Lord? The day this happens, no soul will benefit from believing if it did not believe before that, and did not reap the benefits of belief by leading a righteous life. Say, "Keep on waiting; we too are waiting."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: After believing, the soul must grow and develop through the worship practices prescribed by God.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Religious Sects Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who divide themselves into sects do not belong with you. Their judgment rests with GOD, then He will inform them of everything they had done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whoever does a righteous work receives the reward for ten, and the one who commits a sin is requited for only one. No one suffers the slightest injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord has guided me in a straight path—the perfect religion of Abraham, monotheism. He never was an idol worshiper."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Contact Prayers (Salat), my worship practices, my life and my death, are all devoted absolutely to GOD alone, the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He has no partner. This is what I am commanded to believe, and I am the first to submit."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Shall I seek other than GOD as a lord, when He is the Lord of all things? No soul benefits except from its own works, and none bears the burden of another. Ultimately, you return to your Lord, then He informs you regarding all your disputes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth, and He raised some of you above others in rank, in order to test you in accordance with what He has given you. Surely, your Lord is efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A. L. M. S.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 1 for the role of these initials in the Quran's mathematical miracle.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: This scripture has been revealed to you—you shall not harbor doubt about it in your heart—that you may warn with it, and to provide a reminder for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall all follow what is revealed to you from your Lord; do not follow any idols besides Him. Rarely do you take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community we annihilated; they incurred our retribution while they were asleep, or wide awake.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their utterance when our retribution came to them was: "Indeed, we have been transgressors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will certainly question those who received the message, and we will question the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will inform them authoritatively, for we were never absent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The scales will be set on that day, equitably. Those whose weights are heavy will be the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those whose weights are light, they will be the ones who lost their souls, as a consequence of disregarding our revelations, unjustly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Failing to heed our Creator leads to spiritual starvation and eventual "loss" of the soul.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We have established you on earth, and we have provided for you the means of support therein. Rarely are you appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We created you, then we shaped you, then we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Iblees (Satan); he was not with the prostrators.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Test Begins
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I ordered you?" He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from mud."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Therefore, you must go down, for you are not to be arrogant here. Get out; you are debased."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Grant me a respite, until the Day of Resurrection."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You are granted a respite."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Since You have willed that I go astray, I will skulk for them on Your straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan is a proven liar, and so are his constituents (see 2:36, 6:22-23, & 7:20).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "I will come to them from before them, and from behind them, and from their right, and from their left, and You will find that most of them are unappreciative."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Get out therefrom, despised and defeated. Those among them who follow you, I will fill Hell with you all.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for you, Adam, dwell with your wife in Paradise, and eat therefrom as you please, but do not approach this one tree, lest you fall in sin."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The devil whispered to them, in order to reveal their bodies, which were invisible to them. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you from this tree, except to prevent you from becoming angels, and from attaining eternal existence."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He swore to them, "I am giving you good advice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He thus duped them with lies. As soon as they tasted the tree, their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Their Lord called upon them: "Did I not enjoin you from that tree, and warn you that the devil is your most ardent enemy?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged our souls, and unless You forgive us and have mercy on us, we will be losers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Go down as enemies of one another. On earth shall be your habitation and provision for awhile."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "On it you will live, on it you will die, and from it you will be brought out."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O children of Adam, we have provided you with garments to cover your bodies, as well as for luxury. But the best garment is the garment of righteousness. These are some of GOD's signs, that they may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O children of Adam, do not let the devil dupe you as he did when he caused the eviction of your parents from Paradise, and the removal of their garments to expose their bodies. He and his tribe see you, while you do not see them. We appoint the devils as companions of those who do not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Examine All Inherited Information
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They commit a gross sin, then say, "We found our parents doing this, and GOD has commanded us to do it." Say, "GOD never advocates sin. Are you saying about GOD what you do not know?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord advocates justice, and to stand devoted to Him alone at every place of worship. You shall devote your worship absolutely to Him alone. Just as He initiated you, you will ultimately go back to Him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Beware: They Believe that They Are Guided
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Some He guided, while others are committed to straying. They have taken the devils as their masters, instead of GOD, yet they believe that they are guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Dress Nicely For The Masjid
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O children of Adam, you shall be clean and dress nicely when you go to the masjid. And eat and drink moderately. Surely, He does not love the gluttons.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Innovated Prohibitions Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who prohibited the nice things GOD has created for His creatures, and the good provisions?" Say, "Such provisions are to be enjoyed in this life by those who believe. Moreover, the good provisions will be exclusively theirs on the Day of Resurrection." We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord prohibits only evil deeds, be they obvious or hidden, and sins, and unjustifiable aggression, and to set up beside GOD powerless idols, and to say about GOD what you do not know."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For each community, there is a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Messengers From Among You
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O children of Adam, when messengers come to you from among you, and recite My revelations to you, those who take heed and lead a righteous life, will have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who reject our revelations, and are too arrogant to uphold them, they have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who is more evil than those who invent lies about GOD, or reject His revelations? These will get their share, in accordance with the scripture, then, when our messengers come to terminate their lives, they will say, "Where are the idols you used to implore beside GOD?" They will say, "They have abandoned us." They will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mutual Blaming
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He will say, "Enter with the previous communities of jinns and humans into Hell." Every time a group enters, they will curse their ancestral group. Once they are all in it, the latest one will say of the previous one, "Our Lord, these are the ones who misled us. Give them double the retribution of Hell." He will say, "Each receives double, but you do not know."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The ancestral group will say to the later group, "Since you had an advantage over us, taste the retribution for your own sins."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Rejecting God's Revelations: An Unforgivable Offense
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who reject our revelations and are too arrogant to uphold them, the gates of the sky will never open for them, nor will they enter Paradise until the camel passes through the needle's eye. We thus requite the guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have incurred Hell as an abode; they will have barriers above them. We thus requite the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—we never burden any soul beyond its means—these will be the dwellers of Paradise. They abide in it forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By God's Grace
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We will remove all jealousy from their hearts. Rivers will flow beneath them, and they will say, "GOD be praised for guiding us. We could not possibly be guided, if it were not that GOD has guided us. The messengers of our Lord did bring the truth." They will be called: "This is your Paradise. You have inherited it, in return for your works."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The dwellers of Paradise will call the dwellers of Hell: "We have found our Lord's promise to be the truth, have you found your Lord's promise to be the truth?" They will say, "Yes." An announcer between them will announce: "GOD's condemnation has befallen the transgressors;
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "who repel from the path of GOD, and strive to make it crooked, and, with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A barrier separates them, while the Purgatory is occupied by people who recognize each side by their looks. They will call the dwellers of Paradise: "Peace be upon you." They did not enter (Paradise) through wishful thinking.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Initially, there will be 4 places: (1) the High Heaven, (2) the Lower Heaven, (3) the Purgatory, and (4) Hell. The Purgatory will be annexed into the Lower Heaven.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: When they turn their eyes towards the dwellers of Hell, they will say, "Our Lord, do not put us with these wicked people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Majority Doomed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The dwellers of the Purgatory will call on people they recognize by their looks, saying, "Your great numbers did not avail you in any way, nor did your arrogance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Are those the people you swore that GOD will never touch them with mercy?" (The people in the Purgatory will then be told,) "Enter Paradise; you have nothing to fear, nor will you grieve."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The dwellers of Hell will call on the dwellers of Paradise: "Let some of your water, or some of GOD's provisions to you flow towards us." They will say, "GOD has forbidden them for the disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who do not take their religion seriously, and are totally preoccupied with this worldly life, we forget them on that day, because they forgot that day, and because they spurned our revelations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran: Fully Detailed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have given them a scripture that is fully detailed, with knowledge, guidance, and mercy for the people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Are they waiting until all (prophecies) are fulfilled? The day such fulfillment comes to pass, those who disregarded it in the past will say, "The messengers of our Lord have brought the truth. Are there any intercessors to intercede on our behalf? Would you send us back, so that we change our behavior, and do better works than what we did?" They have lost their souls, and their own innovations have caused their doom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the one GOD; who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all authority. The night overtakes the day, as it pursues it persistently, and the sun, the moon, and the stars are committed to serve by His command. Absolutely, He controls all creation and all commands. Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The six days of creation are allegorical; they serve as a yardstick to let us know the relative complexity of our infinitesimal planet Earth—it was created in "4 days" (see 41:10).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You shall worship your Lord publicly and privately; He does not love the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight, and worship Him out of reverence, and out of hope. Surely, GOD's mercy is attainable by the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sends the wind with good omen, as a mercy from His hands. Once they gather heavy clouds, we drive them to dead lands, and send down water therefrom, to produce with it all kinds of fruits. We thus resurrect the dead, that you may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The good land readily produces its plants by the leave of its Lord, while the bad land barely produces anything useful. We thus explain the revelations for people who are appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders among his people said, "We see that you are far astray."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, I am not astray; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I deliver to you the messages of my Lord, and I advise you, and I know from GOD what you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Is it too much of a wonder that a reminder should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you, and to lead you to righteousness, that you may attain mercy?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They rejected him. Consequently, we saved him and those with him in the ark, and we drowned those who rejected our revelations; they were blind.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Hûd
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To 'Ãd we sent their brother Hûd. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Would you then observe righteousness?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are behaving foolishly, and we think that you are a liar."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, there is no foolishness in me; I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I deliver to you my Lord's messages, and I am honestly advising you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Is it too much of a wonder that a message should come to you from your Lord, through a man like you, to warn you? Recall that He made you inheritors after the people of Noah, and multiplied your number. Remember GOD's blessings, that you may succeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Following the Parents Blindly: A Human Tragedy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "Did you come to make us worship GOD alone, and abandon what our parents used to worship? We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You have incurred condemnation and wrath from your Lord. Do you argue with me in defense of innovations you have fabricated— you and your parents—which were never authorized by GOD? Therefore, wait and I will wait along with you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then saved him and those with him, by mercy from us, and we annihilated those who rejected our revelations and refused to be believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sãleh
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To Thamûd we sent their brother Sãleh. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Proof has been provided for you from your Lord: here is GOD's camel, to serve as a sign for you. Let her eat from GOD's land, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Recall that He made you inheritors after 'Ãd, and established you on earth, building mansions in its valleys, and carving homes from its mountains. You shall remember GOD's blessings, and do not roam the earth corruptingly."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Message: Proof of Messengership
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The arrogant leaders among his people said to the common people who believed, "How do you know that Sãleh is sent by his Lord?" They said, "The message he brought has made us believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The arrogant ones said, "We disbelieve in what you believe in."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, they slaughtered the camel, rebelled against their Lord's command, and said, "O Sãleh, bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are really a messenger."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, the quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He turned away from them, saying, "O my people, I have delivered my Lord's message to you, and advised you, but you do not like any advisers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lot: Homosexuality Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Lot said to his people, "You commit such an abomination; no one in the world has done it before!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You practice sex with the men, instead of the women. Indeed, you are a transgressing people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His people responded by saying, "Evict them from your town. They are people who wish to be pure."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we saved him and his family, but not his wife; she was with the doomed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We showered them with a certain shower; note the consequences for the guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shu'aib: Cheating, Dishonesty Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Proof has come to you from your Lord. You shall give full weight and full measure when you trade. Do not cheat the people out of their rights. Do not corrupt the earth after it has been set straight. This is better for you, if you are believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Refrain from blocking every path, seeking to repel those who believe from the path of GOD, and do not make it crooked. Remember that you used to be few and He multiplied your number. Recall the consequences for the wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Now that some of you have believed in what I was sent with, and some have disbelieved, wait until GOD issues His judgment between us; He is the best judge."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The arrogant leaders among his people said, "We will evict you, O Shu'aib, together with those who believed with you, from our town, unless you revert to our religion." He said, "Are you going to force us?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We would be blaspheming against GOD if we reverted to your religion after GOD has saved us from it. How could we revert back to it against the will of GOD our Lord? Our Lord's knowledge encompasses all things. We have put our trust in GOD. Our Lord, grant us a decisive victory over our people. You are the best supporter."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The disbelieving leaders among his people said, "If you follow Shu'aib, you will be losers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The quake annihilated them, leaving them dead in their homes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who rejected Shu'aib vanished, as if they never existed. Those who rejected Shu'aib were the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He turned away from them, saying, "O my people, I have delivered to you the messages of my Lord, and I have advised you. How can I grieve over disbelieving people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Blessings in Disguise
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whenever we sent a prophet to any community, we afflicted its people with adversity and hardship, that they may implore.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we substituted peace and prosperity in place of that hardship. But alas, they turned heedless and said, "It was our parents who experienced that hardship before prosperity." Consequently, we punished them suddenly when they least expected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most People Make the Wrong Choice
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Had the people of those communities believed and turned righteous, we would have showered them with blessings from the heaven and the earth. Since they decided to disbelieve, we punished them for what they earned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did the people of the present communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the night as they sleep?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did the people of today's communities guarantee that our retribution will not come to them in the daytime while they play?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they taken GOD's plans for granted? None takes GOD's plans for granted except the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Does it ever occur to those who inherit the earth after previous generations that, if we will, we can punish them for their sins, and seal their hearts, causing them to turn deaf?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We narrate to you the history of those communities: their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in what they had rejected before. GOD thus seals the hearts of the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We found that most of them disregard their covenant; we found most of them wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This life is our last chance to redeem ourselves, but most people are proven to be stubbornly rebellious and evil (see the INTRODUCTION).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: After (those messengers,) we sent Moses with our signs to Pharaoh and his people, but they transgressed. Note the consequences for the wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "It is incumbent upon me that I do not say about GOD except the truth. I come to you with a sign from your Lord; let the Children of Israel go."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "If you have a sign, then produce it, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He threw down his staff, and it turned into a tremendous serpent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He took out his hand, and it was white to the beholders.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders among Pharaoh's people said, "This is no more than a clever magician.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He wants to take you out of your land; what do you recommend?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Respite him and his brother, and send summoners to every city.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let them summon every experienced magician."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The magicians came to Pharaoh and said, "Do we get paid if we are the winners?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Yes indeed; you will even become close to me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we are throwing."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You throw." When they threw, they tricked the people's eyes, intimidated them, and produced a great magic.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then inspired Moses: "Throw down your staff," whereupon it swallowed whatever they fabricated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Truth Recognized by the Experts
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Thus, the truth prevailed, and what they did was nullified.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They were defeated then and there; they were humiliated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The magicians fell prostrate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We believe in the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh said, "Did you believe in him without my permission? This must be a conspiracy you schemed in the city, in order to take its people away. You will surely find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I will cut your hands and feet on alternate sides, then I will crucify you all."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We will then return to our Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You persecute us simply because we believed in the proofs of our Lord when they came to us." "Our Lord, grant us steadfastness, and let us die as submitters."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders among Pharaoh's people said, "Will you allow Moses and his people to corrupt the earth, and forsake you and your gods?" He said, "We will kill their sons, and spare their daughters. We are much more powerful than they are."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said to his people, "Seek GOD's help, and steadfastly persevere. The earth belongs to GOD, and He grants it to whomever He chooses from among His servants. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We were persecuted before you came to us, and after you came to us." He said, "Your Lord will annihilate your enemy and establish you on earth, then He will see how you behave."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Plagues
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We then afflicted Pharaoh's people with drought, and shortage of crops, that they may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When good omens came their way, they said, "We have deserved this," but when a hardship afflicted them, they blamed Moses and those with him. In fact, their omens are decided only by GOD, but most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "No matter what kind of sign you show us, to dupe us with your magic, we will not believe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Warnings Go Unheeded
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we sent upon them the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, and the blood—profound signs. But they maintained their arrogance. They were evil people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whenever a plague afflicted them, they said, "O Moses, implore your Lord—you are close to Him. If you relieve this plague, we will believe with you, and will send the Children of Israel with you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, when we relieved the plague for any length of time, they violated their pledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Inevitable Retribution
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we avenged their actions, and drowned them in the sea. That is because they rejected our signs, and were totally heedless thereof.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We let the oppressed people inherit the land, east and west, and we blessed it. The blessed commands of your Lord were thus fulfilled for the Children of Israel, to reward them for their steadfastness, and we annihilated the works of Pharaoh and his people and everything they harvested.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: After All the Miracles
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. When they passed by people who were worshiping statues, they said, "O Moses, make a god for us, like the gods they have." He said, "Indeed, you are ignorant people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "These people are committing a blasphemy, for what they are doing is disastrous for them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Shall I seek for you other than GOD to be your god, when He has blessed you more than anyone else in the world?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Reminder to the Children of Israel
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that we delivered you from Pharaoh's people, who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, killing your sons and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting trial for you from your Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our World Cannot Stand the Physical Presence of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We summoned Moses for thirty nights, and completed them by adding ten. Thus, the audience with his Lord lasted forty nights. Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Stay here with my people, maintain righteousness, and do not follow the ways of the corruptors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The manner in which these numbers are mentioned is significant. As detailed in Appendix 1, all the numbers mentioned in the Quran add up to 162146, 19x8534.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: When Moses came at our appointed time, and his Lord spoke with him, he said, "My Lord, let me look and see You." He said, "You cannot see Me. Look at that mountain; if it stays in its place, then you can see Me." Then, his Lord manifested Himself to the mountain, and this caused it to crumble. Moses fell unconscious. When he came to, he said, "Be You glorified. I repent to You, and I am the most convinced believer."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O Moses, I have chosen you, out of all the people, with My messages and by speaking to you. Therefore, take what I have given you and be appreciative."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We wrote for him on the tablets all kinds of enlightenments and details of everything: "You shall uphold these teachings strongly, and exhort your people to uphold them—these are the best teachings. I will point out for you the fate of the wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Intervention Keeps the Disbelievers in the Dark
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: I will divert from My revelations those who are arrogant on earth, without justification. Consequently, when they see every kind of proof they will not believe. And when they see the path of guidance they will not adopt it as their path, but when they see the path of straying they will adopt it as their path. This is the consequence of their rejecting our proofs, and being totally heedless thereof.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who reject our revelations and the meeting of the Hereafter, their works are nullified. Are they requited only for what they committed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Golden Calf
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: During his absence, Moses' people made from their jewelry the statue of a calf, complete with the sound of a calf. Did they not see that it could not speak to them, or guide them in any path? They worshiped it, and thus turned wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How the golden calf acquired the sound of a calf is explained in Footnote 20:96.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Finally, when they regretted their action, and realized that they had gone astray, they said, "Unless our Lord redeems us with His mercy, and forgives us, we will be losers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, he said, "What a terrible thing you have done in my absence! Could you not wait for the commandments of your Lord?" He threw down the tablets, and took hold of his brother's head, pulling him towards himself. (Aaron) said, "Son of my mother, the people took advantage of my weakness, and almost killed me. Let not my enemies rejoice, and do not count me with the transgressing people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Moses) said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother, and admit us into Your mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who idolized the calf have incurred wrath from their Lord, and humiliation in this life. We thus requite the innovators.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who committed sins, then repented thereafter and believed, your Lord—after this—is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When Moses' anger subsided, he picked up the tablets, containing guidance and mercy for those who reverence their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses then selected seventy men from among his people, to come to our appointed audience. When the quake shook them, he said, "My Lord, You could have annihilated them in the past, together with me, if You so willed. Would You annihilate us for the deeds of those among us who are foolish? This must be the test that You have instituted for us. With it, You condemn whomever You will, and guide whomever You will. You are our Lord and Master, so forgive us, shower us with Your mercy; You are the best Forgiver.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Requirements For Attaining God's Mercy: The Importance of Zakat
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "And decree for us righteousness in this world, and in the Hereafter. We have repented to You. He said, "My retribution befalls whomever I will. But My mercy encompasses all things. However, I will specify it for those who (1) lead a righteous life, (2) give the obligatory charity (Zakat), (3) believe in our revelations, and
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The importance of the obligatory charity (Zakat) cannot be over emphasized. As instituted in 6:141, Zakat must be given away upon receiving any income—2.5% of one's net income must be given to the parents, the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien, in this order (see 2:215).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "(4) follow the messenger, the gentile prophet (Muhammad), whom they find written in their Torah and Gospel. He exhorts them to be righteous, enjoins them from evil, allows for them all good food, and prohibits that which is bad, and unloads the burdens and the shackles imposed upon them. Those who believe in him, respect him, support him, and follow the light that came with him are the successful ones."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad is prophesied in Deuteronomy 18:15-19 and John 14:16-17 & 16:13.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "O people, I am GOD's messenger to all of you. To Him belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. There is no god except He. He controls life and death." Therefore, you shall believe in GOD and His messenger, the gentile prophet, who believes in GOD and His words. Follow him, that you may be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Guided Jews
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among the followers of Moses there are those who guide in accordance with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Miracles in Sinai
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We divided them into twelve tribal communities, and we inspired Moses when his people asked him for water: "Strike the rock with your staff," whereupon twelve springs gushed out therefrom. Thus, each community knew its water. And we shaded them with clouds, and sent down to them manna and quails: "Eat from the good things we provided for you." It is not us that they wronged; it is they who wronged their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Rebellion Despite the Miracles
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that they were told, "Go into this town to live, and eat therefrom as you please, treat the people amicably, and enter the gate humbly. We will then forgive your transgressions. We will multiply the reward for the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But the evil ones among them substituted other commands for the commands given to them. Consequently, we sent upon them condemnation from the sky, because of their wickedness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Observing the Commandments Brings Prosperity
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Remind them of the community by the sea, who desecrated the Sabbath. When they observed the Sabbath, the fish came to them abundantly. And when they violated the Sabbath, the fish did not come. We thus afflicted them, as a consequence of their transgression.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mocking and Ridiculing God's Message
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that a group of them said, "Why should you preach to people whom GOD will surely annihilate or punish severely?" They answered, "Apologize to your Lord," that they might be saved.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they disregarded what they were reminded of, we saved those who prohibited evil, and afflicted the wrongdoers with a terrible retribution for their wickedness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they continued to defy the commandments, we said to them, "Be you despicable apes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additionally, your Lord has decreed that He will raise up against them people who will inflict severe persecution upon them, until the Day of Resurrection. Your Lord is most efficient in enforcing retribution, and He is certainly the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We scattered them among many communities throughout the land. Some of them were righteous, and some were less than righteous. We tested them with prosperity and hardship, that they may return.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequent to them, He substituted new generations who inherited the scripture. But they opted for the worldly life instead, saying, "We will be forgiven." But then they continued to opt for the materials of this world. Did they not make a covenant to uphold the scripture, and not to say about GOD except the truth? Did they not study the scripture? Certainly, the abode of the Hereafter is far better for those who maintain righteousness. Do you not understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who uphold the scripture, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), we never fail to recompense the pious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We raised the mountain above them like an umbrella, and they thought it was going to fall on them: "You shall uphold what we have given you, strongly, and remember the contents thereof, that you may be saved."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We Are Born With Instinctive Knowledge About God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that your Lord summoned all the descendants of Adam, and had them bear witness for themselves: "Am I not your Lord?" They all said, "Yes. We bear witness." Thus, you cannot say on the Day of Resurrection, "We were not aware of this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, every human being is born with an instinctive knowledge about God.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Nor can you say, "It was our parents who practiced idolatry, and we simply followed in their footsteps. Will You punish us because of what others have innovated?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus explain the revelations, to enable the people to redeem themselves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This life is our last chance to return to God's Kingdom (See INTRODUCTION).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Recite for them the news of one who was given our proofs, but chose to disregard them. Consequently, the devil pursued him, until he became a strayer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had we willed, we could have elevated him therewith, but he insisted on sticking to the ground, and pursued his own opinions. Thus, he is like the dog; whether you pet him or scold him, he pants. Such is the example of people who reject our proofs. Narrate these narrations, that they may reflect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Bad indeed is the example of people who reject our proofs; it is only their own souls that they wrong.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whomever GOD guides is the truly guided one, and whomever He commits to straying, these are the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan Hypnotizes His Constituents
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have committed to Hell multitudes of jinns and humans. They have minds with which they do not understand, eyes with which they do not see, and ears with which they do not hear. They are like animals; no, they are far worse—they are totally unaware.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the most beautiful names; call upon Him therewith, and disregard those who distort His names. They will be requited for their sins.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among our creations, there are those who guide with the truth, and the truth renders them righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who reject our revelations, we lead them on without them ever realizing it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: I will even encourage them; My scheming is formidable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Why do they not reflect upon their friend (the messenger)? He is not crazy. He is simply a profound warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not looked at the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all the things GOD has created? Does it ever occur to them that the end of their life may be near? Which Hadith, beside this, do they believe in?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whomever GOD commits to straying, there is no way for anyone to guide him. He leaves them in their sins, blundering.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They ask you about the end of the world (the Hour), and when it will come to pass. Say, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord. Only He reveals its time. Heavy it is, in the heavens and the earth. It will not come to you except suddenly." They ask you as if you are in control thereof. Say, "The knowledge thereof is with GOD," but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
The right time to reveal this information was predestined to be 1980 A.D., through God's Messenger of the Covenant (See 15:87, 72:27, and Appendices 2 & 11).

±±7:187 The "Hour" comes "suddenly" only to the disbelievers (See Appendix 11).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Messengers Are Powerless; They Do Not Know the Future.
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "I have no power to benefit myself, or harm myself. Only what GOD wills happens to me. If I knew the future, I would have increased my wealth, and no harm would have afflicted me. I am no more than a warner, and a bearer of good news for those who believe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our Children Can be Idols
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He created you from one person (Adam). Subsequently, He gives every man a mate to find tranquility with her. She then carries a light load that she can hardly notice. As the load gets heavier, they implore GOD their Lord: "If You give us a good baby, we will be appreciative."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But when He gives them a good baby, they turn His gift into an idol that rivals Him. GOD be exalted, far above any partnership.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is it not a fact that they are idolizing idols who create nothing, and are themselves created?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idols that can neither help them, nor even help themselves?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not follow you. Thus, it is the same for them whether you invite them, or remain silent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The idols you invoke besides GOD are creatures like you. Go ahead and call upon them; let them respond to you, if you are right.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they have legs on which they walk? Do they have hands with which they defend themselves? Do they have eyes with which they see? Do they have ears with which they hear? Say, "Call upon your idols, and ask them to smite me without delay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "GOD is my only Lord and Master; the One who revealed this scripture. He protects the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for the idols you set up beside Him, they cannot help you, nor can they help themselves."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When you invite them to the guidance, they do not hear. And you see them looking at you, but they do not see.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall resort to pardon, advocate tolerance, and disregard the ignorant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the devil whispers to you any whisper, seek refuge in GOD; He is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who are righteous, whenever the devil approaches them with an idea, they remember, whereupon they become seers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their brethren ceaselessly entice them to go astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you do not produce a miracle that they demand, they say, "Why not ask for it?" Say, "I simply follow what is revealed to me from my Lord." These are enlightenments from your Lord, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the Quran is recited, you shall listen to it and take heed, that you may attain mercy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall remember your Lord within yourself, publicly, privately, and quietly, day and night; do not be unaware.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your god is whoever or whatever occupies your mind most of the day. This explains the fact that most of those who believe in God are destined for Hell (See 12:106, 23:84-90, and Appendix 27).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Those at your Lord are never too proud to worship Him; they glorify Him and fall prostrate before Him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They consult you about the spoils of war. Say, "The spoils of war belong to GOD and the messenger." You shall observe GOD, exhort one another to be righteous, and obey GOD and His messenger, if you are believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The True Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The true believers are those whose hearts tremble when GOD is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited to them, their faith is strengthened, and they trust in their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give to charity.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such are the true believers. They attain high ranks at their Lord, as well as forgiveness and a generous provision.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Weak Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When your Lord willed that you leave your home, to fulfill a specific plan, some believers became exposed as reluctant believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They argued with you against the truth, even after everything was explained to them. They acted as if they were being driven to certain death.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Recall that GOD promised you victory over a certain group, but you still wanted to face the weaker group. It was GOD's plan to establish the truth with His words, and to defeat the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For He has decreed that the truth shall prevail, and the falsehood shall vanish, in spite of the evildoers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Invisible Soldiers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Thus, when you implored your Lord to come to the rescue, He responded to you: "I am supporting you with one thousand angels in succession."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Victory Guaranteed for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD gave you this good news to strengthen your hearts. Victory comes only from GOD. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He caused peaceful slumber to overtake you and pacify you, and He sent down water from the sky to clean you therewith. He protected you from the devil's curse, reassured your hearts and strengthened your foothold.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lessons from History
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that your Lord inspired the angels: "I am with you; so support those who believed. I will throw terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved. You may strike them above the necks, and you may strike even every finger."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All wars are governed by the basic rule in 60:8-9.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: This is what they have justly incurred by fighting GOD and His messenger. For those who fight against GOD and His messenger, GOD's retribution is severe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is to punish the disbelievers; they have incurred the retribution of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, if you encounter the disbelievers who have mobilized against you, do not turn back and flee.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Anyone who turns back on that day, except to carry out a battle plan, or to join his group, has incurred wrath from GOD, and his abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Is Doing Everything
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: It was not you who killed them; GOD is the One who killed them. It was not you who threw when you threw; GOD is the One who threw. But He thus gives the believers a chance to earn a lot of credit. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believing in God necessitates believing in His qualities, one of which is that He is doing everything. Without knowing God, there is no belief (23:84-90). Bad things are incurred by us, and executed by Satan, in accordance with God's laws (4:78-79, 42:30).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Additionally, GOD thus nullifies the schemes of the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You sought victory (O disbelievers), and victory did come; it belonged to the believers. If you refrain (from aggression) it would be better for you, but if you return, so will we. Your armies will never help you, no matter how great. For GOD is on the side of the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, obey GOD and His messenger, and do not disregard him while you hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Blocked Out
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not be like those who say, "We hear," when they do not hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are the deaf and dumb, who do not understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had GOD known of any good in them, He would have made them hearers. Even if He made them hearers, they still would turn away in aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Righteous Do Not Really Die
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall respond to GOD and to the messenger when he invites you to what gives you life. You should know that GOD is closer to you than your heart, and that before Him you will be summoned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 17. When the righteous exit their bodies, they go straight to Heaven.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Beware of a retribution that may not be limited to the evildoers among you. You should know that GOD's retribution is severe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A community that tolerates homosexuality, for example, may be hit by an earthquake.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: God Supports the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Remember that you used to be few and oppressed, fearing that the people may snatch you, and He granted you a secure sanctuary, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good provisions, that you may be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not betray GOD and the messenger, and do not betray those who trust you, now that you know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Money & Children Are Tests
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You should know that your money and your children are a test, and that GOD possesses a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, if you reverence GOD, He will enlighten you, remit your sins, and forgive you. GOD possesses infinite grace.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Protects His Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The disbelievers plot and scheme to neutralize you, or kill you, or banish you. However, they plot and scheme, but so does GOD. GOD is the best schemer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God chose His final prophet, Muhammad, from the strongest tribe of Arabia. It was tribal laws and traditions that prevented the disbelievers—by God's leave—from killing Muhammad. Similarly, it was God's will to move His Messenger of the Covenant from the Middle East, where he would have been killed, to the U.S.A. where God's message can flourish and reach every corner of the globe. This is mathematically confirmed: the sura & verse numbers= 8+30=19x2.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: When our revelations are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we wanted to, we could have said the same things. These are no more than tales from the past!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They also said, "Our god, if this is really the truth from You, then shower us with rocks from the sky, or pour upon us a painful punishment."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: However, GOD is not to punish them while you are in their midst; GOD is not to punish them while they are seeking forgiveness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not deserved GOD's retribution, by repelling others from the Sacred Masjid, even though they are not the custodians thereof? The true custodians thereof are the righteous, but most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Contact Prayers (Salat) Existed Before the Quran

segments.text: Their Contact Prayers (Salat) at the shrine (Ka'bah) were no more than a mockery and a means of repelling the people (by crowding them out). Therefore, suffer the retribution for your disbelief.

segments.text: All religious practices in Islam came to us through Abraham; when the Quran was revealed, all rites in "Submission" were already in existence (21:73, 22:78).

segments.text: Spending Their Money to Fight God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve spend their money to repel others from the way of GOD. They will spend it, then it will turn into sorrow and remorse for them. Ultimately, they will be defeated, and all disbelievers will be summoned to Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The idol worshiping leaders of corrupted Islam, Saudi Arabia, have allocated huge sums of money annually to fight God and His miracle. For example, the famous Lebanese publisher Dãr Al-'Ilm Lil-Malãyîn (Knowledge for the Millions) published the Arabic version of "The Miracle of the Quran" in March 1983. The Saudis bought all the copies and destroyed them.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD will sift away the bad from the good, then pile the bad on top of each other, all in one pile, then throw it in Hell. Such are the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Tell those who disbelieved: if they stop, all their past will be forgiven. But if they return, they will incur the same fate as their previous counterparts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall fight them to ward off oppression, and to practice your religion devoted to GOD alone. If they refrain from aggression, then GOD is fully Seer of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they turn away, then you should know that GOD is your Lord and Master; the best Lord and Master, the best supporter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You should know that if you gain any spoils in war, one-fifth shall go to GOD and the messenger, to be given to the relatives, the orphans, the poor, and the traveling alien. You will do this if you believe in GOD and in what we revealed to our servant on the day of decision, the day the two armies clashed. GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Controls Everything and Plans for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that you were on this side of the valley, while they were on the other side. Then their caravan had to move to lower ground. Had you planned it this way, you could not have done it. But GOD was to carry out a predetermined matter, whereby those destined to be annihilated were annihilated for an obvious reason, and those destined to be saved were saved for an obvious reason. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD made them appear in your dream (O Muhammad) fewer in number. Had He made them appear more numerous, you would have failed, and you would have disputed among yourselves. But GOD saved the situation. He is Knower of the innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And when the time came and you faced them, He made them appear fewer in your eyes, and made you appear fewer in their eyes as well. For GOD willed to carry out a certain plan. All decisions are made by GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, when you encounter an army, you shall hold fast and commemorate GOD frequently, that you may succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall obey GOD and His messenger, and do not dispute among yourselves, lest you fail and scatter your strength. You shall steadfastly persevere. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not be like those who left their homes grudgingly, only to show off, and in fact discouraged others from following the path of GOD. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Devil Sees God's Invisible Soldiers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The devil had adorned their works in their eyes, and said, "You cannot be defeated by any people today," and "I will be fighting along with you." But as soon as the two armies faced each other, he turned back on his heels and fled, saying, "I disown you. I see what you do not see. I am afraid of GOD. GOD's retribution is awesome."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The hypocrites and those who harbored doubt in their hearts said, "These people are deceived by their religion." However, if one puts his trust in GOD, then GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you could only see those who disbelieved when the angels put them to death! They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends: "Taste the retribution of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "This is a consequence of what your hands have sent forth. GOD is never unjust towards the creatures."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is the same fate as that of Pharaoh's people and those who disbelieved before them. They rejected GOD's revelations, and GOD punished them for their sins. GOD is powerful, and His retribution is severe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Retribution: A Consequence of Sin
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD does not change a blessing He has bestowed upon any people unless they themselves decide to change. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such was the case with the people of Pharaoh and others before them. They first rejected the signs of their Lord. Consequently, we annihilated them for their sins. We drowned Pharaoh's people; the wicked were consistently punished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The worst creatures in the sight of GOD are those who disbelieved; they cannot believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You reach agreements with them, but they violate their agreements every time; they are not righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, if you encounter them in war, you shall set them up as a deterrent example for those who come after them, that they may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When you are betrayed by a group of people, you shall mobilize against them in the same manner. GOD does not love the betrayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Let not those who disbelieve think that they can get away with it; they can never escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Be Prepared: A Divine Commandment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall prepare for them all the power you can muster, and all the equipment you can mobilize, that you may frighten the enemies of GOD, your enemies, as well as others who are not known to you; GOD knows them. Whatever you spend in the cause of GOD will be repaid to you generously, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they resort to peace, so shall you, and put your trust in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Suffices the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If they want to deceive you, then GOD will suffice you. He will help you with His support, and with the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He has reconciled the hearts (of the believers). Had you spent all the money on earth, you could not reconcile their hearts. But GOD did reconcile them. He is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you prophet, sufficient for you is GOD and the believers who have followed you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you prophet, you shall exhort the believers to fight. If there are twenty of you who are steadfast, they can defeat two hundred, and a hundred of you can defeat a thousand of those who disbelieved. That is because they are people who do not understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Now (that many new people have joined you) GOD has made it easier for you, for He knows that you are not as strong as you used to be. Henceforth, a hundred steadfast believers can defeat two hundred, and a thousand of you can defeat two thousand by GOD's leave. GOD is with those who steadfastly persevere.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No prophet shall acquire captives, unless he participates in the fighting. You people are seeking the materials of this world, while GOD advocates the Hereafter. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If it were not for a predetermined decree from GOD, you would have suffered, on account of what you took, a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, eat from the spoils you have earned that which is lawful and good, and observe GOD. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you prophet, tell the prisoners of war in your hands, "If GOD knew of anything good in your hearts, He would have given you better than anything you have lost, and would have forgiven you. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And if they want to betray you, they have already betrayed GOD. This is why He made them the losers. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who believed, and emigrated, and strove with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD, as well as those who hosted them and gave them refuge, and supported them, they are allies of one another. As for those who believe, but do not emigrate with you, you do not owe them any support, until they do emigrate. However, if they need your help, as brethren in faith, you shall help them, except against people with whom you have signed a peace treaty. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved are allies of one another. Unless you keep these commandments, there will be chaos on earth, and terrible corruption.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who believed and emigrated, and strove in the cause of GOD, as well as those who hosted them and gave them refuge, and supported them, these are the true believers. They have deserved forgiveness and a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who believed afterwards, and emigrated, and strove with you, they belong with you. Those who are related to each other shall be the first to support each other, in accordance with GOD's commandments. GOD is fully aware of all things.

segments.text: An ultimatum is herein issued from GOD and His messenger to the idol worshipers who enter into a treaty with you.

segments.text:

If they repent and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), you shall let them go. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

segments.text: They traded away GOD's revelations for a cheap price. Consequently, they repulsed the people from His path. Miserable indeed is what they did!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They never observe any rights of kinship towards any believer, nor do they uphold their covenants; these are the real transgressors.

segments.text: If they repent and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), then they are your brethren in religion. We thus explain the revelations for people who know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall fight them, for GOD will punish them at your hands, humiliate them, grant you victory over them, and cool the chests of the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will also remove the rage from the believers' hearts. GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

segments.text: The Inevitable Test

segments.text: Did you think that you will be left alone without GOD distinguishing those among you who strive, and never ally themselves with GOD's enemies, or the enemies of His messenger, or the enemies of the believers? GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The idol worshipers are not to frequent the masjids of GOD, while confessing their disbelief. These have nullified their works, and they will abide forever in Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The only people to frequent GOD's masjids are those who believe in GOD and the Last Day, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and do not fear except GOD. These will surely be among the guided ones.

segments.text: Question to the Arabs

segments.text: Have you considered the watering of the pilgrims and caring for the Sacred Masjid a substitute for believing in GOD and the Last Day, and striving in the cause of GOD? They are not equal in the sight of GOD. GOD does not guide the wicked people.

segments.text: Good News
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who believe, and emigrate, and strive in the cause of GOD with their money and their lives, are far greater in rank in the sight of GOD. These are the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their Lord gives them good news: mercy and approval from Him, and gardens where they rejoice in everlasting bliss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eternally they abide therein. GOD possesses a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If You Have to Make a Choice
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not ally yourselves even with your parents and your siblings, if they prefer disbelieving over believing. Those among you who ally themselves with them are transgressing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Important Criterion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "If your parents, your children, your siblings, your spouses, your family, the money you have earned, a business you worry about, and the homes you cherish are more beloved to you than GOD and His messenger, and the striving in His cause, then just wait until GOD brings His judgment." GOD does not guide the wicked people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
Since the odds are overwhelming against any human being to actually believe and devote the worship to God alone (12:103, 106), it is virtually impossible to see a whole family believe. Thus, most believers have been faced with the question: "Either me or God and His messenger." This question is consistently stated by spouses of the believers, or their parents, their children, etc. Consistently, the believers made the right choice. This is a mandatory test for all believers (29:2).

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then GOD sent down contentment upon His messenger and upon the believers. And He sent down invisible soldiers; He thus punished those who disbelieved. This is the requital for the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Ultimately, GOD redeems whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, the idol worshipers are polluted; they shall not be permitted to approach the Sacred Masjid after this year. If you fear loss of income, GOD will shower you with His provisions, in accordance with His will. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.

segments.text: You shall fight back against those who do not believe in GOD, nor in the Last Day, nor do they prohibit what GOD and His messenger have prohibited, nor do they abide by the religion of truth among those who received the scripture, until they pay the due tax, willingly or unwillingly.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The Jews said, "Ezra is the son of GOD," while the Christians said, "Jesus is the son of GOD!" These are blasphemies uttered by their mouths. They thus match the blasphemies of those who have disbelieved in the past. GOD condemns them. They have surely deviated.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They have set up their religious leaders and scholars as lords, instead of GOD. Others deified the Messiah, son of Mary. They were all commanded to worship only one god. There is no god except He. Be He glorified, high above having any partners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you consult the "Muslim scholars" about worshiping God alone, and upholding the word of God alone, as taught in this proven scripture, they will advise you against it. If you consult the Pope about the identity of Jesus, he will advise you to uphold a trinity. If you obey the "Muslim scholars" whose advice is contrary to God's teachings, or if you take the Pope's advice instead of God's, you have set up these religious leaders as gods instead of God.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They want to put out GOD's light with their mouths, but GOD insists upon perfecting His light, in spite of the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Submission" Destined to Prevail
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, and will make it dominate all religions, in spite of the idol worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This statement, letter for letter, occurs here and in 61:9. segments.text: Beware of Professional Religionists
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, many religious leaders and preachers take the people's money illicitly, and repel from the path of GOD. Those who hoard the gold and silver, and do not spend them in the cause of GOD, promise them a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when their gold and silver will be heated in the fire of Hell, then used to burn their foreheads, their sides, and their backs: "This is what you hoarded for yourselves, so taste what you have hoarded."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's System: Twelve Months Per Year
segments.label: heading-1992
