segments.text: The count of months, as far as GOD is concerned, is twelve. This has been GOD's law, since the day He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred. This is the perfect religion; you shall not wrong your souls (by fighting) during the Sacred Months. However, you may declare all-out war against the idol worshipers (even during the Sacred Months), when they declare all-out war against you, and know that GOD is on the side of the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The word "month" is mentioned in the Quran 12 times, and "day" 365 times.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Altering the Sacred Months
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Altering the Sacred Months is a sign of excessive disbelief; it augments the straying of those who have disbelieved. They alternate the Sacred Months and the regular months, while preserving the number of months consecrated by GOD. They thus violate what GOD has consecrated. Their evil works are adorned in their eyes. GOD does not guide the disbelieving people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Sacred Months according to the corrupted Muslim World are Rajab, Zul-Qe'dah, Zul-Hijjah, and Muharram (7th, 11th, 12th and 1st months of the Islamic Calendar). A careful study of the Quran, however, reveals that they should be Zul-Hijjah, Muharram, Safar, and Rabi I (12th, 1st, 2nd, and 3rd months). See Footnote 2:196.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, when you are told, "Mobilize in the cause of GOD," why do you become heavily attached to the ground? Have you chosen this worldly life in place of the Hereafter? The materials of this world, compared to the Hereafter, are nil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Unless you mobilize, He will commit you to painful retribution and substitute other people in your place; you can never hurt Him in the least. GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Invisible Soldiers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you fail to support him (the messenger), GOD has already supported him. Thus, when the disbelievers chased him, and he was one of two in the cave, he said to his friend, "Do not worry; GOD is with us." GOD then sent down contentment and security upon him, and supported him with invisible soldiers. He made the word of the disbelievers lowly. GOD's word reigns supreme. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Better Believers Strive in the Cause of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall readily mobilize, light or heavy, and strive with your money and your lives in the cause of GOD. This is better for you, if you only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Sedentary
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If there were a quick material gain, and a short journey, they would have followed you. But the striving is just too much for them. They will swear by GOD: "If we could, we would have mobilized with you." They thus hurt themselves, and GOD knows that they are liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has pardoned you: why did you give them permission (to stay behind), before you could distinguish those who are truthful from the liars?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who truly believe in GOD and the Last Day do not ask your permission to evade the opportunity to strive with their money and their lives. GOD is fully aware of the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The only people who wish to be excused are those who do not really believe in GOD and the Last Day. Their hearts are full of doubt, and their doubts cause them to waver.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had they really wanted to mobilize, they would have prepared for it thoroughly. But GOD disliked their participation, so He discouraged them; they were told, "Stay behind with those who are staying behind."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had they mobilized with you, they would have created confusion, and would have caused disputes and divisions among you. Some of you were apt to listen to them. GOD is fully aware of the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They sought to spread confusion among you in the past, and confounded the matters for you. However, the truth ultimately prevails, and GOD's plan is carried out, in spite of them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them would say, "Give me permission (to stay behind); do not impose such a hardship on me." In fact, they have thus incurred a terrible hardship; Hell is surrounding the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If something good happens to you, they hurt, and if an affliction befalls you, they say, "We told you so," as they turn away rejoicing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Nothing happens to us, except what GOD has decreed for us. He is our Lord and Master. In GOD the believers shall trust."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You can only expect for us one of two good things (victory or martyrdom), while we expect for you condemnation from GOD and retribution from Him, or at our hands. Therefore, wait, and we will wait along with you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Spend, willingly or unwillingly. Nothing will be accepted from you, for you are evil people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Contact Prayer Existed Before Muhammad
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: What prevented the acceptance of their spending is that they disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and when they observed the Contact Prayers (Salat), they observed them lazily, and when they gave to charity, they did so grudgingly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is another proof that the Contact Prayers (Salat) existed before the Quran, and were handed down from Abraham (see 21:73). Also, it stumps those who challenge God's assertion that the Quran is complete and fully detailed when they ask, "Where can we find the details of the Contact Prayers in the Quran?" (6:19, 38, 114).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Apparent Worldly Success
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not be impressed by their money, or their children. GOD causes these to be sources of retribution for them in this life, and (when they die) their souls depart while they are disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They swear by GOD that they belong with you, while they do not belong with you; they are divisive people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they could find a refuge, or caves, or a hiding place, they would go to it, rushing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them criticize your distribution of the charities; if they are given therefrom, they become satisfied, but if they are not given therefrom, they become objectors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They should be satisfied with what GOD and His messenger have given them. They should have said, "GOD suffices us. GOD will provide for us from His bounties, and so will His messenger. We are seeking only GOD."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Distribution System for Charities
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Charities shall go to the poor, the needy, the workers who collect them, the new converts, to free the slaves, to those burdened by sudden expenses, in the cause of GOD, and to the traveling alien. Such is GOD's commandment. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them hurt the prophet by saying, "He is all ears!" Say, "It is better for you that he listens to you. He believes in GOD, and trusts the believers. He is a mercy for those among you who believe." Those who hurt GOD's messenger have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They swear by GOD to you, to please you, when GOD and His messenger are more worthy of pleasing, if they are really believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Retribution for Opposing God and His Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Did they not know that anyone who opposes GOD and His messenger has incurred the fire of Hell forever? This is the worst humiliation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Hypocrites
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The hypocrites worry that a sura may be revealed exposing what is inside their hearts. Say, "Go ahead and mock. GOD will expose exactly what you are afraid of."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you ask them, they would say, "We were only mocking and kidding." Say, "Do you realize that you are mocking GOD, and His revelations, and His messenger?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not apologize. You have disbelieved after having believed. If we pardon some of you, we will punish others among you, as a consequence of their wickedness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The hypocrite men and the hypocrite women belong with each other—they advocate evil and prohibit righteousness, and they are stingy. They forgot GOD, so He forgot them. The hypocrites are truly wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD promises the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, as well as the disbelievers, the fire of Hell, wherein they abide forever. It suffices them. GOD has condemned them; they have incurred an everlasting retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's System Does Not Change
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Some of those before you were stronger than you, and possessed more money and children. They became preoccupied with their material possessions. Similarly, you have become preoccupied with your material possessions, just like those before you have become preoccupied. You have become totally heedless, just as they were heedless. Such are the people who nullify their works, both in this world and in the Hereafter; they are the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Losers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have they not learned anything from the previous generations; the people of Noah, 'Ãd, Thamûd, the people of Abraham, the dwellers of Midyan, and the evildoers (of Sodom and Gomorrah)? Their messengers went to them with clear proofs. GOD never wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Winners
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The believing men and women are allies of one another. They advocate righteousness and forbid evil, they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they obey GOD and His messenger. These will be showered by GOD's mercy. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD promises the believing men and the believing women gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever, and magnificent mansions in the gardens of Eden. And GOD's blessings and approval are even greater. This is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Be Stern With the Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern in dealing with them. Their destiny is Hell; what a miserable abode!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They swear by GOD that they never said it, although they have uttered the word of disbelief; they have disbelieved after becoming submitters. In fact, they gave up what they never had. They have rebelled even though GOD and His messenger have showered them with His grace and provisions. If they repent, it would be best for them. But if they turn away, GOD will commit them to painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. They will find no one on earth to be their lord and master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them even pledged: "If GOD showered us with His grace, we would be charitable, and would lead a righteous life."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But when He did shower them with His provisions, they became stingy, and turned away in aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, He plagued them with hypocrisy in their hearts, till the day they meet Him. This is because they broke their promises to GOD, and because of their lying.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not realize that GOD knows their secrets, and their conspiracies, and that GOD is the Knower of all secrets?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who criticize the generous believers for giving too much, and ridicule the poor believers for giving too little, GOD despises them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan's Most Effective Bait: The Myth of Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them—even if you ask forgiveness for them seventy times—GOD will not forgive them. This is because they disbelieve in GOD and His messenger. GOD does not guide the wicked people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If Muhammad could not intercede on behalf of his own uncles and cousins, what makes strangers who never met him think that he will intercede on their behalf? Abraham could not intercede on behalf of his father, nor could Noah intercede on behalf of his son (11:46 & 60:4).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The sedentary rejoiced in their staying behind the messenger of GOD, and hated to strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. They said, "Let us not mobilize in this heat!" Say, "The fire of Hell is much hotter," if they could only comprehend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Let them laugh a little, and cry a lot. This is the requital for the sins they have earned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD returns you to a situation where they ask your permission to mobilize with you, you shall say, "You will never again mobilize with me, nor will you ever fight with me against any enemy. For you have chosen to be with the sedentary in the first place. Therefore, you must stay with the sedentary."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall not observe the funeral prayer for any of them when he dies, nor shall you stand at his grave. They have disbelieved in GOD and His messenger, and died in a state of wickedness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Worldly Materials Are Nil
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not be impressed by their money or their children; GOD causes these to be sources of misery for them in this world, and their souls depart as disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When a sura is revealed, stating: "Believe in GOD, and strive with His messenger," even the strong among them say, "Let us stay behind!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They chose to be with the sedentary. Consequently, their hearts were sealed, and thus, they cannot comprehend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: True Believers are Eager to Strive
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for the messenger and those who believed with him, they eagerly strive with their money and their lives. These have deserved all the good things; they are the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Arabs made up excuses, and came to you seeking permission to stay behind. This is indicative of their rejection of GOD and His messenger—they stay behind. Indeed, those who disbelieve among them have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Not to be blamed are those who are weak, or ill, or do not find anything to offer, so long as they remain devoted to GOD and His messenger. The righteous among them shall not be blamed. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also excused are those who come to you wishing to be included with you, but you tell them, "I do not have anything to carry you on." They then turn back with tears in their eyes, genuinely saddened that they could not afford to contribute.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The blame is on those who ask your permission to stay behind, even though they have no excuse. They have chosen to be with the sedentary. Consequently, GOD has sealed their hearts, and thus, they do not attain any knowledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Hard Times Serve to Expose the Hypocrites
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They apologize to you when you return to them (from battle). Say, "Do not apologize; we no longer trust you. GOD has informed us about you." GOD will see your works, and so will the messenger, then you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will swear by GOD to you, when you return to them, that you may disregard them. Do disregard them. They are polluted, and their destiny is Hell, as a requital for the sins they have earned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They swear to you, that you may pardon them. Even if you pardon them, GOD does not pardon such wicked people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Arabs
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The Arabs are the worst in disbelief and hypocrisy, and the most likely to ignore the laws that GOD has revealed to His messenger. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some Arabs consider their spending (in the cause of GOD) to be a loss, and even wait in anticipation that a disaster may hit you. It is they who will incur the worst disaster. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Other Arabs do believe in GOD and the Last Day, and consider their spending to be a means towards GOD, and a means of supporting the messenger. Indeed, it will bring them nearer; GOD will admit them into His mercy. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the early vanguards who immigrated (Muhãjerin), and the supporters who gave them refuge (Ansãr) and those who followed them in righteousness, GOD is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. He has prepared for them gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. This is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Retribution Doubled for the Hypocrites
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among the Arabs around you, there are hypocrites. Also, among the city dwellers, there are those who are accustomed to hypocrisy. You do not know them, but we know them. We will double the retribution for them, then they end up committed to a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The hypocrites sit among the believers, listen to the message and proofs, then spread their poisonous doubts. It is a Quranic law that they receive double the retribution, now and forever.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: There are others who have confessed their sins; they have mixed good deeds with bad deeds. GOD will redeem them, for GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Take from their money a charity to purify them and sanctify them. And encourage them, for your encouragement reassures them. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not realize that GOD accepts the repentance of His worshipers, and takes the charities, and that GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Work righteousness; GOD will see your work, and so will His messenger and the believers. Ultimately, you will be returned to the Knower of all secrets and declarations, then He will inform you of everything you had done."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Others are waiting for GOD's decision; He may punish them, or He may redeem them. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Masjids that Oppose God and His Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: There are those who abuse the masjid by practicing idol worship, dividing the believers, and providing comfort to those who oppose GOD and His messenger. They solemnly swear: "Our intentions are honorable!" GOD bears witness that they are liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Any masjid where the practices are not devoted absolutely to God ALONE belongs to Satan, not God. For example, mentioning the names of Abraham, Muhammad, and/or Ali in the Azan and/or the Salat prayers violates God's commandments in 2:136, 2:285, 3:84, & 72:18. Unfortunately, this is a common idolatrous practice throughout the corrupted Muslim world.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Do Not Pray in Those Masjids
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall never pray in such a masjid. A masjid that is established on the basis of righteousness from the first day is more worthy of your praying therein. In it, there are people who love to be purified. GOD loves those who purify themselves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is one who establishes his building on the basis of reverencing GOD and to gain His approval better, or one who establishes his building on the brink of a crumbling cliff, that falls down with him into the fire of Hell? GOD does not guide the transgressing people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such a building that they have established remains a source of doubt in their hearts, until their hearts are stilled. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Most Profitable Investment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD has bought from the believers their lives and their money in exchange for Paradise. Thus, they fight in the cause of GOD, willing to kill and get killed. Such is His truthful pledge in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran—and who fulfills His pledge better than GOD? You shall rejoice in making such an exchange. This is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They are the repenters, the worshipers, the praisers, the meditators, the bowing and prostrating, the advocators of righteousness and forbidders of evil, and the keepers of GOD's laws. Give good news to such believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Disown God's Enemies Abraham Disowned His Father
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Neither the prophet, nor those who believe shall ask forgiveness for the idol worshipers, even if they were their nearest of kin, once they realize that they are destined for Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The only reason Abraham asked forgiveness for his father was that he had promised him to do so. But as soon as he realized that he was an enemy of GOD, he disowned him. Abraham was extremely kind, clement.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD does not send any people astray, after He had guided them, without first pointing out for them what to expect. GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He controls life and death. You have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has redeemed the prophet, and the immigrants (Muhãjireen) and the supporters who hosted them and gave them refuge (Ansãr), who followed him during the difficult times. That is when the hearts of some of them almost wavered. But He has redeemed them, for He is Compassionate towards them, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do Not Abandon the Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Also (redeemed were) the three who stayed behind. The spacious earth became so straitened for them, that they almost gave up all hope for themselves. Finally, they realized that there was no escape from GOD, except to Him. He then redeemed them that they may repent. GOD is the Redeemer, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall reverence GOD, and be among the truthful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Neither the dwellers of the city, nor the Arabs around them, shall seek to stay behind the messenger of GOD (when he mobilizes for war). Nor shall they give priority to their own affairs over supporting him. This is because they do not suffer any thirst, or any effort, or hunger in the cause of GOD, or make a single step that enrages the disbelievers, or inflict any hardship upon the enemy, without having it written down for them as a credit. GOD never fails to recompense those who work righteousness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor do they incur any expense, small or large, nor do they cross any valley, without having the credit written down for them. GOD will surely reward them generously for their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Importance of Religious Education
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When the believers mobilize, not all of them shall do so. A few from each group shall mobilize by devoting their time to studying the religion. Thus, they can pass the knowledge on to their people when they return, that they may remain religiously informed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall fight the disbelievers who attack you—let them find you stern—and know that GOD is with the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Hypocrites
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When a sura was revealed, some of them would say, "Did this sura strengthen the faith of anyone among you?" Indeed, it did strengthen the faith of those who believed, and they rejoice in any revelation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who harbored doubts in their hearts, it actually added unholiness to their unholiness, and they died as disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not see that they suffer from exacting trials every year once or twice? Yet, they consistently fail to repent, and fail to take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A Historical Crime Unveiled: Tampering With the Word of God.* God Provides Irrefutable Evidence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whenever a sura was revealed, some of them would look at each other as if to say: "Does anyone see you?" Then they left. Thus, GOD has diverted their hearts, for they are people who do not comprehend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A. L. R. These (letters) are the proofs of this book of wisdom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These letters constitute a major portion of the Quran's awesome mathematical code and proof of divine authorship. See Appendix 1 for details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Is it too much of a wonder for the people that we inspired a man like them? He (was inspired to say), "You shall warn the people, and give good news to those who believe that they have attained a position of prominence at their Lord." The disbelievers said, "This is a clever magician!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your only Lord is GOD; the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days, then assumed all authority. He controls all matters. There is no intercessor, except in accordance with His will. Such is GOD your Lord. You shall worship Him. Would you not take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him is your ultimate return, all of you. This is GOD's truthful promise. He initiates the creation, then repeats it, in order to reward those who believe and lead a righteous life, equitably. As for those who disbelieve, they incur hellish drinks, and a painful retribution for their disbelieving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who rendered the sun radiant, and the moon a light, and He designed its phases that you may learn to count the years and to calculate. GOD did not create all this, except for a specific purpose. He explains the revelations for people who know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, in the alternation of night and day, and what GOD created in the heavens and the earth, there are proofs for people who are righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Preoccupation With This World
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who are not expecting to meet us, and are preoccupied with this worldly life and are content with it, and refuse to heed our proofs;
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: these have incurred Hell as their ultimate abode, as a consequence of their own works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Guides the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, their Lord guides them, by virtue of their belief. Rivers will flow beneath them in the gardens of bliss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their prayer therein is: "Be You glorified, our god," their greeting therein is, "Peace," and their ultimate prayer is: "Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD hastened the retribution incurred by the people, the way they demand provisions, they would have been annihilated long ago. However, we leave those who do not believe in meeting us in their transgressions, blundering.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When adversity touches the human being, he implores us while lying down, or sitting, or standing up. But as soon as we relieve his adversity, he goes on as if he never implored us to relieve any hardship! The works of the transgressors are thus adorned in their eyes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lessons from the Past
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Many a generation we have annihilated before you when they transgressed. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they refused to believe. We thus requite the guilty people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Now It Is Your Turn
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Then we made you inheritors of the earth after them, to see how you will do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every Letter Calculated and Divinely Designed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our revelations are recited to them, those who do not expect to meet us say, "Bring a Quran other than this, or change it!" Say, "I cannot possibly change it on my own. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of an awesome day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The word "Quran" is mentioned in the Quran 58 times, but since this verse refers to "another Quran," it must be excluded; "This Quran" is mentioned in the Quran 57 times, 19x3.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "Had GOD willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would you have known anything about it. I have lived among you a whole life before this (and you have known me as a sane, truthful person). Do you not understand?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who is more evil than one who fabricates lies about GOD, or rejects His revelations. Certainly, the transgressors never succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They worship beside GOD idols that possess no power to harm them or benefit them, and they say, "These are our intercessors at GOD!" Say, "Are you informing GOD of something He does not know in the heavens or the earth?" Be He glorified. He is the Most High; far above needing partners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The people used to be one congregation, then they disputed. If it were not for a predetermined word from your Lord, they would have been judged immediately regarding their disputes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Miracle of the Quran to be Unveiled After Muhammad
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They say, "How come no miracle came down to him from his Lord?" Say, "The future belongs to GOD; so wait, and I am waiting along with you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In retrospect, we see now that the Quran's miracle, indeed "One of the greatest miracles" (74:30-35), was divinely predestined to be unveiled 14 centuries after Muhammad. In view of the current condition of the traditional Muslims, if Muhammad had been given this miracle, those Muslims, who are already idolizing Muhammad beside God, would have worshiped him as God incarnate. Additionally, this miracle is obviously designed for the computer age, and to be appreciated by mathematically sophisticated generations.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Rebellious Humans
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When we bestow mercy upon the people, after adversity had afflicted them, they immediately scheme against our revelations! Say, "GOD's scheming is far more effective. For our messengers are recording everything you scheme."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who moves you across the land and sea. You get onto the ships, and they sail smoothly in nice breeze. Then, while rejoicing therein, violent wind blows, and the waves surround them from every side. This is when they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone: "If You only save us this time, we will be eternally appreciative."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But as soon as He saves them, they transgress on earth, and oppose the truth. O people, your transgression is only to the detriment of your own souls. You remain preoccupied with this worldly life, then to us is your ultimate return, then we inform you of everything you had done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The analogy of this worldly life is like this: we send down water from the sky to produce with it all kinds of plants from the earth, and to provide food for the people and the animals. Then, just as the earth is perfectly adorned, and its people think that they are in control thereof, our judgment comes by night or by day, leaving it completely barren, as if nothing existed the previous day. We thus explain the revelations for people who reflect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God, of course, knows whether His judgment will come during the day, or during the night. But it just happens that the earth will be half day and half night when the end of the world comes. Another "scientific miracle" of the Quran.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD invites to the abode of peace, and guides whomever He wills in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Heaven and Hell are Eternal
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: For the righteous, the reward will be multiplied manifold. Their faces will never experience any deprivation or shame. These are the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who earned sins, their requital is equivalent to their sin. Humiliation is their lot, and no one beside GOD can protect them. Their faces will seem overwhelmed by masses of dark night. They will be the dwellers of Hell; they abide therein forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idols Disown Their Worshipers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: On the day when we summon them all, we will say to those who worshiped idols, "We have summoned you, together with your idols." We will have them confront each other, and their idols will say to them, "We had no idea that you idolized us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD suffices as a witness between us and you, that we were completely unaware of your worshiping us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is when each soul will examine everything it had done. They will be returned to GOD, their rightful Lord and Master, and the idols they had fabricated will disown them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? Who controls all the hearing and the eyesight? Who produces the living from the dead, and the dead from the living? Who is in control of all things?" They would say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you not observe the commandments?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is GOD, your rightful Lord. What is there after the truth, except falsehood? How could you disregard all this?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is what your Lord's decision does to those who choose to be wicked: they cannot believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Reflect on Your Idols
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Can any of your idols initiate creation, then repeat it?" Say, "GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Does any of your idols guide to the truth?" Say, "GOD guides to the truth. Is one who guides to the truth more worthy of being followed, or one who does not guide, and needs guidance for himself? What is wrong with your judgment?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most of them follow nothing but conjecture, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only God Can Author the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This Quran could not possibly be authored by other than GOD. It confirms all previous messages, and provides a fully detailed scripture. It is infallible; for it comes from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they say, "He fabricated it," say, "Then produce one sura like these, and invite whomever you wish, other than GOD, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, they have rejected this without studying and examining it, and before understanding it. Thus did those before them disbelieve. Therefore, note the consequences for the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them believe (in this scripture), while others disbelieve in it. Your Lord is fully aware of the evildoers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they reject you, then say, "I have my works, and you have your works. You are innocent of anything I do, and I am innocent of anything you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them listen to you, but can you make the deaf hear, even though they cannot understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Humans Freely Choose Their Paths
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Some of them look at you, but can you guide the blind, even though they do not see?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD never wrongs the people; it is the people who wrong their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the day when He summons all of them, they will feel as if they lasted in this world one hour of the day, during which they met. Losers indeed are those who disbelieved in meeting GOD; and chose to be misguided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whether we show you some (of the retribution) we promise them, or terminate your life before that, to us is their ultimate return. GOD witnesses everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To each community, a messenger. After their messenger comes, they are judged equitably, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge: "When will this prophecy come to pass, if you are telling the truth?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Messenger Possesses No Power
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "I possess no power to harm myself, or benefit myself; only what GOD wills takes place." Each community has a predetermined life span. Once their interim comes to an end, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Whether His retribution comes to you by night or by day, why are the transgressors in such a hurry?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If it does happen, will you believe then? Why should you believe then? You used to challenge it to come?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It will be said to the transgressors, "Taste the eternal retribution. Are you not requited precisely for what you have earned?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge you to prophesy: "Is this really what will happen?" Say, "Yes indeed, by my Lord, this is the truth, and you can never escape."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What Price Faith
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If any wicked soul possessed everything on earth, it would readily offer it as ransom. They will be ridden with remorse when they see the retribution. They will be judged equitably, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. Absolutely, GOD's promise is truth, but most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He controls life and death, and to Him you will be returned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O people, enlightenment has come to you herein from your Lord, and healing for anything that troubles your hearts, and guidance, and mercy for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joy for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "With GOD's grace and with His mercy they shall rejoice." This is far better than any wealth they can accumulate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Human-made Dietary Prohibitions
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Did you note how GOD sends down to you all kinds of provisions, then you render some of them unlawful, and some lawful?" Say, "Did GOD give you permission to do this? Or, do you fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Does it ever occur to those who fabricate lies about GOD that they will have to face Him on the Day of Resurrection? Certainly, GOD showers the people with His grace, but most of them are unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Knowing God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You do not get into any situation, nor do you recite any Quran, nor do you do anything, without us being witnesses thereof as you do it. Not even an atom's weight is out of your Lord's control, be it in the heavens or the earth. Nor is there anything smaller than an atom, or larger, that is not recorded in a profound record.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Happiness: Now and Forever
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, GOD's allies have nothing to fear, nor will they grieve.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most people think that they have to wait until the Day of Resurrection before they receive their rewards for righteousness, or the retribution for wickedness. But the Quran repeatedly assures the believers that they are guaranteed perfect happiness here in this world, now and forever. At the end of their interim here, they go directly to Paradise (see Appendix 17).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They are those who believe and lead a righteous life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For them, joy and happiness in this world, as well as in the Hereafter. This is GOD's unchangeable law. Such is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not be saddened by their utterances. All power belongs to GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everyone in the heavens and everyone on earth. Those who set up idols beside GOD are really following nothing. They only think that they are following something. They only guess.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who rendered the night for your rest, and rendered the day lighted. These are proofs for people who can hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Gross Blasphemy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "GOD has begotten a son!" Be He glorified. He is the Most Rich. To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. You have no proof to support such a blasphemy. Are you saying about GOD what you do not know?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "Those who fabricate lies about GOD will never succeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They get their temporary share in this world, then to us is their ultimate return, then we commit them to severe retribution for their disbelieving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recite for them the history of Noah. He said to his people, "O my people, if you find my position and my reminding you of GOD's revelations too much for you, then I put my trust in GOD. You should get together with your leaders, agree on a final decision among yourselves, then let me know it without delay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you turn away, then I have not asked you for any wage. My wage comes from GOD. I have been commanded to be a submitter."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They rejected him and, consequently, we saved him and those who joined him in the ark; we made them the inheritors. And we drowned those who rejected our revelations. Note the consequences; they have been warned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Humans Insist on Their Original Sin
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Then we sent after him messengers to their people, and they showed them clear proofs. But they were not to believe in what they had rejected in the past. We thus seal the hearts of the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses and Aaron
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Then we sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his group, with our proofs. But they turned arrogant; and were transgressing people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the truth came to them from us, they said, "This is obviously magic!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "Is this how you describe the truth when it comes to you? Is this magic? How can any magicians prevail?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Did you come to divert us from what we found our parents doing, and to attain positions of prominence for yourselves? We will never join you as believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Truth Prevails
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh said, "Bring to me every experienced magician."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the magicians came, Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you are going to throw."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they threw, Moses said, "What you have produced is magic, and GOD will make it fail. GOD does not support the transgressors' work."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD establishes the truth with His words, despite the criminals.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: None believed with Moses except a few of his people, while fearing the tyranny of Pharaoh and his elders. Surely, Pharaoh was much too arrogant on earth, and a real tyrant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "O my people, if you have really believed in GOD, then put your trust in Him, if you are really submitters."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We trust in GOD. Our Lord, save us from the persecution of these oppressive people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Deliver us, with Your mercy, from the disbelieving people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We inspired Moses and his brother. "Maintain your homes in Egypt for the time being, turn your homes into synagogues, and maintain the Contact Prayers (Salat). Give good news to the believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "Our Lord, You have given Pharaoh and his elders luxuries and wealth in this world. Our Lord, they only use them to repulse others from Your path. Our Lord, wipe out their wealth, and harden their hearts to prevent them from believing, until they see the painful retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your prayer has been answered (O Moses and Aaron), so be steadfast, and do not follow the ways of those who do not know."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We delivered the Children of Israel across the sea. Pharaoh and his troops pursued them, aggressively and sinfully. When drowning became a reality for him, he said, "I believe that there is no god except the One in whom the Children of Israel have believed; I am a submitter."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Too late! For you have rebelled already, and chose to be a transgressor.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believing in God is the first step. Thereafter, one needs to nourish and develop the soul through the practices of worship (see Appendix 15).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh's Body Preserved
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Today, we will preserve your body, to set you up as a lesson for future generations." Unfortunately, many people are totally oblivious to our signs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God endowed the Egyptians with the exclusive knowledge of mummification. Today, Pharaoh's mummified body is on display at the Cairo Museum.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We have endowed the Children of Israel with a position of honor, and blessed them with good provisions. Yet, they disputed when this knowledge came to them. Your Lord will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they disputed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Messenger's Doubt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you have any doubt regarding what is revealed to you from your Lord, then ask those who read the previous scripture. Indeed, the truth has come to you from your Lord. Do not be with the doubters.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor shall you join those who rejected GOD's revelations, lest you be with the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those condemned by a decree from your Lord cannot believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No matter what kind of proof you show them, (they cannot believe), until they see the painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believing Nations Prosper
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Any community that believes will surely be rewarded for believing. For example, the people of Jonah: when they believed, we relieved the humiliating retribution they had been suffering in this world, and we made them prosperous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had your Lord willed, all the people on earth would have believed. Do you want to force the people to become believers?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The test demands that we denounce idolatry on our own, without divine intervention in our initial decision. God blocks out those who choose to disbelieve.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Blocked Out
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: No soul can believe except in accordance with GOD's will. For He places a curse upon those who refuse to understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Look at all the signs in the heavens and the earth." All the proofs and all the warnings can never help people who decided to disbelieve.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Can they expect other than the fate of their counterparts in the past? Say, "Just wait, and, along with you, I am also waiting."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Guaranteed Victory
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We ultimately save our messengers and those who believe. It is our immutable law that we save the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "O people, if you have any doubt regarding my religion, I do not worship what you worship beside GOD. I worship GOD alone; the One who will terminate your lives. I am commanded to be a believer."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: I was commanded: "Keep yourself devoted to the religion of monotheism; you shall not practice idol worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall not worship beside GOD what possesses no power to benefit you or harm you. If you do, you will be a transgressor."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Power Belongs To God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If GOD touches you with a hardship, none can relieve it except He. And when He blesses you, no force can prevent His grace. He bestows it upon whomever He chooses from among His servants. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "O people, the truth has come to you herein from your Lord. Whoever is guided is guided for his own good. And whoever goes astray, goes astray to his own detriment. I am not a guardian over you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Follow what is revealed to you, and be patient until GOD issues His judgment; He is the best judge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A.L.R. This is a scripture whose verses have been perfected, then elucidated. It comes from a Most Wise, Most Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our generation is fortunate to witness two awesome phenomena in the Quran: (1) an extraordinary mathematical code (Appendix 1), and (2) a literary miracle of incredible dimensions. If humans attempt to write a mathematically structured work, the numerical manipulations will adversely affect the literary quality. The Quran sets the standard for literary excellence.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Quran: Messenger of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Proclaiming: "You shall not worship except GOD. I come to you from Him as a warner, as well as a bearer of good news.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall seek your Lord's forgiveness, then repent to Him. He will then bless you generously for a predetermined period, and bestow His grace upon those who deserve it. If you turn away, then I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD is your ultimate return, and He is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, they hide their innermost thoughts, as if to keep Him from knowing them. In fact, as they cover themselves with their clothes, He knows all their secrets and declarations. He knows the innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Provisions Guaranteed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: There is not a creature on earth whose provision is not guaranteed by GOD. And He knows its course and its final destiny. All are recorded in a profound record.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth in six days—and His (earthly) domain was completely covered with water—in order to test you, to distinguish those among you who work righteousness. Yet, when you say, "You will be resurrected after death," those who disbelieve would say, "This is clearly witchcraft."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
The six days are simply a yardstick providing us with a lot of information. Thus, we learn that the vast lifeless physical universe was created in two days, while the tiny mote called "Earth" was created in four days (41:10-12). The provision of food, water, and oxygen for the earth's inhabitants had to be precisely calculated and arranged.

±±11:7 The earth was initially covered with water. Subsequently, the land mass emerged, and the continents drifted apart.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And if we delay the retribution they have incurred—for we reserve it for a specific community—they say, "What is keeping Him?" In fact, once it comes to them, nothing can stop it, and their mocking will come back to haunt them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whenever we bless the human being with mercy from us, then remove it, he turns despondent, unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whenever we bless him, after adversity had afflicted him, he says, "All adversity has gone away from me;" he becomes excited, proud.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who steadfastly persevere, and lead a righteous life, they deserve forgiveness and a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Revelation is Heavy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You may wish to disregard some of that which is revealed to you, and you may be annoyed by it. Also, they may say, "How come no treasure comes down to him, or an angel?" You are only a warner; GOD controls all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran: Impossible to Imitate
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If they say, "He fabricated (the Quran)," tell them, "Then produce ten suras like these, fabricated, and invite whomever you can, other than GOD, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran's mathematical miracle is inimitable (See Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: If they fail to meet your challenge, then know that this is revealed with GOD's knowledge, and that there is no god except He. Will you then submit?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who pursue this worldly life and its material vanities, we will pay them for their works in this life; without the least reduction.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is they who gave up their share in the Hereafter, and, consequently, Hell is their lot. All their works are in vain; everything they have done is nullified.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran's Mathematical Code
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who are given solid proof from their Lord, reported by a witness from Him, and before it, the book of Moses has set a precedent and a mercy, they will surely believe. As for those who disbelieve among the various groups, Hell is awaiting them. Do not harbor any doubt; this is the truth from your Lord, but most people disbelieve.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
The Quran's 19-based mathematical code is a built-in proof of divine authorship. It is noteworthy that the word "Bayyinah" (proof) is mentioned in the Quran 19 times.

±±11:17 As it turns out, Moses' book was also mathematically composed, with "19" as the common denominator. See Footnote 46:10 and Appendix 1.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Who are more evil than those who fabricate lies about GOD? They will be presented before their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied about their Lord. GOD's condemnation has befallen the transgressors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They repel from the way of GOD and seek to make it crooked, and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: These will never escape, nor will they find any lords or masters to help them against GOD. Retribution will be doubled for them. They have failed to hear, and they have failed to see.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These are the ones who lose their souls, and the idols they had fabricated will disown them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There is no doubt that, in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, and devote themselves to their Lord, they are the dwellers of Paradise; they abide therein forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The example of these two groups is like the blind and deaf, compared to the seer and hearer. Are they equal? Would you not take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "I come to you as a clear warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall not worship except GOD. I fear for you the retribution of a painful day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "We see that you are no more than a human being like us, and we see that the first people to follow you are the worst among us. We see that you do not possess any advantage over us. Indeed, we think you are liars."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, what if I have a solid proof from my Lord? What if He has blessed me out of His mercy, though you cannot see it? Are we going to force you to believe therein?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, I do not ask you for any money; my wage comes only from GOD. I am not dismissing those who believed; they will meet their Lord (and He alone will judge them). I see that you are ignorant people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, who can support me against GOD, if I dismiss them? Would you not take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Power Belongs to God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "I do not claim that I possess the treasures of GOD, nor do I know the future, nor do I claim to be an angel. Nor do I say to those despised by your eyes that GOD will not bestow any blessings upon them. GOD knows best what is in their innermost thoughts. (If I did this,) I would be a transgressor."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Noah, you have argued with us, and kept on arguing. We challenge you to bring the doom you threaten us with, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "GOD is the One who brings it to you, if He so wills, then you cannot escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Even if I advised you, my advice cannot benefit you if it is GOD's will to send you astray. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they say, "He made up this story," then say, "If I made it up, then I am responsible for my crime, and I am innocent of any crime you commit."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah was inspired: "No more of your people are going to believe, beyond those who already believe. Do not be saddened by their actions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Build the ark under our watchful eyes, and with our inspiration, and do not implore Me on behalf of those who have transgressed; they are destined to drown."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He Who Laughs Last Laughs Best
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: While he was building the ark, whenever some of his people passed by him they laughed at him. He said, "You may be laughing at us, but we are laughing at you, just as you are laughing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You will surely find out who will suffer a shameful retribution, and incur an everlasting punishment."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our judgment came, and the atmosphere boiled over, we said, "Carry on it a pair of each kind, together with your family, except those who are condemned. Carry with you those who have believed," and only a few have believed with him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: & 44 This is God's proven truth: Noah's ark was made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13). Contrary to common belief, the flood was limited to the area around today's Dead Sea, and the animals were only Noah's livestock; not every animal that lived on earth.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He said, "Come on board. In the name of GOD shall be its sailing, and its mooring. My Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As it sailed with them in waves like hills, Noah called his son, who was isolated: "O my son, come ride with us; do not be with the disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I will take refuge on top of a hill, to protect me from the water." He said, "Nothing can protect anyone today from GOD's judgment; only those worthy of His mercy (will be saved)." The waves separated them, and he was among those who drowned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Where Did the Ark Land
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: It was proclaimed: "O earth, swallow your water," and "O sky, cease." The water then subsided; the judgment was fulfilled. The ark finally rested on the hills of Judea. It was then proclaimed: "The transgressors have perished."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah implored his Lord: "My Lord, my son is a member of my family, and Your promise is the truth. You are the wisest of the wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Myth of Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "O Noah, he is not of your family. It is unrighteous to ask Me for something you do not know. I enlighten you, lest you be like the ignorant."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Intercession is Satan's most effective bait to entice people into idol worship. However, Abraham could not help his father, nor could Noah help his son, nor could Muhammad help his own relatives (2:254, 9:80 & 114).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You, lest I implore You again for something I do not know. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be with the losers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It was proclaimed: "O Noah, disembark, with peace and blessings upon you, and upon nations who will descend from your companions. As for the other nations descending from you, we will bless them for awhile, then commit them to painful retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You had no knowledge about them—neither you, nor your people—before this. Therefore, be patient. The ultimate victory belongs to the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Hûd: One and the Same Message
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To 'Ãd we sent their brother Hûd. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god besides Him. You are inventing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, I do not ask you for any wage. My wage comes only from the One who initiated me. Do you not understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, seek forgiveness from your Lord, then repent to Him. He will then shower you with provisions from the sky, and augment your strength. Do not turn back into transgressors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Hûd, you did not show us any proof, and we are not abandoning our gods on account of what you say. We will never be believers with you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We believe that some of our gods have afflicted you with a curse." He said, "I bear witness before GOD, and you bear witness as well, that I disown the idols you have set up—
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "—beside Him. So, give me your collective decision, without delay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I have put my trust in GOD, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature that He does not control. My Lord is on the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you turn away, I have delivered to you what I was sent with. My Lord will substitute other people in your place; you cannot harm Him in the least. My Lord is in control of all things."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our judgment came, we saved Hûd and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. We saved them from a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such was 'Ãd—they disregarded the revelations of their Lord, disobeyed His messengers, and followed the ways of every stubborn tyrant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, they incurred condemnation in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, 'Ãd rejected their Lord. Indeed, 'Ãd, the people of Hûd, have perished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sãleh: One and the Same Message
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To Thamûd we sent their brother Sãleh. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. He initiated you from the earth, then settled you in it. You shall seek His forgiveness, then repent to Him. My Lord is always near, responsive."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Sãleh, you used to be popular among us before this. Are you enjoining us from worshiping what our parents are worshiping? We are full of doubt concerning everything you have told us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Always Losers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, what if I have solid proof from my Lord, and mercy from Him? Who would support me against GOD, if I disobeyed Him? You can only augment my loss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, this is GOD's camel to serve as a proof for you. You shall let her eat from GOD's earth, and do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur an immediate retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They slaughtered her. He then said, "You have only three days to live. This is a prophecy that is inevitable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our judgment came, we saved Sãleh and those who believed with him by mercy from us, from the humiliation of that day. Your Lord is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who transgressed were annihilated by the disaster, leaving them in their homes, dead.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It was as if they never lived there. Indeed, Thamûd have rejected their Lord. Absolutely, Thamûd have incurred their annihilation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham and Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news, they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and soon brought a roasted calf.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he saw that their hands did not touch it, he became suspicious and fearful of them. They said, "Do not be afraid, we are being dispatched to the people of Lot."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His wife was standing, and she laughed when we gave her the good news about Isaac, and after Isaac, Jacob.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said, "Woe to me, how could I bear a child at my age, and here is my husband; an old man? This is really strange!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Do you find it strange for GOD? GOD has bestowed His mercy and blessings upon you, O inhabitants of the shrine. He is Praiseworthy, Glorious."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When Abraham's fear subsided, and the good news was delivered to him, he proceeded to argue with us on behalf of Lot's people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, Abraham was clement, extremely kind, and obedient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O Abraham, refrain from this. Your Lord's judgment has been issued; they have incurred unavoidable retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Homosexuality Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our messengers went to Lot, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by their presence. He said, "This is a difficult day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His people came rushing; they had grown accustomed to their sinful acts. He said, "O my people, it would be purer for you, if you take my daughters instead. You shall reverence GOD; do not embarrass me with my guests. Have you not one reasonable man among you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "You know well that we have no need for your daughters; you know exactly what we want."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I wish I were strong enough, or had a powerful ally!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (The angels) said, "O Lot, we are your Lord's messengers, and these people cannot touch you. You shall leave with your family during the night, and let not anyone of you look back, except your wife; she is condemned along with those who are condemned. Their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning soon enough?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sodom & Gomorrah Destroyed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our judgment came, we turned it upside down, and we showered it with hard, devastating rocks.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such rocks were designated by your Lord to strike the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shu'aib: One and the Same Message
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, worship GOD; you have no other god beside Him. Do not cheat when you measure or weigh. I see that you are prosperous, and I fear for you the retribution of an overwhelming day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, you shall give full measure and full weight, equitably. Do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Whatever GOD provides for you, no matter how small, is far better for you, if you are really believers. I am not a guardian over you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Shu'aib, does your religion dictate upon you that we must abandon our parents' religion, or running our businesses in any manner we choose? Surely, you are known for being clement, wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, what if I have solid proof from my Lord; what if He has provided me with a great blessing? It is not my wish to commit what I enjoin you from. I only wish to correct as many wrongs as I can. My guidance depends totally on GOD; I have put my trust in Him. To Him I have totally submitted.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And, O my people, do not be provoked by your opposition to me into incurring the same disasters as the people of Noah, or the people of Hûd, or the people of Sãleh; and the people of Lot are not too far from you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall implore your Lord for forgiveness, then repent to Him. My Lord is Most Merciful, Kind."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Shu'aib, we do not comprehend many of the things you are telling us, and we see that you are powerless among us. If it were not for your tribe, we would have stoned you. You have no value for us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, does my tribe command a greater respect than GOD? Is this why you have been heedless of Him? My Lord is fully aware of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, go on doing what you wish, and so will I. You will certainly find out which of us will incur shameful retribution; you will find out who the liar is. Just wait in anticipation, and I will wait in anticipation along with you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our judgment came, we saved Shu'aib and those who believed with him, by mercy from us. As for the evil ones, they were struck by a disaster that left them dead in their homes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It was as though they never existed. Thus, Midyan perished, just like Thamûd had perished before that.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Moses with our signs and a profound authority.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Pharaoh and his elders. But they followed the command of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh's command was not wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will lead his people on the Day of Resurrection, all the way to Hell; what a miserable abode to live in!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have incurred condemnation in this life, as well as on the Day of Resurrection; what a miserable path to follow!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lessons to be Learned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is news from the past communities that we narrate to you. Some are still standing, and some have vanished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We never wronged them; they wronged their own souls. Their gods, whom they invoked beside GOD, could not help them in the least when the judgment of your Lord came. In fact, they only ensured their doom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such was the retribution enforced by your Lord when the communities transgressed. Indeed, His retribution is painful, devastating.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a lesson for those who fear the retribution of the Hereafter. That is a day when all the people will be summoned—a day to be witnessed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have appointed a specific time for it to take place.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day it comes to pass, no soul will utter a single word, except in accordance with His will. Some will be miserable, and some will be happy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the miserable ones, they will be in Hell, wherein they sigh and wail.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eternally they abide therein, for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, in accordance with the will of your Lord. Your Lord is doer of whatever He wills.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the fortunate ones, they will be in Paradise. Eternally they abide therein, for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, in accordance with the will of your Lord—an everlasting reward.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Following Our Parents Blindly A Great Human Tragedy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not have any doubt regarding what these people worship; they worship exactly as they found their parents worshiping. We will requite them their due share fully, without reduction.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given Moses the scripture, but it was disputed, and if it were not for a predetermined word decreed by your Lord, they would have been judged immediately. They are full of doubt about this, suspicious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord will surely recompense everyone for their works. He is fully Cognizant of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, continue on the path you have been enjoined to follow, together with those who repented with you, and do not transgress. He is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992
