segments.text: Do not lean towards those who have transgressed, lest you incur Hell, and find no allies to help you against GOD, then end up losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Three of the Five Prayers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) at both ends of the day, and during the night. The righteous works wipe out the evil works. This is a reminder for those who would take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall steadfastly persevere, for GOD never fails to recompense the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If only some of those among the previous generations possessed enough intelligence to forbid evil! Only a few of them deserved to be saved by us. As for the transgressors, they were preoccupied with their material luxuries; they were guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord never annihilates any community unjustly, while its people are righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Why Were We Created
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Had your Lord willed, all the people would have been one congregation (of believers). But they will always dispute (the truth).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only those blessed with mercy from your Lord (will not dispute the truth). This is why He created them. The judgment of your Lord has already been issued: "I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
The Most Merciful has created us on this earth to give us yet another chance to denounce our original crime and to be redeemed (see the Introduction and Appendix 7).

±±11:119 God does not put a single person in Hell; they choose and insist upon going to Hell.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We narrate to you enough history of the messengers to strengthen your heart. The truth has come to you herein, as well as enlightenments and reminders for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say to those who disbelieve, "Do whatever you can, and so will we.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Then wait; we too will wait."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and all matters are controlled by Him. You shall worship Him and trust in Him. Your Lord is never unaware of anything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A. L. R. These (letters) are proofs of this profound scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quranic initials constitute a major component of a great miracle (App. 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We have revealed it an Arabic Quran, that you may understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Why was the Quran revealed in Arabic? See 41:44 and Appendix 4.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We narrate to you the most accurate history through the revelation of this Quran. Before this, you were totally unaware.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Recall that Joseph said to his father, "O my father, I saw eleven planets, and the sun, and the moon; I saw them prostrating before me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My son, do not tell your brothers about your dream, lest they plot and scheme against you. Surely, the devil is man's worst enemy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Your Lord has thus blessed you, and has given you good news through your dream. He has perfected His blessings upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He did for your ancestors Abraham and Isaac before that. Your Lord is Omniscient, Most Wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In Joseph and his brothers there are lessons for the seekers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Joseph and his brother are favored by our father, and we are in the majority. Indeed, our father is far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph's Fate Already Decided by God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Let us kill Joseph, or banish him, that you may get some attention from your father. Afterwards, you can be righteous people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We learn from Joseph's dream that he was destined for a bright future. Thus, while his brothers met to decide his fate, his fate was already decided by God. Everything is done by God (8:17), and is already recorded (57:22).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: One of them said, "Do not kill Joseph; let us throw him into the abyss of the well. Perhaps some caravan can pick him up, if this is what you decide to do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our father, why do you not trust us with Joseph? We will take good care of him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Send him with us tomorrow to run and play. We will protect him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I worry lest you go away with him, then the wolf may devour him while you are not watching him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Indeed, if the wolf devours him, with so many of us around, then we are really losers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believers are Blessed with God's Assurances
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they went away with him, and unanimously decided to throw him into the abyss of the well, we inspired him: "Some day, you will tell them about all this, while they have no idea."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They came back to their father in the evening, weeping.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our father, we went racing with each other, leaving Joseph with our equipment, and the wolf devoured him. You will never believe us, even if we were telling the truth."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They produced his shirt with fake blood on it. He said, "Indeed, you have conspired with each other to commit a certain scheme. All I can do is resort to a quiet patience. May GOD help me in the face of your conspiracy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph is Taken to Egypt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: A caravan passed by, and soon sent their waterer. He let down his bucket, then said, "How lucky! There is a boy here!" They took him along as merchandise, and GOD was fully aware of what they did.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They sold him for a cheap price— a few Dirhams—for they did not have any need for him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The one who bought him in Egypt said to his wife, "Take good care of him. Maybe he can help us, or maybe we can adopt him." We thus established Joseph on earth, and we taught him the interpretation of dreams. GOD's command is always done, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached maturity, we endowed him with wisdom and knowledge. We thus reward the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Protects the Believers From Sin
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The lady of the house where he lived tried to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "I am all yours." He said, "May GOD protect me. He is my Lord, who gave me a good home. The transgressors never succeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph worded this statement in such a way that the governor's wife thought that he was talking about her husband, when in fact he was talking about God.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: She almost succumbed to him, and he almost succumbed to her, if it were not that he saw a proof from his Lord. We thus diverted evil and sin away from him, for he was one of our devoted servants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The two of them raced towards the door, and, in the process, she tore his garment from the back. They found her husband at the door. She said, "What should be the punishment for one who wanted to molest your wife, except imprisonment or a painful punishment?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "She is the one who tried to seduce me." A witness from her family suggested: "If his garment is torn from the front, then she is telling the truth and he is a liar.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And if his garment is torn from the back, then she lied, and he is telling the truth."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When her husband saw that his garment was torn from the back, he said, "This is a woman's scheme. Indeed, your scheming is formidable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Joseph, disregard this incident. As for you (my wife), you should seek forgiveness for your sin. You have committed an error."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some women in the city gossiped: "The governor's wife is trying to seduce her servant. She is deeply in love with him. We see that she has gone astray."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When she heard of their gossip, she invited them, prepared for them a comfortable place, and gave each of them a knife. She then said to him, "Enter their room." When they saw him, they so admired him, that they cut their hands. They said, "Glory be to GOD, this is not a human being; this is an honorable angel."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is the same word used in 5:38 regarding the hand of the thief, and the sum of sura and verse numbers (12+31 and 5+38) are the same. Therefore, the thief 's hand should be marked, not severed as practiced by the corrupted Islam (see Footnote 5:38).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: She said, "This is the one you blamed me for falling in love with. I did indeed try to seduce him, and he refused. Unless he does what I command him to do, he will surely go to prison, and will be debased."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, the prison is better than giving in to them. Unless You divert their scheming from me, I may desire them and behave like the ignorant ones."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His Lord answered his prayer and diverted their scheming from him. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Later, they saw to it, despite the clear proofs, that they should imprison him for awhile.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Two young men were in the prison with him. One of them said, "I saw (in my dream) that I was making wine," and the other said, "I saw myself carrying bread on my head, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of the interpretation of these dreams. We see that you are righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "If any food is provided to you, I can inform you about it before you receive it. This is some of the knowledge bestowed upon me by my Lord. I have forsaken the religion of people who do not believe in GOD, and with regard to the Hereafter, they are really disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And I followed instead the religion of my ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. We never set up any idols beside GOD. Such is the blessing from GOD upon us and upon the people, but most people are unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my prison mates, are several gods better, or GOD alone, the One, the Supreme?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You do not worship beside Him except innovations that you have made up, you and your parents. GOD has never authorized such idols. All ruling belongs to GOD, and He has ruled that you shall not worship except Him. This is the perfect religion, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my prison mates, one of you will be the wine butler for his lord, while the other will be crucified— the birds will eat from his head. This settles the matter about which you have inquired."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He then said to the one to be saved "Remember me at your lord." Thus, the devil caused him to forget his Lord, and, consequently, he remained in prison a few more years.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When Joseph begged his companion to intercede with the king on his behalf, he exhibited dependence on other than God to be saved from the prison. This does not befit a true believer, and such a serious slip cost Joseph a few years in the prison. We learn from the Quran that only God can relieve any hardship that might befall us. A true believer trusts in God and depends totally on Him alone (1:5, 6:17, 8:17, 10:107).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The King's Dream
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The king said, "I saw seven fat cows being devoured by seven skinny cows, and seven green spikes (of wheat), and others shriveled. O my elders, advise me regarding my dream, if you know how to interpret the dreams."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Nonsense dreams. When it comes to the interpretation of dreams, we are not knowledgeable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The one who was saved (from the prison) said, now that he finally remembered, "I can tell you its interpretation, so send me (to Joseph)."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph Interprets the King's Dream
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Joseph my friend, inform us about seven fat cows being devoured by seven skinny cows, and seven green spikes, and others shriveled. I wish to go back with some information for the people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "What you cultivate during the next seven years, when the time of harvest comes, leave the grains in their spikes, except for what you eat.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "After that, seven years of drought will come, which will consume most of what you stored for them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "After that, a year will come that brings relief for the people, and they will, once again, press juice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The king said, "Bring him to me." When the messenger came to him, he said, "Go back to your lord and ask him to investigate the women who cut their hands. My Lord is fully aware of their schemes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (The king) said (to the women), "What do you know about the incident when you tried to seduce Joseph?" They said, "GOD forbid; we did not know of anything evil committed by him." The wife of the governor said, "Now the truth has prevailed. I am the one who tried to seduce him, and he was the truthful one.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I hope that he will realize that I never betrayed him in his absence, for GOD does not bless the schemes of the betrayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not claim innocence for myself. The self is an advocate of vice, except for those who have attained mercy from my Lord. My Lord is Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph Attains Prominence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The king said, "Bring him to me, so I can hire him to work for me." When he talked with him, he said, "Today, you have a prominent position with us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Make me the treasurer, for I am experienced in this area and knowledgeable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus established Joseph on earth, ruling as he wished. We shower our mercy upon whomever we will, and we never fail to recompense the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additionally, the reward in the Hereafter is even better for those who believe and lead a righteous life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph's brothers came; when they entered, he recognized them, while they did not recognize him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: After he provided them with their provisions, he said, "Next time, bring with you your half-brother. Do you not see that I give full measure, and treat you generously?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you fail to bring him to me, you will get no share from me; you will not even come close."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We will negotiate with his father about him. We will surely do this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He then instructed his assistants: "Put their goods back in their bags. When they find them upon their return to their family, they may come back sooner."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they returned to their father, they said, "Our father, we can no longer get any provisions, unless you send our brother with us. We will take good care of him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Shall I trust you with him, as I trusted you with his brother before that? GOD is the best Protector, and, of all the merciful ones, He is the Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they opened their bags, they found their goods returned to them. They said, "Our father, what more can we ask for? Here are our goods returned to us. We can thus provide for our family, protect our brother, and receive one more camel-load. This is certainly a profitable deal."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I will not send him with you, unless you give me a solemn pledge before GOD that you will bring him back, unless you are utterly overwhelmed." When they gave him their solemn pledge, he said, "GOD is witnessing everything we say."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one door; enter through separate doors. However, I cannot save you from anything that is predetermined by GOD. To GOD belongs all judgments. I trust in Him, and in Him shall all the trusters put their trust."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Jacob Senses Joseph
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they went (to Joseph), they entered in accordance with their father's instructions. Although this could not change anything decreed by GOD, Jacob had a private reason for asking them to do this. For he possessed certain knowledge that we taught him, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Back in Egypt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they entered Joseph's place, he brought his brother closer to him and said, "I am your brother; do not be saddened by their actions."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Joseph Keeps His Brother
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When he provided them with their provisions, he placed the drinking cup in his brother's bag, then an announcer announced: "The owners of this caravan are thieves."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, as they came towards them, "What did you lose?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We lost the king's cup. Anyone who returns it will receive an extra camel-load; I personally guarantee this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "By GOD, you know full well that we did not come here to commit evil, nor are we thieves."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "What is the punishment for the thief, if you are liars?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "The punishment, if it is found in his bag, is that the thief belongs to you. We thus punish the guilty."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He then started by inspecting their containers, before getting to his brother's container, and he extracted it out of his brother's container. We thus perfected the scheme for Joseph; he could not have kept his brother if he applied the king's law. But that was the will of GOD. We exalt whomever we choose to higher ranks. Above every knowledgeable one, there is one who is even more knowledgeable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "If he stole, so did a brother of his in the past." Joseph concealed his feelings in himself, and did not give them any clue. He said (to himself), "You are really bad. GOD is fully aware of your accusations."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, “O you noble one, he has a father who is elderly; would you take one of us in his place? We see that you are a kind man."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "GOD forbid that we should take other than the one in whose possession we found our goods. Otherwise, we would be unjust."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they despaired of changing his mind, they conferred together. Their eldest said, "Do you realize that your father has taken a solemn pledge from you before GOD? In the past you lost Joseph. I am not leaving this place until my father gives me permission, or until GOD judges for me; He is the best Judge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Back In Palestine
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Go back to your father and tell him...'Our father, your son has committed a theft. We know for sure, because this is what we have witnessed. This was an unexpected occurrence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You may ask the community where we were, and the caravan that came back with us. We are telling the truth.'"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Indeed, you have conspired to carry out a certain scheme. Quiet patience is my only recourse. May GOD bring them all back to me. He is the Omniscient, Most Wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He turned away from them, saying, "I am grieving over Joseph." His eyes turned white from grieving so much; he was truly sad.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "By GOD, you will keep on grieving over Joseph until you become ill, or until you die."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I simply complain to GOD about my dilemma and grief, for I know from GOD what you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my sons, go fetch Joseph and his brother, and never despair of GOD's grace. None despairs of GOD's grace except the disbelieving people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Israel Goes to Egypt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they entered (Joseph's) quarters, they said, "O you noble one, we have suffered a lot of hardship, along with our family, and we have brought inferior goods. But we hope that you will give us full measure and be charitable to us. GOD rewards the charitable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Do you recall what you did to Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "You must be Joseph." He said, "I am Joseph, and here is my brother. GOD has blessed us. That is because if one leads a righteous life, and steadfastly perseveres, GOD never fails to reward the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "By GOD, GOD has truly preferred you over us. We were definitely wrong."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "There is no blame upon you today. May GOD forgive you. Of all the merciful ones, He is the Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Take this shirt of mine; when you throw it on my father's face, his vision will be restored. Bring your whole family and come back to me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This marks the beginning of the Children of Israel in Egypt. Moses led them out of Egypt a few centuries later.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Even before the caravan arrived, their father said, "I can sense the smell of Joseph. Will someone enlighten me?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "By GOD, you are still in your old confusion."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the bearer of good news arrived, he threw (the shirt) on his face, whereupon his vision was restored. He said, "Did I not tell you that I knew from GOD what you did not know?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our father, pray for our forgiveness; we were wrong indeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In Egypt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they entered Joseph's quarters, he embraced his parents, saying, "Welcome to Egypt. GOD willing, you will be safe here."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He raised his parents upon the throne. They fell prostrate before him. He said, "O my father, this is the fulfillment of my old dream. My Lord has made it come true. He has blessed me, delivered me from the prison, and brought you from the desert, after the devil had driven a wedge between me and my brothers. My Lord is Most Kind towards whomever He wills. He is the Knower, the Most Wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, You have given me kingship and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Initiator of the heavens and the earth; You are my Lord and Master in this life and in the Hereafter. Let me die as a submitter, and count me with the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is news from the past that we reveal to you. You were not present when they made their unanimous decision (to throw Joseph in the well), as they conspired together.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Majority of People Do Not Believe
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Most people, no matter what you do, will not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You are not asking them for any money; you simply deliver this reminder for all the people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: So many proofs in the heavens and the earth are given to them, but they pass by them, heedlessly!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Majority of Believers Destined for Hell
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The majority of those who believe in GOD do not do so without committing idol worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they guaranteed that an overwhelming retribution from GOD will not strike them, or the Hour will not come to them suddenly, when they least expect it?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "This is my path: I invite to GOD, on the basis of a clear proof, and so do those who follow me. GOD be glorified. I am not an idol worshiper."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired, chosen from the people of various communities. Did they not roam the earth and see the consequences for those before them? The abode of the Hereafter is far better for those who lead a righteous life. Would you then understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Victory, Ultimately, Belongs to the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Just when the messengers despair, and think that they had been rejected, our victory comes to them. We then save whomever we choose, while our retribution for the guilty people is unavoidable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran is All We Need
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: In their history, there is a lesson for those who possess intelligence. This is not fabricated Hadith; this (Quran) confirms all previous scriptures, provides the details of everything, and is a beacon and mercy for those who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A. L. M. R. These (letters) are proofs of this scripture. What is revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most people do not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These initials constitute a major component of the Quran's built-in proof of divine authorship, the miraculous mathematical code. See Appendix 1.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who raised the heavens without pillars that you can see, then assumed all authority. He committed the sun and the moon, each running (in its orbit) for a predetermined period. He controls all things, and explains the revelations, that you may attain certainty about meeting your Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who constructed the earth and placed on it mountains and rivers. And from the different kinds of fruits, He made them into pairs—males and females. The night overtakes the day. These are solid proofs for people who think.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On earth, there are adjacent lots that produce orchards of grapes, crops, palm trees—dioecious and non-dioecious. Although they are irrigated with the same water, we prefer some of them over others in eating. These are solid proofs for people who understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Belief in the Hereafter Required For Salvation
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you ever wonder, the real wonder is their saying: "After we turn into dust, do we get recreated anew?" These are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord. These are the ones who have incurred shackles around their necks. These are the ones who have incurred Hell, wherein they abide forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge you to bring doom upon them, rather than turning righteous! Sufficient precedents have been set for them in the past. Indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness towards the people, in spite of their transgressions, and your Lord is also strict in enforcing retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved say, "If only a miracle could come down to him from his Lord (we will then believe)." You are simply a warner—every community receives a guiding teacher.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD knows what every female bears, and what every womb releases, or gains. Everything He does is perfectly measured.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Supreme, the Most High.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is the same whether you conceal your thoughts, or declare them, or hide in the darkness of the night, or act in the daylight.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shifts (of angels) take turns, staying with each one of you—they are in front of you and behind you. They stay with you, and guard you in accordance with GOD's commands. Thus, GOD does not change the condition of any people unless they themselves make the decision to change. If GOD wills any hardship for any people, no force can stop it. For they have none beside Him as Lord and Master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who shows you the lightning as a source of fear, as well as hope, and He initiates the loaded clouds.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The thunder praises His glory, and so do the angels, out of reverence for Him. He sends the lightning bolts, which strike in accordance with His will. Yet, they argue about GOD, though His power is awesome.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Imploring Him is the only legitimate supplication, while the idols they implore beside Him, cannot ever respond. Thus, they are like those who stretch their hands to the water, but nothing reaches their mouths. The supplications of the disbelievers are in vain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Creation Has Submitted to God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To GOD prostrates everyone in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and so do their shadows in the mornings and the evenings.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Even the disbelievers prostrate; they cannot, for example, control their heartbeats, their lungs, or peristalsis. The shadows are predetermined by God's design of the solar and the lunar orbits, and by the peculiar shape of the planet earth which causes the four seasons. The absolute precision of the sun/earth relation is proven by the invention of solar clocks and their shadows.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who is the Lord of the heavens and the earth?" Say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you set up besides Him masters who do not possess any power to benefit or harm even themselves?" Say, "Is the blind the same as the seer? Is darkness the same as the light?" Have they found idols besides GOD who created creations similar to His creations, to the point of not distinguishing the two creations? Say, "GOD is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Supreme."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Truth vs Falsehood
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He sends down water from the sky, causing the valleys to overflow, then the rapids produce abundant foam. Similarly, when they use fire to refine metals for their jewelry or equipment, foam is produced. GOD thus cites analogies for the truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it goes to waste, while that which benefits the people stays close to the ground. GOD thus cites the analogies.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who respond to their Lord deserve the good rewards. As for those who failed to respond to Him, if they possessed everything on earth—even twice as much—they would readily give it up as ransom. They have incurred the worst reckoning, and their final abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believers Versus Disbelievers (1) The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Is one who recognizes that your Lord's revelations to you are the truth equal to one who is blind? Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are the ones who fulfill their pledge to GOD, and do not violate the covenant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They join what GOD has commanded to be joined, reverence their Lord, and fear the dreadful reckoning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They steadfastly persevere in seeking their Lord, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), spend from our provisions to them secretly and publicly, and counter evil with good. These have deserved the best abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They enter the gardens of Eden, together with the righteous among their parents, their spouses, and their children. The angels will enter to them from every door.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Peace be upon you, because you steadfastly persevered. What a joyous destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (2) The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who violate GOD's covenant after pledging to keep it, and sever what GOD has commanded to be joined, and commit evil, they have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Controls All Provisions
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He wills, or withholds it. They have become preoccupied with this life, and this life, compared to the Hereafter, is nil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve would say, "If only a miracle could come down to him from his Lord (we would believe)." Say, "GOD sends astray whomever He wills, and guides to Him only those who obey."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are the ones whose hearts rejoice in remembering GOD. Absolutely, by remembering GOD, the hearts rejoice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved happiness and a joyous destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent you (O Rashad) to this community, just as we did for other communities in the past. You shall recite to them what we reveal to you, for they have disbelieved in the Most Gracious. Say, "He is my Lord. There is no god except He. I put my trust in Him alone; to Him is my ultimate destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we add the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the sura number (13), plus the verse number (30), we get 505+725+13+30 = 1273 = 19x67. God thus specifies the name of His messenger (see Appendix 2 for the details).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Even if a Quran caused mountains to move, or the earth to tear asunder, or the dead to speak (they will not believe). GOD controls all things. Is it not time for the believers to give up and realize that if GOD willed, He could have guided all the people? The disbelievers will continue to suffer disasters, as a consequence of their own works, or have disasters strike close to them, until GOD's promise is fulfilled. GOD will never change the predetermined destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Messengers Must Be Ridiculed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Messengers before you have been ridiculed; I permitted the disbelievers to carry on, then I punished them. How terrible was My retribution!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is there any equal to the One who controls every single soul? Yet, they set up idols to rival GOD. Say, "Name them. Are you informing Him of something on earth that He does not know? Or, are you fabricating empty statements?" Indeed, the schemes of those who disbelieve have been adorned in their eyes. They are thus diverted from the right path. Whomever GOD sends astray can never find a guiding teacher.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have incurred retribution in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter is far worse. Nothing can protect them against GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Heaven Allegorically Described
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The allegory of Heaven, which is promised for the righteous, is flowing streams, inexhaustible provisions, and cool shade. Such is the destiny for those who observe righteousness, while the destiny for the disbelievers is Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who received the scripture rejoice in what was revealed to you; some others may reject parts of it. Say, "I am simply enjoined to worship GOD, and never associate any idols with Him. I invite to Him, and to Him is my ultimate destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Authorization of the Quran's Mathematical Code
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We revealed these laws in Arabic, and if you ever acquiesce to their wishes, after this knowledge has come to you, you will have no ally, nor a protector, against GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The verse number (38) = 19x2. Placing the values of "Rashad" (505) and "Khalifa" (725) next to 13:37-38, gives 505 725 13 37 38, or 19x26617112302 (Appendix 2).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We have sent messengers before you (O Rashad), and we made them husbands with wives and children. No messenger can produce a miracle without GOD's authorization, and in accordance with a specific, predetermined time.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD erases whatever He wills, and fixes. With Him is the original Master Record.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whether we show you what we promise them, or terminate your life before that, your sole mission is to deliver (the message). It is us who will call them to account.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not see that every day on earth, brings them closer to the end, and that GOD decides their life span, irrevocably? He is the most efficient Reckoner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Others before them have schemed, but to GOD belongs the ultimate scheming. He knows what everyone is doing. The disbelievers will find out who the ultimate winners are.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved will say, "You are not a messenger!" Say, "GOD suffices as a witness between me and you, and those who possess knowledge of the scripture."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A. L. R. A scripture that we revealed to you, in order to lead the people out of darkness into the light—in accordance with the will of their Lord —to the path of the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These initials remained a divinely guarded secret until the Quran's mathematical code was discovered in 1974 A.D. See Appendix 1 for the significance of these initials.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: (The path of) GOD; the One who possesses everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Woe to the disbelievers; they have incurred a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What is Your Priority?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They are the ones who give priority to this life over the Hereafter, repel from the way of GOD, and seek to make it crooked; they have gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Messenger's Language
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We did not send any messenger except (to preach) in the tongue of his people, in order to clarify things for them. GOD then sends astray whomever He wills, and guides whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Thus, we sent Moses with our miracles, saying, "Lead your people out of darkness into the light, and remind them of the days of GOD." These are lessons for every steadfast, appreciative person.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Importance of Being Appreciative
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that Moses said to his people, "Remember GOD's blessings upon you. He saved you from Pharaoh's people who inflicted the worst persecution upon you, slaughtering your sons and sparing your daughters. That was an exacting trial from your Lord."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Appreciative vs Unappreciative
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Your Lord has decreed: "The more you thank Me, the more I give you." But if you turn unappreciative, then My retribution is severe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "If you disbelieve, along with all the people on earth, GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Egotistic Defiance: A Human Trait
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have you not heard about those before you—the people of Noah, 'Ãd, Thamûd, and others who came after them and known only to GOD? Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they treated them with contempt and said, "We disbelieve in what you are sent with. We are skeptical about your message; full of doubt."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Following Our Parents Blindly: A Great Human Tragedy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Their messengers said, "Do you have doubts about GOD; the Initiator of the heavens and the earth? He invites you only to forgive your sins, and to give you another chance to redeem yourselves." They said, "You are no more than humans like us, who want to repel us from the way our parents used to worship. Show us some profound authority."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their messengers said to them, "We are no more than humans like you, but GOD blesses whomever He chooses from among His servants. We could not possibly show you any kind of authorization, except in accordance with GOD's will. In GOD the believers shall trust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Why should we not trust in GOD, when He has guided us in our paths? We will steadfastly persevere in the face of your persecution. In GOD all the trusters shall trust."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will banish you from our land, unless you revert to our religion." Their Lord inspired them: "We will inevitably annihilate the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And we will let you dwell in their land after them. This is (the reward) for those who reverence My majesty, and reverence My promise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They issued a challenge, and consequently, every stubborn tyrant ended up doomed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Awaiting him is Hell, wherein he will drink putrid water.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will gulp it down, though he cannot stand it, as death comes to him from every direction, but he will never die. Awaiting him is a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we rebelled against God, and agreed with Satan during the great feud (38:69), the angels suggested that we should be banished to Hell (Appendix 7). But the Most Merciful decided to give us another chance to redeem ourselves. He said to the angels, "I know what you do not know" (2:30). God knew that many humans would have protested that they had no idea how bad Hell was. The awesome description of Hell in 14:17 and in 22:19-22, nullifies such a protest. Now we have a pretty good idea how terrible Hell is.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The allegory of those who disbelieve in their Lord: their works are like ashes in a violent wind, on a stormy day. They gain nothing from whatever they earn; such is the farthest straying.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Worship Only the Omnipotent One
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that GOD has created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose? If He wills, He can remove you, and substitute a new creation in your place.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is not too difficult for GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they all stand before GOD, the followers will say to the leaders, "We used to follow you. Can you spare us even a little bit of GOD's retribution?" They will say, "Had GOD guided us, we would have guided you. Now it is too late, whether we grieve or resort to patience, there is no exit for us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Frequently, the Quran talks about the Hereafter in the past tense. This is because those are future events already witnessed by God, and will surely come to pass.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Satan Disowns His Followers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And the devil will say, after the judgment had been issued, "GOD has promised you the truthful promise, and I promised you, but I broke my promise. I had no power over you; I simply invited you, and you accepted my invitation. Therefore, do not blame me, and blame only yourselves. My complaining cannot help you, nor can your complaining help me. I have disbelieved in your idolizing me. The transgressors have incurred a painful retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they will be admitted into gardens with flowing streams. They abide therein forever, in accordance with the will of their Lord. Their greeting therein is: "Peace."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Truth vs Falsehood
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that GOD has cited the example of the good word as a good tree whose root is firmly fixed, and its branches are high in the sky?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It produces its crop every season, as designed by its Lord. GOD thus cites the examples for the people, that they may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And the example of the bad word is that of a bad tree chopped at the soil level; it has no roots to keep it standing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD strengthens those who believe with the proven word, in this life and in the Hereafter. And GOD sends the transgressors astray. Everything is in accordance with GOD's will.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Remove Their Families From God's Protection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have you noted those who responded to GOD's blessings by disbelieving, and thus brought disaster upon their own families?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idol Worship: The Mother of All Evil
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Hell is their destiny, wherein they burn; what a miserable end!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Crucial Commandments
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They set up rivals to rank with GOD and to divert others from His path. Say, "Enjoy for awhile; your final destiny is Hell."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Exhort My servants who believed to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and to give (to charity) from our provisions to them, secretly and publicly, before a day comes where there is neither trade, nor nepotism.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and He sends down from the sky water to produce all kinds of fruit for your sustenance. He has committed the ships to serve you on the sea in accordance with His command. He has committed the rivers as well to serve you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He has committed the sun and the moon in your service, continuously. He has committed the night and the day to serve you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He gives you all kinds of things that you implore Him for. If you count GOD's blessings, you can never encompass them. Indeed, the human being is transgressing, unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a peaceful land, and protect me and my children from worshiping idols.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, they have misled so many people. As for those who follow me, they belong with me. As for those who disobey me, You are Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Our Lord, I have settled part of my family in this plantless valley, at Your Sacred House. Our Lord, they are to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), so let throngs of people converge upon them, and provide for them all kinds of fruits, that they may be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Our Lord, You know whatever we conceal and whatever we declare— nothing is hidden from GOD on earth, nor in the heavens.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Praise be to GOD for granting me, despite my old age, Ismail and Isaac. My Lord answers the prayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Contact Prayers: Gift From God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, make me one who consistently observes the Contact Prayers (Salat), and also my children. Our Lord, please answer my prayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, forgive me and my parents, and the believers, on the day when the reckoning takes place."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not ever think that GOD is unaware of what the transgressors are doing. He only respites them until a day where the eyes stare in horror.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As they rush (out of the graves), their faces will be looking upward, their eyes will not even blink, and their minds will be horrified.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Sends His Commands Through His Messengers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall warn the people of the day when the retribution comes to them. Those who transgressed will say, "Our Lord, give us one more respite. We will then respond to Your call and follow the messengers." Did you not swear in the past that you will last forever?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You dwelled in the homes of those before you, who wronged their souls, and you have seen clearly what we did to them. We have set many precedents for you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They schemed their schemes, and GOD is fully aware of their schemes. Indeed, their schemes were sufficient to erase mountains.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Guaranteed Victory for God's Messengers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not think that GOD will ever break His promise to His messengers. GOD is Almighty, Avenger.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: New Heavens and New Earth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The day will come when this earth will be substituted with a new earth, and also the heavens, and everyone will be brought before GOD, the One, the Supreme.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This prophecy is also found in the Old Testament (Isaiah 65:17 & 66:22) and the New Testament: "What we await are new heavens and a new earth where, according to his promise, the justice of God will reside." (2 Peter 3:13).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And you will see the guilty on that day chained in shackles.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their garments will be made of tar, and fire will overwhelm their faces.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For GOD will pay each soul for whatever it earned; GOD is the most efficient reckoner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is a proclamation for the people, to be warned herewith, and to let them know that He is only one god, and for those who possess intelligence to take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A.L.R. These (letters) are proofs of this scripture; a profound Quran.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: & ±15:9 The divine source and the perfect preservation of the Quran are proven by the Quran's mathematical code (App. 1). God's Messenger of the Covenant was destined to unveil this great miracle. The word "Dhikr" denotes the Quran's code in several verses (15:6, 21:2, 26:5, 38:1, 38:8, 74:31). The value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230)+15+9=1254, 19x66.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Certainly, those who disbelieved will wish they were submitters.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Let them eat, enjoy, and remain blinded by wishful thinking; they will find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We never annihilated any community, except in accordance with a specific, predetermined time.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The end of any community can never be advanced, nor delayed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O you who received this reminder, you are crazy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Why do you not bring down the angels, if you are truthful?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We do not send down the angels except for specific functions. Otherwise, no one will be respited.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, we have revealed the reminder, and, absolutely, we will preserve it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent (messengers) before you to the communities in the past.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every time a messenger went to them, they ridiculed him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus control the minds of the guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, they cannot believe in him. This has been the system since the past generations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Even if we opened for them a gate into the sky, through which they climb;
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: they will say, "Our eyes have been deceived. We have been bewitched."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We placed galaxies in the sky, and adorned it for the beholders.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we guarded it against every rejected devil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If any of them sneaks around to listen, a mighty projectile will chase him back.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the earth, we constructed it, and placed on it stabilizers (mountains), and we grew on it a perfect balance of everything.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We made it habitable for you, and for creatures you do not provide for.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we send astronauts into space, we provide them with precisely measured quantities of food, water, and oxygen. God created the spaceship Earth with billions of astronauts who work and reproduce; He supplied them with a self-supporting system that generates oxygen, fresh water, and a great variety of delicious foods and drinks.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: There is nothing that we do not own infinite amounts thereof. But we send it down in precise measure.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we send the winds as pollinators, and cause water to come down from the sky for you to drink. Otherwise, you could not keep it palatable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is we who control life and death, and we are the ultimate inheritors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we fully know those among you who advance, and we fully know those who regress.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord will surely summon them. He is Most Wise, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Human Race
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We created the human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the jinns, we created them, before that, from blazing fire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from aged mud, like the potter's clay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Once I perfect him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The angels fell prostrate; all of them,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: except Iblis (Satan). He refused to be with the prostrators.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O Iblis (Satan), why are you not with the prostrators?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I am not to prostrate before a human being, whom You created from aged mud, like the potter's clay."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Therefore, you must get out; you are banished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, respite me until the day they are resurrected."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You are respited.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Until the specified day and time."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, since You have willed that I go astray, I will surely entice them on earth; I will send them all astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Except those among Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "This is a law that is inviolable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You have no power over My servants. You only have power over the strayers who follow you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And Hell awaits them all.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "It will have seven gates. Each gate will get a specific share of them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the righteous, they will enjoy gardens and springs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Enter therein, peaceful and secure.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We remove all jealousy from their hearts. Like one family, they will be on adjacent furnishings.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Never will they suffer any fatigue therein; never will they be evicted therefrom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And that My retribution is the most painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Angels Visit Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Inform them about Abraham's guests.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they entered his quarters, they said, "Peace." He said, "We are apprehensive about you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Do not be apprehensive. We have good news for you: an enlightened son."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "How can you give me such good news, when I am so old? Do you still give me this good news?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "The good news we give you is true; do not despair."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "None despairs of his Lord's mercy, except the strayers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "What is your mission, O messengers?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We are being dispatched to guilty people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for Lot's family, we will save them all.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "But not his wife; she is destined to be with the doomed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The messengers went to Lot's town.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You are unknown people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We bring to you what they have been doubting.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We bring to you the truth; we are truthful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall take your family during the night. Stay behind them, and make sure that none of you looks back. Go straight as commanded."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We delivered to him this command: those people are to be annihilated in the morning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The people of the city came joyfully.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "These are my guests; do not embarrass me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Fear GOD, and do not shame me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Did we not enjoin you from contacting anyone?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Here are my daughters, if you must."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But, alas, they were totally blinded by their lust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, the disaster struck them in the morning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We turned it upside down, and showered them with devastating rocks.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is a lesson for those who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This will always be the system.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is a sign for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The people of the woods also were transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we avenged from them, and both communities are fully documented.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The people of Al-Hijr disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We gave them our revelations, but they disregarded them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They used to carve secure homes out of the mountains.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The disaster hit them in the morning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What they hoarded did not help them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: End of the World Unveiled
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, except for a specific purpose. The end of the world will come, so treat them with benign neglect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One of the functions of God's Messenger of the Covenant is to deliver the Quranic assertion that the world will end in AD 2280 (20:15, 72:27 & Appendix 25).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the Creator, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given you the seven pairs, and the great Quran.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not be jealous of what we bestowed upon the other (messengers), and do not be saddened (by the disbelievers), and lower your wing for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And proclaim: "I am the manifest warner."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will deal with the dividers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They accept the Quran only partially.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By your Lord, we will question them all,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: about everything they have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, carry out the orders given to you, and disregard the idol worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will spare you the mockers,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: who set up another god beside GOD. They will surely find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We know full well that you may be annoyed by their utterances.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall sing the praises of your Lord, and be with the prostrators.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And worship your Lord, in order to attain certainty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The practices of worship are our means of attaining certainty (Appendix 15).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD's command has already been issued (and everything has already been written), so do not rush it. Be He glorified; the Most High, far above any idols they set up.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Everything is already recorded (57:22). See also Appendix 14.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He sends down the angels with the revelations, carrying His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants: "You shall preach that there is no other god beside Me; You shall reverence Me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He created the heavens and the earth for a specific purpose. He is much too High, far above any idols they set up.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He created the human from a tiny drop, then he turns into an ardent opponent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He created the livestock for you, to provide you with warmth, and many other benefits, as well as food.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They also provide you with luxury during your leisure, and when you travel.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Blessings
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And they carry your loads to lands that you could not reach without a great hardship. Surely, your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And (He created) the horses, the mules, and the donkeys for you to ride, and for luxury. Additionally, He creates what you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD points out the paths, including the wrong ones. If He willed, He could have guided all of you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He sends down from the sky water for your drink, and to grow trees for your benefit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: With it, He grows for you crops, olives, date palms, grapes, and all kinds of fruits. This is (sufficient) proof for people who think.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He commits, in your service, the night and the day, as well as the sun and the moon. Also, the stars are committed by His command. These are (sufficient) proofs for people who understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And (He created) for you on earth things of various colors. This is a (sufficient) proof for people who take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He committed the sea to serve you; you eat from it tender meat, and extract jewelry which you wear. And you see the ships roaming it for your commercial benefits, as you seek His bounties, that you may be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He placed stabilizers (mountains) on earth, lest it tumbles with you, as well as rivers and roads, that you may be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And landmarks, as well as the stars; to be used for navigation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is One who creates like one who does not create? Would you now take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you count GOD's blessings, you cannot possibly encompass them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD knows whatever you conceal and whatever you declare.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Dead Prophets and Saints
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for the idols they set up beside GOD, they do not create anything; they themselves were created.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are dead, not alive, and they have no idea how or when they will be resurrected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your god is one god. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are denying, and they are arrogant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, GOD knows everything they conceal and everything they declare. He does not love those who are arrogant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they are asked, "What do you think of these revelations from your Lord," they say, "Tales from the past."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will be held responsible for their sins on the Day of Resurrection, all of them, in addition to sins of all those whom they misled by their ignorance. What a miserable load!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Others like them have schemed in the past, and consequently, GOD destroyed their building at the foundation, causing the roof to fall on them. The retribution struck them when they least expected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and ask, "Where are My partners that you had set up beside Me, and had opposed Me for their sake?" Those blessed with knowledge will say, "Today, the shame and misery have befallen the disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Death for the Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The angels put them to death in a state of wronging their souls. That is when they finally submit, and say, "We did not do anything wrong!" Yes indeed. GOD is fully aware of everything you have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers Do Not Really Die
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for the righteous, when they are asked, "What do you think of these revelations from your Lord," they say, "Good." For those who lead a righteous life, happiness, and the abode of the Hereafter is even better. What a blissful abode for the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The righteous taste only the first death, which has been already experienced by all of us (see 44:56). At the end of their interim in this world, the angels of death simply invite them to move on to the Paradise where Adam and Eve once lived (2:154, 3:169, 8:24, 22:58, 36:27).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The gardens of Eden are reserved for them, wherein rivers flow. They have anything they wish therein. GOD thus rewards the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Go Straight to Paradise
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The angels terminate their lives in a state of righteousness, saying, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise (now) as a reward for your works."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Are they waiting for the angels to come to them, or until your Lord's judgment comes to pass? Those before them did the same thing. GOD is not the One who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Famous Excuse
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They have incurred the consequences of their evil works, and the very things they ridiculed came back to haunt them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The idol worshipers say, "Had GOD willed, we would not worship any idols besides Him, nor would our parents. Nor would we prohibit anything besides His prohibitions." Those before them have done the same. Can the messengers do anything but deliver the complete message?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent a messenger to every community, saying, "You shall worship GOD, and avoid idolatry." Subsequently, some were guided by GOD, while others were committed to straying. Roam the earth and note the consequences for the rejectors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No matter how hard you try to guide them, GOD does not guide the ones He had committed to straying. Thus, no one can help them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Deep In Their Minds
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They swore solemnly by GOD: "GOD will not resurrect the dead." Absolutely, such is His inviolable promise, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will then point out to everyone all the things they had disputed, and will let those who disbelieved know that they were liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Resurrect the Dead
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To have anything done, we simply say to it, "Be," and it is.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who emigrated for the sake of GOD, because they were persecuted, we will surely make it up to them generously in this life, and the recompense of the Hereafter is even greater, if they only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because they steadfastly persevere, and in their Lord they trust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask those who know the scripture, if you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We provided them with the proofs and the scriptures. And we sent down to you this message, to proclaim for the people everything that is sent down to them, perhaps they will reflect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did those who scheme evil schemes guarantee that GOD will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the retribution will not come to them when they least expect it?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It may strike them while they are asleep; they can never escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or it may strike them while they are fearfully expecting it. Your Lord is Compassionate, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not seen all the things created by GOD? Their shadows surround them right and left, in total submission to GOD, and willingly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD prostrates everything in the heavens and everything on earth — every creature—and so do the angels; without the least arrogance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The human body, whether it belongs to a believer or a disbeliever, submits to God; the heartbeats, the lungs' movement, and peristalsis illustrate this submission.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They reverence their Lord, high above them, and they do what they are commanded to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has proclaimed: "Do not worship two gods; there is only one god. You shall reverence Me alone."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth and therefore, the religion shall be devoted absolutely to Him alone. Would you worship other than GOD?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Any blessing you enjoy is from GOD. Yet, whenever you incur any adversity you immediately complain to Him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, as soon as He relieves your affliction, some of you revert to idol worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Let them disbelieve in what we have given them. Go ahead and enjoy temporarily; you will surely find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They designate for the idols they set up out of ignorance, a share of the provisions we bestow upon them. By GOD, you will be held accountable for your innovations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Bigoted Bias Against Baby Girls
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They even assign daughters to GOD, be He glorified, while they prefer for themselves what they like.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When one of them gets a baby girl, his face becomes darkened with overwhelming grief.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Ashamed, he hides from the people, because of the bad news given to him. He even ponders: should he keep the baby grudgingly, or bury her in the dust. Miserable indeed is their judgment.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set the worst examples, while to GOD belongs the most sublime examples. He is the Almighty, the Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Original Sin
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If GOD punished the people for their transgressions, He would have annihilated every creature on earth. But He respites them for a specific, predetermined time. Once their interim ends, they cannot delay it by one hour, nor advance it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They ascribe to GOD what they dislike for themselves, then utter the lie with their own tongues that they are righteous! Without any doubt, they have incurred Hell, for they have rebelled.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By GOD, we have sent (messengers) to communities before you, but the devil adorned their works in their eyes. Consequently, he is now their lord, and they have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have revealed this scripture to you, to point out for them what they dispute, and to provide guidance and mercy for people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additional Proofs From God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD sends down from the sky water to revive the land after it had died. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And in the livestock there is a lesson for you: we provide you with a drink from their bellies. From the midst of digested food and blood, you get pure milk, delicious for the drinkers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And from the fruits of date palms and grapes you produce intoxicants, as well as good provisions. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Bee
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And your Lord inspired the bee: build homes in mountains and trees, and in (the hives) they build for you.
segments.label: verse-1992
