segments.text: Then eat from all the fruits, following the design of your Lord, precisely. From their bellies comes a drink of different colors, wherein there is healing for the people. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who reflect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Besides its recognized nutritive value, honey has been scientifically proven as a healing medicine for certain allergies and other ailments.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD created you, then He terminates your lives. He lets some of you live to the oldest age, only to find out that there is a limit to the knowledge they can acquire. GOD is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No Partners With God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD has provided for some of you more than others. Those who are given plenty would never give their properties to their subordinates to the extent of making them partners. Would they give up GOD's blessings?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If the humans would not give up their power to that extent, why do they expect God to do this, and create partners for Himself?
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And GOD made for you spouses from among yourselves, and produced for you from your spouses children and grandchildren, and provided you with good provisions. Should they believe in falsehood, and turn unappreciative of GOD's blessings?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idol Worship: Not Very Intelligent
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Yet, they worship beside GOD what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor can provide them with anything.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, do not cite the examples for GOD; GOD knows while you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Rich Believer is Better than the Poor Believer
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD cites the example of a slave who is owned, and is totally powerless, compared to one whom we blessed with good provisions, from which he gives to charity secretly and publicly. Are they equal? Praise be to GOD, most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD cites the example of two men: one is dumb, lacks the ability to do anything, is totally dependent on his master—whichever way he directs him, he cannot produce anything good. Is he equal to one who rules with justice, and is guided in the right path?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This Life is Very Short
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the future of the heavens and the earth. As far as He is concerned, the end of the world (the Hour) is a blink of an eye away, or even closer. GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD brought you out of your mothers' bellies knowing nothing, and He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains, that you may be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not see the birds committed to fly in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up in the air except GOD. This should be (sufficient) proof for people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD provided for you stationary homes where you can live. And He provided for you portable homes made of the hides of livestock, so you can use them when you travel, and when you settle down. And from their wools, furs, and hair, you make furnishings and luxuries for awhile.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD provided for you shade through things which He created, and provided for you shelters in the mountains, and provided for you garments that protect you from heat, and garments that protect when you fight in wars. He thus perfects His blessings upon you, that you may submit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they still turn away, then your sole mission is the clear delivery (of the message).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Unappreciative
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They fully recognize GOD's blessings, then deny them; the majority of them are disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On The Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The day will come when we raise from every community a witness, then those who disbelieved will not be permitted (to speak), nor will they be excused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Once those who transgressed see the retribution, it will be too late; it will not be commuted for them, nor will they be respited.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Idols Disown Their Idolizers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And when those who committed idol worship see their idols, they will say, "Our Lord, these are the idols we had set up beside You." The idols will then confront them and say, "You are liars."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will totally submit to GOD on that day, and the idols they had invented will disown them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, we augment their retribution by adding more retribution, due to their transgressions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when we will raise from every community a witness from among them, and bring you as the witness of these people. We have revealed to you this book to provide explanations for everything, and guidance, and mercy, and good news for the submitters.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD advocates justice, charity, and regarding the relatives. And He forbids evil, vice, and transgression. He enlightens you, that you may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Keep Your Word
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall fulfill your covenant with GOD when you make such a covenant. You shall not violate the oaths after swearing (by GOD) to carry them out, for you have made GOD a guarantor for you. GOD knows everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not be like the knitter who unravels her strong knitting into piles of flimsy yarn. This is your example if you abuse the oaths to take advantage of one another. Whether one group is larger than the other, GOD thus puts you to the test. He will surely show you on the Day of Resurrection everything you had disputed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had GOD willed, He could have made you one congregation. But He sends astray whoever chooses to go astray, and He guides whoever wishes to be guided. You will surely be asked about everything you have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God knows the sincere believers among us who deserve to be redeemed. Accordingly, He guides them, while blocking out those who choose to disbelieve.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Violating Your Oath: A Serious Offense
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not abuse the oaths among you, lest you slide back after having a strong foothold, then you incur misery. Such is the consequence of repelling from the path of GOD (by setting a bad example); you incur a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not sell your oaths before GOD short. What GOD possesses is far better for you, if you only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What you possess runs out, but what GOD possesses lasts forever. We will surely reward those who steadfastly persevere; we will recompense them for their righteous works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Guaranteed Happiness Now and Forever
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Anyone who works righteousness, male or female, while believing, we will surely grant them a happy life in this world, and we will surely pay them their full recompense (on the Day of Judgment) for their righteous works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: An Important Commandment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When you read the Quran, you shall seek refuge in GOD from Satan the rejected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our salvation is attained by knowing God's message to us, the Quran, and Satan will do his utmost to keep us from being redeemed. Hence this commandment.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He has no power over those who believe and trust in their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His power is limited to those who choose him as their master; those who choose him as their god.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we substitute one revelation in place of another, and GOD is fully aware of what He reveals, they say, "You made this up!" Indeed, most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "The Holy Spirit has brought it down from your Lord, truthfully, to assure those who believe, and to provide a beacon and good news for the submitters."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran Is Not Copied From The Bible
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We are fully aware that they say, "A human being is teaching him!" The tongue of the source they hint at is non-Arabic, and this is a perfect Arabic tongue.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who do not believe in GOD's revelations, GOD does not guide them. They have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The only ones who fabricate false doctrines are those who do not believe in GOD's revelations; they are the real liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lip Service Does Not Count
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve in GOD, after having acquired faith, and become fully content with disbelief, have incurred wrath from GOD. The only ones to be excused are those who are forced to profess disbelief, while their hearts are full of faith.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's wisdom decrees that if someone holds a gun to your head and orders you to declare that you disbelieve in God, you may grant him his wish. What the heart harbors is what counts.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Preoccupation With This Life Leads to Exile From God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is because they have given priority to this life over the Hereafter, and GOD does not guide such disbelieving people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those are the ones whom GOD has sealed their hearts, and their hearing, and their eyesight. Consequently, they remain unaware.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Without a doubt, they will be the losers in the Hereafter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who emigrate because of persecution, then continue to strive and steadfastly persevere, your Lord, because of all this, is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when every soul will serve as its own advocate, and every soul will be paid fully for whatever it had done, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Prohibiting Lawful Food Brings Deprivation
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD cites the example of a community that used to be secure and prosperous, with provisions coming to it from everywhere. But then, it turned unappreciative of GOD's blessings. Consequently, GOD caused them to taste the hardships of starvation and insecurity. Such is the requital for what they did.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A messenger had gone to them from among them, but they rejected him. Consequently, the retribution struck them for their transgression.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall eat from GOD's provisions everything that is lawful and good, and be appreciative of GOD's blessings, if you do worship Him alone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only Four Foods Prohibited
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He only prohibits for you dead animals, blood, the meat of pigs, and food which is dedicated to other than GOD. If one is forced (to eat these), without being deliberate or malicious, then GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: & 118 The most devastating trichinosis parasite, Trichinella spiralis, (also the pork tapeworm Taenia solium) survives in the meat of pigs, not the fat. More than 150,000 people are infected annually in the United States. See 6:145-146, and Appendix 16.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You shall not utter lies with your own tongues stating: "This is lawful, and this is unlawful," to fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD. Surely, those who fabricate lies and attribute them to GOD will never succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They enjoy briefly, then suffer painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For the Jews, we prohibited what we narrated to you previously. It was not us who wronged them; they are the ones who wronged their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, as regards those who fall in sin out of ignorance then repent thereafter and reform, your Lord, after this is done, is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Abraham was indeed an exemplary vanguard in his submission to GOD, a monotheist who never worshiped idols.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Because he was appreciative of His Lord's blessings, He chose him and guided him in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We granted him happiness in this life, and in the Hereafter he will be with the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad: A Follower of Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Then we inspired you (Muhammad) to follow the religion of Abraham, the monotheist; he never was an idol worshiper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This informs us that all religious practices, which came to us through Abraham, were intact at the time of Muhammad (see 22:78 and Appendix 9).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Sabbath Abrogated
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The Sabbath was decreed only for those who ended up disputing it (Jews & Christians). Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection regarding their disputes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How to Spread God's Message
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall invite to the path of your Lord with wisdom and kind enlightenment, and debate with them in the best possible manner. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who are the guided ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And if you punish, you shall inflict an equivalent punishment. But if you resort to patience (instead of revenge), it would be better for the patient ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall resort to patience—and your patience is attainable only with GOD's help. Do not grieve over them, and do not be annoyed by their schemes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is with those who lead a righteous life, and those who are charitable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most glorified is the One who summoned His servant (Muhammad) during the night, from the Sacred Masjid (of Mecca) to the farthest place of prostration, whose surroundings we have blessed, in order to show him some of our signs. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The Aqsa Masjid" means "the farthest place where there is prostration," many billions of Light Years away. This verse informs us that Muhammad, the soul, was taken to the highest Heaven to be given the Quran (2:185, 44:3, 53:1-18, & 97:1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Similarly, we gave Moses the scripture, and rendered it a beacon for the Children of Israel that: "You shall not set up any idol as a Lord and Master beside Me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are descendants of those whom we carried with Noah; he was an appreciative servant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We addressed the Children of Israel in the scripture: "You will commit gross evil on earth, twice. You are destined to fall into great heights of arrogance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "When the first time comes to pass, we will send against you servants of ours who possess great might, and they will invade your homes. This is a prophecy that must come to pass.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Afterwards, we will give you a turn over them, and will supply you with a lot of wealth and children; we will give you the upper hand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you work righteousness, you work righteousness for your own good, but if you commit evil you do so to your own detriment. Thus, when the second time comes to pass, they will defeat you and enter the mosque (masjid), just as they did the first time. They will wipe out all the gains you had accomplished."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord showers you with His mercy. But if you revert to transgression, we will counter with retribution. We have designated Gehenna as a final abode for the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran: Our Means to Salvation
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This Quran guides to the best path, and brings good news to the believers who lead a righteous life, that they have deserved a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who disbelieve in the Hereafter, we have prepared for them a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The human being often prays for something that may hurt him, thinking that he is praying for something good. The human being is impatient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We rendered the night and the day two signs. We made the night dark, and the day lighted, that you may seek provisions from your Lord therein. This also establishes for you a timing system, and the means of calculation. We thus explain everything in detail.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Video Tape
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have recorded the fate of every human being; it is tied to his neck. On the Day of Resurrection we will hand him a record that is accessible.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your life is already recorded, as if on a video tape, from birth to death. This same record will be made accessible to us upon resurrection. See 57:22 & Appendix 14.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Read your own record. Today, you suffice as your own reckoner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whoever is guided, is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray does so to his own detriment. No sinner will bear the sins of anyone else. We never punish without first sending a messenger.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we are to annihilate any community, we let the leaders commit vast corruption therein. Once they deserve retribution, we annihilate it completely.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a generation have we annihilated after Noah. Your Lord is most efficient in dealing with the sins of His servants; He is fully Cognizant, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Choose Your Priorities Carefully This Life
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Anyone who chooses this fleeting life as his priority, we will rush to him what we decide to give him, then we commit him to Gehenna, where he suffers forever, despised and defeated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Hereafter
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who choose the Hereafter as their priority, and work righteousness, while believing, their efforts will be appreciated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For each one of them we provide; we provide those and these from your Lord's bounties. Your Lord's bounties are inexhaustible.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Note how we preferred some people above others (in this life). The differences in the Hereafter are far greater and far more significant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Major Commandments
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not set up any other god beside GOD, lest you end up despised and disgraced.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord has decreed that you shall not worship except Him, and your parents shall be honored. As long as one or both of them live, you shall never say to them, "Uff" (the slightest gesture of annoyance), nor shall you shout at them; you shall treat them amicably.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And lower for them the wings of humility, and kindness, and say, "My Lord, have mercy on them, for they have raised me from infancy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is fully aware of your innermost thoughts. If you maintain righteousness, He is Forgiver of those who repent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall give the due alms to the relatives, the needy, the poor, and the traveling alien, but do not be excessive, extravagant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The extravagant are brethren of the devils, and the devil is unappreciative of his Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Even if you have to turn away from them, as you pursue the mercy of your Lord, you shall treat them in the nicest manner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Stinginess Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not keep your hand stingily tied to your neck, nor shall you foolishly open it up, lest you end up blamed and sorry.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For your Lord increases the provision for anyone He chooses, and reduces it. He is fully Cognizant of His creatures, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abortion is Murder
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not kill your children due to fear of poverty. We provide for them, as well as for you. Killing them is a gross offense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall not commit adultery; it is a gross sin, and an evil behavior.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall not kill any person—for GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. If one is killed unjustly, then we give his heir authority to enforce justice. Thus, he shall not exceed the limits in avenging the murder, he will be helped.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall not touch the orphans' money except for their own good, until they reach maturity. You shall fulfill your covenants, for a covenant is a great responsibility.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall give full measure when you trade, and weigh equitably. This is better and more righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Crucial Advice
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not accept any information, unless you verify it for yourself. I have given you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brain, and you are responsible for using them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall not walk proudly on earth —you cannot bore through the earth, nor can you be as tall as the mountains.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All bad behavior is condemned by your Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran Is Wisdom
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is some of the wisdom inspired to you by your Lord. You shall not set up another god beside GOD, lest you end up in Gehenna, blamed and defeated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Has your Lord given you boys, while giving Himself the angels as daughters?! How could you utter such a blasphemy?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have cited in this Quran (all kinds of examples), that they may take heed. But it only augments their aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "If there were any other gods beside Him, as they claim, they would have tried to overthrow the Possessor of the throne."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Be He glorified, He is much too exalted, far above their utterances.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Everything Glorifies God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Glorifying Him are the seven universes, the earth, and everyone in them. There is nothing that does not glorify Him, but you do not understand their glorification. He is Clement, Forgiver.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Disbelievers Cannot Understand Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When you read the Quran, we place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran: The ONLY Source
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We place shields around their minds, to prevent them from understanding it, and deafness in their ears. And when you preach your Lord, using the Quran alone, they run away in aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Arabic word "alone" refers to God in 7:70, 39:45, 40:12 & 84, and 60:4. If you add these numbers, you get 361, 19x19. But if you include 17:46, which refers to the Quran, the product is not a multiple of 19. "Alone," therefore refers to the Quran in 17:46 (Appendix 18).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We are fully aware of what they hear, when they listen to you, and when they conspire secretly—the disbelievers say, "You are following a crazy man."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Note how they describe you, and how this causes them to stray off the path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "After we turn into bones and fragments, we get resurrected anew?!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Even if you turn into rocks or iron.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Even if you turn into any kind of creation that you deem impossible." They will then say, "Who will bring us back?" Say, "The One who created you in the first place." They will then shake their heads and say, "When will that be?" Say, "It may be closer than you think."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day He summons you, you will respond by praising Him, and you will then realize that you had lasted in this life but a short while.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Treat Each Other Amicably
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Tell My servants to treat each other in the best possible manner, for the devil will always try to drive a wedge among them. Surely, the devil is man's most ardent enemy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord knows you best. According to His knowledge, He may shower you with mercy, or He may requite you. We did not send you to be their advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the best knower of everyone in the heavens and the earth. In accordance with this knowledge, we preferred some prophets over others. For example, we gave David the Psalms.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Implore whatever idols you have set up beside Him." They have no power to relieve your afflictions, nor can they prevent them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Righteous Idols Worship God Alone
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Even the idols that they implore are seeking the ways and means towards their Lord. They pray for His mercy, and fear His retribution. Surely, the retribution of your Lord is dreadful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There is not a community that we will not annihilate before the Day of Resurrection, or inflict severe retribution upon them. This is already written down in the book.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Old Kind of Miracles Made Obsolete
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: What stopped us from sending the miracles is that the previous generations have rejected them. For example, we showed Thamûd the camel, a profound (miracle), but they transgressed against it. We sent the miracles only to instill reverence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We informed you that your Lord fully controls the people, and we rendered the vision that we showed you a test for the people, and the tree that is accursed in the Quran. We showed them solid proofs to instill reverence in them, but this only augmented their defiance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad's journey to the highest heaven to receive the Quran, as stated in 17:1 and 53:1-18, is a test because the people had to believe Muhammad on faith.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Satan Dupes the People
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam," they fell prostrate, except Satan. He said, "Shall I prostrate to one You created from mud?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Since You have honored him over me, if You respite me till the Day of Resurrection, I will possess all his descendants, except a few."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Then go; you and those who follow you will end up in Hell as your requital; an equitable requital.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You may entice them with your voice, and mobilize all your forces and all your men against them, and share in their money and children, and promise them. Anything the devil promises is no more than an illusion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for My servants, you have no power over them." Your Lord suffices as an advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the One who causes the ships to float on the ocean, that you may seek His bounties. He is Most Merciful towards you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We now learn from physics and physical chemistry that water possesses unique qualities that render it perfectly suitable for serving our various needs.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Bad Weather Friends
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you are afflicted in the middle of the sea, you forget your idols and sincerely implore Him alone. But as soon as He saves you to the shore, you revert. Indeed, the human being is unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have you guaranteed that He will not cause the land, on shore, to swallow you? Or, that He will not send upon you a tempest, then you find no protector?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have you guaranteed that He will not return you to the sea another time, then send upon you a storm that drowns you because of your disbelief? Once this happens, we will not give you another chance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have honored the children of Adam, and provided them with rides on land and in the sea. We provided for them good provisions, and we gave them greater advantages than many of our creatures.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when we summon every people, together with their record. As for those who are given a record of righteousness, they will read their record and will not suffer the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who are blind in this life, they will be blind in the Hereafter; even a lot worse.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Strengthens the Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They almost diverted you from the revelations we have given you. They wanted you to fabricate something else, in order to consider you a friend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If it were not that we strengthened you, you almost leaned towards them just a little bit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had you done that, we would have doubled the retribution for you in this life, and after death, and you would have found no one to help you against us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They almost banished you from the land to get rid of you, so they could revert as soon as you left.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This has been consistently the case with all the messengers that we sent before you, and you will find that our system never changes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Noon Prayer
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall observe the Contact Prayer (Salat) when the sun declines from its highest point at noon, as it moves towards sunset. You shall also observe (the recitation of) the Quran at dawn. (Reciting) the Quran at dawn is witnessed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Meditation
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: During the night, you shall meditate for extra credit, that your Lord may raise you to an honorable rank.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And say, "My Lord, admit me an honorable admittance, and let me depart an honorable departure, and grant me from You a powerful support."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim, "The truth has prevailed, and falsehood has vanished; falsehood will inevitably vanish."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Healing and Mercy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We send down in the Quran healing and mercy for the believers. At the same time, it only increases the wickedness of the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we bless the human being, he becomes preoccupied and heedless. But when adversity strikes him, he turns despondent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Everyone works in accordance with his belief, and your Lord knows best which ones are guided in the right path."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Revelation: The Source of All Knowledge
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They ask you about the revelation. Say, "The revelation comes from my Lord. The knowledge given to you is minute."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we will, we can take back what we revealed to you, then you will find no protector against us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is but mercy from your Lord. His blessings upon you have been great.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mathematical Composition of the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "If all the humans and all the jinns banded together in order to produce a Quran like this, they can never produce anything like it, no matter how much assistance they lent one another."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have cited for the people in this Quran all kinds of examples, but most people insist upon disbelieving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messengers Challenged
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "We will not believe you unless you cause a spring to gush out of the ground.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Or unless you own a garden of date palms and grapes, with rivers running through it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Or unless you cause masses from the sky, as you claimed, to fall on us. Or unless you bring GOD and the angels before our eyes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Or unless you own a luxurious mansion, or unless you climb into the sky. Even if you do climb, we will not believe unless you bring a book that we can read." Say, "Glory be to my Lord. Am I any more than a human messenger?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant, Rashad Khalifa, was thus challenged, including the challenge to bring a new book, or bring down masses from the sky. Verse 3:81 defines the duties of God's Messenger of the Covenant. Overwhelming proof is detailed in Appendices 2 & 26.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Messengership: An Essential Test
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: What prevented the people from believing when the guidance came to them, is their saying, "Did GOD send a human being as a messenger?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "If the earth were inhabited by angels, we would have sent down to them from the sky an angel messenger."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Is My Witness
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "GOD suffices as a witness between me and you. He is fully Cognizant of His worshipers, Seer."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whomever GOD guides is the truly guided one. And whomever He sends astray, you will never find for them any lords and masters beside Him. We will summon them on the Day of Resurrection forcibly; blind, dumb, and deaf. Their destination is Hell; whenever it cools down, we will increase their fire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their Innermost Thoughts
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Such is their just retribution, since they rejected our revelations. They said, "After we turn into bones and fragments, do we get resurrected into a new creation?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Could they not see that the GOD who created the heavens and the earth, is able to create the same creations? He has predetermined for them an irrevocable life span? Yet, the disbelievers insist upon disbelieving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim, "If you possessed my Lord's treasures of mercy, you would have withheld them, fearing that you might exhaust them. The human being is stingy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses and Pharaoh
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We supported Moses with nine profound miracles—ask the Children of Israel. When he went to them, Pharaoh said to him, "I think that you, Moses, are bewitched."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You know full well that no one can manifest these except, obviously, the Lord of the heavens and the earth. I think that you, Pharaoh, are doomed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he pursued them, as he chased them out of the land, we drowned him, together with those who sided with him, all of them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we said to the Children of Israel afterwards, "Go live in this land. When the final prophecy comes to pass, we will summon you all in one group."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran Released Slowly To Facilitate Memorization
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Truthfully, we sent it down, and with the truth it came down. We did not send you except as a bearer of good news, as well as a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A Quran that we have released slowly, in order for you to read it to the people over a long period, although we sent it down all at once.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim, "Believe in it, or do not believe in it." Those who possess knowledge from the previous scriptures, when it is recited to them, they fall down to their chins, prostrating.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They say, "Glory be to our Lord. This fulfills our Lord's prophecy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They fall down on their chins, prostrating and weeping. For it augments their reverence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Tone of the Contact Prayers (Salat)
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Call Him GOD, or call Him Most Gracious; whichever name you use, to Him belongs the best names." You shall not utter your Contact Prayers (Salat) too loudly, nor secretly; use a moderate tone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And proclaim: "Praise be to GOD, who has never begotten a son, nor does He have a partner in His kingship, nor does He need any ally out of weakness," and magnify Him constantly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Praise GOD, who revealed to His servant this scripture, and made it flawless.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A perfect (scripture) to warn of severe retribution from Him, and to deliver good news to the believers who lead a righteous life, that they have earned a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Wherein they abide forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And to warn those who said, "GOD has begotten a son!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They possess no knowledge about this, nor did their parents. What a blasphemy coming out of their mouths! What they utter is a gross lie.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You may blame yourself on account of their response to this narration, and their disbelieving in it; you may be saddened.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The End of the World
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have adorned everything on earth, in order to test them, and thus distinguish those among them who work righteousness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Inevitably, we will wipe out everything on it, leaving it completely barren.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As it turns out, the history of these Christian believers, the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus, is directly connected with the end of the world as stated in 18:9 & 21. The role of these believers in unveiling the end of the world is detailed in Appendix 25.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Dwellers of the Cave
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Why else do you think we are telling you about the people of the cave, and the numbers connected with them? They are among our wondrous signs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the youths took refuge in the cave, they said, "Our Lord, shower us with Your mercy, and bless our affairs with Your guidance."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then sealed their ears in the cave for a predetermined number of years.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we resurrected them to see which of the two parties could count the duration of their stay therein.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We narrate to you their history, truthfully. They were youths who believed in their Lord, and we increased their guidance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We strengthened their hearts when they stood up and proclaimed: "Our only Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We will never worship any other god beside Him. Otherwise, we would be far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Here are our people setting up gods beside Him. If only they could provide any proof to support their stand! Who is more evil than the one who fabricates lies and attributes them to GOD?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Seven Sleepers of Ephesus
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Since you wish to avoid them, and their worshiping of other than GOD, let us take refuge in the cave. May your Lord shower you with His mercy and direct you to the right decision."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Ephesus is located about 200 miles south of ancient Nicene, and 30 miles south of today's Izmir in Turkey. The dwellers of the cave were young Christians who wanted to follow the teachings of Jesus, and worship God alone. They were fleeing the persecution of neo-Christians who proclaimed a corrupted Christianity three centuries after Jesus, following the Nicene Conferences, when the Trinity doctrine was announced. In 1928, Franz Miltner, an Austrian archeologist discovered the tomb of the seven sleepers of Ephesus. Their history is well documented in several encyclopedias.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: A Guiding Teacher is a Prerequisite
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You could see the sun when it rose coming from the right side of their cave, and when it set, it shone on them from the left, as they slept in the hollow thereof. This is one of GOD's portents. Whomever GOD guides is the truly guided one, and whomever He sends astray, you will not find for him a guiding teacher.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This sign, or hint, tells us that the cave was facing north.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You would think that they were awake, when they were in fact asleep. We turned them to the right side and the left side, while their dog stretched his arms in their midst. Had you looked at them, you would have fled from them, stricken with terror.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we resurrected them, they asked each other, "How long have you been here?" "We have been here one day or part of the day," they answered. "Your Lord knows best how long we stayed here, so let us send one of us with this money to the city. Let him fetch the cleanest food, and buy some for us. Let him keep a low profile, and attract no attention.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If they discover you, they will stone you, or force you to revert to their religion, then you can never succeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Connection With the End of the World
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We caused them to be discovered, to let everyone know that GOD's promise is true, and to remove all doubt concerning the end of the world. The people then disputed among themselves regarding them. Some said, "Let us build a building around them." Their Lord is the best knower about them. Those who prevailed said, "We will build a place of worship around them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As detailed in Appendix 25, this story helped pinpoint the end of the world.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Some would say, "They were three; their dog being the fourth," while others would say, "Five; the sixth being their dog," as they guessed. Others said, "Seven," and the eighth was their dog. Say, "My Lord is the best knower of their number." Only a few knew the correct number. Therefore, do not argue with them; just go along with them. You need not consult anyone about this.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Remembering God Every Chance We Get
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall not say that you will do anything in the future,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: without saying, "GOD willing." If you forget to do this, you must immediately remember your Lord and say, "May my Lord guide me to do better next time."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This important commandment gives us daily opportunities to remember God.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They stayed in their cave three hundred years, increased by nine.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The difference between 300 solar years and 300 lunar years is nine years. Thus, discovering the end of the world was predetermined by the Almighty to take place in 1980 AD (1400 AH), 300 years (309 lunar years) before the end of the world (see 72:27 & Appendix 25).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "GOD is the best knower of how long they stayed there." He knows all secrets in the heavens and the earth. By His grace you can see; by His grace you can hear. There is none beside Him as Lord and Master, and He never permits any partners to share in His kingship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall recite what is revealed to you of your Lord's scripture. Nothing shall abrogate His words, and you shall not find any other source beside it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quranic Study Groups
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall force yourself to be with those who worship their Lord day and night, seeking Him alone. Do not turn your eyes away from them, seeking the vanities of this world. Nor shall you obey one whose heart we rendered oblivious to our message; one who pursues his own desires, and whose priorities are confused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absolute Freedom of Religion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "This is the truth from your Lord," then whoever wills let him believe, and whoever wills let him disbelieve. We have prepared for the transgressors a fire that will completely surround them. When they scream for help, they will be given a liquid like concentrated acid that scalds the faces. What a miserable drink! What a miserable destiny!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, we never fail to recompense those who work righteousness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have deserved gardens of Eden wherein rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and will wear clothes of green silk and velvet, and will rest on comfortable furnishings. What a wonderful reward; what a wonderful abode!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Property as an Idol
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Cite for them the example of two men: we gave one of them two gardens of grapes, surrounded by date palms, and placed other crops between them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran cites many examples of the different gods that people worship beside God; they include children (7:190), religious leaders and scholars (9:31), property (18:42), dead saints and prophets (16:20-21, 35:14, & 46:5-6), and the ego (25:43, 45:23).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Both gardens produced their crops on time, and generously, for we caused a river to run through them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Once, after harvesting, he boastfully told his friend: "I am far more prosperous than you, and I command more respect from the people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he entered his garden, he wronged his soul by saying, "I do not think that this will ever end.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Moreover, I think this is it; I do not think that the Hour (the Hereafter) will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will (be clever enough to) possess an even better one over there."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His friend said to him, as he debated with him, "Have you disbelieved in the One who created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then perfected you into a man?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for me, GOD is my Lord, and I will never set up any other god besides my Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Important Commandment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "When you entered your garden, you should have said, 'This is what GOD has given me (Mã Shã Allãh). No one possesses power except GOD (Lã Quwwata Ellã Bellãh).' You may see that I possess less money and less children than you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord may grant me better than your garden. He may send a violent storm from the sky that wipes out your garden, leaving it completely barren.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Or, its water may sink deeper, out of your reach."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, his crops were wiped out, and he ended up sorrowful, lamenting what he had spent on it in vain, as his property lay barren. He finally said, "I wish I never set up my property as a god beside my Lord."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No force on earth could have helped him against GOD, nor was it possible for him to receive any help.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is because the only true Lord and master is GOD; He provides the best recompense, and with Him is the best destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Cite for them the example of this life as water that we send down from the sky to produce plants of the earth, then they turn into hay that is blown away by the wind. GOD is able to do all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Rearranging Our Priorities
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Money and children are the joys of this life, but the righteous works provide an eternal recompense from your Lord, and a far better hope.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when we wipe out the mountains, and you will see the earth barren. We will summon them all, not leaving out a single one of them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will be presented before your Lord in a row. You have come to us as individuals, just as we created you initially. Indeed, this is what you claimed will never happen.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The record will be shown, and you will see the guilty fearful of its contents. They will say, "Woe to us. How come this book leaves nothing, small or large, without counting it?" They will find everything they had done brought forth. Your Lord is never unjust towards anyone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Classification of God's Creatures
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Satan. He became a jinn, for he disobeyed the order of His Lord. Will you choose him and his descendants as lords instead of Me, even though they are your enemies? What a miserable substitute!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the great feud in the heavenly society took place (38:69), all creatures became classified into angels, jinns, and humans (Appendix 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: I never permitted them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor the creation of themselves. Nor do I permit the wicked to work in My kingdom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God knew that Satan and his supporters (jinns and humans) were going to make the wrong decision. Hence their exclusion from witnessing the creation process.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The day will come when He says, "Call upon My partners, whom you claimed to be gods beside Me," they will call on them, but they will not respond to them. An insurmountable barrier will separate them from each other.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The guilty will see Hell, and will realize that they will fall into it. They will have no escape therefrom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Disbelievers Refuse to Accept the Completeness of the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have cited in this Quran every kind of example, but the human being is the most argumentative creature.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nothing prevented the people from believing, when the guidance came to them, and from seeking the forgiveness of their Lord, except that they demanded to see the same (kind of miracles) as the previous generations, or challenged to see the retribution beforehand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We only send the messengers as simply deliverers of good news, as well as warners. Those who disbelieve argue with falsehood to defeat the truth, and they take My proofs and warnings in vain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Intervention
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Who are more evil than those who are reminded of their Lord's proofs, then disregard them, without realizing what they are doing. Consequently, we place shields on their hearts to prevent them from understanding it (the Quran), and deafness in their ears. Thus, no matter what you do to guide them, they can never ever be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, your Lord is the Forgiver, full of mercy. If He called them to account for their deeds, He would annihilate them right there and then. Instead, He gives them a respite until a specific, predetermined time; then they can never escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community we annihilated because of their transgressions, we designated a specific time for their annihilation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Valuable Lessons from Moses and His Teacher
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Moses said to his servant, "I will not rest until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, no matter how long it takes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they reached the point where they met, they forgot their fish, and it found its way back to the river, sneakily.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: After they passed that point, he said to his servant, "Let us have lunch. All this traveling has thoroughly exhausted us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Remember when we sat by the rock back there? I paid no attention to the fish. It was the devil who made me forget it, and it found its way back to the river, strangely."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Moses) said, "That was the place we were looking for." They traced their steps back.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They found one of our servants, whom we blessed with mercy, and bestowed upon him from our own knowledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said to him, "Can I follow you, that you may teach me some of the knowledge and the guidance bestowed upon you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You cannot stand to be with me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "How can you stand that which you do not comprehend?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You will find me, GOD willing, patient. I will not disobey any command you give me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "If you follow me, then you shall not ask me about anything, unless I choose to tell you about it."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: So they went. When they boarded a ship, he bore a hole in it. He said, "Did you bore a hole in it to drown its people? You have committed something terrible."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did I not say that you cannot stand to be with me?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I am sorry. Do not punish me for my forgetfulness; do not be too harsh with me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: So they went. When they met a young boy, he killed him. He said, "Why did you kill such an innocent soul, who did not kill another soul? You have committed something horrendous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did I not tell you that you cannot stand to be with me?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "If I ask you about anything else, then do not keep me with you. You have seen enough apologies from me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: So they went. When they reached a certain community, they asked the people for food, but they refused to host them. Soon, they found a wall about to collapse, and he fixed it. He said, "You could have demanded a wage for that!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There is a Good Reason for Everything
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "Now we have to part company. But I will explain to you everything you could not stand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for the ship, it belonged to poor fishermen, and I wanted to render it defective. There was a king coming after them, who was confiscating every ship, forcibly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for the boy, his parents were good believers, and we saw that he was going to burden them with his transgression and disbelief.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Adolf Hitler was a cute and seemingly innocent child. Had he died as a child, many would have grieved, and many would have even questioned God's wisdom. We learn from these profound lessons that there is a good reason behind everything.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "We willed that your Lord substitute in his place another son; one who is better in righteousness and kindness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city. Under it, there was a treasure that belonged to them. Because their father was a righteous man, your Lord wanted them to grow up and attain full strength, then extract their treasure. Such is mercy from your Lord. I did none of that of my own volition. This is the explanation of the things you could not stand."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Zul-Qarnain: The One With the Two Horns or Two Generations
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They ask you about Zul-Qarnain. Say, "I will narrate to you some of his history."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We granted him authority on earth, and provided him with all kinds of means.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then, he pursued one way.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached the far west, he found the sun setting in a vast ocean, and found people there. We said, "O Zul-Qarnain, you can rule as you wish; either punish, or be kind to them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "As for those who transgress, we will punish them, then, when they return to their Lord, He will commit them to more retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a good reward; we will treat them kindly."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then he pursued another way.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached the far east, he found the sun rising on people who had nothing to shelter them from it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Naturally, we were fully aware of everything he found out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He then pursued another way.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached the valley between two palisades, he found people whose language was barely understandable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Gog and Magog
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Zul-Qarnain, Gog and Magog are corruptors of the earth. Can we pay you to create a barrier between us and them?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One of my duties as God's Messenger of the Covenant is to state that Gog and Magog, the final sign before the end of the world, will reappear in 2270 AD (1700 AH), just 10 years before the end. Note that Gog and Magog occur in Suras 18 and 21, precisely 17 verses before the end of each sura, representing 17 lunar centuries (see 72:27 and Appendix 25).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord has given me great bounties. If you cooperate with me, I will build a dam between you and them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Bring to me masses of iron." Once he filled the gap between the two palisades, he said, "Blow." Once it was red hot, he said, "Help me pour tar on top of it."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, they could not climb it, nor could they bore holes in it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "This is mercy from my Lord. When the prophecy of my Lord comes to pass, He will cause the dam to crumble. The prophecy of my Lord is truth."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: At that time, we will let them invade with one another, then the horn will be blown, and we will summon them all together.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will present Hell, on that day, to the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are the ones whose eyes were too veiled to see My message. Nor could they hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do those who disbelieve think that they can get away with setting up My servants as gods beside Me? We have prepared for the disbelievers Hell as an eternal abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Examine Yourself
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Shall I tell you who the worst losers are?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "They are the ones whose works in this life are totally astray, but they think that they are doing good."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such are the ones who disbelieved in the revelations of their Lord and in meeting Him. Therefore, their works are in vain; on the Day of Resurrection, they have no weight.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their just requital is Hell, in return for their disbelief, and for mocking My revelations and My messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life they have deserved a blissful Paradise as their abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Forever they abide therein; they will never want any other substitute.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran: Everything We Need
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would run out, before the words of my Lord run out, even if we double the ink supply."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "I am no more than a human like you, being inspired that your god is one god. Those who hope to meet their Lord shall work righteousness, and never worship any other god beside his Lord."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: K. H. Y. 'A. S. (Kãf Hã Yã 'Ayn Sãd)
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is the maximum number of Quranic Initials, because this sura deals with such crucial matters as the miraculous birth of John and the virgin birth of Jesus, and strongly condemns the gross blasphemy that considers Jesus to be a son of God. The five initials provide a powerful physical evidence to support these issues (See Appendices 1 & 22).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Zachariah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: A narration about your Lord's mercy towards His servant Zachariah.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He called his Lord, a secret call.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, the bones have turned brittle in my body, and my hair is aflame with gray. As I implore You, my Lord, I never despair.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I worry about my dependants after me, and my wife has been sterile. Grant me, from You, an heir.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let him be my heir and the heir of Jacob's clan, and make him, my Lord, acceptable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: John
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "O Zachariah, we give you good news; a boy whose name shall be John (Yahya). We never created anyone like him before."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, will I have a son despite my wife's sterility, and despite my old age?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Thus said your Lord: 'It is easy for Me to do. I created you before that, and you were nothing.'"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, give me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three consecutive nights."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He came out to his family, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them: "Meditate (on GOD) day and night."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O John, you shall uphold the scripture, strongly." We endowed him with wisdom, even in his youth.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And (we endowed him with) kindness from us and purity, for he was righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He honored his parents, and was never a disobedient tyrant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Peace be upon him the day he was born, the day he dies, and the day he is resurrected back to life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mary
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Mention in the scripture Mary. She isolated herself from her family, into an eastern location.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: While a barrier separated her from them, we sent to her our Spirit. He went to her in the form of a human being.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said, "I seek refuge in the Most Gracious, that you may be righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I am the messenger of your Lord, to grant you a pure son."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said, "How can I have a son, when no man has touched me; I have never been unchaste."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Thus said your Lord, 'It is easy for Me. We will render him a sign for the people, and mercy from us. This is a predestined matter.'"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Birth of Jesus
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When she bore him, she isolated herself to a faraway place.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The birth process came to her by the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "(I am so ashamed;) I wish I were dead before this happened, and completely forgotten."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (The infant) called her from beneath her, saying, "Do not grieve. Your Lord has provided you with a stream.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you shake the trunk of this palm tree, it will drop ripe dates for you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, Jesus was born in late September or early October. This is when dates ripen in the Middle East to the point of falling off the tree.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Eat and drink, and be happy. When you see anyone, say, 'I have made a vow of silence; I am not talking today to anyone.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She came to her family, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have committed something that is totally unexpected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O descendant of Aaron, your father was not a bad man, nor was your mother unchaste."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Infant Makes a Statement
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: She pointed to him. They said, "How can we talk with an infant in the crib?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (The infant spoke and) said, "I am a servant of GOD. He has given me the scripture, and has appointed me a prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He made me blessed wherever I go, and enjoined me to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat) for as long as I live.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am to honor my mother; He did not make me a disobedient rebel.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I get resurrected."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Proven Truth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: That was Jesus, the son of Mary, and this is the truth of this matter, about which they continue to doubt.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It does not befit GOD that He begets a son, be He glorified. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He also proclaimed, "GOD is my Lord and your Lord; you shall worship Him alone. This is the right path."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is similar to the statement attributed to Jesus in the Gospel of John 20:17.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The various parties disputed among themselves (regarding the identity of Jesus). Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve from the sight of a terrible day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Wait till you hear them and see them when they come to face us. The transgressors on that day will be totally lost.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Warn them about the day of remorse, when judgment will be issued. They are totally oblivious; they do not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are the ones who inherit the earth and everyone on it; to us everyone will be returned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Mention in the scripture Abraham; he was a saint, a prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor help you in any way?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my father, I have received certain knowledge that you did not receive. Follow me, and I will guide you in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil has rebelled against the Most Gracious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my father, I fear lest you incur retribution from the Most Gracious, then become an ally of the devil."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Have you forsaken my gods, O Abraham? Unless you stop, I will stone you. Leave me alone."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Peace be upon you. I will implore my Lord to forgive you; He has been Most Kind to me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I will abandon you and the gods you worship besides GOD. I will worship only my Lord. By imploring my Lord alone, I cannot go wrong."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Because he abandoned them and the gods they worshiped beside GOD, we granted him Isaac and Jacob, and we made each of them a prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We showered them with our mercy, and we granted them an honorable position in history.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Mention in the scripture Moses. He was devoted, and he was a messenger prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We called him from the right side of Mount Sinai. We brought him close, to confer with him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we granted him, out of our mercy, his brother Aaron as a prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And mention in the scripture Ismail. He was truthful when he made a promise, and he was a messenger prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He used to enjoin his family to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat); he was acceptable to his Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And mention in the scripture Idrîs. He was a saint, a prophet.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We raised him to an honorable rank.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These are some of the prophets whom GOD blessed. They were chosen from among the descendants of Adam, and the descendants of those whom we carried with Noah, and the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom we guided and selected. When the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they fall prostrate, weeping.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Losing the Contact Prayers (Salat)
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: After them, He substituted generations who lost the Contact Prayers (Salat), and pursued their lusts. They will suffer the consequences.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life will enter Paradise, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The gardens of Eden await them, as promised by the Most Gracious for those who worship Him, even in privacy. Certainly, His promise must come to pass.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will not hear any nonsense therein; only peace. They receive their provisions therein, day and night.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is Paradise; we grant it to those among our servants who are righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We do not come down except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs our past, our future, and everything between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; you shall worship Him and steadfastly persevere in worshiping Him. Do you know of anyone who equals Him?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The human being asks, "After I die, do I come back to life?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did the human being forget that we created him already, and he was nothing?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Special Warning to the Leaders
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: By your Lord, we will certainly summon them, together with the devils, and will gather them around Hell, humiliated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we will pick out from each group the most ardent opponent of the Most Gracious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We know full well those who are most deserving of burning therein.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Everyone Sees Hell
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Every single one of you must see it; this is an irrevocable decision of your Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As detailed in Appendix 11, we will be resurrected prior to God's physical arrival to our universe. That will be a temporary taste of Hell, since the absence of God is Hell. When God comes (89:22), the righteous will be rescued. See 19:72.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Then we rescue the righteous, and leave the transgressors in it, humiliated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Majority
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of us is more prosperous? Which of us is in the majority?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a generation have we annihilated before them; they were more powerful, and more prosperous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Those who choose to go astray, the Most Gracious will lead them on, until they see what is promised for them—either the retribution or the Hour. That is when they find out who really is worse off, and weaker in power."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD augments the guidance of those who choose to be guided. For the good deeds are eternally rewarded by your Lord, and bring far better returns.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have you noted the one who rejected our revelations then said, "I will be given wealth and children"?!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Has he seen the future? Has he taken such a pledge from the Most Gracious?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, we will record what he utters, then commit him to ever-increasing retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we inherit everything he possessed, and he comes back to us all alone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They worship beside GOD other gods that may be of help to them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Idols Disown Their Worshipers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: On the contrary; they will reject their idolatry, and will be their enemies.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see how we unleash the devils upon the disbelievers to stir them up?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not be impatient; we are preparing for them some preparation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when we summon the righteous before the Most Gracious in a group.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we will herd the guilty to Hell, to be their eternal abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No one will possess the power to intercede, except those who conform to the laws of the Most Gracious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Gross Blasphemy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
