segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You have uttered a gross blasphemy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The heavens are about to shatter, the earth is about to tear asunder, and the mountains are about to crumble.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Because they claim that the Most Gracious has begotten a son.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is not befitting the Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every single one in the heavens and the earth is a servant of the Most Gracious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He has encompassed them, and has counted them one by one.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All of them will come before Him on the Day of Resurrection as individuals.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who believe and lead a righteous life, the Most Gracious will shower them with love.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus made this (Quran) elucidated in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it the opponents.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a generation before them we annihilated; can you perceive any of them, or hear from them any sound?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: T. H.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The role of these Quranic initials as components of the Quran's awesome mathematical miracle is given in detail in Appendix 1.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We did not reveal the Quran to you, to cause you any hardship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only to remind the reverent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A revelation from the Creator of the earth and the high heavens.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Most Gracious; He has assumed all authority.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everything in the heavens, and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the ground.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whether you declare your convictions (or not) He knows the secret, and what is even more hidden.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD: there is no other god besides Him. To Him belong the most beautiful names.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have you noted the history of Moses?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, "Stay here. I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring you some of it, or find some guidance at the fire."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he came to it, he was called, "O, Moses.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am your Lord; remove your sandals. You are in the sacred valley, Tuwã.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am GOD; there is no other god beside Me. You shall worship Me alone, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) to remember Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: End of the World is Not Hidden
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "The Hour (end of the world) is surely coming; I will keep it almost hidden. For each soul must be paid for its works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The end of the world is given in the Quran, God's final message (15:87).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Do not be diverted therefrom by those who do not believe in it— those who pursue their own opinions—lest you fall.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "What is this in your right hand, Moses?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "This is my staff. I lean on it, herd my sheep with it, and I use it for other purposes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Throw it down, Moses."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He threw it down, whereupon it turned into a moving serpent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Pick it up; do not be afraid. We will return it to its original state.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And hold your hand under your wing; it will come out white without a blemish; another proof.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We thus show you some of our great portents.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Go to Pharaoh, for he has transgressed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, cool my temper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And make this matter easy for me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And untie a knot from my tongue.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "So they can understand my speech.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And appoint an assistant for me from my family.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My brother Aaron.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Strengthen me with him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let him be my partner in this matter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "That we may glorify You frequently.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And commemorate You frequently.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You are Seer of us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your request is granted, O Moses.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We have blessed you another time.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "When we revealed to your mother what we revealed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Saying: 'Throw him into the box, then throw him into the river. The river will throw him onto the shore, to be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.' I showered you with love from Me, and I had you made before My watchful eye.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Your sister walked to them and said, 'I can tell you about a nursing mother who can take good care of him.' We thus returned you to your mother, that she may be happy and stop worrying. And when you killed a soul, we saved you from the grievous consequences; indeed we tested you thoroughly. You stayed years with the people of Midyan, and now you have come back in accordance with a precise plan.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I have made you just for Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Go with your brother, supported by My signs, and do not waver in remembering Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Go to Pharaoh, for he transgressed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Speak to him nicely; he may take heed, or become reverent."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our Lord, we fear lest he may attack us, or transgress."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Do not be afraid, for I will be with you, listening and watching.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Go to him and say, 'We are two messengers from your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go. You must refrain from persecuting them. We bring a sign from your Lord, and peace is the lot of those who heed the guidance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: " 'We have been inspired that the retribution will inevitably afflict those who disbelieve and turn away.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Who is your Lord, O Moses."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Our Lord is the One who granted everything its existence, and its guidance."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "What about the past generations?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and paved in it roads for you. And He sends down from the sky water with which we produce many different kinds of plants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eat and raise your livestock. These are sufficient proofs for those who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who possess intelligence appreciate the fact that we are astronauts who were launched into space on this 'Spaceship Earth.' God provided us with renewable food, water, pets, wildlife, and livestock, as we embark on this temporary space odyssey. Compare God's provisions to 'Spaceship Earth' with the provisions we give to our astronauts (Appendix 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: From it we created you, into it we return you, and from it we bring you out once more.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We showed him all our proofs, but he disbelieved and refused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did you come here to take us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We will surely show you similar magic. Therefore, set an appointment that neither we, nor you will violate; in a neutral place."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your appointed time shall be the day of festivities. Let us all meet in the forenoon."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh summoned his forces, then came.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said to them, "Woe to you. Do you fabricate lies to fight GOD and thus incur His retribution? Such fabricators will surely fail."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They disputed among themselves, as they conferred privately.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "These two are no more than magicians who wish to take you out of your land with their magic, and to destroy your ideal way of life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let us agree upon one scheme and face them as a united front. The winner today will have the upper hand."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "You throw." Whereupon, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, as if they were moving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses harbored some fear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We said, "Have no fear. You will prevail.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Throw what you hold in your right hand, and it will swallow what they fabricated. What they fabricated is no more than the scheming of a magician. The magician's work will not succeed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Experts Recognize The Truth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The magicians fell prostrate, saying, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did you believe in him without my permission? He must be your chief; the one who taught you magic. I will surely sever your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you on the palm trunks. You will find out which of us can inflict the worst retribution, and who outlasts whom."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We will not prefer you over the clear proofs that came to us, and over the One who created us. Therefore, issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We have believed in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic that you forced us to perform. GOD is far better and Everlasting."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Anyone who comes to his Lord guilty will incur Hell, wherein he never dies, nor stays alive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who come to Him as believers who had led a righteous life, they attain the high ranks.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The gardens of Eden, beneath which rivers flow, will be their abode forever. Such is the reward for those who purify themselves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We inspired Moses: "Lead My servants out, and strike for them a dry road across the sea. You shall not fear that you may get caught, nor shall you worry."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, but the sea overwhelmed them, as it was destined to overwhelm them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, Pharaoh misled his people; he did not guide them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O Children of Israel, we delivered you from your enemy, summoned you to the right side of Mount Sinai, and we sent down to you manna and quails.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eat from the good things we provided for you, and do not transgress, lest you incur My wrath. Whoever incurs My wrath has fallen.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: I am surely Forgiving for those who repent, believe, lead a righteous life, and steadfastly remain guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Children of Israel Rebel
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "Why did you rush away from your people, O Moses?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "They are close behind me. I have rushed to You my Lord, that You may be pleased."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "We have put your people to the test after you left, but the Samarian misled them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed, saying, "O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Could you not wait? Did you want to incur wrath from your Lord? Is this why you broke your agreement with me?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We did not break our agreement with you on purpose. But we were loaded down with jewelry, and decided to throw our loads in. This is what the Samarian suggested."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He produced for them a sculpted calf, complete with a calf's sound. They said, "This is your god, and the god of Moses." Thus, he forgot.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: & 96 The Samarian went to the spot where God spoke to Moses, and grabbed a fistful of dust upon which God's voice had echoed. This dust, when mixed with the molten gold caused the golden statue to acquire the sound of a calf.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Could they not see that it neither responded to them, nor possessed any power to harm them, or benefit them?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And Aaron had told them, "O my people, this is a test for you. Your only Lord is the Most Gracious, so follow me, and obey my commands."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We will continue to worship it, until Moses comes back."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Moses) said, "O Aaron, what is it that prevented you, when you saw them go astray,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "from following my orders? Have you rebelled against me?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O son of my mother, do not pull me by my beard and my head. I was afraid that you might say, 'You have divided the Children of Israel, and disobeyed my orders.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "What is the matter with you, O Samarian?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I saw what they could not see. I grabbed a fistful (of dust) from the place where the messenger stood, and used it (to mix into the golden calf). This is what my mind inspired me to do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Then go, and, throughout your life, do not even come close. You have an appointed time (for your final judgment) that you can never evade. Look at your god that you used to worship; we will burn it and throw it into the sea, to stay down there forever."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Have But One God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Your only god is GOD; the One beside whom there is no other god. His knowledge encompasses all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus narrate to you some news from the past generations. We have revealed to you a message from us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disregard it will bear a load (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eternally they abide therein; what a miserable load on the Day of Resurrection!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is the day when the horn is blown, and we summon the guilty on that day blue.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whispering among themselves, they will say, "You have stayed (in the first life) no more than ten days!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are fully aware of their utterances. The most accurate among them will say, "You stayed no more than a day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They ask you about the mountains. Say, "My Lord will wipe them out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He will leave them like a barren, flat land.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Not even the slightest hill will you see therein, nor a dip."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On that day, everyone will follow the caller, without the slightest deviation. All sounds will be hushed before the Most Gracious; you will hear nothing but whispers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On that day, intercession will be useless, except for those permitted by the Most Gracious, and whose utterances conform to His will.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He knows their past and their future, while none encompasses His knowledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All faces will submit to the Living, the Eternal, and those who are burdened by their transgressions will fail.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who worked righteousness, while believing, they will have no fear of injustice or adversity.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus revealed it, an Arabic Quran, and we cited in it all kinds of prophecies, that they may be saved, or it may cause them to take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most Exalted is GOD, the only true King. Do not rush into uttering the Quran before it is revealed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase my knowledge."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Humans Fail to Make a Firm Stand
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We tested Adam in the past, but he forgot, and we found him indecisive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When Satan challenged God's absolute authority (38:69), you and I did not make a firm stand against Satan. God is giving us a chance, on this earth, to redeem ourselves by denouncing Satan and upholding God's absolute authority (Appendix 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Recall that we said to the angels, "Fall prostrate before Adam." They fell prostrate, except Satan; he refused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then said, "O Adam, this is an enemy of you and your wife. Do not let him evict you from Paradise, lest you become miserable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You are guaranteed never to hunger therein, nor go unsheltered.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Nor will you thirst therein, nor suffer from any heat."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But the devil whispered to him, saying, "O Adam, let me show you the tree of eternity and unending kingship."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They ate from it, whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they tried to cover themselves with the leaves of Paradise. Adam thus disobeyed his Lord, and fell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, his Lord chose him, redeemed him, and guided him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Go down therefrom, all of you. You are enemies of one another. When guidance comes to you from Me, anyone who follows My guidance will not go astray, nor suffer any misery.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For the Disbelievers: Miserable Life Unavoidable
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "As for the one who disregards My message, he will have a miserable life, and we resurrect him, on the Day of Resurrection, blind."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will say, "My Lord, why did you summon me blind, when I used to be a seer?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will say, "Because you forgot our revelations when they came to you, you are now forgotten."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus requite those who transgress and refuse to believe in the revelations of their Lord. The retribution in the Hereafter is far worse and everlasting.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Does it ever occur to them how many previous generations we have annihilated? They are now walking in the homes of those before them. These are signs for those who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If it were not for your Lord's predetermined plan, they would have been judged immediately.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before sunset. And during the night glorify Him, as well as at both ends of the day, that you may be happy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And do not covet what we bestowed upon any other people. Such are temporary ornaments of this life, whereby we put them to the test. What your Lord provides for you is far better, and everlasting.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Parents' Responsibility
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall enjoin your family to observe the contact prayers (Salat), and steadfastly persevere in doing so. We do not ask you for any provisions; we are the ones who provide for you. The ultimate triumph belongs to the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Why Messengers?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "If he could only show us a miracle from his Lord!" Did they not receive sufficient miracles with the previous messages?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had we annihilated them before this, they would have said, "Our Lord, had You sent a messenger to us, we would have followed Your revelations, and would have avoided this shame and humiliation."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "All of us are waiting, so wait; you will surely find out who are on the correct path, and who are truly guided."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Fast approaching is the reckoning for the people, but they are oblivious, averse.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Opposition to the New Evidence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When a proof comes to them from their Lord, that is new, they listen to it heedlessly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their minds are heedless. And the transgressors confer secretly: "Is he not just a human being like you? Would you accept the magic that is presented to you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Although the Bible (Malachi 3:1) and the Quran (3:81) prophesy the advent of God's Messenger of the Covenant, when he did appear, supported by 'one of the greatest miracles' (74:30-35), he was met with heedlessness and opposition. The divine assertion that every 'new' proof is opposed has been proven by the Arabs' opposition to the Quran's miracle. (App. 1 & 2).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord knows every thought in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They even said, "Hallucinations," "He made it up," and, "He is a poet. Let him show us a miracle like those of the previous messengers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We never annihilated a believing community in the past. Are these people believers?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We did not send before you except men whom we inspired. Ask those who know the scripture, if you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We did not give them bodies that did not eat, nor were they immortal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We fulfilled our promise to them; we saved them together with whomever we willed, and annihilated the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent down to you a scripture containing your message. Do you not understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community we terminated because of their transgression, and we substituted other people in their place.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our requital came to pass, they started to run.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not run, and come back to your luxuries and your mansions, for you must be held accountable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Woe to us. We were really wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This continued to be their proclamation, until we completely wiped them out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and everything between them just for amusement.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we needed amusement, we could have initiated it without any of this, if that is what we wanted to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Instead, it is our plan to support the truth against falsehood, in order to defeat it. Woe to you for the utterances you utter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth, and those at Him are never too arrogant to worship Him, nor do they ever waver.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They glorify night and day, without ever tiring.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have they found gods on earth who can create?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If there were in them (the heavens and the earth) other gods beside GOD, there would have been chaos. Glory be to GOD; the Lord with absolute authority. He is high above their claims.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Never Question God's Wisdom
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He is never to be asked about anything He does, while all others are questioned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they found other gods beside Him? Say, "Show me your proof. This is the message to my generation, consummating all previous messages." Indeed, most of them do not recognize the truth; this is why they are so hostile.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One God / One Message / One Religion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We did not send any messenger before you except with the inspiration: "There is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, they said, "The Most Gracious has begotten a son!" Glory be to Him. All (messengers) are (His) honored servants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They never speak on their own, and they strictly follow His commands.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Myth of Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He knows their future and their past. They do not intercede, except for those already accepted by Him, and they are worried about their own necks.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The myth of intercession is Satan's most effective bait (see Appendix 8).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: If any of them claims to be a god beside Him, we requite him with Hell; we thus requite the wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Big Bang Theory Confirmed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do the unbelievers not realize that the heaven and the earth used to be one solid mass that we exploded into existence? And from water we made all living things. Would they believe?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Big Bang Theory is now supported by the Creator's infallible mathematical code (Appendix 1). Thus, it is no longer a theory; it is a law, a proven fact.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And we placed on earth stabilizers, lest it tumbles with them, and we placed straight roads therein, that they may be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we rendered the sky a guarded ceiling. Yet, they are totally oblivious to all the portents therein.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He is the One who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in its own orbit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We never decreed immortality for anyone before you; should you die, are they immortal?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every soul will taste death, after we put you to the test through adversity and prosperity, then to us you ultimately return.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Messengers Ridiculed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When those who disbelieve see you, they ridicule you: "Is this the one who challenges your gods?" Meanwhile, they remain totally heedless of the message from the Most Gracious.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The human being is impatient by nature. I will inevitably show you My signs; do not be in such a hurry.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge: "Where is that (retribution), if you are truthful?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If only those who disbelieve could envision themselves when they try to ward off the fire; off their faces and their backs! No one will help them then.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, it will come to them suddenly, and they will be utterly stunned. They can neither avoid it, nor can they receive any respite.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Messengers before you have been ridiculed, and, consequently, those who ridiculed them incurred the retribution for their ridiculing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Priorities Confused
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who can protect you from the Most Gracious during the night or during the day?" Indeed, they are totally oblivious to the message of their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they have gods who can protect them from us? They cannot even help themselves. Nor can they accompany one another when they are summoned to face us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have provided for these people and their ancestors, up until an old age. Do they not see that every day on earth brings them closer to the end? Can they reverse this process?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "I am warning you in accordance with divine inspiration." However, the deaf cannot hear the call, when they are warned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When a sample of your Lord's retribution afflicts them, they readily say, "We were indeed wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will establish the scales of justice on the Day of Resurrection. No soul will suffer the least injustice. Even the equivalent of a mustard seed will be accounted for. We are the most efficient reckoners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Prophets Moses and Aaron
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We gave Moses and Aaron the Statute Book, a beacon, and a reminder for the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The ones who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and they worry about the Hour.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This too is a blessed reminder that we sent down. Are you denying it?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Before that, we granted Abraham his guidance and understanding, for we were fully aware of him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Was Abraham so smart as to discover God, or, did God grant him the intelligence because He knew that he deserved to be saved? As it turns out, this whole world was created to redeem those among us who deserve redemption. When the angels suggested that all the rebels, humans and jinns, must be banished out of God's kingdom, 'I know what you do not know' (2:30). At the same time, this world proves Satan's incompetence as a god (App. 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoting yourselves?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We found our parents worshiping them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Indeed, you and your parents have gone totally astray."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Are you telling us the truth, or are you playing?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your only Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, who created them. This is the testimony to which I bear witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I swear by GOD, I have a plan to deal with your statues, as soon as you leave."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He broke them into pieces, except for a big one, that they may refer to it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Whoever did this to our gods is really a transgressor."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We heard a youth threaten them; he is called Abraham."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Bring him before the eyes of all the people, that they may bear witness."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Did you do this to our gods, O Abraham?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham Proves His Point
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "It is that big one who did it. Go ask them, if they can speak."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They were taken aback, and said to themselves, "Indeed, you are the ones who have been transgressing."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, they reverted to their old ideas: "You know full well that these cannot speak."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Do you then worship besides GOD what possesses no power to benefit you or harm you?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You have incurred shame by worshiping idols beside GOD. Do you not understand?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Profound Miracle
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "Burn him and support your gods, if this is what you decide to do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We said, "O fire, be cool and safe for Abraham."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Cool," without "and safe" would have caused Abraham to freeze.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Thus, they schemed against him, but we made them the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We saved him, and we saved Lot, to the land that we blessed for all the people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift, and we made them both righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham: Delivered All Religious Duties of Submission
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We made them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, and we taught them how to work righteousness, and how to observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat). To us, they were devoted worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the Quran was revealed, all religious duties were already established through Abraham (2:128, 16:123, 22:78).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for Lot, we granted him wisdom and knowledge, and we saved him from the community that practiced abominations; they were wicked and evil people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We admitted him into our mercy, for he was righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And, before that, Noah called and we responded to him. We saved him and his family from the great disaster.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We supported him against the people who rejected our revelations. They were evil people, so we drowned them all.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: David and Solomon
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And David and Solomon, when they once ruled with regard to someone's crop that was destroyed by another's sheep. We witnessed their judgment.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We granted Solomon the correct understanding, though we endowed both of them with wisdom and knowledge. We committed the mountains to serve David in glorifying (GOD), as well as the birds. This is what we did.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we taught him the skill of making shields to protect you in war. Are you then thankful?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For Solomon, we committed the wind gusting and blowing at his disposal. He could direct it as he wished, to whatever land he chose, and we blessed such land for him. We are fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And of the devils there were those who would dive for him (to harvest the sea), or do whatever else he commanded them to do. We committed them in his service.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Job
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And Job implored his Lord: "Adversity has befallen me, and, of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We responded to him, relieved his adversity, and restored his family for him, even twice as much. That was a mercy from us, and a reminder for the worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also, Ismail, Idrîs, Zal-Kifl; all were steadfast, patient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We admitted them into our mercy, for they were righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Jonah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And Zan-Noon (Jonah, "the one with an 'N' in his name"), abandoned his mission in protest, thinking that we could not control him. He ended up imploring from the darkness (of the big fish's belly): "There is no god other than You. Be You glorified. I have committed a gross sin."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We responded to him, and saved him from the crisis; we thus save the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Zachariah and John
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And Zachariah implored his Lord: "My Lord, do not keep me without an heir, though You are the best inheritor."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We responded to him and granted him John; we fixed his wife for him. That is because they used to hasten to work righteousness, and implored us in situations of joy, as well as fear. To us, they were reverent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The use of the plural tense throughout the Quran indicates participation of the angels. It is clear from 3:39 and from the Bible that the angels dealt with Zachariah extensively, as they gave him the good news about John. See Appendix 10.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Mary and Jesus
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for the one who maintained her virginity, we blew into her from our spirit, and thus, we made her and her son a portent for the whole world.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One God / One Religion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Your congregation is but one congregation, and I alone am your Lord; you shall worship Me alone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: However, they divided themselves into disputing religions. All of them will come back to us (for judgment).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who work righteousness, while believing, their work will not go to waste; we are recording it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is forbidden for any community we had annihilated to return.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The End of the World
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Not until Gog and Magog reappear, will they then return—they will come from every direction.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By the year 2270 AD, thanks to God's mathematical miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1), America will be the heart of Submission, and billions around the globe will have believed in the Quran (9:33, 41:53, 48:28, 61:9). Gog and Magog (allegorical names of villainous communities), will be the only bastions of heathenism, and they will attack the submitters. That is when the world will end (15:87, 18:94, Appendix 25). Gog and Magog are mentioned in 18:94 & 21:96, 17 verses before the end of each sura; this may indicate the time of their appearance.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: That is when the inevitable prophecy will come to pass, and the disbelievers will stare in horror: "Woe to us; we have been oblivious. Indeed, we have been wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Hereafter
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You and the idols you worship besides GOD will be fuel for Hell; this is your inevitable destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If those were gods, they would not have ended up in Hell. All its inhabitants abide in it forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will sigh and groan therein, and they will have no access to any news.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who deserved our magnificent rewards, they will be protected from it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Righteous
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They will not hear its hissing. They will enjoy an abode where they can get everything they desire, forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The great horror will not worry them, and the angels will receive them joyfully: "This is your day, that has been promised to you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: On that day, we will fold the heaven, like the folding of a book. Just as we initiated the first creation, we will repeat it. This is our promise; we will certainly carry it out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have decreed in the Psalms, as well as in other scriptures, that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is a proclamation for people who are worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent you out of mercy from us towards the whole world.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim, "I have been given divine inspiration that your god is one god. Will you then submit?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they turn away, then say, "I have warned you sufficiently, and I have no idea how soon or late (the retribution) will come to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He is fully aware of your public utterances, and He is fully aware of everything you conceal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "For all that I know, this world is a test for you, and a temporary enjoyment."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord, Your judgment is the absolute justice. Our Lord is the Most Gracious; only His help is sought in the face of your claims."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O people, you shall reverence your Lord, for the quaking of the Hour is something horrendous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day you witness it, even a nursing mother will discard her infant, and a pregnant woman will abort her fetus. You will see the people staggering, as if they are intoxicated, even though they are not intoxicated. This is because GOD's retribution is so awesome.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among the people, there are those who argue about GOD without knowledge, and follow every rebellious devil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is decreed that anyone who allies himself with him, he will mislead him and guide him to the agony of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Where Did We Come From?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O people, if you have any doubt about resurrection, (remember that) we created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, which turns into a hanging (embryo), then it becomes a fetus that is given life or deemed lifeless. We thus clarify things for you. We settle in the wombs whatever we will for a predetermined period. We then bring you out as infants, then you reach maturity. While some of you die young, others live to the worst age, only to find out that no more knowledge can be attained beyond a certain limit. Also, you look at a land that is dead, then as soon as we shower it with water, it vibrates with life and grows all kinds of beautiful plants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran's mathematical miracle is based on the number 19. As it turns out, this number represents the Creator's signature on His creations. Thus, you and I have 209 bones in our bodies (209=19x11). The length of pregnancy for a full term fetus is 266 days (19x14) (Langman's Medical Embryology, T. W. Sadler, Page 88, 1985).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: This proves that GOD is the Truth, and that He revives the dead, and that He is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And that the Hour is coming, no doubt about it, and that GOD resurrects those who are in the graves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A Common Occurrence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among the people there is the one who argues about GOD without knowledge, and without guidance, and without an enlightening scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Arrogantly he strives to divert the people from the path of GOD. He thus incurs humiliation in this life, and we commit him on the Day of Resurrection to the agony of burning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is what your hands have sent ahead for you. GOD is never unjust towards the people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Fair Weather Friends
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among the people there is the one who worships GOD conditionally. If things go his way, he is content. But if some adversity befalls him, he makes an about-face. Thus, he loses both this life and the Hereafter. Such is the real loss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He idolizes beside GOD what possesses no power to harm him or benefit him; such is the real straying.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He idolizes what is more apt to harm him than benefit him. What a miserable lord! What a miserable companion!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. Everything is in accordance with GOD's will.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Happiness Now, and Forever
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If anyone thinks that GOD cannot support him in this life and in the Hereafter, let him turn completely to (his Creator in) heaven, and sever (his dependence on anyone else). He will then see that this plan eliminates anything that bothers him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have thus revealed clear revelations herein, then GOD guides whomever He wills.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God: The Only Judge
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who believe, those who are Jewish, the converts, the Christians, the Zoroastrians, and the idol worshipers, GOD is the One who will judge among them on the Day of Resurrection. GOD witnesses all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that to GOD prostrates everyone in the heavens and the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the animals, and many people? Many others among the people are committed to doom. Whomever GOD shames, none will honor him. Everything is in accordance with GOD's will.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How Terrible is Hell!
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Here are two parties feuding with regard to their Lord. As for those who disbelieve, they will have clothes of fire tailored for them. Hellish liquid will be poured on top of their heads.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: People who have insisted upon going to Hell will inevitably complain: 'Had we known how bad this is, we would have behaved differently.' They will be told that the horrors of Hell have been pointed out to them in the most graphic, though symbolic, terms. It should be noted that Heaven and Hell are almost invariably mentioned together in the Quran.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: It will cause their insides to melt, as well as their skins.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will be confined in iron pots.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whenever they try to exit such misery, they will be forced back in: "Taste the agony of burning."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Bliss of Heaven
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD will admit those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have been guided to the good words; they have been guided in the path of the Most Praised.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who disbelieve and repulse others from the path of GOD, and from the Sacred Masjid that we designated for all the people—be they natives or visitors—and seek to pollute it and corrupt it, we will afflict them with painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pilgrimage, Like All Duties in Submission, Decreed Through Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We appointed Abraham to establish the Shrine: "You shall not idolize any other god beside Me, and purify My shrine for those who visit it, those who live near it, and those who bow and prostrate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham was the original messenger of Submission (Islam). See 22:78 and Appendix 9.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "And proclaim that the people shall observe Hajj pilgrimage. They will come to you walking or riding on various exhausted (means of transportation). They will come from the farthest locations."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They may seek commercial benefits, and they shall commemorate GOD's name during the specified days for providing them with livestock. "Eat therefrom and feed the despondent and the poor."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They shall complete their obligations, fulfill their vows, and visit the ancient shrine.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who reverence the rites decreed by GOD have deserved a good reward at their Lord. All livestock is made lawful for your food, except for those specifically prohibited for you. You shall avoid the abomination of idol worship, and avoid bearing false witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall maintain your devotion absolutely to GOD alone. Anyone who sets up any idol beside GOD is like one who fell from the sky, then gets snatched up by vultures, or blown away by the wind into a deep ravine.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, those who reverence the rites decreed by GOD demonstrate the righteousness of their hearts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Livestock Offerings During Pilgrimage
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The (livestock) provide you with many benefits for a period, before being donated to the ancient shrine.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For each congregation we have decreed rites whereby they commemorate the name of GOD for providing them with the livestock. Your god is one and the same god; you shall all submit to Him. Give good news to the obedient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are the ones whose hearts tremble upon mentioning GOD, they steadfastly persevere during adversity, they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them, they give to charity.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The animal offerings are among the rites decreed by GOD for your own good. You shall mention GOD's name on them while they are standing in line. Once they are offered for sacrifice, you shall eat therefrom and feed the poor and the needy. This is why we subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Animal offerings from the pilgrims conserve the resources at the pilgrimage site. Note that almost 2,000,000 pilgrims converge on Mecca during pilgrimage.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Neither their meat, nor their blood reaches GOD. What reaches Him is your righteousness. He has subdued them for you, that you may show your appreciation by glorifying GOD for guiding you. Give good news to the charitable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Defends the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD defends those who believe. GOD does not love any betrayer, unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Synagogues, Churches, and Masjids
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Permission is granted to those who are being persecuted, since injustice has befallen them, and GOD is certainly able to support them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They were evicted from their homes unjustly, for no reason other than saying, "Our Lord is GOD." If it were not for GOD's supporting of some people against others, monasteries, churches, synagogues, and masjids—where the name of GOD is commemorated frequently—would have been destroyed. Absolutely, GOD supports those who support Him. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are those who, if we appointed them as rulers on earth, they would establish the Contact Prayers (Salat) and the obligatory charity (Zakat), and would advocate righteousness and forbid evil. GOD is the ultimate ruler.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they reject you, the people of Noah, 'Ãd, and Thamûd have also disbelieved before them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And the dwellers of Midyan. Moses was also rejected. I led all those people on, then I called them to account; how (devastating) was My requital!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community have we annihilated because of their wickedness. They ended up with ruins, stilled wells, and great empty mansions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did they not roam the earth, then use their minds to understand, and use their ears to hear? Indeed, the real blindness is not the blindness of the eyes, but the blindness of the hearts inside the chests.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge you to bring retribution, and GOD never fails to fulfill His prophecy. A day of your Lord is like a thousand of your years.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community in the past committed evil, and I led them on for awhile, then I punished them. To Me is the ultimate destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "O people, I have been sent to you as a profound warner."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This command is directed specifically to God's Messenger of the Covenant. This fact, and the specific name of the messenger are mathematically coded into the Quran. See the details, together with the irrefutable proofs, in Appendices 2 and 26.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who strive to challenge our revelations, they incur Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The System
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We did not send before you any messenger, nor a prophet, without having the devil interfere in his wishes. GOD then nullifies what the devil has done. GOD perfects His revelations. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Throughout this worldly test, Satan is allowed to present his point of view (we are born with a representative of Satan in our bodies). This allows the people to make a choice between God's evidence and Satan's evidence. Satan's evidence is invariably based on lies. This system explains the fact that the devil's agents continuously come up with the most absurd lies, insults and accusations against every messenger (see 6:33-34, 8:30, 17:76-77, 27:70).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Hypocrites Drop Out
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He thus sets up the devil's scheme as a test for those who harbor doubts in their hearts, and those whose hearts are hardened. The wicked must remain with the opposition.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who are blessed with knowledge will recognize the truth from your Lord, then believe in it, and their hearts will readily accept it. Most assuredly, GOD guides the believers in the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who disbelieve, they will continue to harbor doubts until the Hour comes to them suddenly, or until the retribution of a terrible day comes to them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan's Temporary Kingship
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: All sovereignty on that day belongs to GOD, and He will judge among them. As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the gardens of bliss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: While those who disbelieved and rejected our revelations have incurred a shameful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Striving in the Cause of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who emigrate for the sake of GOD, then get killed, or die, GOD will surely shower them with good provisions. GOD is certainly the best Provider.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, He will admit them an admittance that will please them. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Help for the Oppressed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: It is decreed that if one avenges an injustice that was inflicted upon him, equitably, then is persecuted because of this, GOD will surely support him. GOD is Pardoner, Forgiving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Omnipotence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: It is a fact that GOD merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night, and that GOD is Hearer, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is a fact that GOD is the Truth, while the setting up of any idols beside Him constitutes a falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, the Supreme.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water that turns the land green? GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything on earth? The ships run in the ocean by His command. He prevents the heavenly bodies from crashing onto the earth, except in accordance with His command. GOD is Most Kind towards the people, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who granted you life, then He puts you to death, then He brings you back to life. Surely, the human being is unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For each congregation, we have decreed a set of rites that they must uphold. Therefore, they should not dispute with you. You shall continue to invite everyone to your Lord. Most assuredly, you are on the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they argue with you, then say, "GOD is fully aware of everything you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD will judge among you on the Day of Resurrection regarding all your disputes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that GOD knows everything in the heavens and everything on earth? All this is recorded in a record. This is easy for GOD to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, they idolize beside GOD idols wherein He placed no power, and they know nothing about them. The transgressors have no helper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Violence & Belligerence: Signs of Disbelief
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our revelations are recited to them, clearly, you recognize wickedness on the faces of those who disbelieve. They almost attack those who recite our revelations to them. Say, "Shall I inform you of something much worse? Hell is promised by GOD for those who disbelieve; what a miserable destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Can They Create a Fly?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O people, here is a parable that you must ponder carefully: the idols you set up beside GOD can never create a fly, even if they banded together to do so. Furthermore, if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it; weak is the pursuer and the pursued.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They do not value GOD as He should be valued. GOD is the Most Powerful, the Almighty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD chooses from among the angels messengers, as well as from among the people. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He knows their past and their future. To GOD belongs the ultimate control of all matters.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall bow, prostrate, worship your Lord, and work righteousness, that you may succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham: Original Messenger of Submission
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall strive for the cause of GOD as you should strive for His cause. He has chosen you and has placed no hardship on you in practicing your religion—the religion of your father Abraham. He is the one who named you "Submitters" originally. Thus, the messenger shall serve as a witness among you, and you shall serve as witnesses among the people. Therefore, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and hold fast to GOD; He is your Lord, the best Lord and the best Supporter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Although all messengers preached one and the same message, "Worship God alone," Abraham was the first messenger to coin the terms "Submission" (Islam) and "Submitter" (Muslim) (2:128). What did Abraham contribute to Submission (Islam)? We learn from 16:123 that all religious duties in Submission were revealed through Abraham (see Appendices 9 & 26).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Successful indeed are the believers;
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: who are reverent during their Contact Prayers (Salat).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they avoid vain talk.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they give their obligatory charity (Zakat).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they maintain their chastity.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only with their spouses, or those who are rightfully theirs, do they have sexual relations; they are not to be blamed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who transgress these limits are the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When it comes to deposits entrusted to them, as well as any agreements they make, they are trustworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they observe their Contact Prayers (Salat) regularly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such are the inheritors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will inherit Paradise, wherein they abide forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Accurate Embryology
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We created the human being from a certain kind of mud.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, we reproduced him from a tiny drop, that is placed into a well protected repository.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we developed the drop into a hanging (embryo), then developed the hanging (embryo) into a bite-size (fetus), then created the bite-size (fetus) into bones, then covered the bones with flesh. We thus produce a new creature. Most blessed is GOD, the best Creator.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then, later on, you die.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Seven Universes
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We created above you seven universes in layers, and we are never unaware of a single creature in them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Innumerable Blessings From God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We send down from the sky water, in exact measure, then we store it in the ground. Certainly, we can let it escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: With it, we produce for you orchards of date palms, grapes, all kinds of fruits, and various foods.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also, a tree native to Sinai produces oil, as well as relish for the eaters.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And the livestock should provide you with a lesson. We let you drink (milk) from their bellies, you derive other benefits from them, and some of them you use for food.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On them, and on the ships, you ride.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Noah to his people, saying, "O my people, worship GOD. You have no other god beside Him. Would you not be righteous?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders who disbelieved among his people said, "This is no more than a human like you, who wants to gain prominence among you. Had GOD willed, He could have sent down angels. We never heard of anything like this from our ancestors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He is simply a man gone crazy. Just ignore him for awhile."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then inspired him: "Make the watercraft under our watchful eyes, and in accordance with our inspiration. When our command comes, and the atmosphere boils up, put on it a pair of every kind (of your domesticated animals), and your family, except those condemned to be doomed. Do not speak to Me on behalf of those who transgressed; they will be drowned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The story tellers have created a mockery of Noah's history. Noah's ark was a flat watercraft made of logs, tied together with primitive ropes (54:13), the flood was local, around the Dead Sea area, and the animals were Noah's domesticated animals.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Once you are settled, together with those who are with you, on the watercraft, you shall say, 'Praise GOD for saving us from the evil people.'
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And say, 'My Lord, let me disembark onto a blessed location; You are the best deliverer.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These should provide sufficient proofs for you. We will certainly put you to the test.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, we established another generation after them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We sent to them a messenger from among them, saying, "You shall worship GOD. You have no other god beside Him. Would you not be righteous?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders among his people who disbelieved and rejected the idea of the Hereafter—although we provided for them generously in this life—said, "This is no more than a human being like you. He eats from what you eat, and drinks as you drink.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If you obey a human being like you, then you are really losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Does he promise you that, after you die and turn into dust and bones, you will come out again?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Impossible, impossible indeed is what is promised to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We only live this life—we live and die—and we will never be resurrected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He is just a man who fabricated lies and attributed them to GOD. We will never believe him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory, for they have disbelieved me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Soon they will be sorry."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The retribution struck them, equitably, and thus, we turned them into ruins. The wicked people perished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, we established other generations after them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No community can advance its predetermined fate, nor delay it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we sent our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger went to his community, they disbelieved him. Consequently, we annihilated them, one after the other, and made them history. The people who disbelieved have perished.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses and Aaron
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Then we sent Moses and his brother Aaron with our revelations and a profound proof.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Pharaoh and his elders, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Shall we believe for two men whose people are our slaves?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They rejected the two, and consequently, they were annihilated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We gave Moses the scripture, that they may be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and we gave them refuge on a mesa with food and drink.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One God/One Religion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you messengers, eat from the good provisions, and work righteousness. I am fully aware of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is your congregation—one congregation—and I am your Lord; you shall reverence Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But they tore themselves into disputing factions; each party happy with what they have.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, just leave them in their confusion, for awhile.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they think that, since we provided them with money and children,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: we must be showering them with blessings? Indeed, they have no idea.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who are reverently conscious of their Lord,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And who never set up any idols beside their Lord,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As they give their charities, their hearts are fully reverent. For they recognize that they will be summoned before their Lord,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are eager to do righteous works; they compete in doing them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Unappreciative
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We never burden any soul beyond its means, and we keep a record that utters the truth. No one will suffer injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Because their minds are oblivious to this, they commit works that do not conform with this; their works are evil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then, when we requite their leaders with retribution, they complain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not complain now; you have given up all help from us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: My proofs have been presented to you, but you turned back on your heels.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You were too arrogant to accept them, and you defiantly disregarded them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Why do they not reflect upon this scripture? Do they not realize that they have received something never attained by their ancestors?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they failed to recognize their messenger? Is this why they are disregarding him?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they decided that he is crazy? Indeed, he has brought the truth to them, but most of them hate the truth.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, if the truth conformed to their wishes, there would be chaos in the heavens and the earth; everything in them would be corrupted. We have given them their proof, but they are disregarding their proof.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Are you asking them for a wage? Your Lord's wage is far better. He is the best Provider.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, you are inviting them to a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve in the Hereafter will surely deviate from the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Even when we showered them with mercy, and relieved their problems, they plunged deeper into transgression, and continued to blunder.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Even when we afflicted them with retribution, they never turned to their Lord imploring.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, when we requited them with the severe retribution they had incurred, they were shocked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who granted you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains. Rarely are you appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who established you on earth, and before Him you will be summoned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who controls life and death, and He is the One who alternates the night and day. Do you not understand?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said what their ancestors said.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "After we die and become dust and bones, we get resurrected?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Such promises were given to us and to our parents in the past. These are no more than tales from the past."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most Believers are Destined for Hell
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "To whom belongs the earth and everyone on it, if you know?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Belief in God is valid only if one recognizes God's qualities, such as the fact that God controls everything (8:17). Believers who do not know God are not really believers. Most believers nullify their belief by idolizing such powerless idols as the prophets and saints (6:106).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They will say, "To GOD." Say, "Why then do you not take heed?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who is the Lord of the seven universes; the Lord of the great dominion?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you not turn righteous?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "In whose hand is all sovereignty over all things, and He is the only one who can provide help, but needs no help, if you know?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "GOD." Say, "Where did you go wrong?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given them the truth, while they are liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has never begotten a son. Nor was there ever any other god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have declared independence with his creations, and they would have competed with each other for dominance. GOD be glorified; far above their claims.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Knower of all secrets and declarations; be He exalted, far above having a partner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord, whether You show me (the retribution) they have incurred,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, let me not be one of the transgressing people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To show you (the retribution) we have reserved for them is something we can easily do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, counter their evil works with goodness; we are fully aware of their claims.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Be Protected From Satan
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of the devils.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come near me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Dead Never Come Back Until the Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I will then work righteousness in everything I left." Not true. This is a false claim that he makes. A barrier will separate his soul from this world until resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the horn is blown, no relations among them will exist on that day, nor will they care about one another.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those whose weights are heavy, they will be the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those whose weights are light are the ones who lost their souls; they abide in Hell forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Fire will overwhelm their faces, and they last miserably therein.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Our Lord, our wickedness overwhelmed us, and we were people gone astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Our Lord, take us out of this; if we return (to our old behavior), then we are really wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will say, "Abide therein, humiliated, and do not speak to Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Ridiculed the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "A group of My servants used to say, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and shower us with mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful.'
