segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "But you mocked and ridiculed them, to the extent that you forgot Me. You used to laugh at them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I have rewarded them today, in return for their steadfastness, by making them the winners."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "How long have you lasted on earth? How many years?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We lasted a day or part of a day. Ask those who counted."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "In fact, you stayed but a brief interim, if you only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Did you think that we created you in vain; that you were not to be returned to us?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most exalted is GOD, the true Sovereign. There is no other god beside Him; the Most Honorable Lord, possessor of all authority.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Anyone who idolizes beside GOD any other god, and without any kind of proof, his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers never succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord, shower us with forgiveness and mercy. Of all the merciful ones, You are the Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A sura that we have sent down, and we have decreed as law. We have revealed in it clear revelations, that you may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Adultery
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The adulteress and the adulterer you shall whip each of them a hundred lashes. Do not be swayed by pity from carrying out GOD's law, if you truly believe in GOD and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their penalty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Social pressure, i.e., public witnessing of the penalty, is the basic punishment (see also 5:38). The lashes shall be symbolic, not severe.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The adulterer will end up marrying an adulteress or an idol worshiper, and the adulteress will end up marrying an adulterer or an idol worshiper. This is prohibited for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who accuse married women of adultery, then fail to produce four witnesses, you shall whip them eighty lashes, and do not accept any testimony from them; they are wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they repent afterwards and reform, then GOD is Forgiver, Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who accuse their own spouses, without any other witnesses, then the testimony may be accepted if he swears by GOD four times that he is telling the truth.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The fifth oath shall be to incur GOD's condemnation upon him, if he was lying.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She shall be considered innocent if she swears by GOD four times that he is a liar.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The fifth oath shall incur GOD's wrath upon her if he was telling the truth.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is GOD's grace and mercy towards you. GOD is Redeemer, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How to Deal With Rumors and Unproven Accusations
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: A gang among you produced a big lie. Do not think that it was bad for you; instead, it was good for you. Meanwhile, each one of them has earned his share of the guilt. As for the one who initiated the whole incident, he has incurred a terrible retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This refers to a historical incident where the Prophet's wife Aysha was left in the desert by mistake, and later found by a young man who helped her catch up with the Prophet's caravan. This triggered the famous 'Big Lie' against Aysha.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: When you heard it, the believing men and the believing women should have had better thoughts about themselves, and should have said, "This is obviously a big lie."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only if they produced four witnesses (you may believe them). If they fail to produce the witnesses, then they are, according to GOD, liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy in this world and in the Hereafter, you would have suffered a great retribution because of this incident.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You fabricated it with your own tongues, and the rest of you repeated it with your mouths without proof. You thought it was simple, when it was, according to GOD, gross.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What to Do
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When you heard it, you should have said, "We will not repeat this. Glory be to You. This is a gross falsehood."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD admonishes you that you shall never do it again, if you are believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD thus explains the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers have incurred a painful retribution in this life and in the Hereafter. GOD knows, while you do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD showers you with His grace and mercy. GOD is Most Kind towards the believers, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Devil Encourages Baseless Accusations
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not follow the steps of Satan. Anyone who follows the steps of Satan, should know that he advocates evil and vice. If it were not for GOD's grace towards you, and His mercy, none of you would have been purified. But GOD purifies whomever He wills. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those among you who are blessed with resources and wealth shall be charitable towards their relatives, the poor, and those who have immigrated for the sake of GOD. They shall treat them with kindness and tolerance; do you not love to attain GOD's forgiveness? GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Gross Sin
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who falsely accuse married women who are pious believers have incurred condemnation in this life and in the Hereafter; they have incurred a horrendous retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when their own tongues, hands, and feet will bear witness to everything they had done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On that day, GOD will requite them fully for their works, and they will find out that GOD is the Truth.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The bad women for the bad men, and the bad men for the bad women, and the good women for the good men, and the good men for the good women. The latter are innocent of such accusations. They have attained forgiveness and a generous reward.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Divine Etiquette
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not enter homes other than yours without permission from their inhabitants, and without greeting them. This is better for you, that you may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you find no one in them, do not enter them until you obtain permission. If you are told, "Go back," you must go back. This is purer for you. GOD is fully aware of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You commit no error by entering uninhabited homes wherein there is something that belongs to you. GOD knows everything you reveal, and everything you conceal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Dress Code for Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Tell the believing men that they shall subdue their eyes (and not stare at the women), and to maintain their chastity. This is purer for them. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Dressing modestly, therefore, is a trait of the believing men and women. The minimum requirements for a woman's dress is to lengthen her garment (33:59) and to cover her chest. Tyrannical Arab traditions have given a false impression that a woman must be covered from head to toe; such is not a Quranic or Islamic dress.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And tell the believing women to subdue their eyes, and maintain their chastity. They shall not reveal any parts of their bodies, except that which is necessary. They shall cover their chests, and shall not relax this code in the presence of other than their husbands, their fathers, the fathers of their husbands, their sons, the sons of their husbands, their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, other women, the male servants or employees whose sexual drive has been nullified, or the children who have not reached puberty. They shall not strike their feet when they walk in order to shake and reveal certain details of their bodies. All of you shall repent to GOD, O you believers, that you may succeed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Encourage Marriage to Discourage Immorality
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall encourage those of you who are single to get married. They may marry the righteous among your male and female servants, if they are poor. GOD will enrich them from His grace. GOD is Bounteous, Knower.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who cannot afford to get married shall maintain morality until GOD provides for them from His grace. Those among your servants who wish to be freed in order to marry, you shall grant them their wish, once you realize that they are honest. And give them from GOD's money that He has bestowed upon you. You shall not force your girls to commit prostitution, seeking the materials of this world, if they wish to be chaste. If anyone forces them, then GOD, seeing that they are forced, is Forgiver, Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have revealed to you clarifying revelations, and examples from the past generations, and an enlightenment for the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD is the light of the heavens and the earth. The allegory of His light is that of a concave mirror behind a lamp that is placed inside a glass container. The glass container is like a bright, pearl-like star. The fuel thereof is supplied from a blessed oil-producing tree, that is neither eastern, nor western. Its oil is almost self-radiating; needs no fire to ignite it. Light upon light. GOD guides to His light whomever He wills. GOD thus cites the parables for the people. GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (GOD's guidance is found) in houses exalted by GOD, for His name is commemorated therein. Glorifying Him therein, day and night—
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those Who Frequent the Masjid
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: People who are not distracted by business or trade from commemorating GOD; they observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they are conscious of the day when the minds and the eyes will be horrified.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD will certainly reward them for their good works, and will shower them with His grace. GOD provides for whomever He wills without limits.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Chasing A Mirage
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who disbelieve, their works are like a mirage in the desert. A thirsty person thinks that it is water. But when he reaches it, he finds that it is nothing, and he finds GOD there instead, to requite him fully for his works. GOD is the most efficient reckoner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Exile From God: Total Darkness
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Another allegory is that of being in total darkness in the midst of a violent ocean, with waves upon waves, in addition to thick fog. Darkness upon darkness—if he looked at his own hand, he could barely see it. Whomever GOD deprives of light, will have no light.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that everyone in the heavens and the earth glorifies GOD, even the birds as they fly in a column? Each knows its prayer and its glorification. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and to GOD is the final destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that GOD drives the clouds, then gathers them together, then piles them on each other, then you see the rain coming out of them? He sends down from the sky loads of snow to cover whomever He wills, while diverting it from whomever He wills. The brightness of the snow almost blinds the eyes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD controls the night and day. This should be a lesson for those who possess eyes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD created every living creature from water. Some of them walk on their bellies, some walk on two legs, and some walk on four. GOD creates whatever He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent down to you clarifying revelations, then GOD guides whoever wills in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Sends Instructions Through His Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They say, "We believe in GOD and in the messenger, and we obey," but then some of them slide back afterwards. These are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they are invited to GOD and His messenger to judge among them, some of them get upset.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: However, if the judgment is in their favor, they readily accept it!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is there a disease in their hearts? Are they doubtful? Are they afraid that GOD and His messenger may treat them unfairly? In fact, it is they who are unjust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believers Unhesitatingly Obey God and His Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The only utterance of the believers, whenever invited to GOD and His messenger to judge in their affairs, is to say, "We hear and we obey." These are the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who obey GOD and His messenger, and reverence GOD and observe Him, these are the triumphant ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They swear by GOD, solemnly, that if you commanded them to mobilize, they would mobilize. Say, "Do not swear. Obedience is an obligation. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Obey GOD, and obey the messenger." If they refuse, then he is responsible for his obligations, and you are responsible for your obligations. If you obey him, you will be guided. The sole duty of the messenger is to deliver (the message).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Promise Kings and Queens on Earth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD promises those among you who believe and lead a righteous life, that He will make them sovereigns on earth, as He did for those before them, and will establish for them the religion He has chosen for them, and will substitute peace and security for them in place of fear. All this because they worship Me alone; they never set up any idols beside Me. Those who disbelieve after this are the truly wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Formula for Success
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat) and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and obey the messenger, that you may attain mercy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not think that those who disbelieve will ever get away with it. Their final abode is Hell; what a miserable destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Etiquette Two Prayers Mentioned by Name
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, permission must be requested by your servants and the children who have not attained puberty (before entering your rooms). This is to be done in three instances—before the Dawn Prayer, at noon when you change your clothes to rest, and after the Night Prayer. These are three private times for you. At other times, it is not wrong for you or them to mingle with one another. GOD thus clarifies the revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Once the children reach puberty, they must ask permission (before entering) like those who became adults before them have asked permission (before entering). GOD thus clarifies His revelations for you. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Dress Modestly
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The elderly women who do not expect to get married commit nothing wrong by relaxing their dress code, provided they do not reveal too much of their bodies. To maintain modesty is better for them. GOD is Hearer, Knower.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Be Sure Your Meal is Lawful
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, nor the handicapped is to be blamed, just as you are not to be blamed for eating at your homes, or the homes of your fathers, or the homes of your mothers, or the homes of your brothers, or the homes of your sisters, or the homes of your fathers' brothers, or the homes of your fathers' sisters, or the homes of your mothers' brothers, or the homes of your mothers' sisters, or the homes that belong to you and you possess their keys, or the homes of your friends. You commit nothing wrong by eating together or as individuals. When you enter any home, you shall greet each other a greeting from GOD that is blessed and good. GOD thus explains the revelations for you, that you may understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The true believers are those who believe in GOD and His messenger, and when they are with him in a community meeting, they do not leave him without permission. Those who ask permission are the ones who do believe in GOD and His messenger. If they ask your permission, in order to tend to some of their affairs, you may grant permission to whomever you wish, and ask GOD to forgive them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This verse refers to God's Messenger of the Covenant; by adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505) plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus the verse number (62), we get 1292, a multiple of 19 (1292=19x68). See Appendix 2.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Do not treat the messenger's requests as you treat each others' requests. GOD is fully aware of those among you who sneak away using flimsy excuses. Let them beware—those who disobey his orders—for a disaster may strike them, or a severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, to GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. He fully knows every condition you may be in. The day you are returned to Him, He will inform them of everything they had done. GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most blessed is the One who revealed the Statute Book to His servant, so he can serve as a warner to the whole world.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The One to whom belongs all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He never had a son, nor does He have any partners in sovereignty. He created everything in exact measure; He precisely designed everything.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we launch astronauts into space, we measure precisely the amount of food, water, oxygen, and other needs throughout the journey. Similarly, God has launched us into space—on board spaceship Earth—and He has designed all kinds of renewable provisions for us and other creatures, a perfect design. Think, for example, of the symbiotic relationship between us and the plants; we use the oxygen they produce in photosynthesis, while they use the carbon dioxide we produce in respiration.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Yet, they set up beside Him gods who do not create anything—they themselves are created—and who possess no power to even harm or benefit themselves, nor do they possess any power to control life, or death, or resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers Rebutted by the Quran's Mathematical Code
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved said, "This is a fabrication that he produced, with the help of some other people." They have uttered a blasphemy and a falsehood.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They also said, "Tales from the past that he wrote down; they were dictated to him day and night."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad's contemporaries knew that he was a literate man who could read and write; he wrote God's revelations with his own hand (see Appendix 28).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "This was revealed by the One who knows the Secret in the heavens and the earth. He is Forgiving, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran's miraculous mathematical code, the incontrovertible answer to the disbelievers' claims, remained a divinely guarded secret for 1400 years. God's Messenger of the Covenant was destined to unveil it by God's leave (Appendices 1, 2, & 26).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Typical Utterances of Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: And they said, "How come this messenger eats the food and walks in the markets? If only an angel could come down with him, to serve with him as a preacher!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or, "If only a treasure could be given to him!" Or, "If only he could possess an orchard from which he eats!" The transgressors also said, "You are following a bewitched man."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Note how they called you all kinds of names, and how this led them astray, never to find their way back.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most blessed is the One who can, if He wills, give you much better than their demands—gardens with flowing streams, and many mansions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Real Reason
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: In fact, they have disbelieved in the Hour (Day of Resurrection), and we have prepared for those who disbelieve in the Hour a flaming Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Retribution for the Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When it sees them from afar, they will hear its rage and fuming.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And when they are thrown into it, through a narrow place, all shackled, they will declare their remorse.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You will not declare just a single remorse, on that day; you will suffer through a great number of remorses.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Reward for the Righteous
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Is this better or the eternal Paradise that is promised for the righteous? It is their well deserved reward; a well deserved destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They get anything they wish therein, forever. This is your Lord's irrevocable promise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the day when He summons them, together with the idols they had set up beside GOD, He will say, "Have you misled these servants of Mine, or did they go astray on their own?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Be You glorified, it was not right for us to set up any lords beside You. But You allowed them to enjoy, together with their parents. Consequently, they disregarded the message and thus became wicked people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have disbelieved in the message you have given them, and, consequently, you can neither protect them from the retribution they have incurred, nor can you help them in any way. Anyone among you who commits evil, we will commit him to severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Messengers Are Just Human Beings
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We did not send any messengers before you who did not eat food and walk in the markets. We thus test you by each other; will you steadfastly persevere? Your Lord is Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who do not expect to meet us said, "If only the angels could come down to us, or we could see our Lord (we would then believe)!" Indeed, they have committed a gross arrogance, and have produced a gross blasphemy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day they see the angels, it will not be good news for the guilty; they will say, "Now, we are irreversibly confined."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will look at all the works they have done, and render them null and void.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The dwellers of Paradise are far better on that day; they will hear better news.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The heaven will break apart, into masses of clouds, and the angels will descend in multitudes.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All sovereignty on that day belongs to the Most Gracious. For the disbelievers, it will be a difficult day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The day will come when the transgressor will bite his hands (in anguish) and say, "Alas, I wish I had followed the path with the messenger.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This verse refers also to God's Messenger of the Covenant whose name is mathematically coded in the Quran as "Rashad Khalifa." If you write down the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), followed by the gematrical value of "Khalifa" (725), followed by this sura number (25), followed by verses 27, 28, 29, and 30, the final number (5057252527282930) is a multiple of 19 (see Appendices 2 & 26 for details). The prophet Muhammad will also make such a statement as in 25:30 on the Day of Judgment.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Alas, woe to me, I wish I did not take that person as a friend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He has led me away from the message after it came to me. Indeed, the devil lets down his human victims."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The messenger said, "My Lord, my people have deserted this Quran."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We also set up against every prophet enemies from among the guilty. Your Lord suffices as a guide, a master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved said, "Why did not the Quran come through him all at once?" We have released it to you gradually, in order to fix it in your memory. We have recited it in a specific sequence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Evidence is Overwhelming
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whatever argument they come up with, we provide you with the truth, and a better understanding.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who are forcibly summoned to Hell are in the worst position; they are the farthest from the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given Moses the scripture, and appointed his brother Aaron to be his assistant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We said, "Go, both of you, to the people who rejected our revelations," and subsequently, we utterly annihilated the rejectors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Similarly, when the people of Noah disbelieved the messengers, we drowned them, and we set them up as a sign for the people. We have prepared for the transgressors a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also 'Ãd, Thamûd, the inhabitants of Al-Russ, and many generations between them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To each of these groups, we delivered sufficient examples, before we annihilated them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have passed by the community that was showered with a miserable shower (Sodom). Did they not see it? The fact is, they never believed in resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Messengers Ridiculed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they saw you, they always ridiculed you: "Is this the one chosen by GOD to be a messenger?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He almost diverted us from our gods, if it were not that we steadfastly persevered with them." They will certainly find out, when they see the retribution, who are the real strayers from the path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Ego as a god
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have you seen the one whose god is his own ego? Will you be his advocate?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you think that most of them hear, or understand? They are just like animals; no, they are far worse.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Infinite Blessings From God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have you not seen how your Lord designed the shadow? If He willed, He could have made it fixed, then we would have designed the sun accordingly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But we designed it to move slowly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who designed the night to be a cover, and for you to sleep and rest. And He made the day a resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sends the winds with good omens of His mercy, and we send down from the sky pure water.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: With it, we revive dead lands and provide drink for our creations—multitudes of animals and humans.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have distributed it among them in exact measure, that they may take heed. But most people insist upon disbelieving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we willed, we could have sent to every community a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with this, a great striving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who merges the two seas; one is fresh and palatable, while the other is salty and undrinkable. And He separated them with a formidable, inviolable barrier (evaporation).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who created from water a human being, then made him reproduce through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yet, they still set up beside GOD idols that cannot benefit them, nor harm them. Indeed, the disbeliever is an enemy of his Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent you (Rashad) as a deliverer of good news, as well as a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the sura and verse number (25+56) give a total of 1230+25+56=1311=19x69.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "I do not ask you for any money. All I seek is to help you find the right path to your Lord, if this is what you choose."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Prophets and the Saints Are Dead
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall put your trust in the One who is Alive—the One who never dies—and praise Him and glorify Him. He is fully Cognizant of His creatures' sins.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, in six days, then assumed all authority. The Most Gracious; ask about Him those who are well founded in knowledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Unappreciative Human
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they are told, "Fall prostrate before the Most Gracious," they say, "What is the Most Gracious? Shall we prostrate before what you advocate?" Thus, it only augments their aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most blessed is the One who placed constellations in the sky, and placed in it a lamp, and a shining moon.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who designed the night and the day to alternate: a sufficient proof for those who wish to take heed, or to be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Traits of the Righteous
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The worshipers of the Most Gracious are those who tread the earth gently, and when the ignorant speak to them, they only utter peace.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In the privacy of the night, they meditate on their Lord, and fall prostrate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they say, "Our Lord, spare us the agony of Hell; its retribution is horrendous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "It is the worst abode; the worst destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they give, they are neither extravagant, nor stingy; they give in moderation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They never implore beside GOD any other god, nor do they kill any soul—for GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. Nor do they commit adultery. Those who commit these offenses will have to pay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Retribution is doubled for them on the Day of Resurrection, and they abide therein humiliated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Exempted are those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life. GOD transforms their sins into credits. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who repent and lead a righteous life, GOD redeems them; a complete redemption.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additional Traits of the Righteous
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They do not bear false witness. When they encounter vain talk, they ignore it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When reminded of their Lord's revelations, they never react to them as if they were deaf and blind.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And they say, "Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us, and keep us in the forefront of the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These are the ones who attain Paradise in return for their steadfastness; they are received therein with joyous greetings and peace.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eternally they abide therein; what a beautiful destiny; what a beautiful abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You attain value at my Lord only through your worship. But if you disbelieve, you incur the inevitable consequences."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: T. S. M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 1 for the significance of these previously mysterious letters.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: These (letters) constitute proofs of this clarifying scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You may blame yourself that they are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we will, we can send from the sky a sign that forces their necks to bow.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran's Mathematical Code
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whenever a reminder from the Most Gracious comes to them, that is new, they turn away in aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Since they disbelieved, they have incurred the consequences of their heedlessness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not seen the earth, and how many kinds of beautiful plants we have grown thereon?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a sufficient proof for them, but most of them are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that your Lord called Moses: "Go to the transgressing people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Pharaoh's people; perhaps they reform."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, I fear lest they disbelieve me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I may lose my temper. My tongue gets tied; send for my brother Aaron.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Also, they consider me a fugitive; I fear lest they kill me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "No, (they will not). Go with My proofs. We will be with you, listening.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are messengers from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: " 'Let the Children of Israel go.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did we not raise you from infancy, and you spent many years with us?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Then you committed the crime that you committed, and you were ungrateful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Indeed, I did it when I was astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Then I fled, when I feared you, and my Lord endowed me with wisdom and made me one of the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You are boasting that you did me a favor, while enslaving the Children of Israel!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh said, "What is the Lord of the universe?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. You should be certain about this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said to those around him, "Did you hear this?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Your messenger who is sent to you is crazy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "The Lord of the east and the west, and everything between them, if you understand."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "If you accept any god, other than me, I will throw you in the prison."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "What if I show you something profound?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Then produce it, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He then threw his staff, whereupon it became a profound snake.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And he took out his hand, and it was white to the beholders.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said to the elders around him, "This is an experienced magician.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He wants to take you out of your land, with his magic. What do you suggest?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Respite him and his brother, and send summoners to every town.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let them summon every experienced magician."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The magicians were gathered at the appointed time, on the appointed day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The people were told: "Come one and all; let us gather together here.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Maybe we will follow the magicians, if they are the winners."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, "Do we get paid, if we are the winners?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Yes indeed; you will even be close to me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said to them, "Throw what you are going to throw."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They threw their ropes and sticks, and said, "By Pharaoh's majesty, we will be the victors."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses threw his staff, whereupon it swallowed what they fabricated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Experts See the Truth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The magicians fell prostrate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We believe in the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Did you believe with him before I give you permission? He must be your teacher, who taught you magic. You will surely find out. I will cut your hands and feet on alternate sides. I will crucify you all."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "This will not change our decision; to our Lord we will return.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, especially that we are the first believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We inspired Moses: "Travel with My servants; you will be pursued."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh sent to the cities callers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Proclaiming,) "This is a small gang.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "They are now opposing us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let us all beware of them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Inevitable Retribution
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we deprived them of gardens and springs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And treasures and an honorable position.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we made it an inheritance for the Children of Israel.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They pursued them towards the east.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When both parties saw each other, Moses' people said, "We will be caught."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "No way. My Lord is with me; He will guide me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then inspired Moses: "Strike the sea with your staff," whereupon it parted. Each part was like a great hill.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then delivered them all.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus saved Moses and all those who were with him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we drowned the others.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a sufficient proof, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Narrate to them Abraham's history.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said to his father and his people, "What is this you are worshiping?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We worship statues; we are totally devoted to them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Can they hear you when you implore?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Can they benefit you, or harm you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "No; but we found our parents doing this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Do you see these idols that you worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You and your ancestors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am against them, for I am devoted only to the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The One who created me, and guided me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The One who feeds me and waters me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And when I get sick, He heals me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The One who puts me to death, then brings me back to life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The One who hopefully will forgive my sins on the Day of Judgment.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let the example I set for the future generations be a good one.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Make me one of the inheritors of the blissful Paradise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And forgive my father, for he has gone astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And do not forsake me on the Day of Resurrection."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is the day when neither money, nor children, can help.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only those who come to GOD with their whole heart (will be saved).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Paradise will be presented to the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Hell will be set up for the strayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Will Disown Their Idols
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They will be asked, "Where are the idols you had worshiped
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "beside GOD? Can they help you now? Can they help themselves?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will be thrown therein, together with the strayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And all of Satan's soldiers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say as they feud therein,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "By GOD, we were far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "How could we set you up to rank with the Lord of the universe?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Those who misled us were wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Now we have no intercessors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Nor a single close friend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "If only we could get another chance, we would then believe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a good lesson. But most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their brother Noah said to them, "Would you not be righteous?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am an honest messenger to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not ask you for any wage. My wage comes from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD and obey me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "How can we believe with you, when the worst among us have followed you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "How do I know what they did?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Their judgment rests only with my Lord, if you could perceive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I will never dismiss the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am no more than a clarifying warner."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Unless you refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, my people have disbelieved me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Grant me victory against them, and deliver me and my company of believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We delivered him and those who accompanied him in the loaded ark.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then we drowned the others.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Hûd
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Ãd disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their brother Hûd said to them, "Would you not be righteous?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am an honest messenger to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You build on every hill a mansion for vanity's sake.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You set up buildings as if you last forever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And when you strike, you strike mercilessly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Reverence the One who provided you with all the things you know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He provided you with livestock and children.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And gardens and springs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I fear for you the retribution of an awesome day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "It is the same whether you preach, or not preach.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "That affliction was limited to our ancestors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "No retribution will ever befall us."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They thus disbelieved and, consequently, we annihilated them. This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sãleh
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Thamûd disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their brother Sãleh said to them, "Would you not be righteous?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am an honest messenger to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes only from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Do you suppose you will be left forever, secure in this state?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You enjoy gardens and springs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And crops and date palms with delicious fruits.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You carve out of the mountains luxurious mansions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Do not obey the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Who commit evil, not good works."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "You are bewitched.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You are no more than a human like us. Produce a miracle, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Here is a camel that will drink only on a day that is assigned to her; a day that is different from your specified days of drinking.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Do not touch her with any harm, lest you incur retribution on an awesome day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They slaughtered her, and thus incurred sorrow.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The retribution overwhelmed them. This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their brother Lot said to them, "Would you not be righteous?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am an honest messenger to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes only from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Do you have sex with the males, of all the people?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You forsake the wives that your Lord has created for you! Indeed, you are transgressing people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be banished."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I deplore your actions."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "My Lord, save me and my family from their works."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We saved him and all his family.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But not the old woman; she was doomed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We then destroyed the others.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We showered them with a miserable shower; what a terrible shower for those who had been warned!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shu'aib
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shu'aib said to them, "Would you not be righteous?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am an honest messenger to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall reverence GOD, and obey me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I do not ask you for any wage; my wage comes only from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall give full measure when you trade; do not cheat.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall weigh with an equitable scale.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not roam the earth corruptingly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Reverence the One who created you and the previous generations."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "You are bewitched.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You are no more than a human being like us. In fact, we think you are a liar.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Let masses from the sky fall on us, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord is the One who knows everything you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They disbelieved him and, consequently, they incurred the retribution of the Day of the Canopy. It was the retribution of an awesome day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a lesson, but most people are not believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, your Lord is the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is a revelation from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Honest Spirit (Gabriel) came down with it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To reveal it into your heart, that you may be one of the warners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In a perfect Arabic tongue.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It has been prophesied in the books of previous generations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is it not a sufficient sign for them that it was known to the scholars among the Children of Israel?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran Must Be Translated
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If we revealed this to people who do not know Arabic.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And had him recite it (in Arabic), they could not possibly believe in it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus render it (like a foreign language) in the hearts of the guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, they cannot believe in it; not until they see the painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It will come to them suddenly, when they least expect it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will then say, "Can we have a respite?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did they not challenge our retribution?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As you see, we allowed them to enjoy for years.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then the retribution came to them, just as promised.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their vast resources did not help them in the least.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We never annihilate any community without sending warners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, this is a reminder, for we are never unjust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: False Messengers Incapable of Preaching the Worship of God ALONE
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The devils can never reveal this.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A false messenger is a messenger of Satan, for he is the fabricator of the most horrendous lie. Such a messenger can never denounce idolatry, or preach the worship of God ALONE.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They neither would, nor could.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For they are prevented from hearing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, do not idolize beside GOD any other god, lest you incur the retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall preach to the people who are closest to you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These verses refer to God's Messenger of the Covenant: the sum of the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (214) is 1230+ 214=1444=19x76= 19x19x4, and the sum of the verse numbers from 214 through 223 is 2185=19x115 (Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And lower your wing for the believers who follow you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they disobey you, then say, "I disown what you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who sees you when you meditate during the night.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And your frequent prostrations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They descend upon every guilty fabricator.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They pretend to listen, but most of them are liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the poets, they are followed only by the strayers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that their loyalty shifts according to the situation?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And that they say what they do not do?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Exempted are those who believe, lead a righteous life, commemorate GOD frequently, and stand up for their rights. Surely, the transgressors will find out what their ultimate destiny is.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: T. S. These (letters) constitute proofs of the Quran; a profound scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 1 for the meaning of these Quranic initials.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: A beacon, and good news, for the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and they are, with regard to the Hereafter, absolutely certain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter, we adorn their works in their eyes. Thus, they continue to blunder.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is these who incur the worst retribution, and in the Hereafter, they will be the worst losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, you are receiving the Quran from a Most Wise, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that Moses said to his family, "I see a fire; let me bring you news therefrom, or a torch to warm you."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is the One (who is speaking from) within the fire, and those around it." Glory be to GOD, Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O Moses, this is Me, GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Throw down your staff." When he saw it moving like a demon, he turned around and fled. "O Moses, do not be afraid. My messengers shall not fear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Except those who commit a transgression, then substitute righteousness after sinning; I am Forgiving, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Put your hand in your pocket; it will come out white, without a blemish. These are among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are wicked people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our miracles were presented to them, clear and profound, they said, "This is obviously magic."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They rejected them and were utterly convinced of their wrong ways, due to their arrogance. Note the consequences for the evildoers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: David and Solomon
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We endowed David and Solomon with knowledge, and they said, "Praise GOD for blessing us more than many of His believing servants."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Solomon was David's heir. He said, "O people, we have been endowed with understanding the language of the birds, and all kinds of things have been bestowed upon us. This is indeed a real blessing."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mobilized in the service of Solomon were his obedient soldiers of jinns and humans, as well as the birds; all at his disposal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they approached the valley of the ants, one ant said, "O you ants, go into your homes, lest you get crushed by Solomon and his soldiers, without perceiving."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The more unusual the events in a given sura, the stronger the mathematical evidence supporting them. This helps assure us that such strange phenomena are indicative of God's power. This sura's initials, T.S., constitute a complex part of the mathematical miracles related to the Quranic initials. The unusual birth and miracles of Jesus are in Sura 19, which is prefixed with five Quranic Initials. See Appendix 1 for the details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He smiled and laughed at her statement, and said, "My Lord, direct me to be appreciative of the blessings You have bestowed upon me and my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You. Admit me by Your mercy into the company of Your righteous servants."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He inspected the birds, and noted: "Why do I not see the hoopoe? Why is he missing?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I will punish him severely or sacrifice him, unless he gives me a good excuse."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He did not wait for long. (The hoopoe) said, "I have news that you do not have. I brought to you from Sheba, some important information.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I found a woman ruling them, who is blessed with everything, and possesses a tremendous palace.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I found her and her people prostrating before the sun, instead of GOD. The devil has adorned their works in their eyes, and has repulsed them from the path; consequently, they are not guided."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They should have been prostrating before GOD, the One who manifests all the mysteries in the heavens and the earth, and the One who knows everything you conceal and everything you declare.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD: there is no other god beside Him; the Lord with the great dominion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Solomon) said, "We will see if you told the truth, or if you are a liar.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Take this letter from me, give it to them, then watch for their response."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Back in Sheba
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: She said, "O my advisers, I have received an honorable letter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "It is from Solomon, and it is, 'In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.'
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The 'Basmalah' included in this verse compensates for the 'Basmalah' that is missing from Sura 9, 19 suras earlier. This restores the total occurrence of 'Basmalah' to 114, 19x6. See Appendix 29 for details of a vast and profound miracle attached to this 'Basmalah.'
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Proclaiming: 'Do not be arrogant; come to me as submitters.' "
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said, "O my advisers, counsel me in this matter. I am not deciding anything until you advise me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We possess the power, we possess the fighting skills, and the ultimate command is in your hand. You decide what to do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said, "The kings corrupt any land they invade, and subjugate its dignified people. This is what they usually do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I am sending a gift to them; let us see what the messengers come back with."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the hoopoe returned to Solomon (he told him the news), and he responded (to Sheba's people): "Are you giving me money? What GOD has given me is far better than what He has given you. You are the ones to rejoice in such gifts."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (To the hoopoe, he said,) "Go back to them (and let them know that) we will come to them with forces they cannot imagine. We will evict them, humiliated and debased."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Faster Than the Speed of Light
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "O you elders, which of you can bring me her mansion, before they arrive here as submitters?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One afrit from the jinns said, "I can bring it to you before you stand up. I am powerful enough to do this."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The one who possessed knowledge from the book said, "I can bring it to you in the blink of your eye." When he saw it settled in front of him, he said, "This is a blessing from my Lord, whereby He tests me, to show whether I am appreciative or unappreciative. Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good, and if one turns unappreciative, then my Lord is in no need for him, Most Honorable."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Remodel her mansion for her. Let us see if she will be guided, or continue with the misguided."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When she arrived, she was asked, "Does your mansion look like this?" She said, "It seems that this is it." (Solomon said,) "We knew beforehand what she was going to do, and we were already submitters."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She had been diverted by worshiping idols instead of GOD; she belonged to disbelieving people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She was told, "Go inside the palace." When she saw its interior, she thought it was a pool of water, and she (pulled up her dress,) exposing her legs. He said, "This interior is now paved with crystal." She said, "My Lord, I have wronged my soul. I now submit with Solomon to GOD, Lord of the universe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sãleh
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent to Thamûd their brother Sãleh, saying, "You shall worship GOD." But they turned into two feuding factions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "O my people, why do you hasten to commit evil instead of good works? If only you implore GOD for forgiveness, you may attain mercy."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "We consider you a bad omen for us, you and those who joined you." He said, "Your omen is fully controlled by GOD. Indeed, you are deviant people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There were nine gangsters in the city who were wicked, and never did anything good.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Let us swear by GOD that we kill him and his people, then tell his tribe, 'We know nothing about their death. We are truthful.'"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Protects The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They plotted and schemed, but we also plotted and schemed, while they did not perceive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Note the consequences of their plotting; we annihilated them and all their people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Here are their homes utterly ruined, because of their transgression. This should be a lesson for people who know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We save those who believe and lead a righteous life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Lot said to his people, "How could you commit such an abomination, publicly, while you see?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We recite to you herein some history of Moses and Pharaoh, truthfully, for the benefit of people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh turned into a tyrant on earth, and discriminated against some people. He persecuted a helpless group of them, slaughtering their sons, while sparing their daughters. He was indeed wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Compensates the Oppressed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We willed to compensate those who were oppressed on earth, and to turn them into leaders, and make them the inheritors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And to establish them on earth, and to give Pharaoh, Hãmãn, and their troops a taste of their own medicine.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Confidence in God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We inspired Moses' mother: "Nurse him, and when you fear for his life, throw him into the river without fear or grief. We will return him to you, and will make him one of the messengers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh's family picked him up, only to have him lead the opposition and to be a source of grief for them. That is because Pharaoh, Hãmãn, and their troops were transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Inside the Lion's Den
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh's wife said, "This can be a joyous find for me and you. Do not kill him, for he may be of some benefit for us, or we may adopt him to be our son." They had no idea.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The mind of Moses' mother was growing so anxious that she almost gave away his identity. But we strengthened her heart, to make her a believer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: She said to his sister, "Trace his path." She watched him from afar, while they did not perceive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Infant Returned to His Mother
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We forbade him from accepting all the nursing mothers. (His sister) then said, "I can show you a family that can raise him for you, and take good care of him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached maturity and strength, we endowed him with wisdom and knowledge. We thus reward the righteous.

segments.text: Moses Commits Manslaughter
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Once he entered the city unexpectedly, without being recognized by the people. He found two men fighting; one was (a Hebrew) from his people, and the other was (an Egyptian) from his enemies. The one from his people called on him for help against his enemy. Moses punched him, killing him. He said, "This is the work of the devil; he is a real enemy, and a profound misleader."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, I have wronged my soul. Please forgive me," and He forgave him. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, in return for Your blessings upon me, I will never be a supporter of the guilty ones."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In the morning, he was in the city, afraid and watchful. The one who sought his help yesterday, asked for his help again. Moses said to him, "You are really a troublemaker."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses' Crime Exposed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Before he attempted to strike their common enemy, he said, "O Moses, do you want to kill me, as you killed the other man yesterday? Obviously, you wish to be a tyrant on earth; you do not wish to be righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A man came running from the other side of the city, saying, "O Moses, the people are plotting to kill you. You better leave immediately. I am giving you good advice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He fled the city, afraid and watchful. He said, "My Lord, save me from the oppressive people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In Midyan
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As he traveled towards Midyan, he said, "May my Lord guide me in the right path."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he reached Midyan's water, he found a crowd of people watering, and noticed two women waiting on the side. He said, "What is it that you need?" They said, "We are not able to water, until the crowd disperses, and our father is an old man."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He watered for them, then turned to the shade, saying, "My Lord, whatever provision You send to me, I am in dire need for it."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Soon, one of the two women approached him, shyly, and said, "My father invites you to pay you for watering for us." When he met him, and told him his story, he said, "Have no fear. You have been saved from the oppressive people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses Marries
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: One of the two women said, "O my father, hire him. He is the best one to hire, for he is strong and honest."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "I wish to offer one of my two daughters for you to marry, in return for working for me for eight pilgrimages; if you make them ten, it will be voluntary on your part. I do not wish to make this matter too difficult for you. You will find me, GOD willing, righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "It is an agreement between me and you. Whichever period I fulfill, you will not be averse to either one. GOD is the guarantor of what we said."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Back to Egypt
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When he had fulfilled his obligation, he traveled with his family (towards Egypt). He saw from the slope of Mount Sinai a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here. I have seen a fire. Maybe I can bring to you news, or a portion of the fire to warm you."

segments.text: The Torah is the collection of all the scriptures revealed to all the prophets of Israel, including the book of Moses. The Quran consistently states that Moses was given a book, or "the Statute Book." Nowhere in the Quran do we see that Moses was given "the Torah." Today's Old Testament, therefore, is the Torah (see 3:50, 5:46).

segments.text: Qãroon
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Qãroon (the slave driver) was one of Moses' people who betrayed them and oppressed them. We gave him so many treasures that the keys thereof were almost too heavy for the strongest band. His people said to him, "Do not be so arrogant; GOD does not love those who are arrogant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Use the provisions bestowed upon you by GOD to seek the abode of the Hereafter, without neglecting your share in this world. Be charitable, as GOD has been charitable towards you. Do not keep on corrupting the earth. GOD does not love the corruptors.

segments.text: He said, "I attained all this because of my own cleverness." Did he not realize that GOD had annihilated before him generations that were much stronger than he, and greater in number? The (annihilated) transgressors were not asked about their crimes.

segments.text: One day, he came out to his people in full splendor. Those who preferred this worldly life said, "Oh, we wish that we possess what Qãroon has attained. Indeed, he is very fortunate."

segments.text: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. But if they try to force you to set up idols beside Me, do not obey them. To Me is your ultimate return, then I will inform you of everything you had done.

segments.text: Those who believe and lead a righteous life, we will certainly admit them with the righteous.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among the people there are those who say, "We believe in GOD," but as soon as they suffer any hardship because of GOD, they equate the people's persecution with GOD's retribution. But if blessings from your Lord come your way, they say, "We were with you." Is GOD not fully aware of the people's innermost thoughts?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD will most certainly distinguish those who believe, and He will most certainly expose the hypocrites.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved said to those who believed, "If you follow our way, we will be responsible for your sins." Not true; they cannot bear any of their sins. They are liars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In fact, they will carry their own sins, in addition to loads of other people's sins for which they were responsible. Most certainly, they will be asked on the Day of Resurrection about their false claims.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Noah
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Noah to his people, and he stayed with them one thousand years, less fifty. Subsequently, they incurred the flood because of their transgressions.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "What you worship instead of GOD are powerless idols; you have invented a lie." The idols you worship beside GOD do not possess any provisions for you. Therefore, you shall seek provisions only from GOD. You shall worship Him alone, and be appreciative of Him; to Him is your ultimate return.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you disbelieve, generations before you have also disbelieved. The sole function of the messenger is to deliver (the message).

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have they not seen how GOD initiates the creation, then repeats it? This is easy for GOD to do.
