segments.text: Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Lot said to his people, "You commit such an abomination, no one in the world has ever done it before you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You practice sex with the men, you commit highway robbery, and you allow all kinds of vice in your society." The only response from his people was to say, "Bring to us GOD's retribution, if you are truthful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "My Lord, grant me victory over these wicked people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Angels Visit Abraham and Lot
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our messengers went to Abraham with good news (about Isaac's birth), they also said, "We are on our way to annihilate the people of that town (Sodom). For its people have been wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "But Lot is living there." They said, "We are fully aware of everyone who lives in it. We will of course save him and his family, except his wife; she is doomed."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When our messengers arrived at Lot's place, they were mistreated, and he was embarrassed by their presence. But they said, "Have no fear, and do not worry. We will save you and your family, except your wife; she is doomed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We will pour upon the people of this town a disaster from the sky, as a consequence of their wickedness."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We left standing some of their ruins, to serve as a profound lesson for people who understand.

segments.text: Shu'aib

segments.text: To Midyan we sent their brother Shu'aib. He said, "O my people, you shall worship GOD and seek the Last Day, and do not roam the earth corruptingly."

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Immutable System
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: All those disbelievers were doomed as a consequence of their sins. Some of them we annihilated by violent winds, some were annihilated by the quake, some we caused the earth to swallow, and some we drowned. GOD is not the One who wronged them; it is they who wronged their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Spider
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The allegory of those who accept other masters beside GOD is that of the spider and her home; the flimsiest of all homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It takes a knowledgeable person to know that the Black Widow spider kills her mate. The use of the feminine reference to the spider in 29:41 is thus significant. This is in addition to the fact that the spider web is physically very flimsy.

segments.text: The Contact Prayers (Salat)
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall recite what is revealed to you of the scripture, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), for the Contact Prayers prohibit evil and vice. But the remembrance of GOD (through Salat) is the most important objective. GOD knows everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your god is whatever occupies your mind most of the time (see 20:14 & Appendix 27).

segments.text: One God/One Religion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do not argue with the people of the scripture (Jews, Christians, & Muslims) except in the nicest possible manner—unless they transgress— and say, "We believe in what was revealed to us and in what was revealed to you, and our god and your god is one and the same; to Him we are submitters."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have revealed to you this scripture, and those whom we blessed with the previous scripture will believe in it. Also, some of your people will believe in it. Indeed, those who disregard our revelations are the real disbelievers.

segments.text: Quran: Muhammad's Miracle
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You did not read the previous scriptures, nor did you write them with your hand. In that case, the rejectors would have had reason to harbor doubts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It was the will of the Most Wise to separate the Quran from its awesome mathematical miracle by 1400 years. Seeing how the Muslims en masse have idolized Muhammad, it is obvious that if the Quran's mathematical miracle were also revealed through Muhammad, many people would have worshiped him as God incarnate. As it is, God willed that the great miracle of the Quran (74:30-35) shall await the computer age, and to have it revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (see Appendices 1, 2, & 26).

segments.text: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be more powerful, more prosperous, and more productive on earth. Their messengers went to them with clear signs. Consequently, GOD was not the One who wronged them, they are the ones who wronged their own souls.

segments.text: Remember God, Always
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall glorify GOD when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.

segments.text: All praise is due to Him in the heavens and the earth, throughout the evening, as well as in the middle of your day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is that He created you from dust, then you became reproducing humans.

segments.text: Among His proofs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves, in order to have tranquility and contentment with each other, and He placed in your hearts love and care towards your spouses. In this, there are sufficient proofs for people who think.

segments.text: More Proofs
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and your colors. In these, there are signs for the knowledgeable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is your sleeping during the night or the day, and your working in pursuit of His provisions. In this, there are sufficient proofs for people who can hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is that He shows you the lightning as a source of fear, as well as hope, then He sends down from the sky water to revive a land that has been dead. In these, there are sufficient proofs for people who understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is that the heaven and the earth are standing at His disposal. Finally, when He calls you out of the earth, one call, you will immediately come out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth; all are subservient to Him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He is the One who initiates the creation, then repeats it; this is even easier for Him. To Him belongs the most sublime similitude, in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Absurdity of Idol Worship
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He cites for you herein an example from among yourselves: Do you ever elevate your servants or subordinates to the level where they rival you, and to the point that you pay them as much allegiance as is being paid to you? We thus explain the revelations for people who understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, the transgressors have followed their own opinions, without knowledge. Who then can guide those who have been sent astray by GOD? No one can ever help them.

segments.text: Monotheism: Natural Instinct
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall devote yourself to the religion of strict monotheism. Such is the natural instinct placed into the people by GOD. Such creation of GOD will never change. This is the perfect religion, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Recognizing God ALONE as our Lord and Master is a natural instinct. We are born into this world with such an instinct. See 7:172-173 and Appendix 7.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You shall submit to Him, reverence Him, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and—whatever you do—do not ever fall into idol worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: (Do not fall in idol worship,) like those who divide their religion into sects; each party rejoicing with what they have.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When adversity afflicts the people, they turn to their Lord, totally devoting themselves to Him. But then, as soon as He showers them with mercy, some of them revert to idol worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A common example is the classified advertisements we note in the newspapers, placed by people thanking St. Jude for healing them. Before undergoing surgery, they sincerely implore God to heal them. But as soon as the surgery succeeds, they thank St. Jude!!!

segments.text: Let them be unappreciative of what we have given them. Enjoy temporarily; you will surely find out.

segments.text: Therefore, you shall give the relatives their rightful share (of charity), as well as the poor, and the traveling alien. This is better for those who sincerely seek GOD's pleasure; they are the winners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The usury that is practiced to increase some people's wealth, does not gain anything at GOD. But if you give to charity, seeking GOD's pleasure, these are the ones who receive their reward manifold.

segments.text: Who Is Worthy of Worship?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who created you. He is the One who provides for you. He is the One who puts you to death. He is the One who resurrects you. Can any of your idols do any of these things? Be He glorified. He is much too exalted to have any partners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Disasters have spread throughout the land and sea, because of what the people have committed. He thus lets them taste the consequences of some of their works, that they may return (to the right works).

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "Roam the earth and note the consequences for those before you." Most of them were idol worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall devote yourself completely to this perfect religion, before a day comes which is made inevitable by GOD. On that day, they will be shocked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whoever disbelieves, disbelieves to the detriment of his own soul, while those who lead a righteous life, do so to strengthen and develop their own souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For He will generously recompense those who believe and lead a righteous life from His bounties. He does not love the disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is that He sends the winds with good omen, to shower you with His mercy, and to allow the ships to run in the sea in accordance with His rules, and for you to seek His bounties (through commerce), that you may be appreciative.

segments.text: Guaranteed Victory for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent messengers before you to their people, with profound signs. Subsequently, we punished those who transgressed. It is our duty that we grant victory to the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who sends the winds, to stir up clouds, to be spread throughout the sky in accordance with His will. He then piles the clouds up, then you see the rain coming down therefrom. When it falls on whomever He chooses from among His servants, they rejoice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Before it fell on them, they had resorted to despair.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall appreciate GOD's continuous mercy, and how He revives the land that has been dead. He will just as certainly resurrect the dead. He is Omnipotent.

segments.text: Had we sent upon them instead a yellow sandstorm, they would have continued to disbelieve.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You cannot make the dead, nor the deaf, hear the call, once they turn away.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can only be heard by those who believe in our revelations, and decide to become submitters.

segments.text: This Life is Very Short
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who created you weak, then granted you after the weakness strength, then substituted after the strength weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, no apology, on that day, will benefit the transgressors, nor will they be excused.

segments.text: Luqmãn's Wisdom
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have endowed Luqmãn with wisdom: "You shall be appreciative of GOD." Whoever is appreciative is appreciative for his own good. As for those who turn unappreciative, GOD is in no need, Praiseworthy.

segments.text: Recall that Luqmãn said to his son, as he enlightened him, "O my son, do not set up any idols beside GOD; idolatry is a gross injustice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How will you feel if you take care of a child, give him the best education, and prepare him for life, only to see him thank someone else? Thus is idolatry; injustice.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Second Commandment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him, and the load got heavier and heavier. It takes two years (of intensive care) until weaning. You shall be appreciative of Me, and of your parents. To Me is the ultimate destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they try to force you to set up any idols beside Me, do not obey them. But continue to treat them amicably in this world. You shall follow only the path of those who have submitted to Me. Ultimately, you all return to Me, then I will inform you of everything you have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Luqmãn's Advice
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "O my son, know that even something as tiny as a mustard seed, deep inside a rock, be it in the heavens or the earth, GOD will bring it. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my son, you shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). You shall advocate righteousness and forbid evil, and remain steadfast in the face of adversity. These are the most honorable traits.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You shall not treat the people with arrogance, nor shall you roam the earth proudly. GOD does not like the arrogant showoffs.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Walk humbly and lower your voice—the ugliest voice is the donkey's voice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that GOD has committed in your service everything in the heavens and the earth, and has showered you with His blessings— obvious and hidden? Yet, some people argue about GOD without knowledge, without guidance, and without the enlightening scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Following the Parents Blindly: A Common Tragedy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When they are told, "Follow these revelations of GOD," they say, "No, we follow only what we found our parents doing." What if the devil is leading them to the agony of Hell?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Strongest Bond
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who submit completely to GOD, while leading a righteous life, have gotten hold of the strongest bond. For GOD is in full control of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who disbelieve, do not be saddened by their disbelief. To us is their ultimate return, then we will inform them of everything they had done. GOD is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We let them enjoy temporarily, then commit them to severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Believe in God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth," they will say, "GOD." Say, "Praise be to GOD." Yet, most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is the Most Rich, Most Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These Are All the Words We Need
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If all the trees on earth were made into pens, and the ocean supplied the ink, augmented by seven more oceans, the words of GOD would not run out. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The creation and resurrection of all of you is the same as that of one person. GOD is Hearer, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God ALONE Worthy of Worship
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that GOD merges the night into the day and merges the day into the night, and that He has committed the sun and the moon in your service, each running in its orbit for a specific life span, and that GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This proves that GOD is the truth, while any idol they set up beside Him is falsehood, and that GOD is the Most High, Most Great.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that the ships roam the sea, carrying GOD's provisions, to show you some of His proofs? Indeed, these should be sufficient proofs for everyone who is steadfast, appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When violent waves surround them, they implore GOD, sincerely devoting their prayers to Him alone. But as soon as He saves them to the shore, some of them revert. None discards our revelations except those who are betrayers, unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O people, you shall reverence your Lord, and fear a day when a father cannot help his own child, nor a child can help his father. Certainly, GOD's promise is truth. Therefore, do not be distracted by this life; do not be distracted from GOD by mere illusions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Things We May and May Not Know
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: With GOD is the knowledge regarding the Hour (end of the world). He is the One who sends down the rain, and He knows the contents of the womb. No soul knows what will happen to it tomorrow, and no one knows in which land he or she will die. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God reveals His knowledge whenever He wills. We learn from this verse that we may be able to predict the rain, and the gender of the fetus. But we can never know the time or place of death. In accordance with 72:27, God has revealed the end of the world through His Messenger of the Covenant. See 15:87, 20:15, and Appendix 25 for the details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: A. L. M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The meaning of these letters is given in the next verse: "This book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe." See Appendix 1 for the details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The book is, without a doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "He fabricated it." Indeed, this is the truth from your Lord, to warn people who never received a warner before you, that they may be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No Mediator Between God And You
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, then assumed all authority. You have none beside Him as Lord, nor do you have an intercessor. Would you not take heed?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All matters are controlled by Him from the heaven to the earth. To Him, the day is equivalent to one thousand of your years.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Knower of all secrets and declarations; the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Origin of Man
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He is the One who perfected everything He created, and started the creation of the human from clay.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then He continued his reproduction through a certain lowly liquid.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He shaped him and blew into him from His spirit. And He gave you the hearing, the eyesight, and the brains; rarely are you thankful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They wonder, "After we vanish into the earth, do we get created anew?" Thus, as regards meeting their Lord, they are disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You will be put to death by the angel in whose charge you are placed, then to your Lord you will be returned."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Too Late
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If only you could see the guilty when they bow down their heads before their Lord: "Our Lord, now we have seen and we have heard. Send us back and we will be righteous. Now we have attained certainty."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If sent back, they would commit the same transgressions. See Footnote 6:28.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Had we willed, we could have given every soul its guidance, but it is already predetermined that I will fill Hell with jinns and humans, all together.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The majority of humans "insist" upon going to Hell, by choosing to ignore God's invitations to redeem them. God will not put a single person in Hell. Those who fail to redeem themselves by denouncing idolatry and devoting themselves to God ALONE, and fail to develop their souls through the practices prescribed by our Creator, will have to run to Hell on their own volition. They will be too weak to stand the physical presence of God's energy.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Taste the consequences of your forgetting this day; now we forget you. You have incurred eternal retribution in return for your own works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The only people who truly believe in our revelations are those who fall prostrate upon hearing them. They glorify and praise their Lord, without any arrogance.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their sides readily forsake their beds, in order to worship their Lord, out of reverence and hope, and from our provisions to them, they give.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Heaven: Indescribably Beautiful
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You have no idea how much joy and happiness are waiting for you as a reward for your (righteous) works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is one who is a believer the same as one who is wicked? They are not equal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they have deserved the eternal Paradise. Such is their abode, in return for their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the wicked, their destiny is Hell. Every time they try to leave it, they will be forced back. They will be told, "Taste the agony of Hell which you used to disbelieve in."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Take A Hint
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We let them taste the smaller retribution (of this world), before they incur the greater retribution (of the Hereafter), that they may (take a hint and) reform.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who is more evil than one who is reminded of these revelations of his Lord, then insists upon disregarding them? We will certainly punish the guilty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given Moses the scripture—do not harbor any doubt about meeting Him—and we made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We appointed from among them imams who guided in accordance with our commandments, because they steadfastly persevered and attained certainty about our revelations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your Lord is the One who will judge them on the Day of Resurrection, regarding everything they disputed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Does it ever occur to them how many generations we have annihilated before them? They now live and walk in their ancestors' homes. This should provide sufficient proofs. Do they not hear?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not realize that we drive the water to barren lands, and produce with it crops to feed their livestock, as well as themselves? Do they not see?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They challenge: "Where is that victory, if you are truthful?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "The day such a victory comes, believing will not benefit those who did not believe before that, nor will they be given another chance."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, disregard them and wait, they too are waiting.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you prophet, you shall reverence GOD and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord. GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you all do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And put your trust in GOD. GOD suffices as an advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Devotion to God Is Indivisible
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD did not give any man two hearts in his chest. Nor did He turn your wives whom you estrange (according to your custom) into your mothers. Nor did He turn your adopted children into genetic offspring. All these are mere utterances that you have invented. GOD speaks the truth, and He guides in the (right) path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It was a custom in Arabia to estrange the wife by declaring that she was like the husband's mother. Such an unfair practice is abrogated herein.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Do Not Change Your Names
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relationship to their genetic parents. This is more equitable in the sight of GOD. If you do not know their parents, then, as your brethren in religion, you shall treat them as members of your family. You do not commit a sin if you make a mistake in this respect; you are responsible for your purposeful intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The prophet is closer to the believers than they are to each other, and his wives are like mothers to them. The relatives ought to take care of one another in accordance with GOD's scripture. Thus, the believers shall take care of their relatives who immigrate to them, provided they have taken care of their own families first. These are commandments of this scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad Pledges to Support God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that we took from the prophets their covenant, including you (O Muhammad), Noah, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary. We took from them a solemn pledge.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The covenant is detailed in 3:81. God took a covenant from the prophets that they shall support His Messenger of the Covenant who would come after Muhammad to purify and unify their messages. The Covenant was made before the earth's creation, and was fulfilled in Mecca Zul-Hijja 3, 1391 (Dec. 21, 1971). The sum of the Islamic month (12), plus the day (3), plus the year (1391) gives 1406, 19x74. Overwhelming proof identifying God's Messenger of the Covenant as Rashad Khalifa is provided throughout the Quran (Appendices 2 & 26).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, He will surely question the truthful about their truthfulness, and has prepared for the disbelievers (in this Quranic fact) a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Battle of the Parties
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, remember GOD's blessing upon you; when soldiers attacked you, we sent upon them violent wind and invisible soldiers. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they came from above you, and from beneath you, your eyes were terrified, your hearts ran out of patience, and you harbored unbefitting thoughts about GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is when the believers were truly tested; they were severely shaken up.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The hypocrites and those with doubts in their hearts said, "What GOD and His messenger promised us was no more than an illusion!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A group of them said, "O people of Yathrib, you cannot attain victory; go back." Others made up excuses to the prophet: "Our homes are vulnerable," when they were not vulnerable. They just wanted to flee.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had the enemy invaded and asked them to join, they would have joined the enemy without hesitation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They had pledged to GOD in the past that they would not turn around and flee; making a pledge with GOD involves a great responsibility.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "If you flee, you can never flee from death or from being killed. No matter what happens, you only live a short while longer."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who would protect you from GOD if He willed any adversity, or willed any blessing for you?" They can never find, beside GOD, any other Lord and Master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is fully aware of the hinderers among you, and those who say to their comrades, "Let us all stay behind." Rarely do they mobilize for defense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also, they are too stingy when dealing with you. If anything threatens the community, you see their eyes rolling with fear, as if death had already come to them. Once the crisis is over, they whip you with sharp tongues. They are too stingy with their wealth. These are not believers, and, consequently, GOD has nullified their works. This is easy for GOD to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They thought that the parties might come back. In that case, they would wish that they were lost in the desert, asking about your news from afar. Had the parties attacked you while they were with you, they would rarely support you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Prophet's Courage
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The messenger of GOD has set up a good example for those among you who seek GOD and the Last Day, and constantly think about GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan took this verse out of context, and relied on the people's idolization of the prophet Muhammad to innovate a whole set of unauthorized and unreasonable regulations called "Sunna of the Prophet." This created a totally different religion (see 42:21 and Appendix 18).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: When the true believers saw the parties (ready to attack), they said, "This is what GOD and His messenger have promised us, and GOD and His messenger are truthful." This (dangerous situation) only strengthened their faith and augmented their submission.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among the believers there are people who fulfill their pledges with GOD. Some of them died, while others stand ready, never wavering.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD will surely recompense the truthful for their truthfulness, and will punish the hypocrites, if He so wills, or redeem them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: During Muhammad's Time
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD repulsed those who disbelieved with their rage, and they left empty handed. GOD thus spared the believers any fighting. GOD is Powerful, Almighty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He also brought down their allies among the people of the scripture from their secure positions, and threw terror into their hearts. Some of them you killed, and some you took captive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He made you inherit their land, their homes, their money, and lands you had never stepped on. GOD is in full control of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Special Responsibility For Being Close
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O prophet, say to your wives, "If you are seeking this life and its vanities, then let me compensate you and allow you to go amicably.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "But if you are seeking GOD and His messenger, and the abode of the Hereafter, then GOD has prepared for the righteous among you a great recompense."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Special Responsibility
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O wives of the prophet, if any of you commits a gross sin, the retribution will be doubled for her. This is easy for GOD to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Any one of you who obeys GOD and His messenger, and leads a righteous life, we will grant her double the recompense, and we have prepared for her a generous provision.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Setting the Example
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O wives of the prophet, you are not the same as any other women, if you observe righteousness. (You have a greater responsibility.) Therefore, you shall not speak too softly, lest those with disease in their hearts may get the wrong ideas; you shall speak only righteousness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall settle down in your homes, and do not mingle with the people excessively, like you used to do in the old days of ignorance. You shall observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and obey GOD and His messenger. GOD wishes to remove all unholiness from you, O you who live around the Sacred Shrine, and to purify you completely.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Remember what is being recited in your homes of GOD's revelations and the wisdom inherent therein. GOD is Sublime, Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Equality of Men and Women
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The submitting men, the submitting women, the believing men, the believing women, the obedient men, the obedient women, the truthful men, the truthful women, the steadfast men, the steadfast women, the reverent men, the reverent women, the charitable men, the charitable women, the fasting men, the fasting women, the chaste men, the chaste women, and the men who commemorate GOD frequently, and the commemorating women; GOD has prepared for them forgiveness and a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
Major Error Committed by Muhammad
Muhammad the Man Disobeys Muhammad the Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: No believing man or believing woman, if GOD and His messenger issue any command, has any choice regarding that command. Anyone who disobeys GOD and His messenger has gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Recall that you said to the one who was blessed by GOD, and blessed by you, "Keep your wife and reverence GOD," and you hid inside yourself what GOD wished to proclaim. Thus, you feared the people, when you were supposed to fear only GOD. When Zeid was completely through with his wife, we had you marry her, in order to establish the precedent that a man can marry the divorced wife of his adopted son. GOD's commands shall be done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The prophet is not committing an error by doing anything that is made lawful by GOD. Such is GOD's system since the early generations. GOD's command is a sacred duty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who deliver GOD's messages, and who reverence Him alone, shall never fear anyone but GOD. GOD is the most efficient reckoner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Not The Final Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Muhammad was not the father of any man among you. He was a messenger of GOD and the final prophet. GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Despite this clear definition of Muhammad, most Muslims insist that he was the last prophet and also the last messenger. This is a tragic human trait as we see in 40:34. Those who readily believe God realize that God sends His purifying and consolidating Messenger of the Covenant after the final prophet Muhammad (3:81, 33:7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall remember GOD frequently.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your god is whatever occupies your thoughts most of the time. Hence the commandment to commemorate God and glorify Him day and night. See Appendix 27.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You shall glorify Him day and night.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who helps you, together with His angels, to lead you out of darkness into the light. He is Most Merciful towards the believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their greeting the day they meet Him is, "Peace," and He has prepared for them a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O prophet, we have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Inviting to GOD, in accordance with His will, and a guiding beacon.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Deliver good news to the believers, that they have deserved from GOD a great blessing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, disregard their insults, and put your trust in GOD; GOD suffices as an advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Marriage Laws
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, if you married believing women, then divorced them before having intercourse with them, they do not owe you any waiting interim (before marrying another man). You shall compensate them equitably, and let them go amicably.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O prophet, we made lawful for you your wives to whom you have paid their due dowry, or what you already have, as granted to you by GOD. Also lawful for you in marriage are the daughters of your father's brothers, the daughters of your father's sisters, the daughters of your mother's brothers, the daughters of your mother's sisters, who have emigrated with you. Also, if a believing woman gave herself to the prophet—by forfeiting the dowry—the prophet may marry her without a dowry, if he so wishes. However, her forfeiting of the dowry applies only to the prophet, and not to the other believers. We have already decreed their rights in regard to their spouses or what they already have. This is to spare you any embarrassment. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You may gently shun any one of them, and you may bring closer to you any one of them. If you reconcile with any one you had estranged, you commit no error. In this way, they will be pleased, will have no grief, and will be content with what you equitably offer to all of them. GOD knows what is in your hearts. GOD is Omniscient, Clement.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Beyond the categories described to you, you are enjoined from marrying any other women, nor can you substitute a new wife (from the prohibited categories), no matter how much you admire their beauty. You must be content with those already made lawful to you. GOD is watchful over all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Etiquette
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not enter the prophet's homes unless you are given permission to eat, nor shall you force such an invitation in any manner. If you are invited, you may enter. When you finish eating, you shall leave; do not engage him in lengthy conversations. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too shy to tell you. But GOD does not shy away from the truth. If you have to ask his wives for something, ask them from behind a barrier. This is purer for your hearts and their hearts. You are not to hurt the messenger of GOD. You shall not marry his wives after him, for this would be a gross offense in the sight of GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are enjoined in 4:22 from marrying women who were previously married to our fathers. Nor can the father marry the divorced wife of his son (4:23). This divine commandment preserves our respect for our fathers and their most private affairs. Similarly, the prophet was a father figure to the believers of his time. For the good of those believers, God enjoined them from marrying women who were previously married to the prophet. Marriage is a sacred and very private relationship, and the prophet's private life was better kept private.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Whether you declare anything, or hide it, GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The women may relax (their dress code) around their fathers, their sons, their brothers, the sons of their brothers, the sons of their sisters, the other women, and their (female) servants. They shall reverence GOD. GOD witnesses all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: During the Prophet's Life
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD and His angels help and support the prophet. O you who believe, you shall help and support him, and regard him as he should be regarded.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The word "prophet" (Nabi) consistently refers to Muhammad only when he was alive. Satan used this verse to entice the Muslims into commemorating Muhammad, constantly, instead of commemorating God as enjoined in 33:41-42.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who oppose GOD and His messenger, GOD afflicts them with a curse in this life, and in the Hereafter; He has prepared for them a shameful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who persecute the believing men and the believing women, who did not do anything wrong, have committed not only a falsehood, but also a gross sin.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Dress Code for Women
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O prophet, tell your wives, your daughters, and the wives of the believers that they shall lengthen their garments. Thus, they will be recognized (as righteous women) and avoid being insulted. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Unless the hypocrites, and those with disease in their hearts, and the vicious liars of the city refrain (from persecuting you), we will surely grant you the upper hand, then they will be forced to leave within a short while.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have incurred condemnation wherever they go; (unless they stop attacking you,) they may be taken and killed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is GOD's eternal system, and you will find that GOD's system is unchangeable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: End of the World Revealed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The people ask you about the Hour (end of the world). Say, "The knowledge thereof is only with GOD. For all that you know, the Hour may be close."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Less than a century ago, only God possessed knowledge about television and space satellites, for example. He revealed this knowledge at the predetermined time. Similarly, God has revealed the time appointed for the end of this world (Appendix 25).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Followers Turn On Their Leaders
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD has condemned the disbelievers, and has prepared for them Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Eternally they abide therein. They will find no lord, nor a supporter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day they are thrown into Hell, they will say, "Oh, we wish we obeyed GOD, and obeyed the messenger."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will also say, "Our Lord, we have obeyed our masters and leaders, but they led us astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Our Lord, give them double the retribution, and curse them a tremendous curse."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not be like those who hurt Moses, then GOD absolved him of what they said. He was, in the sight of GOD, honorable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, reverence GOD and utter only the correct utterances.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will then fix your works, and forgive your sins. Those who obey GOD and His messenger have triumphed a great triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Freedom of Choice
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have offered the responsibility (freedom of choice) to the heavens and the earth, and the mountains, but they refused to bear it, and were afraid of it. But the human being accepted it; he was transgressing, ignorant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The animals, trees, stars, etc. took advantage of this most gracious offer. See Appendix 7.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: For GOD will inevitably punish the hypocrite men and the hypocrite women, and the idol worshiping men and the idol worshiping women. GOD redeems the believing men and the believing women. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Praise be to GOD—to whom belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; all praise is also due to Him in the Hereafter. He is the Most Wise, the Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He knows everything that goes into the earth, and everything that comes out of it, and everything that comes down from the sky, and everything that climbs into it. He is the Most Merciful, the Forgiving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve have said, "The Hour will never come to pass!" Say, "Absolutely—by my Lord—it will most certainly come to you. He is the Knower of the future. Not even the equivalent of an atom's weight is hidden from Him, be it in the heavens or the earth. Not even smaller than that, or larger (is hidden). All are in a profound record."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most certainly, He will reward those who believe and lead a righteous life. These have deserved forgiveness and a generous provision.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who constantly challenge our revelations, they have incurred a retribution of painful humiliation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is evident to those who are blessed with knowledge that this revelation from your Lord to you is the truth, and that it guides to the path of the Almighty, the Most Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve have said, "Let us show you a man who tells you that after you are torn apart you will be created anew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Either he fabricated lies about GOD, or he is crazy." Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Hereafter have incurred the worst retribution; they have gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not seen all the things in front of them and behind them, in the heaven and the earth? If we willed, we could have caused the earth to swallow them, or caused masses to fall on them from the sky. This should be a sufficient proof for every obedient servant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: David and Solomon
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We endowed David with blessings from us: "O mountains, submit with him, and you too, O birds." We softened the iron for him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You may make shields that fit perfectly, and work righteousness. Whatever you do, I am Seer thereof."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The First Oil Field
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: To Solomon we committed the wind at his disposal, traveling one month coming and one month going. And we caused a spring of oil to gush out for him. Also, the jinns worked for him, by his Lord's leave. Any one of them who disregarded our commands, we subjected him to a severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They made for him anything he wanted—niches, statues, deep pools, and heavy cooking pots. O family of David, work (righteousness) to show your appreciation. Only a few of My servants are appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Jinns' Knowledge is Limited
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When the appointed time for his death came, they had no clue that he had died. Not until one of the animals tried to eat his staff, and he fell down, that the jinns realized that he was dead. They thus realized that if they really knew the unseen, they would have stopped working so hard as soon as he died.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sheba's homeland used to be a marvel, with two gardens on the right and the left. Eat from your Lord's provisions, and be appreciative of Him—good land, and a forgiving Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They turned away and, consequently, we poured upon them a disastrous flood, and we substituted their two gardens into two gardens of bad tasting fruits, thorny plants, and a skimpy harvest.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus requited them for their disbelief. Do we not requite only the disbelievers?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We placed between them and the communities that we blessed other oases, and we secured the journey between them: "Travel therein days and nights in complete security."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: But they (turned unappreciative and) challenged: "Our Lord, we do not care if You increase the distance of our journeys (without any stations)." They thus wronged their own souls. Consequently, we made them history, and scattered them into small communities throughout the land. This should provide lessons for those who are steadfast, appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Satan Claims the Majority
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Satan found them readily fulfilling his expectations. They followed him, except a few believers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Objective: Do We Believe in the Hereafter?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He never had any power over them. But we thus distinguish those who believe in the Hereafter from those who are doubtful about it. Your Lord is in full control of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The criteria that inform us whether we believe in the Hereafter or not are in 6:113, 17:45, & 39:45. These three criteria bring out our true convictions, regardless of our oral statements.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "Implore the idols you have set up beside GOD. They do not possess as much as a single atom in the heavens, or the earth. They possess no partnership therein, nor does He permit them to be His assistants."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Intercession with Him will be in vain, unless it coincides with His will. When their minds are finally settled down, and they ask, "What did your Lord say," they will say, "The truth." He is the Most High, the Most Great.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Who provides for you, from the heavens and the earth?" Say, "GOD," and "Either we or you are guided, or have gone far astray."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You are not responsible for our crimes, nor are we responsible for what you do."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Our Lord will gather us all together before Him, then He will judge between us equitably. He is the Judge, the Omniscient."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Show me the idols you have set up as partners with Him!" Say, "No; He is the one GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent you (O Rashad) to all the people, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As detailed in Appendix 2, the name of this messenger is mathematically coded into the Quran as "Rashad Khalifa." By adding the numerical value of the name "Rashad" (505), plus the numerical value of the name "Khalifa" (725), plus the number of the sura (34), plus the number of the verse (28), we obtain a total that conforms with the Quran's 19-based mathematical miracle, which was unveiled through Rashad Khalifa. (505+725+34+28=1292=19x68). More information is given in 5:19 and its footnote.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They challenge, "When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You have a specific time, on a specific day, that you cannot delay by one hour, nor advance."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve have said, "We will not believe in this Quran, nor in the previous scriptures." If you could only envision these transgressors when they stand before their Lord! They will argue with one another back and forth. The followers will tell their leaders, "If it were not for you, we would have been believers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the Day of Resurrection
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The leaders will say to those who followed them, "Are we the ones who diverted you from the guidance after it came to you? No; it is you who were wicked."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The followers will say to their leaders, "It was you who schemed night and day, then commanded us to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up idols to rank with Him." They will be ridden with remorse, when they see the retribution, for we will place shackles around the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they not justly requited for what they did?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every Time!
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Every time we sent a warner to a community, the leaders of that community said, "We reject the message you are sent with."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They also said, "We are more powerful, with more money and children, and we will not be punished."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord is the One who controls all provisions; He grants the provisions to whomever He wills, or reduces them, but most people do not know."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is not your money or your children that bring you closer to us. Only those who believe and lead a righteous life will receive the reward for their works, multiplied manifold. In the abode of Paradise they will live in perfect peace.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who consistently challenge our revelations, they will abide in retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord is the One who controls all provisions; He increases the provisions for whomever He chooses from among His servants, or reduces them. Anything you spend (in the cause of GOD), He will reward you for it; He is the Best Provider."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the day when He summons them all, He will say to the angels, "Did these people worship you?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will answer, "Be You glorified. You are our Lord and Master, not them. Instead, they were worshiping the jinns; most of them were believers therein."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On that day, you possess no power to help or harm one another, and we will say to the transgressors, "Taste the retribution of the Hell that you used to deny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When our proofs were recited to them, perfectly clear, they said, "This is simply a man who wants to divert you from the way your parents are worshiping." They also said, "These are fabricated lies." Those who disbelieved also said about the truth that came to them, "This is obviously magic."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus this verse number (43), we get 505+725+43=1273=19x67. See Appendices 1 & 2.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We did not give them any other books to study, nor did we send to them before you another warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those before them disbelieved, and even though they did not see one-tenth of (the miracle) we have given to this generation, when they disbelieved My messengers, how severe was My retribution!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The great miracles given to Moses and Jesus were limited in time and place; they were witnessed by a few people who happened to exist in that place at that time. But the mathematical miracle of the Quran is perpetual (see 74:30-35 & Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "I ask you to do one thing: Devote yourselves to GOD, in pairs or as individuals, then reflect. Your friend (Rashad) is not crazy. He is a manifest warner to you, just before the advent of a terrible retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: By placing the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505) next to the value of "Khalifa" (725), then the sura number (34), and the verse number (46), we get 5057253446 = 19x266171234.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Say, "I do not ask you for any wage; you can keep it. My wage comes only from GOD. He witnesses all things."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "My Lord causes the truth to prevail. He is the Knower of all secrets."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "The truth has come; while falsehood can neither initiate anything, nor repeat it."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "If I go astray, I go astray because of my own shortcomings. And if I am guided, it is because of my Lord's inspiration. He is Hearer, Near."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you could only see them when the great terror strikes them; they cannot escape then, and they will be taken away forcibly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will then say, "We now believe in it," but it will be far too late.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They have rejected it in the past; they have decided instead to uphold conjecture and guesswork.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: People of all religions tend to forsake the word of God and uphold the words of men. The Jews and the Muslims uphold the Mishnah (Hadith) and Gemarrah (Sunna), while the Christians uphold a trinity invented by the Nicene Conference, 325 years after Jesus.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Consequently, they were deprived of everything they longed for. This is the same fate as their counterparts in the previous generations. They harbored too many doubts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Praise be to GOD, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, and appointer of the angels to be messengers with wings—two, three, and four (wings). He increases the creation as He wills. GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When GOD showers the people with mercy, no force can stop it. And if He withholds it, no force, other than He, can send it. He is the Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O people, remember GOD's blessings upon you. Is there any creator other than GOD who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no other god beside Him. How could you deviate?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they disbelieve you, messengers before you have been disbelieved. GOD is in control of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O people, GOD's promise is the truth; therefore, do not be distracted by this lowly life. Do not be diverted from GOD by mere illusions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The devil is your enemy, so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his party to be the dwellers of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve have incurred a severe retribution, and those who believe and lead a righteous life have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Note the one whose evil work is adorned in his eyes, until he thinks that it is righteous. GOD thus sends astray whoever wills (to go astray), and He guides whoever wills (to be guided). Therefore, do not grieve over them. GOD is fully aware of everything they do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who sends the winds to stir up clouds, then we drive them towards barren lands, and revive such lands after they were dead. Thus is the resurrection.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: All Dignity Belongs With God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Anyone seeking dignity should know that to GOD belongs all dignity. To Him ascends the good words, and He exalts the righteous works. As for those who scheme evil works, they incur severe retribution; the scheming of such people is destined to fail.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God is in Full Control
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD created you from dust, then from a tiny drop, then He causes you to reproduce through your spouses. No female becomes pregnant, nor gives birth, without His knowledge. No one survives for a long life, and no one's life is snapped short, except in accordance with a pre-existing record. This is easy for GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Appreciating God's Greatness
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The two seas are not the same; one is fresh and delicious, while the other is salty and undrinkable. From each of them you eat tender meat, and extract jewelry to wear. And you see the ships sailing through them, seeking His provisions, that you may be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we send our astronauts into space, we provide them with their minimum needs of food, water, and oxygen. When we sided with Satan's blasphemy billions of years ago (Appendix 7), God launched us into space aboard the spaceship Earth. But God has supplied our spaceship with awesome renewable systems that provide a great variety of fresh foods, water, oxygen, and even the reproduction of us astronauts.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He merges the night into the day, and merges the day into the night. He has committed the sun and the moon to run for a predetermined period of time. Such is GOD your Lord; to Him belongs all kingship. Any idols you set up beside Him do not possess as much as a seed's shell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Idols Utterly Powerless
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you call on them, they cannot hear you. Even if they hear you, they cannot respond to you. On the Day of Resurrection, they will disown you. None can inform you like the Most Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: People idolize Jesus, Mary, Muhammad, Ali, and/or the saints; such idols are dead, unaware, and utterly powerless. Even when they were alive, they were powerless.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: O people, you are the ones who need GOD, while GOD is in no need for anyone, the Most Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If He wills, He can get rid of you and substitute a new creation.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is not too difficult for GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No soul can carry the sins of another soul. If a soul that is loaded with sins implores another to bear part of its load, no other soul can carry any part of it, even if they were related. The only people to heed your warnings are those who reverence their Lord, even when alone in their privacy, and observe the Contact Prayers (Salat). Whoever purifies his soul, does so for his own good. To GOD is the final destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The blind and the seer are not equal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor are the darkness and the light.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor are the coolness of the shade and the heat of the sun.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Nor are the living and the dead; GOD causes whomever He wills to hear. You cannot make hearers out of those in the graves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You are no more than a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent you with the truth, a bearer of good news, as well as a warner. Every community must receive a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (24) give us a total that is a multiple of 19 (1230+24=1254=19x66).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: If they disbelieve you, those before them have also disbelieved. Their messengers went to them with clear proofs, and the Psalms, and the enlightening scriptures.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, I punished those who disbelieved; how terrible was My retribution!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Colorful Creations
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Do you not realize that GOD sends down from the sky water, whereby we produce fruits of various colors? Even the mountains have different colors; the peaks are white, or red, or some other color. And the ravens are black.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also, the people, the animals, and the livestock come in various colors. This is why the people who truly reverence GOD are those who are knowledgeable. GOD is Almighty, Forgiving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who recite the book of GOD, observe the Contact Prayers (Salat), and from our provisions to them they spend—secretly and publicly—are engaged in an investment that never loses.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will recompense them generously, and will multiply His blessings upon them. He is Forgiving, Appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran: The Consummation of All the Scriptures
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: What we revealed to you in this scripture is the truth, consummating all previous scriptures. GOD is fully Cognizant of His servants, Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We passed the scripture from generation to generation, and we allowed whomever we chose from among our servants to receive it. Subsequently, some of them wronged their souls, others upheld it only part of the time, while others were eager to work righteousness in accordance with GOD's will; this is the greatest triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They will enter the gardens of Eden, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments in it will be made of silk.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Praise GOD for removing all our worries. Our Lord is Forgiving, Appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "He has admitted us into the abode of eternal bliss, out of His grace. Never do we get bored herein, never do we get tired."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who disbelieve, they have incurred the fire of Hell, where they are never finished by death, nor is the retribution ever commuted for them. We thus requite the unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will scream therein, "Our Lord, if you get us out of here, we will work righteousness, instead of the works we used to do." Did we not give you a life-long chance, with continuous reminders for those who would take heed? Did you not receive the warner? Therefore, taste (the consequences). The transgressors will have no one to help them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the Knower of the future of the heavens and the earth. He is the Knower of all innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Winners and the Losers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He is the One who made you inheritors of the earth. Subsequently, whoever chooses to disbelieve does so to his own detriment. The disbelief of the disbelievers only augments their Lord's abhorrence towards them. The disbelief of the disbelievers plunges them deeper into loss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Consider the idols you have set up beside GOD; show me what on earth have they created." Do they own any partnership in the heavens? Have we given them a book wherein there is no doubt? Indeed, what the transgressors promise one another is no more than an illusion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who holds the heavens and the earth, lest they vanish. If anyone else is to hold them, they will most certainly vanish. He is Clement, Forgiving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Putting Them to the Test
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They swore by GOD solemnly that if a warner went to them, they would be better guided than a certain congregation! However, now that the warner did come to them, this only plunged them deeper into aversion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They resorted to arrogance on earth, and evil scheming, and the evil schemes only backfire on those who scheme them. Should they then expect anything but the fate of those who did the same things in the past? You will find that GOD's system is never changeable; you will find that GOD's system is immutable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They were even stronger than they. Nothing can be hidden from GOD in the heavens, nor on earth. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD punished the people for their sins, He would not leave a single creature on earth. But He respites them for a predetermined interim. Once their interim is fulfilled, then GOD is Seer of His servants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Y. S.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 1 for the detailed explanation of these initials.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And the Quran that is full of wisdom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, you (Rashad) are one of the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendices 2 & 26 for the irrefutable physical evidence.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: On a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This revelation is from the Almighty, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To warn people whose parents were never warned, and therefore, they are unaware.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It has been predetermined that most of them do not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For we place around their necks shackles, up to their chins. Consequently, they become locked in their disbelief.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we place a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and thus, we veil them; they cannot see.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is the same whether you warn them or not, they cannot believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Everyone is already stamped as a believer or a disbeliever. See Appendix 14.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You will be heeded only by those who uphold this message, and reverence the Most Gracious—even when alone in their privacy. Give them good news of forgiveness and a generous recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will certainly revive the dead, and we have recorded everything they have done in this life, as well as the consequences that continue after their death. Everything we have counted in a profound record.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Rejecting The Messengers: A Tragic Human Trait
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Cite for them the example of people in a community that received the messengers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's messengers have proof, advocate God alone, and do not ask for money.

segments.text: David's Exemplary Piety
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He said, "He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few." Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In this clear example, 99 on one side vs 1 on the other side, David's extreme care to render the correct judgment caused him to ask forgiveness. Are we this careful?
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We forgave him in this matter. We have granted him a position of honor with us, and a beautiful abode.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. Therefore, you shall judge among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To David we granted Solomon; a good and obedient servant.

segments.text: He then said, "I enjoyed the material things more than I enjoyed worshiping my Lord, until the sun was gone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Solomon missed his afternoon prayer because of his horses. To nullify Satan's possible claim that Solomon loved his horses more than loving God, he got rid of his horses.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: "Bring them back." (To bid farewell,) he rubbed their legs and necks.

segments.text: The Idols as Mediators A Common Myth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Absolutely, the religion shall be devoted to GOD alone. Those who set up idols beside Him say, "We idolize them only to bring us closer to GOD; for they are in a better position!" GOD will judge them regarding their disputes. GOD does not guide such liars, disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD wanted to have a son, He could have chosen whomever He willed from among His creations. Be He glorified; He is GOD, the One, the Supreme.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Shape of the Earth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He created the heavens and the earth truthfully. He rolls the night over the day, and rolls the day over the night. He committed the sun and the moon, each running for a finite period. Absolutely, He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This verse clearly informs us that the earth is round. The Arabic for "He rolls" (Yukawwir) is derived from the Arabic word for "ball" (Kurah). Since the Earth is not exactly round, a specific reference to its shape is given in 79:30. The Quran is replete with scientific information that became known to us centuries after the revelation of the Quran. See Appendix 20.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He created you from one person, then created from him his mate. He sent down to you eight kinds of livestock. He creates you in your mothers' bellies, creation after creation, in trimesters of darkness. Such is GOD your Lord. To Him belongs all sovereignty. There is no other god beside Him. How could you deviate?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believe For Your Own Good
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you disbelieve, GOD does not need anyone. But He dislikes to see His servants make the wrong decision. If you decide to be appreciative, He is pleased for you. No soul bears the sins of any other soul. Ultimately, to your Lord is your return, then He will inform you of everything you had done. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the human being is afflicted, he implores his Lord, sincerely devoted to Him. But as soon as He blesses him, he forgets his previous imploring, sets up idols to rank with GOD and to divert others from His path. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief temporarily; you have incurred the hellfire."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is it not better to be one of those who meditate in the night, prostrating and staying up, being aware of the Hereafter, and seeking the mercy of their Lord? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only those who possess intelligence will take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "O My servants who believed, you shall reverence your Lord." For those who worked righteousness in this world, a good reward. GOD's earth is spacious, and those who steadfastly persevere will receive their recompense generously, without limits.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the retribution of a great day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "GOD is the only One I worship, devoting my religion absolutely to Him alone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Therefore, worship whatever you wish besides Him." Say, "The real losers are those who lose their souls, and their families, on the Day of Resurrection." Most certainly, this is the real loss.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will have masses of fire on top of them, and under them. GOD thus alerts His servants: O My servants, you shall reverence Me.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who discard the worship of all idols, and devote themselves totally to GOD alone, they have deserved happiness. Give good news to My servants.
