segments.text: Follow the Word of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They are the ones who examine all words, then follow the best. These are the ones whom GOD has guided; these are the ones who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: With regard to those who have deserved the retribution, can you save those who are already in Hell?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Righteous
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who reverence their Lord, they will have mansions upon mansions constructed for them, with flowing streams. This is GOD's promise, and GOD never breaks His promise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do you not see that GOD sends down from the sky water, then places it into underground wells, then produces with it plants of various colors, then they grow until they turn yellow, then He turns them into hay? This should be a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD renders one's heart content with Submission, he will be following a light from his Lord. Therefore, woe to those whose hearts are hardened against GOD's message; they have gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Best Hadith
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: GOD has revealed herein the best Hadith; a book that is consistent, and points out both ways (to Heaven and Hell). The skins of those who reverence their Lord cringe therefrom, then their skins and their hearts soften up for GOD's message. Such is GOD's guidance; He bestows it upon whomever He wills. As for those sent astray by GOD, nothing can guide them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: What is better than saving one's face from the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection? The transgressors will be told, "Taste the consequences of what you earned."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Others before them have disbelieved and, consequently, the retribution afflicted them whence they never expected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has condemned them to humiliation in this life, and the retribution in the Hereafter will be far worse, if they only knew.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quran: No Ambiguity
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have cited for the people every kind of example in this Quran, that they may take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: An Arabic Quran, without any ambiguity, that they may be righteous.

segments.text: GOD cites the example of a man who deals with disputing partners (Hadith), compared to a man who deals with only one consistent source (Quran). Are they the same? Praise be to GOD; most of them do not know.

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: As for those who promote the truth, and believe therein, they are the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD remits their sinful works, and rewards them generously for their good works.

segments.text: Profound Question
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Is GOD not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with the idols they set up beside Him. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And whomever GOD guides, nothing can send him astray. Is GOD not Almighty, Avenger?

segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If you ask them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they will say, "GOD." Say, "Why then do you set up idols beside GOD? If GOD willed any adversity for me, can they relieve such an adversity? And if He willed a blessing for me, can they prevent such a blessing?" Say, "GOD is sufficient for me." In Him the trusters shall trust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "O my people, do your best and I will do my best; you will surely find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "(You will find out) who has incurred shameful punishment, and has deserved an eternal retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have revealed the scripture through you for the people, truthfully. Then, whoever is guided is guided for his own good, and whoever goes astray goes astray to his own detriment. You are not their advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD puts the souls to death when the end of their life comes, and also at the time of sleep. Thus, He takes some back during their sleep, while others are allowed to continue living until the end of their predetermined interim. This should provide lessons for people who reflect.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Myth of Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Have they invented intercessors to mediate between them and GOD? Say, "What if they do not possess any power, nor understanding?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "All intercession belongs to GOD." To Him belongs all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Greatest Criterion
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When GOD ALONE is mentioned, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion. But when others are mentioned beside Him, they become satisfied.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Despite the clear commandment in 3:18 that the First Pillar of Submission is proclaiming: "Ash-hadu An Lã Elãha Ellã Allãh (there is no other god beside God)," the majority of "Muslims" insist upon adding the name of Muhammad. This Greatest Criterion alerts us that rejoicing in adding the name of Muhammad, or any other name, exposes disbelief in the Hereafter. See also Footnote 17:46.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "Our god, Initiator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of all secrets and declarations, You are the only One who judges among Your servants regarding their disputes."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If those who transgressed owned everything on earth, even twice as much, they would readily give it up to avoid the terrible retribution on the Day of Resurrection. They will be shown by GOD what they never expected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The sinful works they had earned will be shown to them, and the very things they used to mock will come back to haunt them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Human Fickleness
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If the human is touched by adversity, he implores us, but as soon as we bestow a blessing upon him, he says, "I attained this because of my cleverness!" Indeed, this is only a test, but most of them do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those before them have uttered the same thing, and their earnings did not help them in the least.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They suffered the consequences of their evil works. Similarly, the transgressors among the present generation will suffer the consequences of their evil works; they cannot escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not realize that GOD is the One who increases the provision for whomever He chooses, and withholds? These are lessons for people who believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Infinite Mercy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "O My servants who exceeded the limits, never despair of GOD's mercy. For GOD forgives all sins. He is the Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall obey your Lord, and submit to Him totally, before the retribution overtakes you, then you cannot be helped.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And follow the best path that is pointed out for you by your Lord, before the retribution overtakes you suddenly when you least expect it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Lest a soul may say, "How sorry I am for disregarding GOD's commandments; I was certainly one of the mockers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or say, "Had GOD guided me, I would have been with the righteous."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or say, when it sees the retribution, "If I get another chance, I will work righteousness."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Yes indeed (you did get enough chances). My proofs came to you, but you rejected them, turned arrogant, and became a disbeliever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those who lied about GOD covered with misery. Is Hell not the right retribution for the arrogant ones?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And GOD will save those who have maintained righteousness; He will reward them. No harm will touch them, nor will they have any grief.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the Creator of all things, and He is in full control of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs all decisions in the heavens and the earth, and those who disbelieve in GOD's revelations are the real losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Is it other than GOD you exhort me to worship, O you ignorant ones?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idol Worship Nullifies All Work
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: It has been revealed to you, and to those before you that if you ever commit idol worship, all your works will be nullified, and you will be with the losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall worship GOD alone, and be appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Greatness of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They can never fathom the greatness of GOD. The whole earth is within His fist on the Day of Resurrection. In fact, the universes are folded within His right hand. Be He glorified; He is much too high above needing any partners.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our universe, with its billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies, spanning many billions of light-years, is the smallest and innermost of seven universes. This incomprehensible vastness of the seven universes is within God's hand. Such is the greatness of God. See Appendix 6.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Day of Judgment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The horn will be blown, whereupon everyone in the heavens and the earth will be struck unconscious, except those who will be spared by GOD. Then it will be blown another time, whereupon they will all rise up, looking.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The sequence of events on the Day of Resurrection begins with the symbolic blowing of the horn. The second blowing of the horn—by a creature who was spared from unconsciousness—marks the resurrection of all people; they will be resurrected on today's earth. This earth will then be destroyed by the physical coming of God, then a new earth and new heavens will be created (14:48). We will then be stratified according to our degree of development (Appendix 11).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Then the earth will shine with the light of its Lord. The record will be proclaimed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought forth. Everyone will then be judged equitably, without the least injustice.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every soul will be paid for whatever it did, for He is fully aware of everything they have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Disbelievers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved will be led to Hell in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, "Did you not receive messengers from among you, who recited to you the revelations of your Lord, and warned you about meeting this day?" They will answer, "Yes indeed. But the word 'retribution' was already stamped upon the disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell, wherein you abide forever." What a miserable destiny for the arrogant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who reverenced their Lord will be led to Paradise in throngs. When they get to it, and its gates are opened, its guards will say, "Peace be upon you; you have won. Therefore, you abide herein forever."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Praise be to GOD, who fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the earth, enjoying Paradise as we please." What a beautiful recompense for the workers!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You will see the angels floating around the throne, glorifying and praising their Lord. After the equitable judgment is issued to all, it will be proclaimed: "Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: H. M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The initials "Hã Mîm" occur in Suras 40-46. The total frequency of occurrence of the letters "Hã" and "Mîm" in the seven suras is 2147, or 19x113 (Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: This revelation of the scripture is from GOD, the Almighty, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Forgiver of sins, acceptor of repentance, strict in enforcing retribution, and possessor of all power. There is no other god beside Him. To Him is the ultimate destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: None argues against GOD's revelations except those who disbelieve. Do not be impressed by their apparent success.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, and many other opponents after them. Every community persecuted their messenger to neutralize him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat the truth. Consequently, I punished them; how terrible was My retribution!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, the judgment of your Lord is already stamped upon those who disbelieve, that they are the dwellers of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Angels Pray for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who serve the throne and all those around it glorify and praise their Lord, and believe in Him. And they ask forgiveness for those who believe: "Our Lord, Your mercy and Your knowledge encompass all things. Forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and spare them the retribution of Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Our Lord, and admit them into the gardens of Eden that You promised for them and for the righteous among their parents, spouses, and children. You are the Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "And protect them from falling in sin. Whomever You protect from falling in sin, on that day, has attained mercy from You. This is the greatest triumph."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God ALONE: The Disbelievers Confess
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve will be told, "GOD's abhorrence towards you is even worse than your own abhorrence towards yourselves. For you were invited to believe, but you chose to disbelieve."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God ALONE: The Disbelievers Suffer Two Deaths
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Our Lord, you have put us to death twice, and You gave us two lives; now we have confessed our sins. Is there any way out?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The disbelievers go through two deaths, while the righteous believers do not taste death, beyond the death we already experienced (44:56). Please see Appendix 17. The reason for going to Hell is obvious; even those who believe in God associate others with Him (see 39:45).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: God ALONE: Note the Reason
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is because when GOD ALONE was advocated, you disbelieved, but when others were mentioned beside Him, you believed. Therefore, GOD's judgment has been issued; He is the Most High, the Great.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who continuously shows you His proofs, and sends down to you from the sky provisions. Only those who totally submit will be able to take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall devote your worship absolutely to GOD ALONE, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Possessor of the highest ranks, and Ruler of the whole dominion. He sends inspiration, bearing His commands, to whomever He chooses from among His servants, to warn about the Day of Summoning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is the day when everyone will be completely exposed; none of them will hide anything from GOD. To whom belongs all sovereignty on that day? To GOD, the One, the Supreme.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Prepare for the Big Day
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: On that day, every soul will be requited for whatever it had earned. There will be no injustice on that day. GOD is most efficient in reckoning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: No Intercession
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Warn them about the imminent day, when the hearts will be terrified, and many will be remorseful. The transgressors will have no friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is fully aware of what the eyes cannot see, and everything that the minds conceal.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD judges equitably, while the idols they implore beside Him cannot judge anything. GOD is the One who is the Hearer, the Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did they not roam the earth and note the consequences for those before them? They used to be stronger than they, and more productive on earth. But GOD punished them for their sins, and nothing could protect them from GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is because their messengers went to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved. Consequently, GOD punished them. He is Mighty, strict in enforcing retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We sent Moses with our signs and a profound authority.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Pharaoh, Hãmãn, and Qãroon. But they said, "A magician; a liar."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And when he showed them the truth from us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who believed with him, and spare their daughters." Thus, the scheming of the disbelievers is always wicked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses vs Pharaoh
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses, and let him implore his Lord. I worry lest he corrupts your religion, or spreads evil throughout the land."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Moses said, "I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord, from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Guides Not the Liars
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: A believing man among Pharaoh's people, who was concealing his belief, said, "How can you kill a man just for saying, 'My Lord is GOD,' and he has shown you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, that is his problem, and if he is truthful, you benefit from his promises. Surely, GOD does not guide any transgressor, liar.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, today you have kingship and the upperhand. But who will help us against GOD's judgment, should it come to us?" Pharaoh said, "You are to follow only what I see fit; I will guide you only in the right path."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The one who believed said, "O my people, I fear for you the same fate as the previous opponents.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "The opponents of Noah, and 'Ãd, Thamûd, and others who came after them. GOD does not wish any injustice for the people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, I fear for you the Day of Summoning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "That is the day when you may wish to turn around and flee. But nothing will protect you then from GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray, nothing can guide him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who is the Last Messenger?* A Tragic Human Trait
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Joseph had come to you before that with clear revelations, but you continued to doubt his message. Then, when he died you said, "GOD will not send any other messenger after him. (He was the last messenger)!" GOD thus sends astray those who are transgressors, doubtful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text:
The Jews refused to believe in the Messiah when he came to them, the Christians refused to believe in Muhammad when he came to them, and a majority of today's Muslims believe that Muhammad was the last messenger. On that erroneous basis, they refused to accept God's Messenger of the Covenant. We learn from 3:81-90 and 33:7 that those who fail to accept the Quranic injunction to "believe in and support God's Messenger of the Covenant" are no longer believers. See Appendices 2 & 26.

±±40:34 It is noteworthy that we find the name "Rashad" in the Arabic text precisely four verses ahead of the injunction against saying "the last messenger," and also four verses after it.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They argue against GOD's revelations, without any basis. This is a trait that is most abhorred by GOD and by those who believe. GOD thus seals the hearts of every arrogant tyrant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Pharaoh said, "O Hãmãn, build for me a high tower, that I may reach out and discover.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "I want to reach the heaven, and take a look at the god of Moses. I believe he is a liar." Thus were the evil works of Pharaoh adorned in his eyes, and thus was he kept from following (the right) path. Pharaoh's scheming was truly evil.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The one who believed said, "O my people, follow me, and I will guide you in the right way.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "O my people, this first life is a temporary illusion, while the Hereafter is the eternal abode."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Best Deal
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Whoever commits a sin is requited for just that, and whoever works righteousness—male or female—while believing, these will enter Paradise wherein they receive provisions without any limits.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believing Egyptian Debates With His People
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "O my people, while I invite you to be saved, you invite me to the hellfire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "You invite me to be unappreciative of GOD, and to set up beside Him idols that I do not recognize. I am inviting you to the Almighty, the Forgiver.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "There is no doubt that what you invite me to do has no basis in this world, nor in the Hereafter, that our ultimate return is to GOD, and that the transgressors have incurred the hellfire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Some day you will remember what I am telling you now. I leave the judgment of this matter to GOD; GOD is the Seer of all the people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD then protected him from their evil schemes, while the people of Pharaoh have incurred the worst retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: While in the Grave: A Continuous Nightmare
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The Hell will be shown to them day and night, and on the Day of Resurrection: "Admit Pharaoh's people into the worst retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As they argue in Hell, the followers will say to their leaders, "We used to be your followers, can you spare us any part of this Hell?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The leaders will say, "We are all in this together. GOD has judged among the people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Too Late
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those in the hellfire will say to the guardians of Hell, "Call upon your Lord to reduce the retribution for us, for even one day."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They will say, "Did you not receive your messengers who delivered to you clear messages?" They will reply, "Yes we did." They will say, "Then implore (as much as you wish); the imploring of the disbelievers is always in vain."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Guaranteed Victory; Here and Forever
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Most assuredly, we will give victory to our messengers and to those who believe, both in this world and on the day the witnesses are summoned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On that day, the apologies of the disbelievers will not benefit them. They have incurred condemnation; they have incurred the worst destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Learn From History
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have given Moses the guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (Their history) is a lesson and a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, be patient, for GOD's promise is true, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and glorify and praise your Lord night and day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who argue against GOD's revelations without proof are exposing the arrogance that is hidden inside their chests, and they are not even aware of it. Therefore, seek refuge in GOD; He is the Hearer, the Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Awesome Construction of the Universe
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The creation of the heavens and the earth is even more awesome than the creation of the human being, but most people do not know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Not equal are the blind and the seer. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. Rarely do you take heed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Most certainly, the Hour (Day of Judgment) is coming, no doubt about it, but most people do not believe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Supplication: A Form of Worship
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Your Lord says, "Implore Me, and I will respond to you. Surely, those who are too arrogant to worship Me will enter Gehenna, forcibly."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Supplication, imploring God for anything, even material luxuries, is a form of worship. Hence the commandment to implore God whenever we have any need. An atheist will never implore God for anything.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who designed the night so you can rest in it, and the day lighted. GOD bestows many blessings upon the people, but most people are not thankful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is GOD your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no god except He. How could you deviate?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Deviating are those who disregard GOD's revelations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who rendered the earth habitable for you, and the sky a formidable structure, and He designed you, and designed you well. He is the One who provides you with good provisions. Such is GOD your Lord; Most Exalted is GOD, Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the Living; there is no god except He. You shall worship Him alone, devoting your religion absolutely to Him alone. Praise be to GOD, Lord of the universe.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Before God's Blessings Upon Him, Muhammad Used to Worship Idols
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say, "I have been enjoined from worshiping the idols you worship beside GOD, when the clear revelations came to me from my Lord. I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the universe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Arabic word "Nahaa" used in this verse indicates the stopping of something that was going on. See for example the same word in 4:171. See also 93:7.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He is the One who created you from dust, and subsequently from a tiny drop, then from a hanging embryo, then He brings you out as a child, then He lets you reach maturity, then you become old—some of you die earlier. You attain a predetermined age, that you may understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the only One who controls life and death. To have anything done, He simply says to it, "Be," and it is.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have you noted those who argue against GOD's proofs, and how they have deviated?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They are the ones who have disbelieved in the scripture, and in the messages we have sent with our messengers. Therefore, they will surely find out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The shackles will be around their necks, and the chains will be used to drag them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In the Inferno, then in the Fire, they will burn.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who did not prepare themselves will suffer tremendously in the presence of God, on the Day of Judgment. They cannot stand the closeness to God due to lack of sufficient growth and development of their souls. I am using "Inferno" to describe this particular situation (55:44). Preparation of the soul is accomplished by the rites decreed by God, such as the Contact Prayer.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They will be asked, "Where are the idols you used to worship,
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They Worshiped Nothing
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: "beside GOD?" They will say, "They have abandoned us. In fact, when we worshiped them, we were worshiping nothing." Thus does GOD send the disbelievers astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because you used to rejoice in false doctrines, on earth, and you used to promote them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Enter the gates of Gehenna, wherein you abide forever. What a miserable destiny for the arrogant ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall be patient, for GOD's promise is truth. Whether we show you some of (the retribution) we have promised for them, or terminate your life before that, they will be returned to us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Authorization for the Quran's Mathematical Miracle
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent messengers before you—some of them we mentioned to you, and some we did not mention to you. No messenger can produce any miracle without GOD's authorization. Once GOD's judgment is issued, the truth dominates, and the falsifiers are exposed and humiliated.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We learn from 17:45-46, 18:57, and 56:79 that the unbelievers have no access to the Quran; only the believers and the sincere seekers are permitted by God to understand it. The Quran's mathematical code, "One of the great miracles" (74:30-35), was authorized by God, and revealed through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 2).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who created the livestock for you; some you ride, and some you eat.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They also provide you with additional benefits that satisfy many of your needs. On them, as well as on the ships, you are carried.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He thus shows you His proofs. Which of GOD's proofs can you deny?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not roamed the earth and noted the consequences for those who preceded them? They used to be greater in number, greater in power, and possessed a greater legacy on earth. Yet, all their achievements did not help them in the least.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When their messengers went to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they had inherited, and the very things they ridiculed were the cause of their fall.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God ALONE
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Subsequently, when they saw our retribution they said, "Now we believe in GOD ALONE, and we now disbelieve in the idol worship that we used to practice."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Too Late
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Their belief then could not help them in the least, once they saw our retribution. Such is GOD's system that has been established to deal with His creatures; the disbelievers are always doomed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: H. M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: For the significance of these Quranic Initials, see Footnote 40:1.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: A revelation from the Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A scripture whose verses provide the complete details, in an Arabic Quran, for people who know.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A bearer of good news, as well as a warner. However, most of them turn away; they do not hear.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They said, "Our minds are made up, our ears are deaf to your message, and a barrier separates us from you. Do what you want, and so will we."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "I am no more than a human being like you, who has been inspired that your god is one god. You shall be devoted to Him, and ask His forgiveness. Woe to the idol worshipers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Who do not give the obligatory charity (Zakat), and with regard to the Hereafter, they are disbelievers."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life, they receive a well deserved recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "You disbelieve in the One who created the earth in two days, and you set up idols to rank with Him, though He is Lord of the universe."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The "days" of creation represent a yardstick. Thus, the physical universe was created in two days, while the calculation of provisions for all the creatures on earth required four. This also teaches us that there is life only on this planet Earth.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He placed on it stabilizers (mountains), made it productive, and He calculated its provisions in four days, to satisfy the needs of all its inhabitants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Then He turned to the sky, when it was still gas, and said to it, and to the earth, "Come into existence, willingly or unwillingly." They said, "We come willingly."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, He completed the seven universes in two days, and set up the laws for every universe. And we adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and placed guards around it. Such is the design of the Almighty, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God alone created the universe (18:51), but the angels participated in handling certain jobs in the lowest universe. Our universe cannot stand the physical presence of God (7:143). The plural tense acknowledges the angels' role in our universe (Appendix 10).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Warning
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If they turn away, then say, "I am warning you of a disaster like the disaster that annihilated 'Ãd and Thamûd."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their messengers went to them, as well as before them and after them, saying, "You shall not worship except GOD." They said, "Had our Lord willed, He could have sent angels. We are disbelievers in what you say."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for 'Ãd, they turned arrogant on earth, opposed the truth, and said, "Who is more powerful than we?" Did they not realize that GOD, who created them, is more powerful than they? They were unappreciative of our revelations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we sent upon them violent wind, for a few miserable days. We thus afflicted them with humiliating retribution in this life, and the retribution of the Hereafter is more humiliating; they can never win.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for Thamûd, we provided them with guidance, but they preferred blindness over guidance. Consequently, the disastrous and shameful retribution annihilated them, because of what they earned.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We always save those who believe and lead a righteous life.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when the enemies of GOD will be summoned to the hellfire, forcibly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Once they get there, their own hearing, eyes, and skins will bear witness to everything they had done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Video Record
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They will say to their skins, "Why did you bear witness against us?" They will reply, "GOD made us speak up; He is the One who causes everything to speak. He is the One who created you the first time, and now you have been returned to Him."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There is no way you can hide from your own hearing, your eyes, or your skins. In fact, you thought that GOD was unaware of much of what you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This kind of thinking about your Lord will cause you to fall, and then you become losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they continue the way they are, Hell will be their destiny, and if they make up excuses, they will not be excused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Jinn Companions
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We assign to them companions who adorn everything they do in their eyes. Thus, they end up incurring the same fate as the previous communities of jinns and humans, who were also losers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved said, "Do not listen to this Quran and distort it, that you may win."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will certainly afflict these disbelievers with a severe retribution. We will certainly requite them for their evil works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is the requital that awaits GOD's enemies. Hell will be their eternal abode; a just requital for discarding our revelations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: On the Day of Judgment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieved will say, "Our Lord, show us those among the two kinds—jinns and humans—who misled us, so we can trample them under our feet, and render them the lowliest."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Perfect Happiness: Now and Forever
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who proclaim: "Our Lord is GOD," then lead a righteous life, the angels descend upon them: "You shall have no fear, nor shall you grieve. Rejoice in the good news that Paradise has been reserved for you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We are your allies in this life, and in the Hereafter. You will have in it anything you wish for; you will have anything you want.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "(Such is your) ultimate abode, from a Forgiver, Most Merciful."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Submitters
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Who can utter better words than one who invites to GOD, works righteousness, and says, "I am one of the submitters"?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Not equal is the good response and the bad response. You shall resort to the nicest possible response. Thus, the one who used to be your enemy, may become your best friend.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: None can attain this except those who steadfastly persevere. None can attain this except those who are extremely fortunate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the Devil Entices You
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: When the devil whispers an idea to you, you shall seek refuge in GOD. He is the Hearer, the Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proofs of God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate before the sun, nor the moon; you shall fall prostrate before the GOD who created them, if you truly worship Him alone.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If they are too arrogant to do this, then those at your Lord glorify Him night and day, without ever tiring.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is that you see the land still, then, as soon as we shower it with water, it vibrates with life. Surely, the One who revived it can revive the dead. He is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who distort our revelations are not hidden from us. Is one who gets thrown into Hell better, or one who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you wish; He is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mathematical Miracle of the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who have rejected the Quran's proof  when it came to them, have also rejected an Honorable book.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The word "Zikr" refers to the Quran's mathematical code, as made clear in 38:1.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: No falsehood could enter it, in the past or in the future; a revelation from a Most Wise, Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: One of the major functions of the Quran's mathematical miracle is to guard every letter and every aspect of the Quran. Thus, any tampering is immediately recognized (Apps. 1 & 24).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: What is said to you is precisely what was said to the previous messengers. Your Lord possesses forgiveness, and He also possesses painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mathematical proof shows that this verse refers to God's Messenger of the Covenant. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad" (505), plus the value of "Khalifa" (725), plus this verse number (43), we get 505+725+43=1273=19x67. See Appendix 2.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Language is Irrelevant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If we made it a non-Arabic Quran they would have said, "Why did it come down in that language?" Whether it is Arabic or non-Arabic, say, "For those who believe, it is a guide and healing. As for those who disbelieve, they will be deaf and blind to it, as if they are being addressed from faraway."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have given Moses the scripture and it was also disputed. If it were not for your Lord's predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, they harbor too many doubts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whoever works righteousness, does so for his own good, and whoever works evil does so to his own detriment. Your Lord is never unjust towards the people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Idols Disown Their Followers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: With Him is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world). No fruits emerge from their sheaths, nor does any female conceive or give birth, without His knowledge. The day will come when He asks them: "Where are those idols that you set up beside Me?" They will say, "We proclaim to You that none of us bears witness to that."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God has revealed this knowledge through His Messenger of the Covenant (Appendix 25).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The idols they had idolized will disown them, and they will realize that there will be no escape.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Bad Weather Friends
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The human being never tires of imploring for good things. And when adversity befalls him, he turns despondent, desperate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And when we bless him after suffering some adversity, he says, "This belongs to me. I do not believe that the Hour will ever come to pass. Even if I am returned to my Lord, I will find at Him better things." Most certainly, we will inform the disbelievers of all their works, and will commit them to severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When we bless the human being, he turns away, and drifts farther and farther away, and when he suffers any affliction, he implores loudly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proclaim: "What if this is truly from GOD, then you decide to reject it? Who are farther astray than those who decide to oppose this?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: A Great Prophecy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We will show them our proofs in the horizons, and within themselves, until they realize that this is the truth. Is your Lord not sufficient, as a witness of all things?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The letters that compose this verse are 19, and their gematrical values add up to 1387, 19x73. This great prophecy, together with 9:33, 48:28, 61:9 & 110:2, informs us that the whole world is destined to accept the Quran as God's unaltered message (See Appendix 38).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Indeed, they are doubtful about meeting their Lord. He is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: H.M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: These initials constitute a significant part of the Quran's miracle (Footnote 40:1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: A. S. Q.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is the only sura where we see the initials 'A.S.Q. ('Ayn Seen Qaf), and the total occurrence of these three letters in this sura is 209, 19x11. Also, the letter "Q" occurs in this sura 57 times, 19x3. The only other sura where we see the initial "Q" is Sura 50, and this letter occurs in that sura also 57 times (See Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Inspiring you, and those before you, is GOD, the Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth, and He is the Most High, the Great.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The heavens above them almost shatter, out of reverence for Him, and the angels praise and glorify their Lord, and they ask forgiveness for those on earth. Absolutely, GOD is the Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who set up other lords beside Him, GOD is the One in charge of them; you are not their advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We thus reveal to you an Arabic Quran to warn the central community and all around it, and to warn about the Day of Summoning that is inevitable. Some will end up in Heaven, and some in Hell.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had GOD willed, He could have made them one community. But He redeems into His mercy whomever He wills. As for the transgressors, they have no master, nor a helper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did they find other lords beside Him? GOD is the only Lord and Master. He is the One who resurrects the dead, and He is the Omnipotent One.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you dispute any part of this message, the judgment for doing this rests with GOD. Such is GOD my Lord. In Him I trust, and to Him I submit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: None Equals God
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Initiator of the heavens and the earth. He created for you from among yourselves spouses—and also for the animals. He thus provides you with the means to multiply. There is nothing that equals Him. He is the Hearer, the Seer.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To Him belongs absolute control of the heavens and the earth. He is the One who increases the provision for whomever He wills, or reduces it. He is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only One Religion, Monotheists vs Idol Worshipers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He decreed for you the same religion decreed for Noah, and what we inspired to you, and what we decreed for Abraham, Moses, and Jesus: "You shall uphold this one religion, and do not divide it."The idol worshipers will greatly resent what you invite them to do. GOD redeems to Himself whomever He wills; He guides to Himself only those who totally submit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Ironically, they broke up into sects only after the knowledge had come to them, due to jealousy and resentment among themselves. If it were not for a predetermined decision from your Lord to respite them for a definite interim, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the later generations who inherited the scripture are full of doubts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Message to the Christians and the Jews
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: This is what you shall preach, and steadfastly maintain what you are commanded to do, and do not follow their wishes. And proclaim: "I believe in all the scriptures sent down by GOD. I was commanded to judge among you equitably. GOD is our Lord and your Lord. We have our deeds and you have your deeds. There is no argument between us and you. GOD will gather us all together; to Him is the ultimate destiny."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who argue about GOD, after receiving His message, their argument is nullified at their Lord. They have incurred condemnation, and have deserved a severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is the One who sent down the scripture, to deliver the truth and the law. For all that you know, the Hour (Day of Judgment) may be very close.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Believers Mindful of the Day of Judgment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Challenging it are those who do not believe in it. As for those who believe, they are concerned about it, and they know that it is the truth. Absolutely, those who deny the Hour have gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is fully aware of all His creatures; He provides for whomever He wills. He is the Powerful, the Almighty.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whoever seeks the rewards of the Hereafter, we multiply the rewards for him. And whoever seeks the materials of this world, we give him therefrom, then he receives no share in the Hereafter.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Idols: Innovating New Religious Laws
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They follow idols who decree for them religious laws never authorized by GOD. If it were not for the predetermined decision, they would have been judged immediately. Indeed, the transgressors have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Islam of today's Muslim world has been so distorted, it has become a Satanic cult. The Ulama, or religious scholars, have added many extraneous laws, prohibitions, dress codes, dietary regulations, and religious practices never authorized by God. This is one of the main reasons for sending God's Messenger of the Covenant (9:31, 33:67, and Appendix 33).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: You will see the transgressors worried about everything they had committed; everything will come back and haunt them. As for those who believed and led a righteous life, they will be in the gardens of Paradise. They will receive whatever they wish from their Lord. This is the great blessing.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is the good news from GOD to His servants who believe and lead a righteous life. Say, "I do not ask you for any wage. I do ask each of you to take care of your own relatives." Anyone who does a righteous work, we multiply his reward for it. GOD is Forgiver, Appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God Erases the Falsehood and Affirms the Truth
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Are they saying, "He (Rashad) has fabricated lies about GOD!"? If GOD willed, He could have sealed your mind, but GOD erases the falsehood and affirms the truth with His words. He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The disbelievers added 2 false statements at the end of Sura 9 to commemorate their idol, the prophet Muhammad. God has revealed overwhelming evidence to erase this blasphemy and establish the truth. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the verse number (24), we get 1254, 19x66 (please see Appendices 2 & 24 for the details).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: He is the One who accepts the repentance from His servants, and remits the sins. He is fully aware of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Responding to Him are those who believe and lead a righteous life. He will shower them with His blessings. As for the disbelievers, they have incurred a severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If GOD increased the provision for His servants, they would transgress on earth. This is why He sends it precisely measured to whomever He wills. He is fully Cognizant and Seer of His servants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sends down the rain after they had despaired, and spreads His mercy. He is the only Master, Most Praiseworthy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the creatures He spreads in them. He is able to summon them, when He wills.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Only A Consequence
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Anything bad that happens to you is a consequence of your own deeds, and He overlooks many (of your sins).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You can never escape, and you have none beside GOD as a Lord and Master.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Among His proofs are the ships that sail the sea with sails like flags.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If He willed, He could have stilled the winds, leaving them motionless on top of the water. These are proofs for those who are steadfast, appreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He can annihilate them, as a consequence of their own works. Instead, He overlooks many (of their sins).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who argue against our proofs will find out that they have no basis.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whatever you are given is no more than temporary material of this life. What GOD possesses is far better and everlasting, for those who believe and trust in their Lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Traits of the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They avoid gross sins and vice, and when angered they forgive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They respond to their Lord by observing the Contact Prayers (Salat). Their affairs are decided after due consultation among themselves, and from our provisions to them they give (to charity).
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When gross injustice befalls them, they stand up for their rights.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Although the just requital for an injustice is an equivalent retribution, those who pardon and maintain righteousness are rewarded by GOD. He does not love the unjust.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Certainly, those who stand up for their rights, when injustice befalls them, are not committing any error.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The wrong ones are those who treat the people unjustly, and resort to aggression without provocation. These have incurred a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Resorting to patience and forgiveness reflects a true strength of character.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whomever GOD sends astray will never find any other lord, and you will see such transgressors, when they see the retribution, saying, "Can we get another chance?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You will see them facing it, humiliated and debased, and looking, yet trying to avoid looking. Those who believed will proclaim: "The real losers are those who lost their souls and their families on the Day of Resurrection. The transgressors have deserved an everlasting retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: There will be no allies to help them against GOD. Whomever GOD sends astray can never be guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall respond to your Lord before a day comes which is decreed inevitable by GOD. There will be no refuge for you on that day, nor an advocate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Sole Mission of the Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If they turn away, we did not send you as their guardian. Your sole mission is delivering the message. When we shower the human beings with mercy, they become proud, and when adversity afflicts them, as a consequence of their own deeds, the human beings turn into disbelievers.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills, granting daughters to whomever He wills, and granting sons to whomever He wills.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or, He may have the males and the females marry each other, then render whomever He wills sterile. He is Omniscient, Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How God Communicates With Us
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: No human being can communicate with GOD except through inspiration, or from behind a barrier, or by sending a messenger through whom He reveals what He wills. He is the Most High, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Thus, we inspired to you a revelation proclaiming our commandments. You had no idea about the scripture, or faith. Yet, we made this a beacon to guide whomever we choose from among our servants. Surely, you guide in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The path of GOD, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Absolutely, all matters are controlled by GOD.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: H. M.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Footnote 40:1. The frequency of occurrence of the letters "H" (Hã) and "M" (Mîm) in the seven H.M.-initialed suras is 292, and 1855, respectively. This adds up to 2147, or 19x113.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: And the enlightening scripture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have rendered it an Arabic Quran, that you may understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Arabic is the most efficient language, especially in expressing commandments, statutes and exacting laws. Hence the revelation of the Quran in Arabic for the clear understanding of all peoples, regardless of their tongues. See Appendix 4 for the details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: It is preserved with us in the original master, honorable and full of wisdom.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Should we just ignore the fact that you have transgressed the limits?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This refers to our original sin as detailed in the Introduction and Appendix 7.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: The Plan for Redemption
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We have sent many a prophet to the previous generations.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every time a prophet went to them, they ridiculed him.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we annihilated people who were even more powerful than these. We thus set the examples from the previous communities.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth," they would say, "The Almighty, the Omniscient has created them."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who made the earth habitable for you, and created for you roads therein, that you may follow the right way.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sends down from the sky water, in exact measure, to revive dead lands therewith. Similarly, you will be resurrected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who created all kinds, in pairs (male and female), and He created for you ships and livestock to ride.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As you rest on top of them, you shall appreciate such a blessing from your Lord, and say, "Glory be to the One who subdued this for us. We could not have controlled them by ourselves.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "We ultimately return to our Lord."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Angels As Daughters: A Blasphemy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They even assigned for Him a share from His own creation! Surely, the human being is profoundly unappreciative.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Has He chosen from among His creations daughters for Himself, while blessing you with sons?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When one of them is given news (of a daughter) as they claimed for the Most Gracious, his face is darkened with misery and anger!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (They say,) "What is good about an offspring that is brought up to be beautiful, and cannot help in war?"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They claimed that the angels, who are servants of the Most Gracious, are females! Have they witnessed their creation? Their claims are recorded, and they will be asked.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They even said, "If the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them." They have no basis for such a claim; they only conjecture.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The idol worshipers cannot blame God for their idolatry, since we have absolute freedom of choice to worship God alone, or not.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Have we given them a book before this, and they are upholding it?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Inherited Traditions Condemned
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The fact is: they said, "We found our parents carrying on certain practices, and we are following in their footsteps."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Invariably, when we sent a warner to any community, the leaders of that community would say, "We found our parents following certain practices, and we will continue in their footsteps."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: (The messenger) would say, "What if I brought to you better guidance than what you inherited from your parents?" They would say, "We are disbelievers in the message you brought."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Consequently, we requited them. Note the consequences for the rejectors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Abraham's Example
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Abraham said to his father and his people, "I disown what you worship.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Only the One who initiated me can guide me."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This example (of Abraham) was rendered an everlasting lesson for subsequent generations; perhaps they redeem their souls.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Indeed, I have given these people and their ancestors sufficient chances, then the truth came to them, and a clarifying messenger.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and we are disbelievers therein."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muhammad Ridiculed
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They said, "If only this Quran was sent down through another man from the two communities (Mecca or Yathrib) who is prominent!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Are they the ones who assign your Lord's mercy? We have assigned their shares in this life, raising some of them above others in ranks, in order to let them serve one another. The mercy from your Lord is far better than any material they may hoard.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Materials of This World: All That The Disbelievers Get
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If it were not that all the people might become one (disbelieving) congregation, we would have granted everyone who disbelieves in the Most Gracious mansions with silver roofs, and stairs upon which they could climb.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Their mansions would have impressive gates, and luxurious furnishings.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Also many ornaments. All these are the temporary materials of this lowly life. The Hereafter—at your Lord—is far better for the righteous.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Invisible, Devilish, Companions
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Anyone who disregards the message of the Most Gracious, we appoint a devil to be his constant companion.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Each one of us has a representative of Satan as a constant companion (App. 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Such companions will divert them from the path, yet make them believe that they are guided.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When he comes before us he will say, "Oh I wish you were as far from me as the two easts. What a miserable companion!"
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The "easts" imply the locations of sunrise, moonrise, and the rising of heavenly bodies.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: It will not console you on that day, as transgressors, that both of you will share in the retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Can you make the deaf hear; can you make the blind see, or those who are far astray?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whether we let you die before it or not, we will surely requite them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Or, we may show you (the retribution) we promised for them. We are in full control over them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You shall steadfastly preach what is revealed to you; you are in the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Jesus and the End of the World

segments.text: He is to serve as a marker for knowing the end of the world, so you can no longer harbor any doubt about it. You shall follow Me; this is the right path.

segments.text: As detailed in Appendix 25, the End of the World is given in the Quran, and the birth date of Jesus provided one of the significant signs that the calculations are correct. We learn that the world will end in the year 2280 (19x120) after the birth of Jesus (see 47:18). Additionally, both the lunar year (1710) & the solar year (2280) are divisible by 570 (19x30), the number of years from the birth of Jesus to the birth of Muhammad. Thus, the birth date of Jesus is a marker.

segments.text: 40: The Age of Decision
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: We enjoined the human being to honor his parents. His mother bore him arduously, gave birth to him arduously, and took intimate care of him for thirty months. When he reaches maturity, and reaches the age of forty, he should say, "My Lord, direct me to appreciate the blessings You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do the righteous works that please You. Let my children be righteous as well. I have repented to You; I am a submitter."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God knows full well who deserves to go to Heaven and who deserves to go to Hell. It is His law that whomever He puts to death before the age of 40 shall go to Heaven. God's immense mercy is reflected in the fact that most people have difficulty accepting this divine mercy; they argue: "Put them in Hell!" See Appendix 32.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: It is from these that we accept the righteous works, and overlook their sins. They have deserved Paradise. This is the truthful promise that is promised to them.

The parents would cry for GOD's help and say, "Woe to you; please believe! GOD's promise is the truth." He would say, "Tales from the past!"
