segments.text: Believers Among the Jinns
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Recall that we directed a number of jinns to you, in order to let them hear the Quran. When they got there, they said, "Listen." As soon as it was over, they rushed to their people, warning.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Jinns are the creatures who fully agreed with Satan when he initiated his famous blasphemy billions of years ago. They are brought into this world as descendants of Satan. One jinn is born every time a human being is born. The newly born jinn is assigned to the same body as the newly born human, and constantly pushes Satan's point of view (Appendix 7).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They said, "O our people, we have heard a book that was revealed after Moses, and confirms the previous scriptures. It guides to the truth; to the right path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O our people, respond to the call of GOD, and believe in Him. He will then forgive your sins, and spare you a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who fail to respond to GOD's call cannot escape, and will have no Lord other than Him; they have gone far astray.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Do they not realize that GOD, who created the heavens and the earth without the least effort is able to revive the dead? Yes indeed; He is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day the disbelievers are introduced to the Hellfire, they will be asked, "Is this not the truth?" They will answer, "Yes indeed, by our Lord." He will say, "Then suffer the retribution for your disbelief."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: God's Messenger of the Covenant
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Therefore, be patient like the messengers before you who possessed strength and resorted to patience. Do not be in a hurry to see the retribution that will inevitably come to them. The day they see it, it will seem as if they lasted one hour of the day. This is a proclamation: Is it not the wicked who are consistently annihilated?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Quranic and mathematical evidence proves that the messenger addressed here is Rashad Khalifa. By adding the gematrical value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230), plus the sura number (46), plus the verse number (35), we get 1311, or 19x69. This conforms with the Quran's code (App 2).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, He nullifies their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who believe and work righteousness, and believe in what was sent down to Muhammad—which is the truth from their Lord—He remits their sins, and blesses them with contentment.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because those who disbelieve are following falsehood, while those who believe are following the truth from their Lord. GOD thus cites for the people, their examples.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If you encounter (in war) those who disbelieve, you may strike the necks. If you take them as captives you may set them free or ransom them, until the war ends. Had GOD willed, He could have granted you victory, without war. But He thus tests you by one another. As for those who get killed in the cause of GOD, He will never put their sacrifice to waste.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will guide them, and bless them with contentment.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will admit them into Paradise, that He described to them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, if you support GOD, He will support you, and strengthen your foothold.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve incur misery; He causes their works to be utterly in vain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is because they hated what GOD revealed and consequently, He nullifies their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did they not roam the earth and see the consequences for those before them? GOD destroyed their works; all disbelievers will suffer the same fate.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because GOD is the Lord of those who believe, while the disbelievers have no lord.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD admits those who believe and lead a righteous life into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who disbelieve, they live and eat like the animals eat, then end up in the hellfire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a community was much stronger than the community that evicted you from your town; when we annihilated them, no one could help them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Are those enlightened by their Lord the same as those whose evil works are adorned in their eyes, and they follow their own opinions?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The allegory of Paradise that is promised for the righteous is this: it has rivers of unpolluted water, and rivers of fresh milk, and rivers of wine— delicious for the drinkers—and rivers of strained honey. They have all kinds of fruits therein, and forgiveness from their Lord. (Are they better) or those who abide forever in the hellfire, and drink hellish water that tears up their intestines?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Some of them listen to you, then as soon as they leave they ask those who were enlightened, "What did he just say?" GOD thus seals their hearts and, consequently, they follow only their opinions.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for those who are guided, He augments their guidance, and grants them their righteousness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: End of the World
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Are they waiting until the Hour comes to them suddenly? All the signs thereof have already come. Once the Hour comes to them, how will they benefit from their message?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran, being the Final Testament, provides all the signs needed to pinpoint the end of the world; AD 2280. See Appendix 25 for the details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Lã Elãha Ellã Allãh: First Commandment
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You shall know that: "There is no other god beside GOD," and ask forgiveness of your sins and the sins of all believing men and women. GOD is fully aware of your decisions and your ultimate destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Significantly, the "First Pillar" of religion is stated in the sura entitled Muhammad, and is utterly devoted to God alone. Muhammad's name was added by his idolizers, against his will.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Exposing the Hypocrites
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who believed said: "When will a new sura be revealed?" But when a straightforward sura was revealed, wherein fighting was mentioned, you would see those who harbored doubts in their hearts looking at you, as if death had already come to them. They were thus exposed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Proof of Faith During Muhammad's Era
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Obedience and righteous utterances are expected of them. If only they showed confidence in GOD, when mobilization was called for, it would have been better for them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Is it also your intention that as soon as you leave you will commit evil and mistreat your relatives?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is those who incurred a curse from GOD, whereby He rendered them deaf and blind.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Study the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Why do they not study the Quran carefully? Do they have locks on their minds?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who slide back, after the guidance has been manifested to them, the devil has enticed them and led them on.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because they said to those who hated what GOD has sent down, "We will obey you in certain matters." GOD fully knows their secret conspiracies.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: How will it be for them when the angels put them to death? They will beat them on their faces and their rear ends.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is because they followed what angered GOD and hated the things that please Him. Consequently, He has nullified their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Did those who harbor doubts in their hearts think that GOD will not bring out their evil thoughts?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If we will, we can expose them for you, so that you can recognize them just by looking at them. However, you can recognize them by the way they talk. GOD is fully aware of all your works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We will certainly put you to the test, in order to distinguish those among you who strive, and steadfastly persevere. We must expose your true qualities.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, and oppose the messenger after the guidance has been manifested for them, will never hurt GOD in the least. Instead, He nullifies their works.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall obey GOD, and obey the messenger. Otherwise, all your works will be in vain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Great Disaster
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Those who disbelieve and repel from the path of GOD, then die as disbelievers, GOD will never forgive them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, you shall not waver and surrender in pursuit of peace, for you are guaranteed victory, and GOD is with you. He will never waste your efforts.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This worldly life is no more than play and vanity. But if you believe and lead a righteous life, He will reward you, without asking you for any money.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: If He asked you for money, to the extent of creating a hardship for you, you might have become stingy, and your hidden evil might be exposed.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Warning to the Arabs
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: You are invited to spend in the cause of GOD, but some of you turn stingy. The stingy are stingy towards their own souls. GOD is Rich, while you are poor.  If you turn away, He will substitute other people in your place, and they will not be like you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Quran was given to the Arabs, in their language, for 1400 years, but they clearly rejected it and refused to believe that it is complete; they fabricated Hadith & Sunna.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: We have bestowed upon you (O Messenger) a great victory.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This profound statement consists of 19 letters, indicating that our generation is the generation of victory for God's purified, unified, and consolidated religion—Submission (3:19, 85). It is our generation that witnessed the revelations of God's great miracle in the Quran (Appendix 1).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Whereby GOD forgives your past sins, as well as future sins, and perfects His blessings upon you, and guides you in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additionally, GOD will support you with an unwavering support.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who places contentment into the hearts of believers to augment more faith, in addition to their faith. To GOD belongs all forces of the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He will certainly admit the believing men and women into gardens with flowing streams, wherein they abide forever. He will remit their sins. This is, in the sight of GOD, a great triumph.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And He will requite the hypocrite men and women and the idol worshiping men and women, for they have harbored evil thoughts about GOD. Their evil will backfire against them. For GOD is angry with them, condemns them, and has prepared for them Gehenna. What a miserable destiny!
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs all the forces in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of good news, and a warner.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That you people may believe in GOD and His messenger, and reverence Him, and observe Him, and glorify Him, day and night.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You Shall Support God's Messenger
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who pledge allegiance to you, are pledging allegiance to GOD. GOD approves their pledge; He places His hand above their hands. Those who violate such a pledge, commit the violation to their own detriment. As for those who fulfill their pledge with GOD, He will grant them a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The sedentary Arabs who stay behind will say, "We have been preoccupied with our money and our families, so ask forgiveness for us!" They utter with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, "Who can protect you from GOD, if He willed any adversity for you, or if He willed any blessing for you?" GOD is fully Cognizant of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You secretly believed that the messenger and the believers will be defeated and never come back to their families, and this was firmly established in your hearts. You harbored evil thoughts and turned into wicked people.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Anyone who refuses to believe in GOD and His messenger, we have prepared for the disbelievers a hellfire.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: To GOD belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomever He wills, and punishes whomever He wills. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The sedentary who stay behind will say, when you are expected to collect spoils of war, "Let us follow you to share in this!" They thus wish to alter GOD's words. Say, "You will not follow us. This is GOD's decision." They will then say, "You must be envious of us (for staying behind)." Indeed, they rarely understood anything.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Test for Early Generations
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Say to the sedentary Arabs who stay behind, "You will be invited to face powerful people and to fight them, unless they submit. If you obey, GOD will reward you with a generous recompense. But if you turn away again, as you did in the past, He will requite you with a painful retribution."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The blind is not to be blamed, the crippled is not to be blamed, and the sick is not to be blamed. Those who obey GOD and His messenger, He will admit them into gardens with flowing streams. As for those who turn away, He will requite them with a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD is pleased with the believers who pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts and, consequently, He blessed them with contentment, and rewarded them with an immediate victory.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Additionally, they gained many spoils. GOD is Almighty, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has promised you many spoils that you will gain. He thus advanced some benefits for you in this life, and He has withheld the people's hands of aggression against you, and has rendered this a sign for the believers. He thus guides you in a straight path.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: As for the group that you could not possibly defeat, GOD took care of them; GOD is Omnipotent.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Victory Guaranteed for the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If the disbelievers ever fought you, they would turn around and flee. They have no Lord and Master; they have no helper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is GOD's system throughout history, and you will find that GOD's system is unchangeable.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He is the One who withheld their hands of aggression against you, and withheld your hands of aggression against them in the valley of Mecca, after He had granted you victory over them. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: It is they who disbelieved and barred you from the Sacred Masjid, and even prevented your offerings from reaching their destination. There were believing men and women (within the enemy camp) whom you did not know, and you were about to hurt them, unknowingly. GOD thus admits into His mercy whomever He wills. If they persist, He will requite those among them who disbelieve with a painful retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: While those who disbelieved were enraged, and their hearts were filled with the pride of the days of ignorance, GOD blessed His messenger and the believers with peaceful contentment, and directed them to uphold the word of righteousness. This is what they well deserved. GOD is fully aware of all things.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD has fulfilled His messenger's truthful vision: "You will enter the Sacred Masjid, GOD willing, perfectly secure, and you will cut your hair or shorten it (as you fulfill the pilgrimage rituals) there. You will not have any fear. Since He knew what you did not know, He has coupled this with an immediate victory."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Great Prophecy
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: He is the One who sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all other religions. GOD suffices as a witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This important prophecy informs us that Submission will inevitably dominate the whole world. This, together with Verses 9:33, 41:53, and 61:9 leave no doubt that God's mathematical miracle of the Quran will play a major role in this prophecy. Solid Quranic mathematical evidence points to God's Messenger of the Covenant as fulfilling this prophecy. See Appendices 2 & 26 for the evidence and specific details.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Qualities of the Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: Muhammad—the messenger of GOD—and those with him are harsh and stern against the disbelievers, but kind and compassionate amongst themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating, as they seek GOD's blessings and approval. Their marks are on their faces, because of prostrating. This is the same example as in the Torah. Their example in the Gospel is like plants that grow taller and stronger, and please the farmers. He thus enrages the disbelievers. GOD promises those among them who believe and lead a righteous life forgiveness and a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not place your opinion above that of GOD and His messenger. You shall reverence GOD. GOD is Hearer, Omniscient.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, do not raise your voices above the voice of the prophet, nor shall you shout at him as you shout at each other, lest your works become nullified while you do not perceive.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Whenever the word "prophet" (Nabi) is used in reference to Muhammad, it invariably refers to him during his life, not after his death. Obviously, we cannot possibly raise our voices above Muhammad's voice, now that he is dead. See also 33:56.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Surely, those who lower their voices at the messenger of GOD are the ones whose hearts are prepared by GOD to become righteous. They have deserved forgiveness and a great recompense.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Respecting the messenger helps outsiders and visitors in coming to God's message.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: As for those who call on you from outside the walls, most of them do not understand.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Had they been patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Investigate Rumors Before Believing Them
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, if a wicked person brings any news to you, you shall first investigate, lest you commit injustice towards some people, out of ignorance, then become sorry and remorseful for what you have done.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And know that GOD's messenger has come in your midst. Had he listened to you in many things, you would have made things difficult for yourselves. But GOD made you love faith and adorned it in your hearts, and He made you abhor disbelief, wickedness, and disobedience. These are the guided ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Such is grace from GOD and His blessings. GOD is Omniscient, Most Wise.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Reconcile The Believers
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: If two groups of believers fought with each other, you shall reconcile them. If one group aggresses against the other, you shall fight the aggressing group until they submit to GOD's command. Once they submit, you shall reconcile the two groups equitably. You shall maintain justice; GOD loves those who are just.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Real Family
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The believers are members of one family; you shall keep the peace within your family and reverence GOD, that you may attain mercy.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Believers Set the Example
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, no people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you mock one another, or make fun of your names. Evil indeed is the reversion to wickedness after attaining faith. Anyone who does not repent after this, these are the transgressors.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Suspicion Is Sinful
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O you who believe, you shall avoid any suspicion, for even a little bit of suspicion is sinful. You shall not spy on one another, nor shall you backbite one another; this is as abominable as eating the flesh of your dead brother. You certainly abhor this. You shall observe GOD. GOD is Redeemer, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The Only Criterion For Distinguishing Among The People
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: O people, we created you from the same male and female, and rendered you distinct peoples and tribes, that you may recognize one another. The best among you in the sight of GOD is the most righteous. GOD is Omniscient, Cognizant.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Muslim vs Mu'men
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: The Arabs said, "We are Mu'mens (believers)." Say, "You have not believed; what you should say is, 'We are Muslims (submitters),' until belief is established in your hearts." If you obey GOD and His messenger, He will not put any of your works to waste. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Mu'mens (believers) are those who believe in GOD and His messenger, then attain the status of having no doubt whatsoever, and strive with their money and their lives in the cause of GOD. These are the truthful ones.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Say, "Are you informing GOD about your religion? GOD knows everything in the heavens and the earth. GOD is Omniscient."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Who Is Doing Whom A Favor?
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: They act as if they are doing you a favor by embracing Submission! Say, "You are not doing me any favors by embracing Submission. GOD is the One who is doing you a great favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: GOD knows all the secrets in the heavens and the earth; GOD is Seer of everything you do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Q., and the glorious Quran.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: See Appendix 1 for the awesome miracles connected with the Initial Q (ق).
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: They found it strange that a warner from among them came to them! The disbelievers said, "This is really strange.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "After we die and become dust; this is impossible."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are fully aware of any one of them who gets consumed by the earth; we have an accurate record.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They rejected the truth when it came to them; they are utterly confused.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Have they not looked at the sky above them, and how we constructed it and adorned it, without a flaw?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we created the earth, and scattered on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of beautiful plants.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is an enlightenment, and a reminder for every pious worshiper.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And we sent from the sky blessed water, to grow with it gardens and grains to be harvested.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Tall date palms, with clustered fruit.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Provisions for the people. And we revive with it dead lands; you are similarly resurrected.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, the dwellers of Russ, and Thamûd.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And 'Ãd, Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: And the dwellers of the woods, and the people of Tubba'. All of them disbelieved the messengers and, consequently, My retribution befell them.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Were we too burdened by the first creation? Is this why they doubt resurrection?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We created the human, and we know what he whispers to himself. We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Two recording (angels), at right and at left, are constantly recording.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Not an utterance does he utter without an alert witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Finally, the inevitable coma of death comes; this is what you tried to evade.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The horn is blown; this is the promised day.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Every soul comes with a herder and a witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: You used to be oblivious to this. We now remove your veil; today, your vision is (as strong as) steel.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The companion said, "Here is my formidable testimony."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Your life-time companion witnesses everything you do. See Appendix 7.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: Throw into Gehenna every stubborn disbeliever.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Forbidder of charity, aggressor, full of doubt.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He set up besides GOD another god. Throw him into severe retribution.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: His companion said, "Our Lord, I did not mislead him; he was far astray."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: He said, "Do not feud in front of Me; I have sufficiently warned you.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: "Nothing can be changed now. I am never unjust towards the people."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: That is the day when we ask Hell, "Have you had enough?" It will say, "Give me more."
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Paradise will be offered to the righteous, readily.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is what was promised to every repenter, steadfast.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They reverenced the Most Gracious, in their privacy, and came wholeheartedly.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: They get anything they wish therein, and we have even more.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Many a generation before them, who were more powerful, we annihilated. They searched the land; did they find an escape?
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This should be a lesson for everyone who possesses a mind, or is able to hear and witness.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We have created the heavens and the earth, and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched us.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Therefore, be patient in the face of their utterances, and praise and glorify your Lord before sunrise, and before sunset.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: During the night you shall meditate on His name, and after prostrating.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Prepare for the day when the caller calls from a place that is near.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: When they hear the inevitable cry; that is the day you come out.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are the ones who control life and death; to us is the final destiny.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The day will come when the earth cracks in a hurry, giving rise to them. Such summoning is easy for us to do.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: We are fully aware of everything they utter, while you have no power over them. Therefore, remind with this Quran, those who reverence My warnings.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Bearing rain.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Bringing provisions.

segments.text: People who believe and nourish their souls through worshiping God alone are destined for the High Heaven. The contemporary followers of each messenger invariably suffer persecution from the traditionalists and adherents of the corrupted religion. Thus, they have a special place reserved for them in the High Heaven. All people who die before the age of 40 go to the Lower Heaven, at least (46:15).

segments.text: Only the Sincere Can Understand the Quran
segments.label: heading-1992

segments.text: I swear by the positions of the stars.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: Our universe, the smallest and innermost of seven universes, contains a billion galaxies, a billion trillion stars, spanning billions of light years. These uncountable decillions of heavenly bodies maintain their orbits in a divinely controlled precision. The more we learn, the more we realize how awesome this oath is. See Appendix 6.
segments.label: footnote-1992

segments.text: This is an oath, if you only knew, that is awesome.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: This is an honorable Quran.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: In a protected book.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: None can grasp it except the sincere.
segments.label: verse-1992

segments.text: The insincere who are not satisfied with the Quran alone are divinely prevented from understanding the Quran. This concept is repeated throughout the Quran (17:45, 18:57). Consequently, they cannot understand this verse. For example, compare this translation of 7:3, 17:46, 41:44, & 56:79 with other translations.
segments.label: footnote-1992
