Ray Catton turns a number of knobs, and flicks a number of switches. The main viewscreen flickers then shows a picture of a star studded black horizon. CLOSE SHOT - MAIN VIEWSCREEN Stars fly on both sides of the spaceship as they turn into long luminous streaks. Light from a distant sun creates a bright glow around an oval planet. The density of the stars ahead increases to create a crowded sky.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: "Eternity" is racing towards them, and they appear approaching. FULL SHOT - CONTROL ROOM COMMANDER MOSS Split screen. Bit-Seventy-Six pushes a few buttons and flips a few switches. Picture on the main viewscreen shrinks to the left half, and a label appears under it saying: FRONT. Mu-One-Nine manipulates a few controls on his rectangular boxes. The other half of the screen flickers, then shows a different view of a star-studded black horizon, with the stars streaking away from the spaceship. A label under the picture reads: BACK.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 31 - ETERNITY Suddenly, the cluster of stars ahead appears to surround "Eternity", then passes by in long luminous streaks, causing the left half of the screen to turn completely black except for a distant faint glow. The right half of the screen shows the star cluster streaking away. COMMANDER MOSS Kathleen, would you contact MCC and report our location? KATHLEEN SHEARD Yes, sir. Octa, please send your latest EPIB report. Octa-Ohm-R clicks, clanks, turns his Rubik's cube head, and flicks a couple of switches. OCTA-OHM-R It's on your small screen now. Kathleen Sheard pushes a few buttons. Camera zooms in to show the LED computer numerals of the calendar gauge on Kathleen's desk turning fast, then stopping at "AD 2242". ANGLE on Kathleen as she adjusts her head set, turns a few knobs, then contacts MCC. KATHLEEN SHEARD MCC. Come in MCC.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Radio STATIC is heard before MCC comes in. MCC (V.O.) We read you loud and clear Eternity. You should be exiting the Milky Way any time now. You lucky rascals! KATHLEEN SHEARD As a matter of fact, we just did. Complete void out here; but it feels great. See you later earthlings. She pushes a few buttons, takes off her head set, then talks to Shirley Van Cleef. KATHLEEN SHEARD What earth-shaking events are you planning to show us today, Shirley.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 32 - ETERNITY MIKE BARAKAT Not earth shaking; galaxy shaking. (Laughter) COMMANDER MOSS (Standing by the Computer Encyclopedia) Funny you should use that expression. Down right ironic. Earth shaking is the literal word for it. Shirley, stabilize your monitor at the year 1216 BC. ANGLE on Shirley Van Cleef as she turns a few knobs and flips a few switches. CLOSE SHOT - Main Viewscreen Picture on the screen flickers, then a picture appears of the Israelites camping in Sinai. EXT. SINAI DESERT - DAY PAN SHOT The ISRAELITES are camping in the desert. Circle of MEN and WOMEN are chatting by a fire where quails are being roasted on a stick. SOME WOMEN are shown shaping manna into pita-like bread and baking them in a primitive stone oven. A large boulder with water gushing out of 12 holes in it is shown in the background.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Two bearded middle aged men (MOSES and AARON) are walking towards a sand dune. Moses climbs up the mound, then calls on the people to speak to them with an obvious speech defect, yet with dignity. MOSES Lishin to me, everybody. Pleaj leave everyching and come here. FULL SHOT - ISRAELI CAMP The people slowly gather around Moses. MOSES I have to leave you for forty nightsh, for I have been shummoned to vijit with the Lord and shpeak
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 33 - ETERNITY with Him. A couple of people snicker. Moses stares them down, resuming his speech. MOSES Perhapsh I can bring back Shome good newj. Aaron will take my plashe among you, sho pleaj obey him and follow hij direcchion. And pleaj remember to objerve the Lord in everything you do. Remember Hij favorj, and that He delivered you from shlavery in Egypt. Shalom. Moses hugs a few people as he bids them farewell, then walks away towards a hill. EXT. SINAI - TOP OF A HILL - DAY Just as Moses approaches the top of the hill, he hears the VOICE OF GOD. VOICE Moses, this is your Lord speaking. Remove your sandals, for the ground you are standing on is sacred. Moses is awed. He bends down to remove his sandals, then steps to a flat clear area, and falls to his knees. MOSES Pleaje fiksh my shpeech defect, my Lord. I would be a more effective meshshenger, if I can talk better.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: VOICE I can fix your speech right this second, Moses, but it is not to be. I deliberately impart some kind of a superficial defect upon each one of My messengers. I want My creatures to come to Me, not because of your eloquence or charisma, but because they recognize Me as absolute sovereign of the universe. MOSES Allow me to shee You, my Lord. Let me look at You.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 34 - ETERNITY VOICE It is a physical impossibility, Moses. Look at that mountain over there. Moses looks to his right. Camera PANS to a distant mountain with a sharp peak (Picacho Peak, Arizona). VOICE If it stays in place, then you can see Me. EXT. SINAI DESERT - ISRAELI CAMP - DAY The Israelites are roaming about their desert camp. Suddenly, a thick cloud descends on the camp, heavily shading it. It is almost dark. An ELDERLY MAN walks to a tent where Aaron is visible near its entrance. Man asks Aaron. ELDERLY MAN What's happening, Aaron? Thick clouds in the middle of the desert? AARON I haven't the slightest idea. I will have to ask Moses when he comes back. EXT. MOUNT SINAI - DAY PAN SHOT from behind Moses. Moses is looking at the mountain. Intense light appears descending from the sky, streaming down the center.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: The tip of the streaming light becomes rounded, turning into a blindingly bright sun, still attached to the top light that now dominates the sky all the way from right to left. Moses stands up from his kneeling position, raising his arms to protect his eyes. The descending "sun" streams down towards the mountain peak, then touches it in slow motion. The mountain shatters like a violent volcano, with intensely bright light and a tremendous rumble. Moses wraps his arms around his head, backs up a few steps, spins around, then falls, face down, unconscious. When he comes to, he murmurs.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 35 - ETERNITY MOSES Glory be to You my Lord ... glory be to You; I repent. INT. SPACECRAFT - CONTROL ROOM Main viewscreen shows Moses still on the ground, coming to. All crew members are watching in amazement. COMMANDER MOSS What did I tell you? Earth shaking; wasn't it? MIKE BARAKAT Obviously, the earth cannot stand the manifested presence of God. Which tells me that all those teachings about God existing everywhere are wrong; at least not physically. COMMANDER MOSS That's precisely what the Computer Encyclopedia says. In fact, God is nowhere near the Solar System, the Milky Way Galaxy, or any other galaxy. JANE ANDERSON I wonder if "Eternity" can with- stand the energy of God! Do you think we might reach His physical presence? COMMANDER MOSS There is only one way to find out. (Looking at Raymond Catton) Maximize speed. MU-ONE-NINE (Cowardly) Oh, boy, maximize speed. OCTA-OHM-R (Clicks, grinds, and turns his heads) There goes Mr. Coward Siamese. MU-ONE-NINE Listen octa-head, if the earth
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 36 - ETERNITY could not survive the presence of God, what makes you think we can? Raymond Catton flips a number of switches and turns a few knobs. RAYMOND CATTON Maximizing speed. EXT. HYPERSPACE Rear view of the spaceship shows additional engines firing, until all 95 boosters are lighted. "Eternity" darts forward. INT. SPACESHIP - GAME ROOM Jane Anderson is busy playing a sophisticated video game. INT. SPACESHIP - EXERCISE ROOM This is a large room, with a Solaflex unit, other exercise equip- ment, and free standing weights. Kathleen Sheard, Raymond Catton, and Mike Barakat are exercising. Suddenly, alarm blares, and red lights blink and flash throughout the spaceship. Crew members rush to the control room. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Crew members scurry into the control room, assume their posi- tions, strap themselves to their stations, and put on their head sets.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: With the alarm still sounding and the lights blinking, camera ZOOMS IN to show the odometer reading "25,840,133,760 LIGHT YEARS". Camera ZOOMS IN on the speedometer's "2,888,000 MILES/SECOND". Speedometer starts to slow down fast. Crew members show strain of sudden braking. Camera ZOOMS IN on the speedometer to show it clicking downward fast to "1,330,000 MILES/SECOND", all the way down to "77,900 MILES/SECOND". Every crew member is busy pushing buttons, turning knobs, and flipping switches. SOLID ROSE COLOR appears on the main viewscreen.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 37 - ETERNITY BIT-SEVENTY-SIX We are sinking into a soft object. RAYMOND CATTON (Looking at the screen) Obviously, a soft rose-colored object. COMMANDER MOSS Fire camera satellite. EXT. HYPERSPACE Aperture on top of the spaceship opens up like a camera shutter. A cannon projects out of the hole, then slowly releases a CAMERA- BEARING SATELLITE. The satellite floats upward about one thousand feet, with the camera lens pointing down towards the spaceship. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM From a FULL SHOT of the control room, camera zooms in on the speedometer as it races downward from "22,800 MILES/SECOND", to "5,700 MILES/SECOND", to "12 MILES/SECOND". Braking strain intensifies on the faces of the crew. JANE ANDERSON We are coming to a halt. I wonder if our camera satellite ever made it up there! MIKE BARAKAT (As he flips a switch) I doubt it.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: We are sinking deep into something soft and weird. The solid rose-colored picture on the small screen on Mike Barakat's desk flickers. Barakat pushes a button. Main viewscreen flickers, then stabilizes with a helicopter shot of the spaceship being stopped by the extended hand of an AWESOME-SIZED, ROSE-COLORED CREATURE. The spaceship is dwarfed to a nubbin by the creature's size. EXT. SPACE "Eternity" is shown with the mammoth rose-colored creature
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 38 - ETERNITY stopping it with his hand. PAN SHOT emphasizes that the view behind "Eternity" is a sea of stars, while the view ahead of the spaceship is total darkness. The creature is characterized by six retractable concorde-type wings, three on each side, in addition to four power belts around his body. The power belts, perfectly flush with the body when not in use, consist of what looks like rocket engines that swivel in various directions to steer the creature in any direction, or stop him. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM The main viewscreen focuses on the creature's pleasant and friendly face. JANE ANDERSON For heavens sakes, what is that? MIKE BARAKAT Let us call him an angel. The way he eased us into a halt qualifies him for the honor. Kathleen Sheard manipulates a number of switches and knobs. KATHLEEN SHEARD Contact established with the creature.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: COMMANDER MOSS (Looking at the screen) Sir, do you speak English? CREATURE (On the screen) I speak any language you choose. COMMANDER MOSS Who are you, and why are you stopping us? CREATURE (Laughing) Let us put this question in perspective. Who are you, and what are you doing here? COMMANDER MOSS We are space explorers from the
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 39 - ETERNITY planet Earth. We come in peace, strictly to increase our knowledge. Now, sir, who are you, and why did you stop us? CREATURE You human beings never cease to amaze us. You are actually here. Any way, my identity is irrelevant to your mission. As for the reason I stopped you, it's because you have reached the outer boundary of your universe. You cannot proceed any further; at least not without authorization. COMMANDER MOSS What do you mean "your universe?" How many universes are there? And, how do we secure authorization, to proceed? CREATURE While you remain stationary, I will seek permission for you. COMMANDER MOSS Who issues such authorization? CREATURE This information is again irrelevant to your mission. Please wait here. I should be back shortly with a "yes" or a "no". EXT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: HYPERSPACE Creature's six retractable concorde-type wings spread out, his four power belts fire up, and he darts away into a perfectly black horizon at incomprehensible speed. Camera PANS the space horizon to show the creature flying away from the spacecraft, with the background behind it studded with thousands of stars. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM COMMANDER MOSS Kathleen, please contact MCC and give'em the latest information.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 40 - ETERNITY KATHLEEN SHEARD Yes, sir. She puts on her head set, then fiddles with a number of buttons and switches. Camera ZOOMS IN on a calendar gauge on her desk to show it reading "589,171 BC" and clicking down fast to "133,551 BC", then to "83,657 BC", then to "7,790 BC", to "893 BC", to "38 BC", to "AD 741", to "AD 1985", finally stopping at "AD 2242." Camera ZOOMS AWAY to show Kathleen flipping a switch before talking into her head set. KATHLEEN SHEARD MCC, come in MCC. This is "Eternity." Come in.... Radio STATIC interrupts, then MCC voice. MCC (V.O.) Kathleen, you've kept your promise. Where in the heavens are you? KATHLEEN SHEARD (Laughing) We're awaiting permission to enter...uh...let us call it the second universe. It's a strange sight over here; millions of stars and galaxies between you and us, but total darkness ahead of us.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: We are 26 billion light years from you folks, so focus your telescopes and try to find us. (Laughter) MCC (V.O.) We'll try to do that. Tell me, Kathleen, what permission, and from whom? KATHLEEN SHEARD I'd rather let Commander Moss give you the details. EXT. SPACE "Eternity" is shown stationary in the midst of a sea of stars. A
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 41 - ETERNITY small dot appears on the opposite side, in the black horizon. It is the rose-colored creature approaching at lightning speed. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Main viewscreen shows creature approaching. CREATURE (On screen) Commander, you have authorization to proceed. Crew members cheer. Kathleen Sheard gets busy with her knobs and switches, trying to contact MCC. EXT. SPACE Creature moves to the side, allowing spaceship to proceed. Part of Eternity's engines are shown firing up as it moves past the creature. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Camera ZOOMS IN from a FULL SHOT to show odometer coming to life at "26,030,779,342 LIGHT YEARS". Camera moves on to the speedometer to show it coming to life and speeding upward to "266,342 MILES/SECOND." FULL SHOT - CONTROL ROOM Commander Moss walks over to the computer encyclopedia.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: All crew members are busy carrying out their duties. COMMANDER MOSS (While looking at the computer terminal) The encyclopedia confirms what we discovered so far. There are no stars or planets beyond 26 billion light years. He looks at the main viewscreen as it shows a completely black picture with a hint of faint light around the horizon. RAYMOND CATTON I would certainly agree with that. We are travelling in the midst of absolutely nothing.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY - Screenplay Page 42 - ETERNITY CU ODOMETER Odometer is shown clicking upward from "76,009,120,057 LIGHT YEARS" to "81,700,323,114 LIGHT YEARS". Suddenly, alarm SOUNDS, and RED LIGHTS blink and flash throughout the spaceship. Crew scurries to the control room, starp themselves in, and put on their head sets. CU SPEEDOMETER Speedometer slows down fast from "5,513,040 MILES/SECOND", to "3,230,114 MILES/SECOND", to "95,551 MILES/SECOND." Crew members show the strain of sudden braking, as they frantically manipulate their instruments. Main viewscreen turns rose-colored. CU SPEEDOMETER - as it moves from "2,603 MILES/HOUR", to "608 MILES/HOUR", to "000". The spaceship is eased into a complete halt. The main viewscreen and all small screens in the spaceship are solidly rose-colored. JANE ANDERSON Oh, not again! MIKE BARAKAT It's our friend stopping us again. He sure is fast!
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: COMMANDER MOSS Fire camera satellite. EXT. SPACE Aperture in top of the spaceship opens like a camera shutter, a canon projects out, and launches a camera-carrying satellite to about 1000 feet above the craft. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Main viewscreen flickers, then a helicopter shot appears showing the spaceship dwarfed by EIGHT ANGELIC CREATURES surrounding it in half a circle, with one of them still extending his hand to stop "Eternity."
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: ETERNITY - Screenplay Page 43 - FTFPNITY After manipulating her instruments, Kathleen Sheard establishes contact with the creatures. Eternity's satellite camera zooms in on the highest ranking one, as recognized by his four power belts and six concorde-type wings. Main viewscreen shows a WIDE ANGLE SHOT of some of the creatures. COMMANDER MOSS Peace and greetings, my friends. CREATURE (On the screen) Peace and greetings to you Mr. Moss. You've exhausted the limit of your authorization. COMMANDER MOSS I had no idea our authorization was limited. What is it that caused it to expire? CREATURE (On the screen) You have reached the outer boundary of the second universe. COMMANDER MOSS (Surprised) Second universe? How many universes are there? CREATURE (On the screen) Well, you did come here to learn, didn't you? Mr. Moss, there are seven universes, and we are guardians of the third universe.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: I am afraid you cannot proceed any further. We will be glad to help you turn around and back to Earth. We will even give you a push, although your breeder reactors can take you back and forth indefinitely. SHIRLEY VAN CLEFF What a waste! We've travelled billions of light years, just to learn there is nothing out here. MU-ONE-NINE Remember, even nothing is a significant piece of information.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 44 - ETERNITY Now you know that there are seven universes guarded by strange creatures, that our universe is the smallest and innermost, and that it is the only one where you can find stars and constellations. Let's go back. MIKE BARAKAT There goes Mr. Coward Siamese again. We have five more universes to explore. (Looking at Mu-One-Nine) Do you have a family back on earth or something? COMMANDER MOSS (Speaking to creature on the screen) How can we secure a blanket authorization to explore all seven universes? CREATURE (On the screen) I doubt very much that any authorization can be granted, let alone a blanket authorization. However, just to be equitable with you, let me go try. EXT. HYPERSPACE Helicopter shot shows three of the eight creatures spreading their retractable wings, firing their engines, and darting away. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM COMMANDER MOSS Kathleen, contact MCC to update information. KATHLEEN SHEARD Yes, sir. She starts to manipulate her instruments.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 45 - ETERNITY EXT. HYPERSPACE Helicopter shot shows the five remaining creatures still outside spacecraft. A small dot appears in the horizon; it is one of the creatures returning to "Eternity." INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Approaching creature appears on the main viewscreen, and addresses the crew. CREATURE (On the screen) Earthlings, you are very fortunate indeed. Blanket authorization is granted to proceed. No guardians will stop you anywhere in the seven universes. Not only do you secure this blanket permit, but we will coat your spaceship with a de-energizer shield to protect you from intensifying energy fields. COMMANDER MOSS Thank you, sir. Could you tell us who grants such authorizations? CREATURE (On the screen) Just proceed, Commander, and be thankful. A word of warning though.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: You are approaching Time Zero, beyond which nothing whatsoever is supposed to exist; only the Creator. EXT. HYPERSPACE Helicopter shot shows two of the friendly creatures spraying rose-colored misty material all around the spaceship. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Hyperspace appears on the main viewscreen and the small monitors through a rose-colored hue. Octa-Ohm-R clicks, grinds, and turns his multi-heads. OCTA-OHM-R What happens to us when we reach Time Zero?
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 46 - ETERNITY MU-ONE-NINE (Cowardly) We simply cease to exist. Let's go back. EXT. HYPERSPACE Helicopter shot shows the creatures moving to the sides, allowing the now rose-colored spaceship to proceed. Eternity's engines fire up, and the spacecraft begins to move. CU ODOMETER then SPEEDOMETER Odometer comes to life at "82,080,912,665 LIGHT YEARS". Speedometer picks up momentum, ticking upward from "418,000 MILES/SECOND" to "680,000 MILES/SECOND" as "Eternity" crosses into the third universe. The spaceship jerks as it breaks the light barrier. Kathleen Sheard advances the Time Advance Monitor to AD 2247, and contacts MCC. KATHLEEN SHEARD We are now 90 billion light years from you, and our compressed time dimension reads millions of years.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: So, here I am, a voice from the deep, deep past, speaking to you at the speed of thinking and telling you that we have just entered the third universe. (As she glances at the rose-tinted giant screen) Through rose-colored glasses, I am looking at absolutely nothing. Any special instructions? Radio produces STATIC SOUNDS for a few seconds, then faint MCC voice comes in. MCC (V.O.) Carry on. You are doing fine, just fine. SHIRLEY VAN CLEEF Kathleen, did you inform MCC of the Time Zero warning?
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 47 - ETERNITY KATHLEEN SHEARD Sure did. They don't seem alarmed. MU-ONE-NINE Why should they? They are sitting comfortably on earth, listening to our adventures. MIKE BARAKAT Just think, Mr. Siamese, Octa will be with you all the way. Octa-Ohm-R clicks, grinds, turns his heads, then murmurs. OCTA-OHM-R Big deal. TWO SHOT - Shirley and Ray SHIRLEY VAN CLEEF (Whispering) Hey, Ray, do you think it's wise that we proceed beyond this point? RAYMOND CATTON (Whispering) Frankly, no. We haven't the slightest idea what this Time Zero business means, or how we can handle it. FULL SHOT - CONTROL ROOM With a concerned look, Kathleen Sheard nods to Mike Barakat and the two of them leave the control room. INT. SPACESHIP - HALLWAY. Kathleen Sheard is walking with Mike Barakat past the sign reading "Game Room." They turn left into the dining area. INT. SPACESHIP - DINING ROOM Kathleen and Mike begin to serve themselves coffee. They chat while sitting at the dining table. KATHLEEN SHEARD Can't we possibly talk Commander Moss out of proceeding into Time
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY - Screenplay Page 48 - ETERNITY Zero? MIKE BARAKAT Kathleen, you know as well as I do that Virgil is a veteran intergalactic maniac. He seems to thrive on intrigue and danger. Nothing short of a successful mutiny can change our course. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM COMMANDER MOSS Activate nuclear observatory. Jane Anderson turns knobs, and flips switches of her instruments. Bit-Seventy-Six is busy manipulating his buttons, knobs, and switches. EXT. HYPERSPACE An observatory dome projects on top of the spaceship close to the front, an aperture slides open in the dome, and a giant telescope projects out of it. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Kathleen and Ray walk into the control room and assume their stations. COMMANDER MOSS Aim telescope ahead, and monitor on viewscreen. Jane Anderson, Raymond Catton, and Bit-Seventy-Six get busy with their instruments. Main viewscreen flickers then produces a picture of black sky with faint light at the horizon, and streaks of faint light here and there. Light intensifies as the telescope's picture zooms in. COMMANDER MOSS Zoom in. Full power. Jane Anderson turns a couple of knobs.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 49 - ETERNITY The main viewscreen shows a faint picture of a round object zooming closer and closer until it fills the screen. It is a perfectly round planet with millions of tiny lighted dots. Crew watches almost in shock. COMMANDER MOSS Zoom in, full power, and compute size and distance. Picture on viewscreen continues to zoom in on the planet until half of it fills the picture. A hazy figure of a dome-shaped structure, with a large opening in its top, becomes visible on the planet. Octa-Ohm-R manipulates his instruments, and consults his computer display terminals. OCTA-OHM-R I can't believe the size of this thing. I may be a dumb computer, but I simply can't believe the size. MIKE BARAKAT I am dying of suspense, Octa. Just give us some figure, not your expressions of amazement. OCTA-OHM-R How about a billion times as large as the planet Earth?
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: SHIRLEY VAN CLEFF Are you sure the calculations are correct? OCTA-OHM-R What an insult to an eight-headed master brain, what an insult! The structure you see on that planet, the structure alone is thousands of times larger than the whole planet Earth. MIKE BARAKAT What kind of distance are we talking about? OCTA-OHM-R We're talking about billions of
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY - Screenplay Page 50 - ETERNITY light years. COMMANDER MOSS This is a stunning discovery. Wait till we inform MCC. (Looking at Jane) Zoom away, and scan the total horizon. Jane, Ray, and Bit-Seventy-Six fiddle with their instruments. Picture on the main viewscreen zooms away from the planet, until it looks like a distant object, then swings to the left, panning the horizon. Another planet appears. The crew gasp. Picture on the screen zooms in on the second planet, as it turns rose-colored. COMMANDER MOSS (Overwhelmed) Zoom in, full power, and report size and distance. OCTA-OHM-P This one is almost as big as the other one, at about the same distance. Crew get busy with their instruments. Picture on the viewscreen continues to zoom at the rose-colored planet. Through rose-colored misty atmosphere, picture shows a hint of trees. Kathleen rubs her eyes, and taps her head. KATHLEEN SHEARD Am I looking at trees? JANE ANDERSON It's the Earth again. We made a complete circle. I'll be damned; we've come back to the earth. RAYMOND CATTON Wait a minute. This could be a
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 51 - ETERNITY repeat of the Christopher Columbus adventure. He thought he found India in the west, didn't he? OCTA-OHM-R These are not normal size trees either. These are giant trees. MIKE BARAKAT Oh, I get it. Giant planets. Giant trees. I bet our computers have gone bananas. From a FULL SHOT of the control room, camera ZOOMS IN on the odometer. Odometer reads "209 BILLION LIGHT YEARS". Camera PANS all gauges (Odometer, Speedometer, Calendar) as they suddenly spin backward at high speed, causing LED numerals to become unreadable, then stop with an infinity sign in each one of the gauges. FULL SHOT - CONTROL ROOM All human beings in the control room dematerialize into invisible molecules. The three robots take over. Octa-Ohm-R clicks, grinds, turns his multi-head, then rolls to Commander Moss' station. INT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: SPACESHIP - DINING ROOM All organic materials in the dining room, plants and foods, dematerialize and vanish. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM Octa-Ohm-R is at the commander's station. OCTA-OHM-R I suppose when the creature said that nothing is supposed to exist beyond Time Zero, he meant "nothing organic." Bit-Seventy-six, would you contact MCC and convey the latest? Bit-Seventy-Six rolls over to Kathleen Sheard's desk, and manipulates some knobs and buttons to establish contact with MCC
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 52 - ETERNITY at 2242 AD. BIT-SEVENTY-SIX MCC ... this is Eternity ... MCC Radio produces STATIC NOISE, then responds. MCC (V.O.) Yes, Eternity, where are you? Bit-Seventy-Six raises up three of his nine arms, opens up the four-pronged hand at the tip of each arm to reveal three eyes looking at the main viewscreen. BIT-SEVENTY-SIX I am not sure MCC, but I think we are beyond Time Zero. MCC (V.O.) What makes you think you've crossed Time Zero, and where is Captain Sheard? BIT-SEVENTY-SIX This is how I knew that we've gone beyond Time Zero. The whole crew, and everything organic on board has dematerialized. MCC (V.O.) (Very alarmed) What do you mean "dematerialized?" BIT-SEVENTY-SIX Vanished. disappeared. No one is left, except us, the three inorganic creatures. MCC (V.O.) Is Octa-Ohm-R in command? OCTA-OHM-R Yes, sir. MCC (V.O.) Octa, turn around and come back. OCTA-OHM-R Right away, sir. We're turning around. (Looking at Mu-One-Nine)
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY - Screenplay Page 53 - ETERNITY Mu-One-Nine, activate return. Mu-One-Nine moves to Octa-Ohm-R's original station and manipulates the controls on Octa's desk. MU-ONE-NINE No response, Octa. Nothing is happening. EXT. HYPERSPACE Light begins to intensify at the top of the screen, and ahead of "Eternity". The rose-colored protective shield around "Eternity" slowly disintegrates. The spacecraft slowly melts into the intense light. ************************************************************************ I N T E R M I S S I O N ************************************************************************
segments.label: page - ETERNITY - Screenplay

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 54 - ETERNITY EXT. HYPERSPACE Intense "solid" light dominates the top third of the screen, featuring waves of rainbow colors, and awesome beauty; provokes ecstacy. It is absolutely quiet. A pointed stream of light emanates from the center top, then slowly drifts downward, separating from the light at the top. As the ball of light drifts farther and farther down, it cools down, and the light intensity dims progressively, then a perfect sphere is revealed, spinning slowly. The ANGELS' PLANET is created. It looks like the first giant planet detected by Eternity's telescope before it vanished. A fountain of fire surrounded by intense light issues downward from the center top, accompanied by a low rumble. The mass of fire and its intense halo changes form, breaks up into thousands of small fiery suns, then each sun transforms into a rose-colored light-emitting angelic creature.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: The creatures derive their energy from the intense light at the top of the screen. An angel's rank is recognized by the number of retractable concorde-type wings and the number of power belts. The process is repeated, giving the impression that millions of ANGELS are created; columns upon columns of them are shown flying to their planet. The Angels' Planet becomes dominated by lighted dots representing the angels. Camera ZOOMS IN on the Angels' Planet to show the angels' mansion, which looks from the outside like a giant dome with a large opening in the center top. The cumulative light emanating from the angels' bodies radiates like a band of light out of the dome's aperture. INT. ANGELS' MANSION The majestic dome is lined with angels in every direction as far as the eye can see. The center dais is a raised giant disc of crystal-like material. Scintillating bands of light wave into the dome in perfect coordination with God's voice (same voice as that communicating with Moses earlier). God's voice addresses the assembled angels. GOD'S VOICE I have created you to carry out specific functions in areas where
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 55 - ETERNITY My presence is not necessary, or is utterly devastating. I have given you a mind of your own, and absolute freedom of choice. No one shall serve in My kingdom grudgingly. An ARCHANGEL (MICHAEL) with the outer edges of three wings visible on each side, and four power belts around his body, steps forward. MICHAEL Our Lord, we will always serve You and submit to you, willingly and joyfully. GOD'S VOICE I know you will Michael, but perhaps you will understand if I ask this question: Suppose you could create three types of creatures. One creature would serve you and do everything you ask because you programmed him that way. The second creature possesses a mind of his own and absolute freedom of choice; he may or may not do what you ask him to do.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: The third creature possesses a mind of his own and freedom of choice, but because he loves you and respects you, he would do everything you ask him to do. Which creature would give you the greatest satisfaction? MICHAEL I understand, my Lord. You have granted us absolute freedom, but we choose to serve You willingly and joyfully because we recognize You as absolute sovereign of the universe.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 56 - ETERNITY GOD'S VOICE There shall be no compulsion in My kingdom. EXT. ANGELS' PLANET The angels are shown dispersing. They fly in different directions out of the opening at the top of their dome-shaped mansion. Camera zooms away until the Angels' Planet fades into infinity. EXT. HYPERSPACE The view is dominated by God's intense light at the top of the screen. A mass of light drifts downward into the void, then materializes into a GIANT PLANET surrounded by a rose-colored atmosphere (the new planet to be known as the Paradise Planet). It is similar to the second giant planet viewed by Eternity's nuclear telescope. The atmosphere of the Paradise Planet is similar to the rose-colored shield that surrounded spaceship "Eternity" before it melted into the light.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Camera ZOOMS IN through the rose-colored mist to show the planet covered with extraordinarily beautiful landscape, gardens, and fruit-bearing trees. Camera ZOOMS AWAY through the rose-colored mist until the new planet disappears into infinity. EXT. HYPERSPACE A great mass of light emanates from the light of God, drifting downward. Big bang. SEVEN MISTY PANCAKE-SHAPED SPHERES emerge. Only the innermost universe contains millions of lighted dots. The shape of a hand (God's hand) descends out of the light at the top, and benignly holds the seven spheres as they spin independently. God's hand emanates radiant, luminescent, light. The seven universes are created. INT. ANGELS' MANSION A conference of angels is chaired by A DISTINCTIVE LOOKING ARCHANGEL (SATAN).
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 57 - ETERNITY SATAN I have summoned you here to inform you that God has created seven universes, and we are to take our positions of service throughout the new creation. Those of you who possess three or less wings can travel as far as the outer two universes. They shall serve in the sixth and seventh universes. Those who possess three or four wings shall serve in the third and fourth universes. Five or more wings will enable you to go all the way to the innermost universe, so you can serve in the two innermost universes. EXT. HYPERSPACE With all seven universes spinning independently, the angels are shown scurrying from their planet towards the newly created system. Both the Angels' Planet and the Paradise Planet appear in the background almost as big as all seven universes.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: CLOSE SHOT of Satan shows him leaving the angels' planet, with his six concorde-type wings fully spread, and his four power belts firing full blast. As the camera ZOOMS AWAY, Satan is shown entering the seven universes. He appears like a dot of light trailing a long blue tail streaking across the universes like a falling star, all the way to the innermost universe. EXT. THE SOLAR SYSTEM Camera ZOOMS IN on the innermost universe, then through clusters of stars and galaxies until the familiar Solar System appears. Satan is shown flying into the solar system. He extends his hand and holds the whole planet Earth within his fist. The planet Earth is dwarfed by the awesome size of Satan, as he looks at it, his hand completely surrounding it. Initially, the Earth is shown completely covered with water. In
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 58 - ETERNITY SLOW MOTION and an awesome RUMBLE, the continents emerge out of the water. Satan's hand continues to surround the evolving planet. Africa and the American continents become recognizable because of a crack separating them. The continents drift apart, and the Earth as we know it today appears on the screen rotating. EXT. SPACE Satan retracts his hand, then flies out of the solar system. Camera ZOOMS AWAY to show him traveling across the first two universes. Camera ZOOMS IN on Satan's smiling face, as his innermost thoughts echo out. SATAN (Strictly within his head) I can rule part of this dominion all by myself, and run it perfectly. The echo travels in waves upward as the camera ZOOMS AWAY. The echo continues upward until it disappears into God's intense light that dominates the top third of the screen.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: GOD'S VOICE (Strictly within His thoughts) So you wish to be a god besides Me. Well, Satan, in spite of the awesome power and authority I have bestowed upon you, you are not capable of ruling as a god. There is much more to godhood than you think. However, I will give you a chance to prove yourself. But first, I must expose your supercilious thoughts before all the angels. EXT. HYPERSPACE - GOD'S LIGHT From the intense light at the top, a gigantic ball of intense light drifts down towards the planet shrouded with rose-colored mist (Paradise Planet). The ball of light breaks down into millions of undefined masses of light, then transforms into HUMAN FIGURES.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 59 - ETERNITY Camera speed-scans the newly created human souls. Within each soul, a miniature replica appears at the bottom, hazy and ethereal. While speed-scanning the miniature replicas, some known and unknown faces of human beings are recognized by the camera: Moses, JESUS, Napoleon, GHANDI, Hitler, EINSTEIN, LUCILLE BALL, and JFK. EXT. PARADISE PLANET Millions of human souls, with their bodies appearing within them as miniature replicas, are assembled on their planet as far as the eye can see. The light of God descends close to the Paradise Planet, then God's voice is heard. GOD'S VOICE I have consulted with each and every one of you, and it is your unanimous choice that you shall possess the freedom of choice. Before I send you off to your designated assignment on Earth, I want you to bear witness that I alone am your Lord.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: THE HUMAN SOULS (In a massive echo) We bear witness that you alone are our Lord. GOD'S VOICE Thus, you cannot say on the Day of Judgment that you never heard of this. None of you can plead ignorance. Nor can you say that your parents or teachers influenced your opinions. I have created you with brains, eyes, and ears, and you are responsible for using them. You shall investigate and verify any information you receive from anyone, including me. You shall be born into the planet Earth with this knowledge as a natural instinct within each one of you. You will be absolutely free to choose Me as your Lord, or choose
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 60 - ETERNITY Satan as your lord. While in your earthly bodies, you will not consciously recall any of this. INT. ANGELS' MANSION Angels are assembled inside their mammoth dome-shaped mansion, as far as the eye can see. Archangel Michael is standing on the crystal dais at the center, addressing the angels' conference. MICHAEL I have been instructed to inform you that God will place an infinitesimally small creature on the infinitesimally small planet earth. In their earthly form, the new creation, known as the human being, will be incapable of seeing God, or seeing you. Like us, the human beings will possess absolute freedom to choose God as their god, or choose anyone or anything else as their god. In either case, we are to guard them and serve them throughout their earthly existence. The archangel looks to the right, and addresses a particular angel.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Camera ZOOMS IN on a PARTICULAR ANGEL WITH A DISTINCTIVE FACE (STARIEL). MICHAEL (V.O.) STARIEL, would you go to the planet earth and bring a small mass of earthly material? Since the new creation is to live on Earth, his body must be made of the same ingredients. EXT. HYPERSPACE - ANGELS' MANSION Stariel darts out of the top central aperture of the angels' mansion and is shown projecting his six concorde-type wings. All boosters in his three power belts are fired up. Stariel flies across the seven universes leaving a streak of blue
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 61 - ETERNITY flame behind him. He is shown entering the innermost universe. Through his eyes, the billion galaxies of the innermost universe fly past him in long streaks of light, until the solar system appears ahead. EXT. SOLAR SYSTEM Stariel swoops towards the planet Earth, looking almost as big as the whole planet. While in flight, Stariel's body shrinks to a size that can be accommodated on Earth. EXT. THE PLANET EARTH Stariel lands by a major river such as the Nile or the Mississippi somewhere on Earth. He scoops what looks like two hundred pounds of mud. His six wings project outwards, his power belts fire up, and he takes off. EXT. THE SEVEN UNIVERSES With all seven universes visible, spinning independently, Stariel appears like a luminous dot with a tail of bluish flame, darting upwards across the seven universes. INT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ANGELS' MANSION Through the aperture at the top of the majestic dome, Stariel flies in. Millions of angels are still assembled, with Michael still standing on the crystal dais. Stariel swoops down, and places the mud in front of Michael. The mud appears like a speck of dirt on the dais. With the angels assembled in the round building as far as the eye can see, God's scintillating light waves through the opening in the mansion's ceiling. GOD'S VOICE Michael, ISRAFEL, and Stariel; I want the three of you to shape the mud you brought from Earth according to My specifications. I will give you directions as you go. CLOSE SHOT of the angels' crystal dais shows the clump of mud in the middle. The three archangels (Michael, Israfel, and Stariel) are shown shrinking down to approximately human size.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 63 - ETERNITY They approach the mud on the dais, and shape it into the distinctive body and face of ADAM, the father of all humanity. Once the job is completed, the three angels enlarge again to assume their original size. EXT. PARADISE PLANET The Paradise Planet, shrouded in its protective rose-colored horizon, fills the screen. Camera zooms in through the rosy mist until the millions of human souls become visible at a great distance. With oriental, blonde, and black bodies specifically shown, all human bodies merge together into one giant DNA helix. At the same time, all human souls merge together into one ball of light that surrounds the DNA helix like a light-emitting circle of mist. The light-shrouded DNA helix then flies gracefully out of the Paradise planet and heads for the angels' planet. INT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ANGELS' MANSION Millions of angels are assembled in the mansion as far as the eye can see. The crystal dais is shown with Adam's clay figure supine in its center. The DNA helix, surrounded by its light ball, descends through the top aperture of the dome, and thrusts into Adam's body, bringing him immediately to life. Adam stands up amid the awed murmurs of the angels. Michael comes forward until he stands at the edge of the crystal dais. MICHAEL Standing in the center is God's new creation, the human being. It is my honor to convey to you God's command that we shall all fall prostrate before the new creature, whose name is Adam. Camera speed-scans the millions of angels as they fall prostrate before Adam. Camera makes a double take, showing Satan standing up arrogantly, refusing to bow down. The voice of God echos in scintillating waves of light through the aperture at the top. GOD'S VOICE
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 63 - ETERNITY Satan, what prevents you from bowing before my creation? While still in prostration, MANY ANGELS raise up their heads, look at Satan standing up arrogantly, then gasp at his blasphemy. SATAN (Arrogantly) I am better than he; You created me from energy, and created him from mud. You granted me enough power and authority to make me a god in my own right. The angels gasp again; shocked. GOD'S VOICE Well, Satan, as you know, I have decreed that no one shall serve in My kingdom grudgingly. Therefore, you no longer qualify as a participant in My kingdom. As for your opinion that you qualify as a god, I will indeed make you a god. I hereby grant you an infinitesimal speck of My dominion, the planet Earth, to serve as your testing ground. The descendants of Adam who freely choose you as their god shall be your constituents.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: You better do your best to take care of them, and prove that you qualify as a god. A bubble of light descends from the top opening of the Angels' Mansion, surrounds Adam, then carries him away through the opening. EXT. ANGELS' MANSION The bubble of light carrying Adam comes out of the Angels' Mansion, posses by the camera to show Adam clearly standing inside. The bubble with Adam in it flies gracefully towards the Paradise Planet with its rose-colored atmosphere. The bubble's POV goes through the rose-colored mist, then descends into a beautiful garden.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 64 - ETERNITY EXT. PARADISE PLANET Close shot of Paradise Planet, shrouded in its rose-colored atmosphere, gets closer and closer until it shows Adam strolling amid a beautiful garden. He appears as a giant in the midst of giant trees, with his earthly body appearing as a miniature, hazy and ethereal, replica within the bigger person. An elongated stream of light descends from the sky, surrounds Adam, and renders him still. The light intensifies around Adam until he becomes invisible, then clears up revealing Adam and EVE strolling together. The angel Michael flies in and addresses Adam and Eve. MICHAEL Adam and Eve, I am here to inform you that you may eat from any tree in this Paradise Planet, except this one tree to your left. Adam and Eve look to their left, and see a particular tree, loaded with fruits.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: MICHAEL If you eat from this tree, you break God's law, and you no longer qualify as participants in His kingdom. Also, my Lord wishes to warn you that Satan is your arch enemy; you shall not listen to him. EXT. ANGELS' MANSION Satan darts out of the angels mansion in a huff, leaving through the aperture at the top of the dome, trailing a long bluish flame, and heads for the Paradise Planet. He swoops down to converse with Adam and Eve. INT. PARADISE PLANET While Adam and Eve stroll in Paradise, Satan flies in and talks to them. SATAN I hear that Michael has enjoined you from this tree (pointing at the
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 65 - ETERNITY forbidden tree). I hope you will not fall for his trick. ADAM What trick, Satan? He also alerted us about your vengeful attitude towards us. Maybe I was the direct cause of exposing your supercilious ideas, but it was you who initiated those ideas in the first place. I was simply a tool. SATAN This is precisely how I feel about it. I realize it was not your fault, and I carry no hard feelings towards you. I still believe that all the power and authority bestowed upon me by God qualify me to rule in a dominion of my own. God intends to grant my wish, and I will prove to everyone that I am indeed qualified to be a god. It is all the knowledge that I possess that leads me to warn you of Michael's trick. He does not want you to eat from this tree, lest you rise to his archangelic level. EVE Please leave us alone Satan.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: We are perfectly happy, and we have no reason to doubt Michael's intentions. SATAN As you wish. But before I leave, I want to swear to you by God my Lord, that this tree is in fact the tree of eternity and everlasting sovereignty. I have given you my sincere advice, and now the choice is yours. Satan spreads his six wings, fires up his power belts, and leaves the Paradise Planet, heading for the Angels' Planet. EXT. PARADISE PLANET
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 66 - ETERNITY Adam and Eve are strolling in Paradise. They stand in front of the forbidden tree. ADAM You know, I couldn't help think about Satan's statements. He swore by God that this is the tree of eternity and everlasting sovereignty. EVE We have strict orders from God that we shall not eat from this tree, and I think we should not. ADAM God also gave us freedom of choice, and independent brains. I tend to believe Satan. He wouldn't dare swear by God falsely. Once we eat from this tree, I am convinced, we have nothing to worry about; we attain everlasting sovereignty. Adam and Eve simultaneously pick two fruits from the forbidden tree, and bite into them. Immediately, their bodies shrink with an awful vacuum sound, as their miniature ethereal replicas materialize to sharp detail. They are naked, ashamed, and they try to cover themselves with leaves.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Light intensifies downward from the sky, and they hear the voice of God. GOD'S VOICE Did I not alert you that Satan is your arch enemy? You have listened to Satan instead of Me, and thus, you have chosen him as your god. Consequently, you no longer qualify as participants in my kingdom. ADAM Our Lord, we made a serious mistake indeed by listening to anyone but You. EVE Please forgive us, our Lord; we repent.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 67 - ETERNITY GOD'S VOICE I have forgiven you, and I have decided to give you another chance to re-enter My kingdom. I will place you on the planet earth for a temporary probationary period. Under rigorous conditions of the test, those among you, you and your descendants, who choose me alone as their God will re-enter my kingdom and will enjoy my full protection. They are absolutely guaranteed to be healthy, wealthy, and happy. A bubble of light descends from the sky, surrounds the leaf-draped couple, then whisks them out of the Paradise Planet. EXT. HYPERSPACE With the seven universes, the Angels' Planet, and the Paradise Planet visible, the light bubble carrying Adam and Eve whisks out of the Paradise Planet, zooming by the camera to make Adam and Eve visible, then fades into a tiny lighted dot, streaking across the seven universes like a falling star.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: The dot is seen entering the innermost universe. EXT. THE SOLAR SYSTEM With the solar system in view, the light bubble carrying Adam and Eve heads for the Planet Earth. INT. ANGELS' MANSION Satan is standing on the central crystal dais, addressing the millions of angels assembled in the Angels' mansion. SATAN (Arrogantly) How do you expect me, the mighty Satan, to bow down before an infinitesimal creature made of mud? God has given me enough power to reign as a god in my own right. How many of you know that? How many of you recognize my power and my abilities?
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 68 - ETERNITY A NUMBER OF ANGELS raise their hands indicating their agreement with Satan. A bubble of light descends through the aperture at the top of the angels' dome, surrounds Satan, carries him, and heads for other angels who agreed with him, getting larger and larger as it takes on more of the rebels. Additional bubbles of light come in through the top, and carry all the rebels away. EXT. HYPERSPACE With the seven universes, the Paradise Planet, and the Angels' Planet visible, camera ZOOMS IN on the aperture at the top of the angels' mansion. The light bubbles dart out of the aperture carrying Satan and his supporters. They become visible in the bubbles as they whisk by the camera. The light bubbles head for the seven universes, and travel like falling stars all the way to the innermost universe. EXT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: HYPERSPACE God's scintillating light dominates the top third of the screen. The Angels' Planet, the Paradise Planet, and the seven universes are visible. Camera moves into the seventh universe. There is nothing on the screen, except God's beautiful light at the top. Out of the scintillating light at the top, misty molecules drift downward, then intensify into the shape of spaceship "Eternity," as the craft materializes with the protective rose-colored shield around it. The spaceship fades in. INT. SPACESHIP - CONTROL ROOM The control room, and all crew members of "Eternity" materialize before our eyes. Odometer flips from the infinity sign to "456,000,000,000 LIGHT YEARS." Calendar gauge speeds up backward from infinity and stop at "76,000,000 BC." Speedometer goes from infinity to read "114,000,000 MILES/SECOND."
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 69 - ETERNITY Crew and robots wonder what has happened. COMMANDER MOSS Octa, check the nearest EPIR and report our position. I want to know where in the heavens we are. Kathleen, try to contact MCC at 2242 as usual. Find out if they know anything. BIT-SEVENTY-SIX We probably know more than they. I remember it when you and all organic matter aboard dematerialized. Octa, Mu, and myself took over, and we informed MCC that you fellows had disappeared. COMMANDER MOSS (Looking at Kathleen) They must be worried sick. At least tell them that we're alive and well, and lost in space. Octa-Ohm-R clicks, clanks, turns his multi-heads, and manipulates some buttons and switches on his desk. Kathleen does the same at her desk. OCTA-OHM-R We are exiting the sixth universe into the fifth universe. COMMANDER MOSS At least we're heading in the right direction. EXT. HYPERSPACE With all seven universes visible, camera zooms in on the innermost universe, heads for a group of stars, then brings a GIANT RED PLANET in view.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 70 - ETERNITY INT. SATAN'S MANSION Huge square pillars as far as the eye can see line up SATAN'S awesome MANSION, dwarfing the huge creatures. A square opening at the top is the mansion's entrance/exit. Satan is holding a meeting with his assistants. He stands on a square marble dais addressing the fallen angels. SATAN If we prove to God that I am capable of ruling a dominion of my own, He will accept us back into His kingdom, and grant us a permanent dominion. This is absolutely our most precious chance to prove that we are right, that I am worthy of godhood. The earth belongs to me, and I intend to make it a perfect place for my constituents; a perfect paradise. EXT. EARTH - DAY Camera travels across beautiful areas on Earth, showing serene, peaceful and breath-takingly beautiful scenes from Alaska, Colorado, Switzerland, and so on.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Scenes of joy and happiness are provided through visits to Disneyland, Sea World, the Lippanzer Horses show at the Spanish Riding School of Vienna, the Moscow circus, and the final scenes of the Swan lake Ballet at Carnegie Hall. Slowly, camera shifts to Africa's famine-afflicted Sahil, showing CHILDREN starving and dying. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH With the globe rotating in the center of the screen, camera ZOOMS IN on England. INT. STABLE - DUSK Beautiful HORSES are being taken to their individual box stalls. MEN and WOMEN are brushing the horses and checking on their food supply, then everybody leaves.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 71 - ETERNITY Wall-mounted electric light sparks due to a short, causing fire to start. Fire is spreading towards the stalls. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH From a CLOSE SHOT of the globe, camera zooms in on California. EXT. STREET - DAY Family of THREE (FATHER, MOTHER, AND TEENAGE DAUGHTER) is leaving the house and getting in the family car. The car leaves the garage, and on to the street. INT. AUTOMOBILE - MOVING SHOT - DAY Husband is driving, the wife is in the passenger seat, and the teen age daughter is in the back seat, leaning on the front seat, so her face is in the middle between her parents. DAUGHTER Mr. Eustice was so impressed, he gave me an "A plus." Just think, me getting an "A plus" in algebra. The daughter caresses her father's shoulder lovingly. DAUGHTER I have to thank you again for helping me, Dad. Your old-fashioned algebra is a lot better than the new math.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: Mother looks at her daughter lovingly, then at her husband, then looks at the street ahead and screams. MOTHER My God, what is this man doing? Look out! Look out! EXT. STREET - DAY Helicopter shot shows the family's car moving away from camera. A car is coming from the opposite direction, weaving into the left lane back and forth; obviously, a drunk driver. INT. DRUNK DRIVER'S CAR - MOVING SHOT - DAY
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 72 - ETERNITY THE DRIVER is very drunk, and the car is winding back and forth into the left lane at high speed. Through the windshield, the family's car is visible ahead, and a terrible crash is about to happen. EXT. THE PLANET EARTH The globe is shown in the center of the screen, rotating. Camera ZOOMS IN on Turkey. EXT. STREET - TURKISH VILLAGE - DAY Peaceful Turkish village is shown with CHILDREN playing soccor ball in the street. GIRLS are happily jumping rope, with two of them holding the ends of the rope, twirling it, while three girls go into the jumping area one at a time. Suddenly, the earth rumbles, the ground cracks open, the mud houses collapse, PEOPLE and CHILDREN are screaming and dying; an earthquake is in progress. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH From a CLOSE SHOT of the rotating planet Earth, camera ZOOMS IN on Sydney, Australia. INT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: HOSPITAL - DELIVERY ROOM - DAY A BABY is born. DOCTOR and NURSES are tending a MOTHER delivering a baby. The baby is born with a serious deformity. DOCTOR (Australian accent) I don't know how to tell you this, but MOTHER (Interrupting, in Australian accent) Anything wrong, doctor? DOCTOR (Very sad) The baby's legs are badly under-developed. It will
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 73 - ETERNITY never walk. Mother breaks into hysteric tears. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH From a CLOSE SHOT of the planet Earth, camera ZOOMS in on the Indian sub-continent. EXT. INDIA - GANGES RIVER - DAY Thousands of PILGRIMS are bathing in the river. Suddenly, a violent whirlpool occurs in the vicinity, sucking hundreds of people into the deep part of the river. Many people are drowning. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH Camera zooms in on New York City. EXT. SUBWAY - NEW YORK CITY - DUSK A train is approaching the station. An ELDERLY LADY is coming down the stairs into the subway. YOUNG HOODLUM follows her, strikes her from behind on the right side of her head. The woman falls down, and the young man snatches her purse, then run up the same stairs. PEOPLE IN THE SUBWAY gasp and come towards the woman to check on her. EXT. SPACE - PLANET EARTH Camera zooms in on Germany. EXT.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: STREET - GERMANY - NIGHT Close shot of an apartment building, showing the figures of TWO MEN and TWO WOMEN through a window. Closer shot of the window shows one man with a gun in his hand. The man with the gun appears to order the other man to put his hands up on the wall as he faces it. The mother and her daughter appear frightened.
segments.label: page - ETERNITY

segments.text: ETERNITY Page 74 - ETERNITY The man with the gun walks closer to the man facing the wall, raises his hand to strike the father with the butt of the gun. segments.text: Dua (Supplication) In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. O Allah, by the power of Your might and Your authority, and by the speed of Your victory, and by Your protection for those who seek refuge in Your sanctity, and by Your defense for those who seek shelter in Your protection, I ask You, O Allah, O All-Hearing, O All-Near, O All-Answering, O All-Swift, O All-Mighty, O All-Compeller, O You who are not overcome by the might of the kings, that You do not make the destruction of the kings and the plotters against me fall upon me, and that You do not make the plot of those who plot against me return upon me, and that You do not make me fall into the trap of those who set traps for me. O my Master, make me a fortress against them and a barrier from them.
segments.label: page - Dua (Supplication)

segments.text: O Allah, make their plots return upon them, and make them a sacrifice for me, and unleash upon them the punishment of the Day of Resurrection and tomorrow. O Allah, disperse their gathering, O Allah, diminish their number, O Allah, make the circle of destruction fall upon them, O Allah, send upon them the punishment of the painful, O Allah, remove them from the circle of forbearance and extend their respite, and bind their hearts and cut off their hopes. O Allah, tear them apart with the tearing of Your enemies. Victory for Your prophets and Your messengers and Your allies. O Allah, grant us victory over our enemies. O Allah, do not let the enemies gain power over us, and do not let them see us. Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim, Ha-Mim. The matter has been decreed, and victory has come, so they will not be victorious. Protect us from the evil of what we fear.
segments.label: page - Dua (Supplication)

segments.text: O Allah, grant us all our hopes. O Hope, O Hope, O Hope, O You who grant by Your grace, we ask You for the swift answer. O God of the people, grant us the answer, grant us the answer, O You who granted victory to Abraham over his enemies, O You who granted Joseph to Jacob, O You who removed the affliction of Job, O You who answered the prayer of Zechariah, O You who answered Jonah, son of Amittai, we ask You by the secrets of these prayers that You accept our prayer and grant us what we ask of You. Grant us Your promise which You promised to Your servants, the believers. There is no god but You, glory be to You, indeed I was of the wrongdoers. Hopes have been cut off, and our hopes have been disappointed, and our expectations have failed except in You. If the help of Allah is delayed, and the help of the swift is far, then the help of the swift is near.
segments.label: page - Dua (Supplication)

segments.text: O You who are the help of the helpless, our enemies have gathered and hoped. Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. Accept our prayer, Amen. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. Accept our prayer, Amen. There is no power and no strength except by Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. Accept our prayer, Amen. So the people who committed wrong were cut off. And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
segments.label: page - Dua (Supplication)

segments.text: And may the blessings of Allah be upon our master Muhammad, the illiterate Prophet, and upon his family and companions, and grant them peace. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ اللَّهُمَّ بِسَطْوَةِ جَبَرُوتِ قَهْرِكَ وَبِسُرْعَةِ إِغَاثَةِ نَصْرِكَ وَبِغَيْرَتِكَ لِانْتِهَاكِ حُرُمَاتِكَ وَبِحِمَايَتِكَ لِمَنِ احْتَمَى بِآيَاتِكَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا قَرِيبُ يَا مُجِيبُ يَا سَرِيعُ يَا جَبَّارُ يَا قَهَّارُ يَا مَنْ لَا يُعْجِزُهُ قَهْرُ الْجَبَابِرَةِ وَلَا يَعْظُمُ عَلَيْهِ هَلَاكُ الْمُتَمَرِّدَةِ مِنَ الْمُلُوكِ وَالْأَكَاسِرَةِ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ كَيْدَ مَنْ كَادَنِي فِي نَحْرِهِ وَمَكْرَ مَنْ مَكَرَ بِي عَائِدًا عَلَيْهِ وَحُفْرَةَ مَنْ حَفَرَ لِي وَاقِعًا فِيهَا وَمَنْ نَصَبَ لِي شَبَكَةَ الْخِدَاعِ اجْعَلْهُ يَا سَيِّدِي مُسَاقًا إِلَيْهَا وَمُصَادَافِيهَا وَأَسِيرًا لَدَيْهَا اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ كَهَيْعَصَ اكْفِنَا الْهَمَّ وَاجْعَلْهُمْ لِكُلِّ حَبِيبٍ فِدَاءً وَسَلِّطْ عَلَيْهِمْ عَاجِلَ النِّقْمَةِ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَالْغَدِ. اللَّهُمَّ بَدِّدْ شَمْلَهُمْ، اللَّهُمَّ أَقْلِلْ عَدَدَهُمْ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الدَّائِرَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ، اللَّهُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْعَذَابَ إِلَيْهِمْ، اللَّهُمَّ أَخْرِجْهُمْ عَنْ دَائِرَةِ الْحِلْمِ وَاسْلُبْهُمْ مَدَدَ الْإِمْهَالِ وَغُلَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَارْبِطْ عَلَى قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَا تُبَلِّغْهُمُ الْآمَالَ، اللَّهُمَّ مَزِّقْهُمْ كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ مَزَّقْتَهُ لِأَعْدَائِكَ انْتِصَارًا لِأَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَوْلِيَائِكَ اللَّهُمَّ انْتَصِرْ لِأَحْبَابِكَ عَلَى أَعْدَائِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا تُمَكِّنِ الْأَعْدَاءَ فِينَا وَلَا تُسَلِّطْهُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا حم حم حم حم حم حم حم الْأَمْرُ وَجَاءَ النَّصْرُ فَعَلَيْنَا لَا يُنْصَرُونَ حِمَايَتُكَ جَمَايَتُنَا مِمَّا نَخَافُ، اللَّهُمَّ قِنَا شَرَّ الْأَسْوَاءِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَحَلًّا لِلْبَلْوَاءِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْطِنَا أَمَلَ الرَّجَاءِ وَفَوْقَ الْأَمَلِ يَا هُوَ يَا هُوَ يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ بِفَضْلِهِ لِفَضْلِهِ نَسْأَلُ - نَسْأَلُكَ الْعَجَلَ الْعَجَلَ إِلَهِي الْإِجَابَةَ الْإِجَابَةَ يَا مَنْ أَجَابَ نُوحًا فِي قَوْمِهِ يَا مَنْ نَصَرَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِ يَا مَنْ رَدَّ يُوسُفَ عَلَى يَعْقُوبَ يَا مَنْ كَشَفَ ضُرَّ أَيُّوبَ يَا مَنْ أَجَابَ دَعْوَةَ زَكَرِيَّا يَا مَنْ قَبِلَ تَسْبِيحَ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى نَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْرَارِ أَصْحَابِ هَذِهِ الدَّعَوَاتِ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ مَا بِهِ دَعَوْنَاكَ وَأَنْ تُعْطِيَنَا مَا سَأَلْنَاكَ أَنْجِزْ لَنَا وَعْدَكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ لِعِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ انْقَطَعَتْ آمَالُنَا وَعِزَّتِكَ إِلَّا مِنْكَ وَخَابَ رَجَاؤُنَا وَحَقِّكَ إِلَّا فِيكَ إِنْ أَبْطَأَتْ غَارَةُ الْأَرْحَامِ وَابْتَعَدَتْ فَأَقْرَبُ الشَّيْءِ غَارَةُ اللَّهِ بِإِغَارَةِ اللَّهِ الْجَدِيِّ السَّرِيعَةِ يَا حَلَّ عُقْدَتِنَا يَا غَارَةَ اللَّهِ عَدَتِ الْعَادُونَ وَجَارُوا وَرَجَوْنَا اللَّهَ مُجِيرًا وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ نَصِيرًا حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ اسْتَجِبْ لَنَا آمِينَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ اسْتَجِبْ لَنَا آمِينَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ اسْتَجِبْ لَنَا آمِينَ فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ

segments.text: Notes to Authors Notes to Authors It the policy of this Journal to publish articles in English in all fields of ISLAM provided they are of a high caliber and contribute to the fundamental knowledge of the religion. In keeping with the universal nature of Islam, this journal is not intended to reflect any political, regional, or nationalistic bias. Articles containing unwarranted attacks, direct or implied, against any other religion, sect, belief, or ideology, shall not be accepted for publication. The journal's sole objective is to work within the framework of ISLAM towards a full appreciation of God's message to all humanity. The journal recognizes the sources of Islamic knowledge to be the Qur'an, the Sunna, analogy (Qiyās), consensus (Ijmā'), and personal thought (Ijtihād). However, THE QUR'AN shall be the ultimate reference.
segments.label: page - Notes to Authors

segments.text: Only statements in full agreement with the Qur'an shall represent the journal's official stand. All other statements, or statements subject to various interpretations shall represent only the author's personal viewpoint. Manuscripts submitted for publication should be typed, double spaced. Only one copy is required. All Qur'anic quotations must be accompanied by the number(s) of sura(s), and the number(s) of verse(s). Colons should separate the number of sura from the number of verse(s) (e.g. 17:28-33). A group of verses from the same sura should be separated from each other by commas (e.g. 17:28-33, 51, 60-62). When more than one sura are involved, a semi-colon should separate the different suras (e.g. 17:28-33, 51, 60-62; 23:16; 36:9-11, 19-25, 44). The journal will undertake to add the Arabic text to all Qur'anic translations.
segments.label: page - Notes to Authors

segments.text: The Bible's Preview of Muhammad by Sulaymān Shāhid Mufassir The Bible's Preview of Muhammad Despite the disastrous human interference in the holy writings of the Torah and the Gospel, as admitted by the Bible's publishers, the scriptures still contain a goodly portion of the original truth. So much so that those who truly believe and follow the Bible, even in its present form, will certainly be guided to Islam [2:121]. Those who honestly follow the teachings of Moses and Jesus (may God bestow blessings and peace upon them), even in their current state, will be led to the completion and fulfillment of what their creator expects of them. This has been the experience of many free-minded followers of the Bible. One such example is the author of this article. As a former ordained Christian minister, Sulaymān Shāhid Mufassir recounts the biblical guidance which led him to the light of Islam.
segments.label: page - The Bible's Preview of Muhammad

segments.text: The BIBLE contains a vivid preview of the person and mission of Muhammad (peace be upon him) that is so distinct and unmistakable that many a sincere Jew and Christian was happy to accept him as the prophet when he appeared. But over the subsequent centuries of theological antagonism, preceded and accompanied by the editing, rewriting and dogmatizing of portions of the scriptural record, that written portrait has become obscured as with a thick layer of dust. When the centuries-old encrustations of dogma and sectarian hermeneutics are removed, many well-known, little understood verses of the Bible serve as signposts for the serious scholar. The Role of the Bible Muslims believe that the original Torah and Gospel were revealed by Almighty God.
segments.label: page - The Bible's Preview of Muhammad

segments.text: When Jesus began to call the Jews to return to sincere and devoted service to God, the Torah of Moses had been subjected to serious instances of careless copying and dogmatic editing, but he confirmed in his preaching whatever remained intact of the divine revelation. He said, "Do not suppose that I have come to abolish the Law (Torah) and the prophets; I did not come to abolish, but to complete. I tell you this: so long as heaven and earth endure, not a letter, not a stroke, will disappear from the Law." ISLAM 1394/1974, 1(1): 1-13
segments.label: page - The Bible's Preview of Muhammad

segments.text: THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD until all that must happen has happened"(1). The essence of the Torah was confirmed in the Gospel. Six hundred years after the Gospel, when it had similarly suffered through careless copying and editing, Muhammad resumed the prophetic mission and confirmed whatever had remained of both the Torah and the Gospel. He received from God the clarified book, the Qur'an, which would be protected forever from error and distortion, and which would therefore serve as the protector or the ultimate reference (muhaimin) of all previous revelations(2). The Bible does not now contain the Torah and Gospel as they were divinely revealed. Biblical scholars themselves have recognized the human nature and composition of the book(3).
segments.label: page - THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: However, we may expect to find within its pages some portion of the Torah and the Gospel, although careful study is necessary in order to make the message comprehensible(4). An amazing feature of the Bible, even in its present form, is that it indicates the divine revelation would progress through a number of message-bearers or prophets and be completed finally in one man, one particular prophet whose message would be so comprehensive and whose mission would be so universal that no further prophets would be needed. It is easy for God to speak with distinction of things thousands of years prior to their occurrence, but impossible for man to do so. According to the Old Testament, the faithfulness of Abraham was given special reward by a covenant or promise to bless all mankind through his descendants. His line would be distinguished by divine guidance and prophecy.
segments.label: page - THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: "By Myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son, that in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the seashore... and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because thou hast hearkened to My voice"(5). The Bible is the record, primarily, of God's favor to Abraham's second son Isaac, in whose line came Moses and Jesus, peace be upon them. But what about the first-born of Abraham, Ishmael? The Genesis story about the turning out of Ishmael and his mother, Hagar, the Egyptian servant woman of Sarah, due to Sarah's jealousy in being unable to bear the first son of Abraham, is an early example of Hebrew chauvinism, full of contradictory elements(6).
segments.label: page - THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: In effect, Genesis closes the door on Hagar and Ishmael; from henceforth only Isaac and Sarah matter. But God's promise to Abraham was not biased. When He made the "everlasting covenant" with the family of Abraham, Isaac was not even in the picture. Ishmael was his only son and God declared: "As for Ishmael, I have heard thee; behold I have blessed him... twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation"(7). 2 ISLAM 1394/1974, 1(1) muhaimin
segments.label: page - THE BIBLE'S PREVIEW OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: Double Honor due to Ishmael's Line Sulaymān Shāhid Mufassir Double Honor due to Ishmael's Line The writers of Genesis wrongly attempted to make it appear that Ishmael would receive an inferior blessing because his mother was a servant woman, but Isaac, being the son of the free woman, would inherit the glory of the first-born son. In so doing, they disregarded the clear family laws of the Torah. According to this law, the rights of the first-born son are not invalid due to the social status of his mother. This applied especially in polygamous marriages such as that of Abraham(8). Man's social prejudices do not in any way dictate the favor of God.
segments.label: page - Double Honor due to Ishmael's Line

segments.text: According to the Torah: "If a man has two wives, one loved and the other unloved (i.e., slighted or socially despised due to inferior social status), and both the loved and the unloved have borne him sons, but the first-born is the son of the unloved wife, when he wills his property to his sons, he may not treat as first-born the son of the loved one in disregard of the son of the unloved one who is older. Instead he must accept the first-born, the son of the unloved one, and allot him a double portion of all he possesses; since he is the first fruit of his vigor, the birthright is his due"(9). But the Bible disregards this fair principle and gives throughout the "double portion" of honor to Isaac, the second son and makes it actually appear that the "birthright" is his (Cf. Genesis 17:21: "but My covenant will I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear . . .").
segments.label: page - Double Honor due to Ishmael's Line

segments.text: This makes the "Torah" of the Bible a contradictory law. By right, the double honor and the birthright belong to the line of Ishmael, and the "unloved" social status of his mother detracts from this not at all. Ishmael's descendants came to be known as Arabs, a term which, in Hebrew, meant those who inhabited the 'arabah or desert (10). It is not a coincidence that the twelve sons of Ishmael (Genesis 25:12-16) the one mentioned most prominently is Qaydar (Qedar in Hebrew). In some Bible verses, Qaydar is synonymous with the Arabs in general(11). This is an important indication that the line of Qaydar was marked by God for a unique purpose, to bring forth the one whose life and work would bring "a double portion" of honor to the house of Ishmael. The nature of this twofold honor begins to be revealed in the Old Testament book of Isaiah.
segments.label: page - Double Honor due to Ishmael's Line
