segments.text: 9. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm (A.L.M.): 9. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm (A.L.M.): These three letters occur as initials in six suras. Four of these suras are Meccan and two are Medinan. The four Meccan suras are Al-'Ankabūt (The Spider), Al-Rūm (The Romans) Luqmān (Prophet Luqmān), and Al-Sajda (Prostration). The two Medinan suras are Al-Baqara (The Heifer) and Āli-'Imrān (The 'Imrān Family). The computer printouts of the percentage values, the absolute frequency values, and the average per verse values of Alif Lām Mīm are shown in Tables 49, 50 and 51, respectively. When we look at the percentage list, we note that the six Alif Lām Mīm suras are scattered among the Qur'an's 114 suras. Some kind of combining and averaging of the Alif Lām Mīm sister-suras is clearly required. The average percentage value of Alif Lām Mīm in the six suras is 38.049.
segments.label: page - 9. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm (A.L.M.):

segments.text: As shown in Table 52, 38 suras in the Qur'an contain a higher percentage of Alif Lām Mīm than the average percentage in the six Alif Lām Mīm suras. To compute the overall frequency value of Alif Lām Mīm in these 38 suras, the magnitudes of difference above and or below the average of the six suras were calculated. The results are shown in Table 52. From this table we note that only two Medinan suras exhibit a higher frequency of Alif Lām Mīm than the united six suras. The observation here is that the average overall frequency of the six Alif Lām Mīm suras is SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS, and not to all the Medinan suras. This observation leads to the logical step of checking the 4 Alif Lām Mīm
segments.label: page - 9. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm (A.L.M.):

segments.text: Meccan suras by themselves, and the 2 Medinan suras by themselves. The results for the united and averaged 4 Meccan suras are shown in Table 53. From this table we note that all the suras which contain a higher frequency of Alif Lām Mīm than the Meccan Alif Lām Mīm suras are Medinan suras. These are sura Al-Ḥadīd (Iron), Al-Mumtaḥina (The Test), Al-Nisā’ (Women), Al-Baqara (The Heifer), Āli-‘Imrān (The ‘Imrān Family), Al-Mujādala (The Argument), Al-Aḥzāb (The Allies), Al-Ra’ad (Thunder), Muḥammad, and Al-Jumu‘a (Friday). All these are Medinan suras (see Tables 2 and 3). The only other suras which show a plus sign in the overall frequency value of Alif Lām Mīm (Table 53), are Ibrāhīm (Abraham) and Yūnus (Jonah). These two suras, however, cannot be included in this particular comparison, since they both belong to the Alif Lām Rā group of suras.
segments.label: page

segments.text: They are themselves initialed with Alif and Lām, in common with the Alif Lām Mīm suras being discussed here. Therefore, the mathematical observation pertaining to the Alif Lām Mīm suras is that the averaged four Meccan suras are SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS IN THE OVERALL FREQUENCY OF ALIF LĀM MĪM. We note here that the 4 Meccan suras bearing the Qur'anic initials Alif Lām Mīm had to be treated as if they were one continous sura. Their frequency values of Alif Lām Mīm were grouped together and averaged. We note also that these four suras are recorded in the Qur'an consecutively (29-32), though they were not revealed in consecutive Al-Ḥadīd, Al-Mumtaḥina, Al-Nisā’, Al-Baqara, Āli-‘Imrān, Al-Mujādala, Al-Aḥzāb, Al-Ra’ad, Muḥammad, Al-Jumu‘a, Ibrāhīm, Yūnus, Alif Lām Mīm, Alif Lām Rā
segments.label: page

segments.text: order (see Tables 2 and 3). We shall observe the same phenomenon with the two Alif Lām Mīm suras which were revealed in Medina, namely, Al-Baqara (The Heifer) and Āli-‘Imrān (The ‘Imrān Family). This is an observation of extreme importance and will be discussed in more detail later. The average percentage frequency of Alif Lām Mīm in the two Medinan suras (Al-Baqara and Āli-‘Imrān) is 38.556. When we insert this value in the proper place in Table 49, we find that 30 suras contain a higher percentage of Alif Lām Mīm than the two united suras. However, computation of the overall frequency values, as shown in Table 54, reveals that the two Alif Lām Mīm suras are actually SUPERIOR TO ALL SURAS OF THE QUR'AN. It should be noted that if we treat these two suras separately, we find that the superiority of sura Āli-‘Imrān is surpassed by sura Al-Mā-eda (The Table).
segments.label: page

segments.text: Thus, superiority requires that the two Medinan Alif Lām Mīm suras should be treated as if they were one continuous sura. As mentioned above, these two suras are recorded in the Qur'an consecutively (2 and 3), but they were not revealed in consecutive order (87 and 89). The Qur'anic initials Alif Lām Mīm, therefore, indicate to us that the Alif Lām Mīm suras which are recorded in the Qur'an in consecutive order must be treated as if they were one continuous sura, regardless of their chronological revelation sequence. These Qur'anic initials, therefore, confirm the recorded sequence of suras 140
segments.label: page

segments.text: as we know it today. The importance of this observation will become obvious when we study the Alif Lām Rā suras. We shall see that while the Alif Lām Mīm group confirms the recorded sequence of Qur'an, the Alif Lām Rā group confirms the revelation sequence. 141

segments.text: 10. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Rā (A.L.R.) 10. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Rā (A.L.R.): These letters occur in five suras, Yūnus (Jonah), Hūd (Prophet Hūd), Yūsuf (Joseph), Ibrāhīm (Abraham), and Al-Ḥijr (The Ḥijr Valley). The recorded numbers of these suras are 10, 11, 12, 14, and 15, respectively. Their numbers in the chronological sequence of revelation are 51, 52, 53, 72, and 54, respectively. In the recorded sequence of Qur'an, we note that the sequence is interrupted by sura Al-Ra'ad (Number 13). And, in the chronological sequence of revelation, the order is interrupted by sura Ibrāhīm (number 72). The percentage values of Alif Lām Rā, their absolute frequency values, and their average occurrence per verse throughout the Qur'an are shown in Tables 55, 56, and 57, respectively.
segments.label: page - 10. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Rā (A.L.R.)

segments.text: When we look at the percentage list (Table 55), we note that the five Alif Lām Rā suras are scattered throughout the list. Obviously, they cannot exhibit mathematical superiority with regard to the frequency of Alif Lām Rā on individual basis. Some kind of averaging would be required in order to see consistent, meaningful observations. Thus, the following combinations were studied in detail. 1. All five Alif Lām Rā suras were combined and averaged. i.e., treated as if they were one continuous sura. 2. The four Alif Lām Rā suras which were revealed consecutively were combined and averaged. These suras are Yūnus (Jonah), Hūd, Yūsuf (Joseph), and Al-Ḥijr (The Ḥijr Valley). 148
segments.label: page - 10. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Rā (A.L.R.)

segments.text: 3. Sura Ibrāhīm (Abraham) which was revealed separately from the other Alif Lām Rā suras was studied by itself. 4. The Alif Lām Rā suras which are recorded consecutively in the Qur'an were combined together and averaged. These included two groups. One group consisted of suras Yūnus, Hūd, and Yūsuf, whose recorded numbers are 10, 11, and 12. The other group consisted of suras Ibrāhīm and Al-Ḥijr, whose recorded numbers are 14 and 15. The overall frequency values of the suras which contained higher percentages of Alif Lām Rā were computed as previously detailed, and compared with the various averages of Alif Lām Rā suras. Due to the vast number of calculations and tabulations involved, only the final observations are reported here. The following mathematical phenomena were observed: 1.
segments.label: page

segments.text: When all five Alif Lām Rā suras were treated as if they were one continuous sura, their average was found SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS, EXCEPT AL-ISRĀ' (The Night Journey, no. 17). 2. The same conclusion was obtained when the four consecutively-revealed suras were combined. This meant the exclusion of sura Ibrāhīm, which was revealed some 18 suras after its 4 sister suras. 3. When sura Ibrāhīm was considered by itself, it was also found SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS EXCEPT SURA AL-ISRĀ' (no. 17). with regard to the overall frequency of Alif Lām Rā. 149 سورة إبراهيم، يونس، هود، يوسف، الحجر، الإسراء
segments.label: page

segments.text: 4. When the three suras revealed consecutively, and also recorded consecutively, were combined, their average overall frequency of Alif Lām Rā was found SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS WITHOUT EXCEPTION. 5. When the two suras recorded consecutively, but not revealed consecutively (Ibrāhīm and Al-Ḥijr) were combined, their average overall frequency of Alif Lām Rā was found SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS EXCEPT SURA AL-ISRĀ’. 6. When sura Al-Ḥijr was studied by itself, it showed no superiority in the overall frequency of Alif Lām Rā. These observations need no further explanation. The reader is reminded that all Alif Lām Rā suras are Meccan. The special position of Al-Isrā’ has been explained on page 125.
segments.label: page

segments.text: Here in the Alif Lām Rā group, sura Al-Isrā’ seems to function as a distinguishing factor between the suras which were revealed and also recorded consecutively (observation #4), and the suras which were recorded consecutively but revealed separately (observation no. 1, 2, 3, & 5). The most important observation here is that the Alif Lām Rā suras must be combined according to their revelation sequence, regardless of their recorded sequence. We have seen that the Alif Lām Mīm suras were required to join each other according to their recorded sequence, regardless of their revelation order. This is clarified in Table 58. Therefore, the Qur'anic initials Alif 150
segments.label: page

segments.text: Lām Mīm inform us that the recorded sequence of the Qur'an is the correct, divinely inspired redording sequence. These three letters occur in two Medinan suras which are recorded consecutively, though revealed separately, and in four Meccan suras which are recorded consecutively, though revealed separately (see Table 58). The Medinan group is separated from the Meccan group, and we saw that mathematical superiority is observed only when these two groups are separated, with each group united and averaged. On the other hand, the function of the initials Alif Lām Rā is to inform us that the revelation sequence of the Qur'an is the correct, divinely inspired, revelation sequence. We have seen that sura Al-Ḥijr by itself exhibits no mathematical superiority in the overall frequency of Alif Lām Rā. It had to be combined with its sister suras which preceded it directly in the chronological sequence. As shown in Table 58, in the recorded sequence of Qur'an, sura Al-Ḥijr (no. 15) is separated from its sister suras by sura Al-Ra'ad (no. 13), and sura Ibrāhīm (no. 14).

segments.text: 11. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād (A.L.M.S.): 11. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād (A.L.M.S.): This set of Qur'anic initials occurs in one sura, namely Al-A'rāf (The Purgatory). This sura ranks 7 in the recorded sequence, and 39 in the revelation sequence of Qur'an. The percentage values of Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād, the absolute frequency values, and the average per verse values are shown in Tables 59, 60, and 61, respectively. Computation of the overall frequency of Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād was carried out for all the suras which contain a higher percentage than sura Al-A'rāf. The results are shown in Table 62. Although a relatively large number of suras do have a higher percentage, only four suras are actually higher than sura Al-A'rāf in the overall frequency of Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād.
segments.label: page - 11. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād (A.L.M.S.):

segments.text: These four suras are Al-Nisā' (Women), Al-Baqara (The Heifer), Āli-'Imrān (The 'Imrān Family), and Al-Mā-eda (The Table). All these are Medinan suras. It appears, therefore, that sura Al-A'rāf is mathematically SUPERIOR TO ALL THE MECCAN SURAS in the overall frequency of Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād. We note that sura Al-A'rāf is a Meccan sura which occurs in a predominately Medinan section of the Qur'an. We also note that this Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād sura is a loner with regard to this particular set of initials. Thus, just as the sura was not combined and averaged with any other sura, no combining or averaging of any suras was required to see the superiority of Al-A'rāf over all the Meccan suras. 156 Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād

segments.text: 12. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Rā (A.L.M.R.): 12. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Rā (A.L.M.R.): This set of initials occurs in one sura, namely, Al-Ra'd (Thunder), which ranks 13 in the recorded sequence and 96 in the revelation sequence of Qur'an. The percent occurrence of these letters, their absolute frequency, and their average occurrence per verse throughout the Qur'an are shown in Tables 63, 64, and 65, respectively. When we look at the percentage figures (Table 63), we note that sura Al-Ra'd (Thunder) has the high rank of 84 among the Qur'an's 114 suras. However, when we take a closer look at the suras which contain a higher percentage of Alif Lām Mīm Rā, we observe that all these suras are in fact lower in the overall frequency values.
segments.label: page - 12. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Rā (A.L.M.R.):

segments.text: Using all three values to calculate the magnitudes of difference above and/or below sura Al-Ra'd, we find that ALL the suras with a higher percentage bear a negative sign in front of the net difference as compared to Al-Ra'd (see Table 66). This observation in effect tells us that sura Al-Ra'd is SUPERIOR TO ALL THE SURAS WITHOUT EXCEPTION in the overall frequency of Alif Lām Mīm Rā. We note that this set of initials occurs in a single sura, where no combining/averaging is required. Consequently, no combining/averaging of any suras was required to see the mathematical superiority of sura Al-Ra'd. The reader will note that this has been a consistent observation throughout the study. Whenever the initials occurred in a number of suras, it was required Alif Lām Mīm Rā
segments.label: page - 12. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Alif Lām Mīm Rā (A.L.M.R.):

segments.text: to combine/average all the suras with identical initials. On the other hand, when combining/averaging was not required for the initialed sura, no combining/averaging was required anywhere else. Another worthwhile observation is that the initialed Meccan suras were always superior to ALL Meccan suras, while the initialed Medinan suras were found superior to ALL the suras, Meccan and Medinan. This was observed here in sura Al-Ra‘d with regard to Alif Lām Mīm Rā, and also in the two Medinan suras Al-Baqara and Āli-‘Imrān when we discussed the Alif Lām Mīm initials. The reader recalls that Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād which occur in the Meccan sura Al-A‘rāf were superior in that sura over ALL the Meccan suras, but not all the Medinan suras. The same observation of course holds for the seven Meccan Ḥā Mīm suras, the Meccan Ṭā Hā sura, and the Meccan Alif Lām Mīm suras.
segments.label: page

segments.text: The fact that the superiority of the initialed Meccan suras was limited to the Meccan suras confirms for us the locations of revelation. And the fact that the mathematical superiority of all the initialed Medinan suras covers ALL suras of the Qur’an without exception, informs us that the details of the divine commandments which are provided in the Medinan suras consummate, complement, and perfect the initial commandments in the Meccan suras. 162 Al-Ra‘d, Alif Lām Mīm Rā, Al-Baqara, Āli-‘Imrān, Alif Lām Mīm, Alif Lām Mīm Ṣād, Al-A‘rāf, Ḥā Mīm, Ṭā Hā, Alif Lām Mīm

segments.text: 13. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād (KHY‘AṢ): 13. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād (KHY‘AṢ): This set of initials occurs in one Meccan sura, namely, Maryam (Mary). It ranks 19 in the recorded sequence; 44 in the revelation sequence of Qur'an. There is only one sura which bears one of the initials in common with sura Maryam, and which occurs in consecutive order after Maryam both in the recording and the revelation sequences. This one sura is Ṭā Hā, which ranks 20 in the recorded sequence; 45 in the revelation sequence. The percentage occurrence values of Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād in each sura, the absolute frequency of occurrence values, and the average per verse values are shown in Tables 67, 68, and 69, respectively. When we look at the percentage list, we note that sura Maryam does have a high percentage of the letters Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād.
segments.label: page - 13. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād (KHY‘AṢ):

segments.text: Only 34 suras out of the Qur'an's 114 contain a higher percentage of these initials. However, we note that if we take into consideration the letter Hā which occurs consecutively in suras Maryam and Ṭā Hā, we note that only 20 suras contain a higher percentage of Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād. By combining and averaging the letter Hā only of suras Maryam and Ṭā Hā, then using this average percentage of Hā to calculate the Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād percentage, the resulting value is 21.005. When we insert this value in its proper place in the percentage table, we see that only 20 suras have a higher percentage value. Thus, the overall frequency of Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād was calculated for each of the 34 suras which are Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād (KHY‘AṢ)
segments.label: page - 13. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād (KHY‘AṢ):

segments.text: higher before considering the letter Hā of sura Ṭā Hā and also for the 20 suras which are higher after considering the letter Hā from sura Ṭā Hā. The results are shown in Tables 70 and 71, respectively. We note from Table 70 that nine suras have higher overall frequencies of Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād than sura Maryam. These suras are Yūsuf (Joseph), Al-Zumur (The Throngs), Al-Anfāl (The Spoils), Al-Qaṣaṣ (History), Al-Nūr (The Light), Al-Ḥajj (Pilgrimage), Al-Shūrā (Consensus), Ṭā Hā (Ṭ.H.), and Muḥammad. Since these include Meccan as well as Medinan suras, we conclude that sura Maryam lacks the overall superiority when considered by itself. It appears therefore, that we are unable to ignore the fact that the letter Hā was revealed and recorded consecutively in the two suras Maryam and Ṭā Hā. The initial Hā even occupies the same place in both suras, namely, the second spot.
segments.label: page

segments.text: Very clearly, we are told here that the placement of the letter Hā in these two suras was not accidental. Once again we are shown that each alphabet in the Qur'an was carefully calculated. By looking at Table 71, we note right away that only six suras bear the plus sign, i.e., they are higher than sura Maryam in the overall frequency of KHY‘AṢ. These six suras are Al-Qaṣaṣ, (History), Al-Nūr (The Light), Al-Ḥajj (Pilgrimage), Al-Shūrā (Consensus), Ṭā Hā (Ṭ.H.), and Al-Fat-ḥ (Victory). Thus, each contains a higher overall frequency of the initials Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Ṣād. And we note that three of these suras are Meccan, the other three are Medinan. But we also note that all 168
segments.label: page

segments.text: three Meccan suras are initialed suras. Sura Al-Qasas (History) is initialed with Tā Sīn Mīm and should be combined/averaged with its sister sura. This takes it out of this comparison. Sura Al-Shūrā (Consensus) belongs to the Hā Mīm group and should be combined/averaged with its six sister suras. The remaining Meccan sura is Tā Hā which of course bears the letter Hā in common with sura Maryam. Thus, we see here again that when combining/averaging is required of the initialed suras, the same combining/averaging is required of the suras being compared. The observation to be recorded here is that, when the letter Hā of both Maryam and Tā Hā is taken into consideration, sura Maryam is SUPERIOR TO ALL MECCAN SURAS in the overall frequency of Kāf Hā Yā ‘Ayn Sād. The reader is reminded that both suras Maryam and Tā Hā are Meccan. This observation is consistent with the other initialed Meccan suras as discussed on page 162; a fact that confirms the location of revelation of the Qur'anic chapters. 169 ط س م ح م ط ه ك ه ي ع ص

segments.text: 14. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf (Ḥ.M. ‘A.S.Q.) 14. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf (Ḥ.M. ‘A.S.Q.): This set of initials occurs in one sura, namely, Al-Shūrā (Consensus). It ranks 42 in the recorded sequence; 62 in the revelation sequence of the Qur'an. The first two letters, Ḥā Mīm, form an independent verse. In that respect, sura Al-Shūrā belongs to the Ḥā Mīm group of seven suras. The three letters ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf constitute verse 2 of sura Al-Shūrā. The percentage occurrence of these initials, their absolute frequency in each sura, and their average occurrence in each verse of each sura are listed in Tables 72, 73, and 74, respectively. The reader by now is familiar with the types of computations and the bases for finding out the overall frequency value for a given set of Qur'anic initials.
segments.label: page - 14. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf (Ḥ.M. ‘A.S.Q.)

segments.text: When these computations were carried out for the five letters Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf, it was observed that sura Al-Shūrā exhibits no mathematical superiority. As a matter of fact, 18 suras were found superior to sura Al-Shūrā in the overall frequency of Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf. Fourteen of these suras were Meccan, the other 4 Medinan. Of the 14 superior Meccan suras, 8 were initialed suras, and 6 were regular, non-initialed suras. Therefore, when considered by itself, sura Al-Shūrā cannot claim any mathematical superiority with regard to its own initials. It appears, therefore, that we cannot ignore the sister suras of Al-Shūrā (the other 6 Ḥā Mīm suras). Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf
segments.label: page - 14. THE QUR'ANIC INITIALS Ḥā Mīm ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf (Ḥ.M. ‘A.S.Q.)

segments.text: This lack of mathematical superiority was also observed when sura Al-Shūrā was considered by itself with regard to the initials Ḥā Mīm, and also with regard to the initials ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf. When the average Ḥā Mīm of the seven Ḥā Mīm suras was added to the ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf values of sura Al-Shūrā, the computer data again showed lack of superiority. Finally, the values of ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf in the seven Ḥā Mīm suras were combined together and averaged in the usual manner. The average of ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf was then added to the one Ḥā Mīm of sura Al-Shūrā to represent the Qur’anic initials Ḥā Mīm‘Ayn Sīn Qāf. This is the ONLY combination where mathematical superiority was observed. Results of computing the overall frequency values are shown in Table 75, and the attempted combinations, with their results, are shown in Table 76.
segments.label: page

segments.text: From Table 75, we can see that only 3 suras have the plus sign, indicating their superiority over the Ḥā Mīm-‘Ayn Sīn Qāf average of the seven suras. These 3 superior suras are Hūd (Prophet Hūd), Al-Rūm (The Romans), and Al-Fat-ḥ (Victory). Strikingly, the only other two sets of Qur’anic initials which occur in consecutive suras, namely, Alif Lām Rā and Alif Lām Mīm, are represented here. Thus, sura Hūd represents the Alif Lām Rā group, and sura Al-Rūm represents the Alif Lām Mīm group. After combining these two suras with their respective sister suras, only one sura is left which exhibits superiority over the Ḥā Mīm group with regard to the overall frequency of Ḥā Mīm-‘Ayn Sīn Qāf. This one sura, Al-Fat-ḥ, is a Medinan sura. 176 Ḥā Mīm, ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf, Al-Shūrā, Hūd, Al-Rūm, Al-Fat-ḥ, Alif Lām Rā, Alif Lām Mīm

The reader is reminded here that this is the same conclusion observed for the initials Ḥā Mīm in the seven Ḥā Mīm suras (page 114). Similarly, if we disregard the average per verse values, and rely only on the percentage values and absolute frequency values in our computations, we find that sura Al-Shūrā is SUPERIOR TO ALL SURAS OF THE QUR’AN WITHOUT EXCEPTION with regard to the initials Ḥā Mīm-‘Ayn Sīn Qāf (of course the ‘Ayn Sīn Qāf of the sister Ḥā Mīm suras must be considered as pointed out above). segments.text: Chapter 7: SUMMARY AND CONCLUSION Chapter 7 SUMMARY AND CONCLUSION The Qur'anic initials and the major observations pertaining to them are all listed in Table 77. By glancing through this table, the reader notes that each one of the Qur'anic initials has its own characteristics. Each one serves to reassure man with regard to specific aspects of the Qur'an (such as the sequence of recording, the sequence of revelation, the length of the verses, the length of the suras, the location of revelation, etc.). Thus, all aspects of the Qur'an are proven and confirmed. These aspects include: 1. The Qur'an is the word of God: The Qur'anic initials as a whole have shown us that every word, indeed every letter, in the Qur'an was carefully calculated. The Qur'an itself states this fact very clearly in the first verse of sura Hūd, which incidentally includes the Qur'anic initials Alif Lām Rā.
segments.label: page - Chapter 7: SUMMARY AND CONCLUSION

segments.text: Placement of the Qur'anic initials in their specific locations proves the existence of advance knowledge of the distribution pattern of the alphabet throughout the Qur'an. No one can claim that such advance knowledge is attainable by man; any man. To translate this into a physical, tangible evidence, the computer was asked to calculate the number of manipulations one should master in order to write a mathematically-controlled book such as the Qur'an. The composition of Qur'an involves 114 chapters where 14 alphabet letters were distributed according to specific
segments.label: page - Chapter 7: SUMMARY AND CONCLUSION

segments.text: combinations. According to the well-known mathematical formula, the number of manipulations involved in this case equals 114^14. The computer's answer was that 114^14 = 6.26 x 10^26 is the number of manipulations that must be controlled in order to write a book like the Qur'an. This value, 626,000,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 (626 septillions) is certainly beyond the capacity of any creature, including today's most sophisticated computers. When we look at this number, we can readily appreciate the divine statement in sura Al-Isra' (The Night Journey), verse 88 (Say, if all the humans and all the Jinns banded together in order to produce a like this, they will surely fail Furthermore, this is the number of controlled manipulations for a specific distribution pattern of the alphabet, without placing them in useful sentences.
segments.label: page

segments.text: To place these mathematically distributed alphabetic letters in useful sentences is another complete job. This fact, and the full awareness of the two requirements, is indicated at the beginning of sura Hūd. The first verse in this sura says, "Alif Lām Rā. This is a book whose verses have been perfectly designed THEN ELUCIDATED. It comes from a Wise, Omniscient (God)." Thus, this verse tells us of the two jobs required; the job of distributing the alphabet in a perfectly controlled and designed pattern, AND the job of making from these letters meaningful sentences. The reader can easily visualize the awesomeness of both jobs. 184 قُل لَّئِنِ اجْتَمَعَتِ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَىٰ أَن يَأْتُوا بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ ظَهِيرًا الر ۚ كِتَابٌ أُحْكِمَتْ آيَاتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتْ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ خَبِيرٍ

segments.text: Since the Qur'an is proven to be the word of God, using the ultimate in scientific proof (namely, mathematics), it serves to confirm the miracles of all previous prophets. Thus, the perpetual miracle of Muhammad puts in our hands physical, examinable evidence that Moses did indeed split the sea with his staff. Though we never saw the staff of Moses turn into a snake, we now have physical proof that such a miracle took place indeed. Since every word in the Qur'an is mathematically proven to have come from God, we now know for sure that Jesus Christ did indeed revive the dead. But the possibility that 2 words in this sentence arc repeated in whole book relative to the number of letters which make up the sentence, this possibility is very slim. And the chance that 3 words are repeated in this manner by sheer coincidence is considered impossible. Here we. find all 4 words of the first Qur'anic verse mentioned in the whole Qur'an multiples of 19, the number of letters which make up the verse. And this could never happen by coincidence. segments.text: This is of course what all the non-Muslims claim. For if they thought or believed that the Qur'an is God's message to them, they would have become Muslims. segments.text: You see, when you recite, "Qul Huwallahu Ahad" (قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ) the word ALLAH here is counted and perfectly placed in this specific position. John 16:13 Obeying the Messenger is obeying God. (Quran 4:80) "and he (Muhammad) does not speak on his own initiative". (53:3) وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
segments.label: page - WHEN DELIVERING GOD'S MESSAGES, messengers do not speak on their own initiative.

segments.text: MUHAMMAD REPRESENTED BY QURAN ALONE MUHAMMAD REPRESENTED BY QURAN ALONE "We sent down to you THIS BOOK truthfully, confirming all previous scriptures, and superseding them. You shall judge among them according to what is sent down from God (this book), and do not follow their wishes if they deviate from the truth. ... You shall judge among them according to what is sent down from God (this book); do not follow their wishes, and BEWARE lest they divert you from that which is sent down to you from God (this book). ... Would they seek the laws of ignorance?
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD REPRESENTED BY QURAN ALONE

segments.text: WHO IS BETTER THAN GOD as a law-maker, for those who sincerely believe?" (5: 48-50) وَأَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَاءَكَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَلَكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِي مَا آتَاكُمْ فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْرَاتِ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ وَأَنِ احْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَاحْذَرْهُمْ أَن يَفْتِنُوكَ عَن بَعْضِ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَن يُصِيبَهُم بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ لَفَاسِقُونَ أَفَحُكْمَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْمًا لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD REPRESENTED BY QURAN ALONE

segments.text: MUHAMMAD FORBIDDEN FROM UTTERING ANY RELIGIOUS INSTRUCTIONS OTHER THAN QURAN - 4 - MUHAMMAD FORBIDDEN FROM UTTERING ANY RELIGIOUS INSTRUCTIONS OTHER THAN QURAN "This (Quran) is the utterance of an honorable messenger. It is not the utterance of a poet; rarely do you believe. Nor is it the utterance of a soothsayer; rarely do you take heed. A revelation from the Lord of the universe. HAD HE EVER UTTERED ANY OTHER RELIGIOUS UTTERANCES (attributed to us), we would have punished him severely, then we would have stopped the revelation to him (fired him) None of you could have protected him against us." (69:40-47) These very clear verses teach us that Muhammad was forbidden from uttering any religious teachings beside Quran. The strength of the Arabic text cannot be fully translated to English.
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD FORBIDDEN FROM UTTERING ANY RELIGIOUS INSTRUCTIONS OTHER THAN QURAN

segments.text: But the powerful expressions leave no doubt whatsoever that the Prophet's sole function was to "DELIVER" Quran, the whole Quran, and NOTHING but Quran. إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ (40) وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تُؤْمِنُونَ (41) وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَا تَذَكَّرُونَ (42) تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ (43) وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ (44) لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ (45) ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ (46) فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ (47)
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD FORBIDDEN FROM UTTERING ANY RELIGIOUS INSTRUCTIONS OTHER THAN QURAN

segments.text: - 5 - MUHAMMAD ORDERED NEVER TO DEVIATE FROM QURAN. DEVIATION MEANT SEVERE PUNISHMENT "They almost diverted you (O Muhammad) from our revelations to you; they wanted you to fabricate something else to consider you a friend. If it were not that we strengthened you, you almost leaned towards them a little bit. Had you done it, we would have doubled the punishment for you in this life, and after death; no one could have protected you against us." (17: 73-75) In setting the example for us, the Prophet was ordered to adhere strictly to God's revelations to Him, specifically identified in 5:48-50 (Page 3) as Quran.
segments.label: page

segments.text: The slightest deviation from Quran (see verse 74 above) incurs severe retribution. وَإِن كَادُوا لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ الَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِيَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُ وَإِذًا لَّاتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًا ۝ وَلَوْلَا أَن ثَبَّتْنَاكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا قَلِيلًا ۝ إِذًا لَّأَذَقْنَاكَ ضِعْفَ الْحَيَاةِ وَضِعْفَ الْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًا ۝
segments.label: page

segments.text: - 6 - Muhammad ordered to deliver QURAN ALONE, without the least alteration, and never to "fabricate" anything else: "When our verses are recited for them, those who do not expect to meet us would say, 'Bring a Quran other than this or change it.' Say (O Muhammad), 'I cannot change it on my own initiative. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the retribution of a terrible day... Who is more wicked than one who invents lies about God or rejects His revelations? The guilty never succeed.
segments.label: page

segments.text: Yet, they idolize beside God those who possess no power to harm them or benefit them, and say, 'These are our intercessors with God.' ... such is idol-worship." (10: 15-18) سورة يونس وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ ۙ قَالَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَاءَنَا ائْتِ بِقُرْآنٍ غَيْرِ هَٰذَا أَوْ بَدِّلْهُ ۚ قُلْ مَا يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أُبَدِّلَهُ مِن تِلْقَاءِ نَفْسِي ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ ۖ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ ۝ قُل لَّوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا أَدْرَاكُم بِهِ ۖ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ ۝ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ لَا يُفْلِحُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝ وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّئُونَ اللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝
segments.label: page

segments.text: ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE - 7 - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE Our Almighty Creator commands that QURAN, specifically QURAN, SHALL BE THE ONLY SOURCE of religious teachings. Furthermore, we are told that THE ACCEPTANCE OF ANY OTHER SOURCES for religious guidance equals the setting up of OTHER GODS BESIDE GOD: 'Say (O Muhammad), 'Whose testimony is greater?' Say, 'God is the witness between me and you that THIS QURAN was given to me to preach it to you, and to whomever it reaches.' However, you certainly bear witness that you set up other gods beside God (by upholding other sources beside Quran).
segments.label: page - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE

segments.text: Say, 'I will never do what you are doing; I disown your idol-worship.' ( 6: 19 ) This profound verse, which happens to be verse [ 19 ] of Sura 6, enjoins the believers from upholding or following ANY OTHER SOURCE BESIDE QURAN, and that doing this is equivalent to the setting up of other gods beside God. قُلْ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً ۖ قُلِ اللَّهُ ۖ شَهِيدٌ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ وَأُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ لِأُنذِرَكُم بِهِ وَمَن بَلَغَ ۚ أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنَّ مَعَ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً أُخْرَىٰ ۚ قُل لَّا أَشْهَدُ ۚ قُلْ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَإِنَّنِي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
segments.label: page - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE

segments.text: ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE - 8 - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE In the strictest possible language, we are commanded to uphold Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but Quran. Repeatedly, we are commanded to uphold Quran as the ONLY SOURCE OF RELIGIOUS GUIDANCE. Again and again, we are reminded that the following of ANY OTHER SOURCE BESIDE QURAN EQUALS THE SETTING UP OF OTHER GODS BESIDE GOD. Verses 22 through 38 of Sura 17 represent some of the most important commandments in Quran. Immediately following these verses we find the verse shown below: (17: 39) "This is some of the wisdom revealed to you (in this Quran), and YOU SHALL NOT SET UP ANY OTHER GOD BESIDE GOD (by following any other source beside Quran). Otherwise, you will be thrown into hell, blamed and debased.
segments.label: page - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE

segments.text: Despite all these clear commandments and extremely strict injunctions, why do the followers of Hadith & Sunna fail to uphold the Quran alone? See the answer on Page 9. ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّا أَوْحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ الْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًا مَّدْحُورًا
segments.label: page - ONE GOD / ONE SOURCE

segments.text: QURAN: AN EXTRAORDINARY BOOK - 9 - QURAN: AN EXTRAORDINARY BOOK Despite the clear commandments, why do the followers of Hadith & Sunna fail to uphold Quran ALONE? The answer is provided in the same Sura following the commandment shown on Page 8. Verses 45 and 46 of Sura 17 inform us that those who refuse to believe God and heed His commandment to uphold Quran ALONE are deliberately isolated from Quran. These two crucial verses are shown below: "When you read the Quran, we place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier. And we place shields on their hearts, to prevent them from understanding Quran, and deafness in their ears.
segments.label: page - QURAN: AN EXTRAORDINARY BOOK

segments.text: Consequently, when you preach your Lord IN THE QURAN ALONE they run away in aversion." (17:45-46) WHAT MORE CAN WE SAY ?? وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ حِجَابًا مَّسْتُورًا ۝ وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًا ۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَحْدَهُ وَلَّوْا عَلَىٰ أَدْبَارِهِمْ نُفُورًا ۝
segments.label: page - QURAN: AN EXTRAORDINARY BOOK

segments.text: - 10 - DO YOU BELIEVE GOD OR NOT? God says that Quran is COMPLETE, PERFECT, & FULLY DETAILED, and that you shall not seek any other source: "We did not leave anything out of this book, then all will be gathered before their Lord (for judgment). Those who do not believe our verses are deaf and dumb; in total darkness.
segments.label: page

segments.text: God sends astray whomever He wills, and directs whomever He wills in the right path." (6: 38-39) "Shall I seek other than God as a source of law, when He revealed THIS BOOK FULLY DETAILED? (6: 114) (6: 115) "The word of your Lord is COMPLETE in truth & justice" مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِي الْكِتَابِ مِن شَيْءٍ ۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يُحْشَرُونَ ﴿٣٨﴾ وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا صُمٌّ وَبُكْمٌ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ ۗ مَن يَشَإِ اللَّهُ يُضْلِلْهُ وَمَن يَشَأْ يَجْعَلْهُ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ﴿٣٩﴾ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْتَغِي حَكَمًا وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكِتَابَ مُفَصَّلًا وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا
segments.label: page

segments.text: THE CONSEQUENCE OF NOT BELIEVING GOD - 11 - THE CONSEQUENCE OF NOT BELIEVING GOD As shown on Page 10, God says that Quran is COMPLETE, PERFECT, AND FULLY DETAILED. His commandments are clear and strict that YOU SHALL NOT UPHOLD ANYTHING ELSE BESIDE QURAN as a source of religious guidance (see pages 7 & 8). Now, you have the total freedom to decide to believe God, or to reject His statements, and ignore His commandments, provided you are willing (or unwilling) to accept the consequences. You agree, no doubt, that refusing to believe God is a very serious offense. Just how serious is expressed in verse 40 of Sura 7: ( 7: 40 ) "Surely, those who do not believe our revelations, and are too arrogant to heed them, the gates of the sky never open for them, nor will they ever enter Paradise until the camel passes through the needle's eye.
segments.label: page - THE CONSEQUENCE OF NOT BELIEVING GOD

segments.text: We thus requite the guilty." Thus, it is A PHYSICAL IMPOSSIBILITY for those who refuse to believe God to enter Paradise. إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّىٰ يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ
segments.label: page - THE CONSEQUENCE OF NOT BELIEVING GOD

segments.text: IMPORTANT CRITERION OF DIVINE REVELATION - 12 - IMPORTANT CRITERION OF DIVINE REVELATION Some people claim that the "Hadith & Sunna" are divine revelations. Obviously, they are not aware that the criterion of divine revelation is PERFECT PRESERVATION. Since the so-called hadith & sunna of the Prophet have been vastly corrupted, they can never meet the criterion of divine revelation. It is an acknowledged fact that the vast majority of Hadiths are false fabrications. "We have sent down the revelation, and we will surely preserve it." (15:9) "Indeed, this is an honorable scripture. Falsehood could never enter it in the past, present, or future; a revelation from the most wise, the most praised." (41:41-42) The blasphemy is evident when they claim that Hadith and Sunna are divine revelations. Do they not realize that God Almighty is capable of preserving His revelations? إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ وَإِنَّهُ لَكِتَابٌ عَزِيزٌ لَا يَأْتِيهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَلَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ حَكِيمٍ حَمِيدٍ (فصلت)
segments.label: page - IMPORTANT CRITERION OF DIVINE REVELATION

segments.text: - 13 - HADITH & SUNNA = 100% CONJECTURE Although God declares that Quran is FULLY DETAILED, & shall be the only source, the majority of Muslims have been duped into following the conjecture known as Hadith & Sunna. While Quran is proven by PHYSICAL EVIDENCE to be the authentic and unaltered word of God (see the book, "QURAN: VISUAL PRESENTATION OF THE MIRACLE"), Hadith and Sunna are unanimously recognized as conjecture. ( 6: 114-116 ) "Shall I seek OTHER THAN GOD as a source of law, when He has revealed THIS BOOK FULLY DETAILED? ..... The word of your Lord is COMPLETE, in truth and justice. Nothing shall abrogate His words; He is the hearer, the omniscient. Yet, if you obey the majority of people, they will take you away from the path of God.
segments.label: page

segments.text: That is because they follow CONJECTURE, and they fail to think." "They insist upon following conjecture, when the guidance is given to them herein from their Lord." ( 53: 23 ) أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ أَبْتَغِي حَكَمًا وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ إِلَيْكُمُ الْكِتَابَ مُفَصَّلًا وَالَّذِينَ آتَيْنَاهُمُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ مُنَزَّلٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ (114) وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدْقًا وَعَدْلًا لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِهِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ (115) وَإِن تُطِعْ أَكْثَرَ مَن فِي الْأَرْضِ يُضِلُّوكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ (116) إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنفُسُ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ
segments.label: page

segments.text: OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED - 14 - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED Obeying the messenger is absolute only as far as the Quranic revelations are concerned. Obeying the messenger is in upholding Quran, the whole Quran, and nothing but Quran. Obedience is strictly ON CONDITION THAT the source is God through the messenger, and not the messenger who is no more than a human being, subject to errors.
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: As shown in the verse below, the messenger as a man is to be obeyed ONLY if he is right: (60: 12) "O prophet, if the believing women come to you and pledge that they will not idolize anything beside God, nor steal, nor commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor produce any falsehood, nor disobey you WHEN YOU ARE RIGHT, you shall accept their pledge, and ask God to forgive them." Thus, the condition is evident that Muhammad the man, unlike Muhammad the messenger, shall be obeyed ONLY IF HE IS RIGHT. يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَىٰ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ وَلَا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتَانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ ۙ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED - 15 - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED The Quran emphasizes that obedience is absolute when the source is God, while the personal opinion of the messenger may be detrimental to him and/or to those who follow his personal opinions: "Anything good that happens to you (O Muhammad) is from God. And anything bad that happens to you is from you. We have sent you as a messenger to the people, and God suffices as a witness. Whoever obeys the messenger is obeying God. As for those who turn away, we did not send you as their guardian." (4: 79-80) Thus, the personal opinion of Muhammad may be bad, and may cause bad things to happen. On the other hand, Muhammad the messenger utters THE WORDS OF GOD, i.e., the Quran, and must be obeyed absolutely.
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: For whoever obeys the messenger is obeying God, and we are to obey the commandments of God, not the commandments of men. مَّا أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَمَا أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٍ فَمِن نَّفْسِكَ وَأَرْسَلْنَاكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولًا وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا مَّن يُطِعِ الرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ وَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED - 16 - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED The Quran gives numerous examples that we must obey what Muhammad uttered as a messenger of God, and NOT NECESSARILY what he uttered as a man. As a messenger, he uttered Quran, and nothing but Quran. Furthermore, the Quran teaches that Muhammad the man actually committed serious errors. Thus, in the verse shown below we see that God wished to establish a law whereby a man can marry the divorced wife of his adopted son. Muhammad was to be our example. However, this was contrary to the traditions of Arabia, and the Prophet actually "feared the people instead of fearing God." (33: 37) "You said to the one blessed by God and blessed by you, 'Do not divorce your wife, and observe God.' Thus, you hid in yourself what God wanted to declare, and you feared the people when God is the one you should fear.
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: Then, when Zeid (Muhammad's adopted son) finally divorced her, we had you marry her. This was done to show that the believing men are allowed to marry the divorced wives of their adopted sons. The commands of God shall be carried out." وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَاهُ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED - 17 - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED One complete Sura illustrates the fact that we are to obey Muhammad ONLY in his Quranic utterances, and NOT in his personal utterances or personal behavior. This rules out the so-called "Hadith" and the so-called "Sunna" as legitimate sources of religious guidance. The Sura is entitled " 'Abasa = He Frowned", and narrates an incident where Muhammad ignored a poor blind man, and gave his full attention to a rich man: "He (Muhammad) frowned and turned away, when the blind man came to him. How do you know; he may be saved? Or, he may heed the message and benefit by such heeding. As for the rich man, you (Muhammad) gave him your attention. Even though you cannot guarantee his salvation. But the one who came to you seeking salvation, and sincerely reverent, you disregarded him.
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: Indeed, THIS IS A REMINDER, for those who choose to remember. (80: 1-12)" بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ۝ أَن جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَىٰ ۝ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ ۝ أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ ۝ أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ ۝ فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ ۝ وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ ۝ وَأَمَّا مَن جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ ۝ وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ ۝ فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ ۝ كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ ۝ فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ ۝
segments.label: page - OBEYING THE MESSENGER IS CONDITIONED

segments.text: THE IDOLIZATION OF MUHAMMAD - 18 - THE IDOLIZATION OF MUHAMMAD Refusing to believe God in His repeated assertions that the QURAN IS COMPLETE, PERFECT, & SHALL BE THE ONLY SOURCE of religious guidance, and following the conjecture known as Hadith & Sunna constitutes deification of the prophet Muhammad against his will. "Say (O Muhammad), 'If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would have run out before my Lord runs out of words, even if we supplied twice as much ink.' Say (O Muhammad), 'I am no more than a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is ONE GOD.
segments.label: page - THE IDOLIZATION OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: Thus, anyone who looks forward to meeting his Lord shall lead a righteous life, and NEVER SET UP ANY IDOLS beside his Lord.'" (18: 109-110) These verses clearly inform us that God does not suffer from shortage of words; that He gave us ALL THE WORDS we need in this Quran, and that we should not seek the words of Muhammad, or anyone else, and that Muhammad is a man like other men; he should not be idolized (see end of verse). قُل لَّوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَادًا لِّكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِ مَدَدًا ۝ قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو لِقَاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا ۝
segments.label: page - THE IDOLIZATION OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: QURAN: YOU SHALL NOT IDOLIZE MUHAMMAD - 19 - QURAN: YOU SHALL NOT IDOLIZE MUHAMMAD There are only two verses in Quran that describe the prophet Muhammad as "no more than a human being like you." IS IT COINCIDENCE THAT BOTH VERSES FORBID IDOLATRY AT THE END OF EACH VERSE ?? The first verse is shown on the previous page, and the second verse is shown below: ( سورة فصلت ) "Say (O Muhammad), 'I am no more than a human being like you. It has been revealed to me that your God is ONE GOD. Therefore, you shall observe Him ALONE, ask His forgiveness, AND WOE TO THE IDOL-WORSHIPPERS.'" (41:6) The true believers believe their Lord in His statements that QURAN IS COMPLETE, PERFECT, FULLY DETAILED, AND SHALL BE THE SOLE SOURCE OF RELIGIOUS GUIDANCE. Only the idol-worshippers will seek other than Quran. Following "Hadith & Sunna" is idolization of the prophet Muhammad against his will. قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِيمُوا إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ۗ وَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِينَ
segments.label: page - QURAN: YOU SHALL NOT IDOLIZE MUHAMMAD

segments.text: THE ABUSE OF QURAN - 20 - THE ABUSE OF QURAN "God and His angels encourage the prophet. O you who believe, you too shall encourage him, and support him completely."(33: 56) This is by far the most abused verse in the whole Quran. Through satanic distortions, ignorance, and idol-worship, this verse causes millions of Muslims to glorify the prophet against his will, instead of glorifying God. People who sing the praises of this particular verse day and night are obviously ignorant of two important facts: (1) The word "Naby = prophet = نبي" when referring to the prophet Muhammad ALWAYS refers to him when he was alive; not after his death. (2) In the same Sura, and 13 verses ahead of this verse, we find that God and His angels do the same honoring for ALL THE BELIEVERS.
segments.label: page - THE ABUSE OF QURAN

segments.text: "God and His angels encourage the believers, to take them out of darkness into the light." (33: 43) إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلَائِكَتُهُ لِيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ
segments.label: page - THE ABUSE OF QURAN

segments.text: THE ABUSE OF QURAN 21 THE ABUSE OF QURAN Verse 103 of Sura 9 further clarifies the meaning of the words "SSALLOO" and "YUSSALLEE." In this verse, we see that the Prophet is commanded to "YUSSALLEE" for the believers, just as they are asked to do for him in verse 56 of Sura 33 (see Page 20). (9: 103) "Take (O Muhammad) a portion of their money for charity, in order to purify them and sanctify them, and encourage them (SSALLEE 'ALAYHIM) for your encouragement is a consolation for them. God is hearer, omniscient."(9: 103). Thus, the true meaning of this expression is "encourage," and NOT "praise day and night" as those who abuse the Quran have indicated. SUMMARY 1. God and His angels encourage the believers, to take them out of darkness into the light (33: 43). 2. God and His angels encourage the Prophet during his life to keep him on the right path (33: 56). 3. The believers are asked to support the Prophet during his life (33: 56), and the Prophet does the same for the believers (9: 103). خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
segments.label: page - THE ABUSE OF QURAN

segments.text: THE ABUSE OF QURAN - 22 - THE ABUSE OF QURAN "In the messenger of God, you have a good example; a good example for those who are seeking God and the Last day, and commemorate God frequently." (33:21) Satan used this verse to claim a special status for the idolization of Muhammad, and to convince the people of the necessity of Sunna (traditions) of the prophet. There is no doubt that the prophet Muhammad is our best example. And his example is set by upholding Quran, and nothing but Quran. Obviously, those who fell in Satan's trap are ignorant of the fact that ABRAHAM IS DESCRIBED IN QURAN IN THE SAME WORDS; word for word.
segments.label: page - THE ABUSE OF QURAN

segments.text: "In Abraham and those who believed with him, you have a good example; for those who are seeking God and the Last day." (60: 4, 6) لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُو اللَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ
segments.label: page - THE ABUSE OF QURAN

segments.text: DOES GOD HATE MUHAMMAD ??? - 23 - DOES GOD HATE MUHAMMAD ??? Of course not. But when you repeat the same things that God says about Muhammad in Quran, they accuse you of hating Muhammad. Similarly, when you tell the Christians that Jesus is a human being and a messenger of God, they accuse you of hating Jesus. MUHAMMAD CANNOT GUIDE ANYONE (28: 56) "You (Muhammad) cannot guide even the ones you love. God is the one who guides whomever He wills, for He knows best those who deserve the guidance." (28: 56) The sole function of the prophet was to deliver Quran without any alteration, addition, reduction, or explanation. Please see pages 29-35. إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ ( سورة القصص )
segments.label: page - DOES GOD HATE MUHAMMAD ???

segments.text: THE TRUE LOVE OF MUHAMMAD - 24 - THE TRUE LOVE OF MUHAMMAD The true love of Jesus is to recognize him as a human and a messenger of God. The Christians love Jesus so much, yet he disowns them on the Day of Judgment (Matthews 7: 23 and Quran 5: 116). The true love of Muhammad is to recognize him as a human and to follow his teachings, i.e., UPHOLD QURAN AND NOTHING BUT QURAN. Those who follow "Hadith & Sunna" are named as Muhammad's enemies, and Muhammad disowns them on the Day of Judgment as we see below: (On the day of judgment) the messenger will say, 'My Lord; my people have deserted THIS QURAN.' We thus set up against every prophet enemies from among the guilty.
segments.label: page - THE TRUE LOVE OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: Your LORD SUFFICES AS A GUIDE AND SUPPORTER." (25: 30-31) Please note the "word for word" similarity between verse 31 above, and verse 112 of Sura 6 which deals specifically with "Hadith." God is the one who created you; God is the one who provides for you; God is the one who terminates your life; God is the one who resurrects you; God is the one who calls you to account. Muhammad does none of these things (see 30: 40). وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ وَكَفَى بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
segments.label: page - THE TRUE LOVE OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE - 25 - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE (46: 9) "Say (O Muhammad), 'I do not bring anything new that is different from any other messenger. I have no idea what may happen to me, or to you. I simply follow what is revealed to me. I am no more than a manifest warner.'" "Say (O Muhammad), 'I possess no power to benefit or harm even myself, except in accordance with God's will. (Nor do I know the future); had I known the future, I would have increased my wealth, and no harm would have afflicted me.
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE

segments.text: I am no more than a warner, as well as bearer of good news for those who believe.'" (7: 188) قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ قُل لَّا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي نَفْعًا وَلَا ضَرًّا إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْ كُنتُ أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ لَاسْتَكْثَرْتُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَمَا مَسَّنِيَ السُّوءُ ۚ إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ وَبَشِيرٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE

segments.text: MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE - 26 - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE Yet, hundreds of "Hadiths" narrate future events that have nothing to do with Quran, and represent personal prediction. One of the most prominent "Hadiths" is shown below: "You shall uphold my Sunna (traditions), and the Sunna of the 'guided Khalifas' (Al-Khulafaa' Al-Rashideen) who will come after me." It should be noted that the expression "Al-Khulafaa' Al-Rashideen" did not appear in Arabic literature until 200 years after the prophet; it is a modern expression. How did the prophet know that there will be "Khulafaa'" who will succeed him, and how did he know that they will be called "Al-Khulafaa' Al-Rashideen"? The expression "Al-Khulafaa' Al-Rashideen" refers specifically to the four Khalifas: Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman, and Ali. It was not known for two centuries after the prophet. عليكم بسنتى وسنة الخلفاء الراشدين من بعدى (حديث صحيح)
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT KNOW THE FUTURE

segments.text: THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION - 27 - THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION Intercession is one of Satan's most effective tricks to dupe the people into idolizing their prophets and/or saints. Although the Quran repeatedly states that there will be no intercession on the day of judgment, many Muslims were duped, through "Hadith & Sunna" into idolizing the prophet Muhammad against his will, and inventing the concept of INTERCESSION (Shafaa'ah): "Spend from our provisions to you before a day comes wherein there will be no trade, no nepotism, and NO INTERCESSION." (2: 254) "The prophets simply follow the commandments of God. He knows their past and future. THEY CANNOT INTERCEDE EXCEPT ON BEHALF OF THOSE ALREADY SAVED BY GOD.
segments.label: page - THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION

segments.text: The prophets themselves worry about their own fate." (21: 28) أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا بَيْعٌ فِيهِ وَلَا خُلَّةٌ وَلَا شَفَاعَةٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ
segments.label: page - THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION

segments.text: THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD / THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION - 28 - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION Despite the Quran's repeated assertions that Muhammad possesses no power to benefit anyone or harm anyone (see Page 25, & Page 30), Satan succeeded in duping many people through the concept of intercession. Satan convinced his victims that Muhammad will actually take them out of hell, and admit them into heaven!
segments.label: page - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD / THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION

segments.text: Many so-called "Muslims" extend the concept of intercession to include numerous saints and/or imams: "They idolize beside God those who possess no power to harm them or benefit them, and say, 'These are our intercessors at God.' Say, 'Are you informing God of something He does not know in the heavens or the earth?' Glory be to Him; He is much too high to have any partners." (10: 18) وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ هَٰؤُلَاءِ شُفَعَاؤُنَا عِندَ اللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَتُنَبِّئُونَ اللَّهَ بِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
segments.label: page - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD / THE MYTH OF INTERCESSION

segments.text: THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD - 29 - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD THE MYTH OF MUHAMMAD THE INTERCESSOR The concept of intercession implies that God has some partners who intercede with Him on behalf of people. Therefore, intercession is idol worship, and those who believe that Muhammad will intercede on behalf of anyone are idolizing the Prophet against his will. Intercession by Muhammad is prevalent in the Satanic innovations known as Hadith and/or Sunna. The Quran clearly identifies intercession as idol worship, and declares a GREAT CRITERION; that those who believe in intercession cannot stand to talk about God alone; THEY HAVE TO MENTION THEIR IDOLS ALONG. "Say, 'To God belongs ALL INTERCESSION.
segments.label: page - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, then to Him you will be returned.' When GOD ALONE is advocated, the hearts of those who do not believe in the hereafter shrink with aversion. But when idols are mentioned along with Him, they become satisfied." ( 39: 45 ) قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ ۝ ( الزمر )
segments.label: page - THE DEIFICATION OF MUHAMMAD

segments.text: - 30 - MUHAMMAD WILL NOT CALL YOU TO ACCOUNT "Your ONLY mission (O Muhammad) is to deliver (Quran), while it is we who will call them to account." [13:40] MUHAMMAD CANNOT BENEFIT YOU OR HARM YOU "Say (O Muhammad), 'I possess no power to harm myself, or benefit myself.'" [10:49] "Say (O Muhammad), 'I possess no power to harm you, or benefit you through guiding you.'" [72:21] Thus, the prophet will not put you in Paradise, nor can he take you out of hell, nor will he call you to account before him, nor can he benefit you, nor can he harm you; HIS SOLE MISSION WAS DELIVERING QURAN, & NOTHING BUT QURAN. To love him and honor him is to follow Quran alone, and reject the fabrications attributed to him. فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَاغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ قُل لَّا أَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِي ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
segments.label: page

segments.text: FUNCTION OF EVERY MESSENGER - 31 - FUNCTION OF EVERY MESSENGER YOU SHALL NOT WORSHIP EXCEPT GOD Neither Jesus, nor Muhammad, want to be idolized. Their sole function was to preach the worship of GOD ALONE. (سورة الأنبياء) "Every messenger we sent before you was instructed to preach that there is no god except Me; you shall worship Me alone. Then they said, 'God most gracious has begotten a son.' Glory be to Him; all the messengers are no more than honored servants. They do not speak on their own; they simply follow His commands. He knows their past and their future, and they possess no power to intercede except on behalf of those already approved by God. The messengers themselves are worried about their own fate.
segments.label: page - FUNCTION OF EVERY MESSENGER

segments.text: And, if any of them claims to be a god beside God, we will punish him in hell; we thus punish the wicked." (21:25-29) (سورة الأنبياء) ۝ وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِ ۝ وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَانَهُ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ ۝ لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ ۝ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي إِلَٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ ۝
segments.label: page - FUNCTION OF EVERY MESSENGER

segments.text: SOLE FUNCTION OF THE PROPHET: DELIVER QURAN - 32 - SOLE FUNCTION OF THE PROPHET: DELIVER QURAN Repeatedly, the Quran employs "the double negative" to emphasize that Muhammad had NO function EXCEPT delivering Quran: "You have NO duty EXCEPT delivering (Quran)" (42: 48) "Your ONLY duty is delivering (Quran), while we will call them to account." (13: 40) "The messenger has NO function EXCEPT delivering (Quran) and God knows whatever you declare, as well as whatever you conceal.
segments.label: page - SOLE FUNCTION OF THE PROPHET: DELIVER QURAN

segments.text: Say, 'The good and the bad are not the same, despite the abundance of the bad.' Therefore, you shall observe God, O you who possess intelligence, that you may succeed." (5: 99-100) Unfortunately, those who refuse to believe that Quran is the ONLY SOURCE OF RELIGIOUS GUIDANCE are much more abundant than those who believe. (see also 16:35, 82; 24:54; 29:18; 36:17; & 64:12) إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَغُ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلَغُ وَعَلَيْنَا الْحِسَابُ مَّا عَلَى الرَّسُولِ إِلَّا الْبَلَغُ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ قُل لَّا يَسْتَوِي الْخَبِيثُ وَالطَّيِّبُ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ الْخَبِيثِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَأُولِي الْأَلْبَبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
segments.label: page - SOLE FUNCTION OF THE PROPHET: DELIVER QURAN

segments.text: - 33 - MUHAMMAD DOES NOT EXPLAIN, INTERPRET, OR ANTICIPATE QURAN; JUST DELIVER & FOLLOW. Hadith & Sunna advocates claim that Hadith & Sunna are needed to explain Quran. However, Quran teaches that God is the teacher of Quran; that God will put Quran into the hearts of believers regardless of their mother tongue; and that Muhammad will not explain Quran. Documents are shown below: God is the teacher of Quran (55: 1-2) "Whether it came down in non-Arabic or Arabic, say, 'For those who believe, it is a guidance and healing. As for the disbelievers, they will be deaf and blind to it.'" (41: 44) (75: 16-19) "Do not move your tongue (O Muhammad) in anticipation of Quran. It is we who put it together as a Quran. Once we recite it, you shall follow it.
segments.label: page

segments.text: Then, it is we who explain it." الرَّحْمَنُ عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَوْ جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا أَعْجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوا لَوْلَا فُصِّلَتْ آيَاتُهُ أَأَعْجَمِيٌّ وَعَرَبِيٌّ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدًى وَشِفَاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَمًى أُولَٰئِكَ يُنَادَوْنَ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
segments.label: page

segments.text: THE FOLLOWERS OF HADITH & SUNNA DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS - 34 - THE FOLLOWERS OF HADITH & SUNNA DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS The most authoritative books of Hadith, namely, Muslim & Ibn Hanbal, report that the Prophet ordered that no one shall take anything from him EXCEPT QURAN. Shown below is the Arabic text of this Hadith: - السابع - النهي عن كتابة غير القرآن. عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا تَكْتُبُوا عَنِّي شَيْئاً سِوَى الْقُرْآنِ. مَنْ كَتَبَ شَيْئاً سِوَى الْقُرْآنِ فَلْيَمْحُهُ» (١). (احمد ج ١ ص ١٧١ ومسلم) "Abi Saeed Al-Khudry - may God be pleased with him - reported that the messenger of God - may God exalt him & grant him peace - had said, 'Do not write anything from me EXCEPT QURAN. Anyone who wrote anything other than Quran shall erase it.'" !!!
segments.label: page - THE FOLLOWERS OF HADITH & SUNNA DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS

segments.text: Thus, according to their own teachings, THEY DISOBEY THE PROPHET السابع - النهي عن كتابة غير القرآن. عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لَا تَكْتُبُوا عَنِّي شَيْئاً سِوَى الْقُرْآنِ. مَنْ كَتَبَ شَيْئاً سِوَى الْقُرْآنِ فَلْيَمْحُهُ» (١). (احمد ج ١ ص ١٧١ ومسلم)
segments.label: page - THE FOLLOWERS OF HADITH & SUNNA DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS

segments.text: INCREDIBLE FACT: THEY DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS - 35 - INCREDIBLE FACT: THEY DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS According to the most "authoritative" sources of Hadith, the Prophet never changed his mind about writing from him ONLY QURAN: Zayd Ibn Thabit (the Prophet's closest revelation writer) visited the Khalifa Mu'aawiyah (more than 30 years after the Prophet's death), and told him a story about the Prophet. Mu'aawiyah liked the story and ordered someone to write it down.
segments.label: page - INCREDIBLE FACT: THEY DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS

segments.text: But Zayd said, "The messenger of God ordered us never to write anything of his Hadith." (reported by Ibn Hanbal) THEY DISOBEY THEIR OWN FABRICATED IDOL !! عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ : [دَخَلَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ، فَحَدَّثَهُ حَدِيثاً ، فَأَمَرَ إِنْسَاناً أَنْ يَكْتُبَ . فَقَالَ زَيْدٌ : إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَهَى أَنْ نَكْتُبَ شَيْئاً مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ ، فَمَحَاهُ] . (أحمد ج ١ ص ١٩٢)
segments.label: page - INCREDIBLE FACT: THEY DO NOT FOLLOW THEIR OWN TEACHINGS

segments.text: QURAN: DO THEY HAVE A "BOOK" WHERE THEY FIND ANYTHING THEY WISH? - 36 - QURAN: DO THEY HAVE A "BOOK" WHERE THEY FIND ANYTHING THEY WISH? When you confront the followers of Hadith & Sunna with the Hadith shown on the previous page, they admit the existence of such Hadith. They explain their failure to follow their own teachings by the fact that there exist equally "authentic" Hadiths where the Prophet ordered the writing of his Hadiths!! The Quran describes such people as "criminals", and asks: "Do they have a 'Book' where they can find anything they wish??" (68: 35-38) "Shall we treat the Muslims like the criminals? What is wrong with your judgment?
segments.label: page - QURAN: DO THEY HAVE A "BOOK" WHERE THEY FIND ANYTHING THEY WISH?

segments.text: DO YOU HAVE A BOOK WHERE YOU CAN FIND ANYTHING YOU WISH?" Both Hadith and Sunna fit this Quranic description; as a "Book where you can find anything you wish." The conjectural and contradictory nature of Hadith and Sunna are unanimously recognized. أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝ مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ ۝ أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ ۝ إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ ۝
segments.label: page - QURAN: DO THEY HAVE A "BOOK" WHERE THEY FIND ANYTHING THEY WISH?

segments.text: THEIR FAVORITE QUESTION - 37 - THEIR FAVORITE QUESTION "If Quran is complete and fully detailed (as God says), where can we find the details of Salat prayers?" This famous question reveals their total ignorance of Quran and a subconcious effort to prove that God is wrong in His repeated assertions that Quran is "complete" and "fully detailed". For the Quran teaches in no uncertain terms that Abraham is the founder of Islam as it is practiced today. As such, what did Abraham contribute to our daily life as Muslims? The Quran teaches that ALL RELIGIOUS PRACTICES IN ISLAM (Salat, Zakat, Fasting & Hajj) CAME TO US FROM ABRAHAM, GENERATION AFTER GENERATION. Thus, Islam in its final form, as is practiced today, is based on two things: (1) QURAN: contributed through Muhammad, and (2) RELIGIOUS PRACTICES: through Abraham. ALL RELIGIOUS PRACTICES IN ISLAM EXISTED BEFORE MUHAMMAD. Muhammad's SOLE FUNCTION was to deliver Quran (see Pages 30-33).
segments.label: page - THEIR FAVORITE QUESTION

segments.text: ABRAHAM: THE FOUNDER OF ISLAM - 38 - ABRAHAM: THE FOUNDER OF ISLAM Abraham was the first recipient of the concept of ISLAM, and the first user of the word "MUSLIM" (see 2: 131). "You shall strive in the cause of God as you should. He has blessed you, and imposed no hardship in your religion; the RELIGION OF YOUR FATHER ABRAHAM. Abraham is the one who named you 'Muslims' in the beginning. Thus, the messenger serves as witness among you, just as you serve as witnesses among the people. Therefore, you shall observe the Salat prayers, give the Zakat charity, and hold fast to God; He is your Lord; the best Lord, and the best supporter." ( 22: 78 ) Thus, if Abraham is the founder of Islam, did he contribute anything to our Islamic life?
segments.label: page - ABRAHAM: THE FOUNDER OF ISLAM

segments.text: The answer is: "YES; he contributed THE RELIGIOUS PRACTICES (Salat, Zakat, Fasting, & Hajj)." وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
segments.label: page - ABRAHAM: THE FOUNDER OF ISLAM

segments.text: ISLAM IS THE RELIGION OF ABRAHAM - 39 - ISLAM IS THE RELIGION OF ABRAHAM While Muhammad's mission, sole mission, was delivering Quran, ALL RELIGIOUS PRACTICES CAME THROUGH ABRAHAM. "They said, 'Be you Jews or Christians in order to be guided.' Say, 'We follow the religion of Abraham, monotheism; he never was an idol-worshiper.'" (2:135) "Abraham was neither Jewish, nor Christian; he was a monotheist; a Muslim; he never was an idol-worshiper. The people most worthy of following Abraham are those who followed him, and this prophet (Muhammad), and those who believed.
segments.label: page - ISLAM IS THE RELIGION OF ABRAHAM

segments.text: God is the Lord of the believers." (3:67-68) وَقَالُوا كُونُوا هُودًا أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ تَهْتَدُوا ۗ قُلْ بَلْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا ۖ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ مَا كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ۝ إِنَّ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَٰذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۗ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
segments.label: page - ISLAM IS THE RELIGION OF ABRAHAM

segments.text: MUHAMMAD WAS A FOLLOWER OF ABRAHAM - 40 - MUHAMMAD WAS A FOLLOWER OF ABRAHAM "Then we inspired you (O Muhammad) to follow the religion of Abraham, monotheism; never was he an idol-worshiper." (16: 123) Logically, if Muhammad was a follower of Abraham, and we are followers of Muhammad, then we are followers of Abraham. What did we learn from Abraham ??? The Quran teaches that we learned all the religious practices of Islam from Abraham. This includes Salat, Zakat, fasting and Hajj. Therefore, ISLAM IS BASED ON TWO THINGS: 1 QURAN: THROUGH MUHAMMAD 2 RELIGIOUS PRACTICES: VIA ABRAHAM ثُمَّ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ أَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
segments.label: page - MUHAMMAD WAS A FOLLOWER OF ABRAHAM
